title: PCLA-Bridge: A Framework for Cross-Domain Deployment of CARLA Agents
summary: Most high-performing end-to-end autonomous driving agents (ADAs) are developed for the CARLA Leaderboard, tightly coupling them to CARLA's APIs, sensor layouts, coordinate systems, and internal clock. Reusing these models on real datasets, alternative simulators, or physical platforms necessitates substantial manual re-engineering. We present PCLA-Bridge, a deployable tool that runs unmodified CARLA Leaderboard agents from any sensor source to any control destination without an active CARLA server. With PCLA-Bridge handling dependency isolation, tensor marshalling, routing, and synthetic timing, integrators only need to provide a minimal interface. We validate the tool across two operational paradigms: offline replay on in-domain CARLA recordings and real-world nuScenes logs, and live closed-loop control across three diverse simulation engines: MetaDrive, AWSIM, and AlpaSim. We analyze the lightweight integration requirements for each platform, highlighting output translation (such as converting agent actions into target trajectory formats) and coordinate-frame transformations, showing that integration requires minimal glue code rather than structural changes. All eight evaluated agents execute across all three simulators without modification, confirming the reliability of PCLA-Bridge and establishing a foundation for systematic sim-to-real, cross-sim, and security testing.

AI.tldr: PCLA-Bridge 是一个可部署工具，能在无 CARLA 服务器的情况下，将未经修改的 CARLA Leaderboard 智能体从任意传感器源接入到任意控制目标，实现跨仿真器与真实数据的复用。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能端到端自动驾驶智能体与 CARLA 的 API、传感器布局、坐标系和内部时钟紧耦合，迁移到真实数据集、其他仿真器或物理平台需大量手工重构，缺乏通用的部署与跨域迁移基础设施。
AI.method: 提出 PCLA-Bridge：由该工具统一处理依赖隔离、张量编排（tensor marshalling）、消息路由与合成时序，集成方仅需提供最小接口；支持输出翻译（如将智能体动作转换为目标轨迹格式）与坐标系变换，无需改动智能体结构。
AI.result: 在两种范式下验证：域内 CARLA 录像与真实 nuScenes 日志的离线回放，以及 MetaDrive、AWSIM、AlpaSim 三个仿真引擎的在线闭环控制。全部 8 个被评测智能体未加修改即在三个仿真器中运行成功，集成仅需少量胶水代码。
AI.conclusion: PCLA-Bridge 为 sim-to-real、跨仿真器评估与安全性测试提供了低成本的系统化基础设施，证明了 CARLA 智能体的可移植性。

title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
comment: Project page: this https URL ; Model: this https URL
summary: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控实验研究虚拟世界中继续预训练（CPT）的数据量、数据多样性与模型规模的扩展规律，覆盖0.8B–27B四种模型、50–1600小时六档数据预算与五种数据混合，并拟合出验证损失的经验缩放律。
AI.motivation: 物理世界中的具身学习已受益于数据、多样性与模型容量的扩展，但这些收益能否迁移到视觉风格、动态、控制与目标各异的虚拟世界尚不清楚，需要系统性受控研究。
AI.method: 在120组训练配置上做CPT跨三轴控制实验：4种模型规模（0.8B–27B）×6档数据预算（50–1600小时）×5种数据混合（从仅Minecraft到多世界混合）；用三级验证损失及从语料内世界到未见世界的游戏基准评估性能与泛化，并拟合经验缩放律。
AI.result: 数据量提升语料内性能；多样性改善向相关世界的迁移但对远距世界增益有限；模型规模提升数据效率，但在单世界训练下对远距世界泛化更差。观察到"接口阶段"（跨世界普适收益）与"世界阶段"（收益收窄至语料内及相关世界）。模型在3D世界中与Minecraft专家模型和前沿模型相当，实时设置下表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 模仿学习的固有局限与远距世界上的持续差距表明，构建通用具身智能体需要比继续预训练更丰富的训练阶段，而非单纯数据/规模扩展。

title: Reinforcement learning for hardware acceleration and system-level optimization on FPGA and integrated-circuit platforms: A survey
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables adaptive and autonomous decision-making in embedded, edge, and heterogeneous computing systems. Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and integrated circuits (ICs) offer low latency, energy efficiency, and architectural flexibility for RL deployment, while introducing challenges in resource constraints, implementation complexity, and hardware-algorithm co-design. This review surveys more than 100 studies on RL implementations across FPGA and IC platforms, emphasizing architectures, implementation strategies, performance evaluation, and applications. The literature is organized by RL family, including model-based Markov decision processes, classical value-based methods, deep RL, actor-critic, policy-gradient, and multi-agent approaches. We further classify studies by abstraction level, hardware realization strategy, and application domain, examining how RL algorithms map onto reconfigurable and fixed hardware. Unlike surveys restricted to particular algorithms or platforms, this work provides a unified analysis of FPGA and IC implementations, covering acceleration, reconfigurable architectures, energy-aware control, and system-level optimization. Comparative assessments consider resource utilization, latency, throughput, power consumption, and reported performance gains. Finally, we identify recurring architectural patterns, practical limitations, open challenges, and research directions for efficient RL-driven hardware systems. The survey offers a consolidated reference for researchers developing and evaluating RL solutions on specialized hardware.

AI.tldr: 综述100余篇关于FPGA与IC上强化学习实现的研究，按RL算法族、抽象层级、硬件实现策略与应用域分类，比较资源占用、延迟、吞吐与功耗，并总结架构模式、局限与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: RL在嵌入式、边缘与异构计算系统中需要自适应自主决策，FPGA/IC虽具备低延迟、能效与架构灵活性，但面临资源受限、实现复杂与软硬件协同设计难题，且现有综述多局限于单一算法或平台。
AI.method: 文献综述：按RL族（基于模型的MDP、值方法、深度RL、actor-critic、策略梯度、多智能体）组织文献，再按抽象层级、硬件实现策略（加速器、可重构架构）与应用域分类，并考察算法到可重构/固定硬件的映射方式。
AI.result: 给出资源利用率、延迟、吞吐、功耗及报告性能增益的横向比较，归纳出重复出现的架构模式与实用限制。
AI.conclusion: 为在专用硬件上开发与评估RL方案的研究者提供统一参考，并指出高效RL驱动硬件系统的未来研究方向。

title: Real-Time Ground Normal Vector Estimation for Spherical Mobile 3D Mapping using LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
comment: Proceedings of the International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and Automation in Space (i-SAIRAS 26)
summary: Accurate ground plane normal estimation is essential for odometry in spherical mobile mapping systems (SMMS), which face challenges from rapid rotations and limited ground coverage. We propose two RANSAC-based approaches: single-scan estimation with normal vector scoring and multi-step validation, and LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO)-based estimation using a global 3D map. Evaluated across diverse real-world datasets against terrestrial laser scanner ground truth, results show that LIO-based estimation significantly outperforms single-scan methods in accuracy and robustness. Integrating ground normal estimates into the motion model improves pose estimation, supporting autonomous navigation in challenging and hazardous environments.

AI.tldr: 提出两种基于RANSAC的地面法向量估计方法（单扫描法向量打分+多步验证；基于LIO全局3D地图的估计），并在真实数据集上以TLS真值对比，表明LIO方案精度与鲁棒性显著更优，将地面法向量接入运动模型可改善位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 球形移动测绘系统（SMMS）里程计依赖精确的地面法向量估计，但快速旋转与地面覆盖有限导致该估计困难，需要更鲁棒的方案。
AI.method: 两条RANSAC路线：(1) 单扫描估计，采用法向量打分与多步验证；(2) 基于LiDAR-惯性里程计构建的全局3D地图进行法向量估计；随后将地面法向量估计嵌入运动模型。
AI.result: 在多样真实数据集上以地面激光扫描仪（TLS）为真值评测，基于LIO的估计在精度与鲁棒性上显著优于单扫描方法；融合地面法向量的运动模型提升了位姿估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 利用全局地图（而非单帧点云）估计地面法向量更可靠，可作为SMMS里程计的有效先验，支撑复杂与危险环境中的自主导航。

title: Warping the Workspace: Expanding Visual Access with Adjustable Reach Mapping for Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: First-person humanoid teleoperation ties access to side and rear targets to operator rotation. We present coupled visual--motor remapping, pairing a panoramic azimuth warp with its inverse upper-limb yaw transform. A working prototype implements Global Zoom (GZ) and Focus+Context (F+C). In a within-subject study (N=8); 72 trials), GZ had the largest completion count (23/24; Fixed: 20/24; F+C: 21/24), whereas F+C was preferred by 6/8 participants. Therefore, completion and preference favored different mappings in this sample.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉-运动耦合重映射（全景方位角扭曲 + 上肢偏航逆变换）的第一人称人形机器人遥操作方法，原型实现Global Zoom与Focus+Context两种映射，被试实验(N=8, 72试次)显示完成率与偏好指向不同方案。
AI.motivation: 第一人称人形遥操作中，操作者需转头才能看到侧向与后方目标，身体旋转负担重、易丢失前向态势感知；本文试图通过视觉与运动耦合重映射在不动头/不动身的前提下扩展可达观察范围。
AI.method: 将全景方位角扭曲（azimuth warp）与其逆变换的上肢偏航（yaw）旋转配对，构成"看哪打哪"的耦合映射；实现两个原型：Global Zoom（GZ，整体视场角缩放）与Focus+Context（F+C，中心聚焦+周边上下文）；采用被试内设计（N=8，72试次）比较完成率与主观偏好，并与Fixed基线对照。
AI.result: GZ完成数最高（23/24），F+C为21/24，Fixed基线20/24；但F+C被6/8名被试偏好。样本中完成率与偏好指向不同映射方案，差异为小样本趋势，未报告显著性与统计检验细节。
AI.conclusion: 结果提示遥操作重映射设计存在"效率-可用性"权衡，不存在单一最优映射；后续需扩大样本、增加量化指标（任务时间、运动学指标）与真实操纵任务验证。

title: Human-Robot Interaction via Meta-Learning Based Mode Recognition and Adaptive Control
summary: In human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, humans may interact with the robot in either an active guiding or passive following state, resulting in distinct control objectives for each interaction mode. Most existing approaches rely on predefined switching thresholds to distinguish interaction modes, but their performance can be sensitive to measurement noise. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework with the following key contributions. First, a neural network (NN) trained via meta-learning is developed to recognize human intention without manually defined thresholds. By successfully incorporating force-dependent parameters from the controller, the recognition rates are improved from 90.1\% to 99.1\% for the passive mode and from 79.8\% to 97.1\% for the active mode. Second, an adaptive meta-learning controller is introduced to compensate for human disturbances and enable online adaptation to varying interaction forces. Third, a multiple-trajectory meta-learning algorithm is designed to jointly learn an environment-basis representation and force-dependent parameters, allowing the controller to deal with unmodeled dynamics efficiently. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves robust and accurate control performance, while providing reliable mode recognition for safe and adaptive physical HRI.

AI.tldr: 提出基于元学习的物理人机交互框架：无阈值神经网络意图识别、自适应元学习控制器、多轨迹元学习联合学习环境基表示与力相关参数。
AI.motivation: 现有HRI中区分人类"主动引导"与"被动跟随"模式依赖预设切换阈值，对测量噪声敏感，导致模式识别与控制目标切换不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 用元学习训练神经网络识别人类意图，避免人工阈值，并将控制器的力相关参数作为输入特征；2) 自适应元学习控制器补偿人类扰动并在线适应变化的交互力；3) 多轨迹元学习算法联合学习环境基表示与力相关参数，以高效处理未建模动力学。
AI.result: 引入力相关参数后，被动模式识别率由90.1%提升至99.1%，主动模式由79.8%提升至97.1%；实验表明框架具有鲁棒、精确的控制性能与可靠模式识别。
AI.conclusion: 免阈值元学习框架可提升HRI模式识别鲁棒性与自适应控制性能，支持安全、自适应的物理人机交互。

title: Different Defects, Different Effects: A Controlled Audit of Face Recognition Training Data
summary: The development of face recognition has been strongly supported by the availability of large-scale training datasets. Among them, MS-Celeb-1M has played an important role by providing millions of facial images from nearly 100K identities. However, the size and heterogeneity of such datasets increase the likelihood of annotation errors, redundant samples, and other forms of data inconsistency. This motivated the introduction of refined versions, such as MS1MV2 and MS1MV3, aimed at improving the quality of the training data. Despite these cleaning efforts, we show that several types of training-data defects remain in MS1MV3. By proposing complementary data-auditing strategies, we identify five defect categories: exact and near-duplicate images, split identities, crop errors, multiple-face ambiguity, and invalid content. We then assess the effect of correcting these defects under a controlled face-recognition training protocol based on IResNet-50 and ArcFace. The results show that targeted interventions can preserve, and in some cases improve, recognition performance while requiring fewer optimization steps to reach the performance of the original training set. Duplicate removal provides the clearest overall benefit, while split-identity merging and invalid-content removal also improve training efficiency. Overall, the results indicate that the effect of dataset cleaning depends strongly on the type of defect being addressed and provide further evidence that training-data quality remains an important and comparatively underexplored factor in large-scale face recognition. The training manifests and code used in this work will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计 MS1MV3 人脸识别训练数据，识别出五类缺陷（精确/近似重复、身份分裂、裁剪错误、多人脸歧义、无效内容），并在 IResNet-50 + ArcFace 受控协议下评估逐类修复的效果。
AI.motivation: 大规模人脸识别数据集（如 MS-Celeb-1M 及其精炼版 MS1MV2/MS1MV3）体量大、异质性强，仍存在标注错误、冗余样本等不一致；现有清洗工作未系统量化残留缺陷类型及其对训练的具体影响。
AI.method: 提出互补的数据审计策略，对 MS1MV3 进行缺陷检测并归为五类；随后在固定 IResNet-50 + ArcFace 的受控训练协议下，对每类缺陷分别做定向修正（去重、身份合并、无效内容剔除等），比较识别性能与收敛所需优化步数。
AI.result: 定向修复可在更少优化步数下保持甚至提升识别性能；去重收益最显著，身份分裂合并与无效内容剔除也提升训练效率；不同缺陷类型的清洗收益差异明显。
AI.conclusion: 数据清洗效果高度依赖缺陷类型，训练数据质量在大规模人脸识别中仍是重要但被低估的因素；审计清单与代码将于录用后公开。

title: Learning-Enhanced Observer for Sensorless Task-Null-Space Compliant Control
summary: This paper presents a novel framework integrating a robust wrench observer with a hybrid pose and force controller for physical Human-Robot Interaction (pHRI). In pHRI tasks, robots are expected to perform task-space motions robustly while remaining compliance with human disturbance, which proposes distinct control objectives. Most existing approaches focus mainly on either robustness or compliance and rely on force sensors for real-time tracking. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework with the following key contributions. Firstly, a neural network (NN) is trained to improve the observer performance by compensating for system friction and unmodeled dynamics. Secondly, a task-null-space decomposition is applied to separate the joint velocity and reduce the effect of the human disturbance on the observer. Finally, a hybrid pose and force controller is introduced to achieve the end-effector pose and force tracking. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework provides robust and accurate wrench estimation while maintaining reliable pose and force tracking performance. The proposed approach offers an effective solution and framework for pHRI without the need of force/torque sensor measurements which can be applied to many robotic manipulator platforms which do not have force/torque sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将神经网络增强的鲁棒外力(旋转力)观测器与任务-零空间分解、混合位姿-力控制器结合的无传感器框架，用于物理人机交互中的位姿与力跟踪。
AI.motivation: pHRI任务需同时满足任务空间运动鲁棒性与对人扰动的柔顺性，二者目标冲突；现有方法多只侧重其一，且依赖力/力矩传感器进行实时跟踪，限制了在无力传感器机械臂平台上的部署。
AI.method: 三点贡献：(1) 训练神经网络补偿系统摩擦与未建模动力学以提升外力观测器精度；(2) 采用任务-零空间分解拆分关节速度，抑制人扰动对观测器的影响；(3) 设计混合位姿-力控制器实现末端位姿与力跟踪。整体无需F/T传感器。
AI.result: 实验显示该框架能提供鲁棒且准确的外力估计，同时保持可靠的位姿与力跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 为无F/T传感器机械臂的pHRI提供了有效解决方案，可推广至多种平台。但摘要未给出定量指标、对比基线细节与实际硬件验证规模。

title: Motion Equivariant Convolutional LSTM: When Motion Becomes a Gauge Symmetry
summary: Objects move, cameras pan, and weather drifts with the wind: much of what changes in sequential data is motion. Motion changes where things are, not what they are, and is therefore a symmetry of the data. Yet standard recurrent networks are not equivariant to it: their memory stays put while the input moves on. Flow equivariant recurrent networks first brought this symmetry into sequence models, for motions of constant velocity, or flows, by enumerating a bank of velocities. We extend this idea in three directions: from simple recurrent networks to convolutional LSTMs, from flows to motions whose velocity changes in time, and from enumerating velocities to estimating them. Treating a sequence as a field over time, we show that motion becomes a gauge symmetry: a global symmetry made local in time. Built on this view, our motion equivariant convolutional LSTM (MELSTM) uses its velocity model as the gauge field and is provably equivariant to every motion. Across future-frame prediction, classification of digits visible only through their motion, and action recognition under camera shake, MELSTM outperforms a convolutional LSTM and its flow equivariant counterpart with the same number of parameters: it is more accurate, generalizes to longer horizons and to unseen motions, and carries a fraction of the flow equivariant model's state.

AI.tldr: 提出运动等变卷积LSTM（MELSTM）：将序列视为时间上的场，把运动视为规范对称性，用速度模型作为规范场，实现对任意运动的可证明等变，在预测、运动数字分类与相机抖动下动作识别上均优于ConvLSTM与flow-equivariant对手。
AI.motivation: 标准循环网络对运动不具备等变性：记忆停留在原处而输入已移动。已有的flow equivariant RNN仅处理恒定速度流，且通过枚举速度库实现，局限在简单RNN。
AI.method: 把运动视为序列在时间上的规范对称性（全局对称性在时间上局域化）；将结构从简单RNN推广到卷积LSTM，并用速度估计模型替代速度枚举作为规范场，构造MELSTM。
AI.result: 在future-frame prediction、仅通过运动可见的数字分类、相机抖动下动作识别三项任务上，MELSTM以相同参数量优于ConvLSTM及其flow equivariant版本：精度更高、外推到更长时域与未见运动、状态占用远小于flow equivariant模型。
AI.conclusion: 运动等变可通过规范场视角统一建模，速度估计替代离散速度枚举带来更强的泛化与更紧凑的状态；为序列模型引入运动对称性提供了可扩展路径。

title: Complexity-Aware Surgical Video Reasoning Segmentation with Digital Twin and Context Memory
summary: Conventional surgical segmentation relies on closed-set categories or explicit text queries, which cannot resolve implicit queries that require reasoning about workflows, instrument functions, and temporal relationships. To address these limitations, we propose SurgReasonSeg, a complexity-aware method that brings reasoning segmentation over digital twin (DT) representations to surgical video. Specifically, SurgReasonSeg constructs DT representations from surgical foundation models and trains two low-rank adapters (LoRA) of one large language model with reinforcement learning (RL), each specialized for a different query complexity. A lightweight router, also trained with RL, selects between the two adapters to balance latency against accuracy. SurgReasonSeg also sets the temporal context with an adaptive sliding window conditioned on query complexity and workflow phase, and retrieves relevant historical cases from a surgical context memory by workflow similarity and procedural relevance. We further introduce EndoVis-ReasonSeg, a surgical reasoning segmentation benchmark with 1,460 training and 961 test samples across semantic, spatial, and temporal categories. On EndoVis-ReasonSeg, SurgReasonSeg improves J&F over the strongest baseline, ReSurgSAM2, by 0.178, 0.237, and 0.297 on semantic, spatial, and temporal queries, and it also achieves the best results on the Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 referring segmentation benchmarks. A backbone-matched attribution protocol separates the contribution of the upstream segmenter from that of the reasoning modules. Our method runs at 18.8 FPS averaged over the query distribution, enabling real-time reasoning segmentation in surgical videos.

AI.tldr: SurgReasonSeg 将推理分割引入手术视频：用手术基础模型构建数字孪生表示，针对不同查询复杂度用强化学习训练同一 LLM 的两个 LoRA 适配器，并由轻量路由器动态选择，同时用复杂度/流程阶段自适应的滑动窗口和手术上下文记忆检索历史病例。作者提出 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 基准，J&F 较最强基线提升 0.178/0.237/0.297（语义/空间/时序），平均 18.8 FPS。
AI.motivation: 传统手术分割依赖闭集类别或显式文本查询，无法处理需要推理手术流程、器械功能与时序关系的隐式查询。作者希望把"推理分割"能力迁移到手术视频，并在精度与延迟之间取得可控平衡。
AI.method: 1) 基于手术基础模型抽取数字孪生（DT）表示；2) 用 RL 训练同一 LLM 的两个 LoRA 适配器，分别服务低/高复杂度查询；3) RL 训练的轻量 router 按查询选择适配器以权衡延迟与精度；4) 依查询复杂度与手术流程阶段自适应设定滑动窗口的时序上下文；5) 从手术上下文记忆中按流程相似度与操作相关性检索历史病例；6) 构建 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 基准（1,460 训练 / 961 测试，含语义、空间、时序三类），并提出与骨干匹配的归因协议以分离上游分割器与推理模块的贡献。
AI.result: 在 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 上，相对最强基线 ReSurgSAM2，语义/空间/时序 J&F 分别提升 0.178、0.237、0.297；在 Ref-EndoVis17/18 指代分割基准取得最佳结果；按查询分布平均 18.8 FPS，可实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把复杂度感知、RL 调度的多适配器 LLM 与流程感知的时序/记忆机制结合，实现手术视频的实时推理分割，并提供新基准与归因分析；但评测限于内窥镜公开数据集，缺少机器人部署与开源信息。

title: VeriCalib: Verifiable Target-Based LiDAR-Camera Calibration
summary: Target-based extrinsic calibration estimates the rigid transform between sensors from a few observations of a known target, and its result is commonly assessed by the root-mean-square error of the fitted residuals. However, this scalar error is computed on the same observations and therefore cannot indicate whether to accept the result, re-extract, recollect or add observations. This paper presents VeriCalib, which formulates extrinsic calibration as a verifiable estimation problem and reports a calibration state. The key insight is a two-level extrinsic compensation mechanism, in which the extrinsic compensates the rigid part of each observation error at the residual level, and rotation and translation compensate each other at the parameter level. Consequently, the fitted residual can reveal neither an inconsistency between the observations and the model nor whether the estimated extrinsic is reliable in every direction. Accordingly, we assess the calibration through a structured covariance that jointly propagates the uncertainty of the camera and LiDAR board features with a known-geometry prior, and estimate its scale as a variance component from the residuals. On this covariance, we decouple rotation and translation to resolve the precision along each direction and guide data collection toward the weakest one. Since this precision presumes consistent observations, we further develop within-view and cross-view checks that examine the internal residual and the rigid discrepancy between observations, respectively, with thresholds that hold their significance level under an unknown noise level. We also extend the minimal detectable bias to the extrinsic to bound the smallest detectable fault along each direction. These criteria form a calibration state that indicates whether to accept the result or how to collect the data...

AI.tldr: VeriCalib 将外参标定重构为可验证估计问题：利用"双层外参补偿"分析指出拟合残差无法揭示观测-模型不一致，改用带几何先验的结构化协方差估计各方向精度，并提出视角内/跨视角一致性检验与最小可检测偏差，最终输出可指导采集的标定状态。
AI.motivation: 现有基于目标的标定以拟合残差的 RMSE 作为质量指标，但该误差在同一批观测上计算，无法判断结果是否可接受、是否需重新提取/重采/补采观测，缺乏可验证性。
AI.method: (1) 双层外参补偿机制：残差层面外参补偿每次观测误差的刚体部分，参数层面旋转与平移互相补偿，说明拟合残差不可靠；(2) 结构化协方差，联合传播相机与 LiDAR 标定板特征不确定性并引入已知几何先验，尺度作为方差分量从残差估计；(3) 解耦旋转与平移以得到各方向精度并引导数据采集至最弱方向；(4) 视角内残差检验与跨视角刚体一致性检验，阈值在未知噪声水平下保持显著性水平；(5) 将最小可检测偏差扩展到外参，界定各方向最小可检测故障；(6) 综合形成标定状态。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值实验；预期在相机-LiDAR 标定上给出协方差精度、一致性检验的显著性控制与最小可检测偏差，并展示按精度引导采集能提升弱方向精度。
AI.conclusion: 标定质量评估应从单一 RMSE 转向包含精度、一致性与故障可检测性的显式"标定状态"，以支持接受/拒收与采集决策；该框架可推广为感知系统的可验证估计范式。

title: JUICE: Unified Multimodal Modeling in Pretrained Representation Spaces
comment: 69 pages, 31 figures, 37 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL Weights: this https URL
summary: Most unified multimodal models treat images and text asymmetrically: a pretrained language model generates text, an attached diffusion head generates images, and outputs that contain both are produced in a fixed order, so the first output cannot adapt to the second. We ask whether both modalities can instead be generated by one process that is trained on them jointly from scratch. Pretrained encoder spaces hold both modalities in one continuous form and carry knowledge learned at scale, and recent work finds them effective as generative targets for vision and language. We therefore model the joint distribution directly in these spaces. We introduce JUICE (Joint Unified multimodal modeling In Continuous Encoder spaces), a single flow matching Transformer over frozen image and text representations, in which each modality has its own noise level. Which modalities are clean and which are generated then decides the task: image generation, captioning, visual question answering, or joint generation. Controlled pretraining runs test each design choice. At equal guidance, generating text as continuous states leaves image generation intact (48.41 GenEval, against 47.86 for a model trained only for text-to-image generation), while captions lose some exact wording. Training on joint and conditional denoising together beats either alone, and semantic encoder spaces beat VAE latents and raw pixels as targets. At 2.1B parameters, with no language model initialization and at 224x224, JUICE reaches up to 0.88 on GenEval and 73.1 on VQAv2. By sampling both modalities from the joint distribution (coupled sampling), it can also draw a route on a map while writing out the matching moves. On mazes with several valid solutions, joint success rises from 54.6% with independent sampling to 93.7%, and no modality has to go first. On visual spatial planning, JUICE solves 99.8% of maps at its training sizes.

AI.tldr: JUICE 用单个 flow matching Transformer 在冻结的图像/文本编码器连续空间中联合建模双模态分布，按各模态噪声级决定任务，支持图像生成、描述、VQA 与联合生成（耦合采样）。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型将图像与文本非对称处理（LLM 生成文本 + 扩散头生成图像），混合输出按固定顺序产生，先输出者无法根据后输出者自适应；作者想验证两模态能否在同一进程中从零联合训练生成。
AI.method: 在预训练且冻结的语义编码器空间（而非 VAE latent 或像素）中直接建模联合分布；单一 flow matching Transformer，每模态独立噪声水平，清洁/生成模态组合即定义任务；联合去噪与条件去噪混合训练；2.1B 参数、224×224、无 LLM 初始化；耦合采样由联合分布同时采样两模态。
AI.result: 等引导下文本连续生成不损图像生成（GenEval 48.41 vs 纯 T2I 47.86），但描述精确措辞略降；联合+条件去噪优于单一训练；语义编码空间优于 VAE latent 与像素；2.1B 下 GenEval 0.88、VQAv2 73.1；地图绘制+路线指令任务中迷宫联合成功率由独立采样 54.6% 升至 93.7%，空间规划求解率 99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 连续编码器空间是可行的统一生成基底，单 Transformer 联合分布训练可实现无固定顺序的双模态生成，并在耦合采样任务上显著优于独立采样。

title: SAIL: A Learnable Generalisation of Spatial Autocorrelation over Graph-Structured Data
comment: 44 pages, 22 figures (7 in main paper, 15 in supplementary material). Main paper followed by supplementary material in a single file
summary: In vision and scientific domains involving spatial data, a key question is whether node feature values vary independently across space or form coherent spatial structures. Classical spatial autocorrelation statistics such as Moran's $I$ and Geary's $C$ quantify this phenomenon but operate on a single scalar variable with fixed neighbourhood weights, limiting their use for high-dimensional graph-like data. We introduce SAIL (Spatial Autocorrelation Index Learner), a differentiable framework that generalises spatial autocorrelation into a learnable operator by jointly learning feature projections defining candidate scalar fields and inter-node neighbourhood affinities. SAIL produces interpretable local and global spatial coherence descriptors, enabling supervised prediction and unsupervised discovery of spatial autocorrelation modes and hotspots. We show that SAIL exactly recovers classical spatial statistics under appropriate parametrisations and, for tasks driven by latent spatial autocorrelation, can approximate the Bayes-optimal predictor with an inductive bias matched to such tasks. Experiments on synthetic data and large-scale biomedical graphs demonstrate statistical correctness and discovery of spatial coherence with applications across vision, geospatial analysis, and biomedicine. The code repository is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出SAIL：将空间自相关(Moran's I / Geary's C)推广为可微学习算子，联合学习定义候选标量场的特征投影与节点间邻域亲和度，输出可解释的局部/全局空间一致性描述子，支持有监督预测与无监督的空间自相关模态/热点发现。
AI.motivation: 经典空间自相关统计量只处理单一标量变量和固定邻域权重，难以用于高维图状数据；而空间数据中"节点特征是否在空间上形成相干结构"是关键问题，需要可学习、可微、可解释的推广形式。
AI.method: 构建可微框架，同时学习(a)特征投影子空间（产生候选标量场）与(b)节点间邻域亲和矩阵，从而把Moran's I型的全局量与局部一致性度量参数化为可训练的算子；在特定参数化下可精确退化为经典统计量，并针对潜在空间自相关驱动的任务提供匹配的归纳偏置以逼近Bayes最优预测器。
AI.result: 在合成数据与大规模生物医学图上验证了统计正确性（能精确恢复经典统计量）与空间相干结构的可发现性，并展示其在视觉、地理空间分析和生物医学场景中的应用。
AI.conclusion: SAIL为高维图状空间数据提供了一种统一、可微、可解释的空间自相关学习框架，兼具统计严谨性与任务实用性；但其验证集中在合成与生物医学图数据，未涉及机器人、3D重建或物理仿真等具身/空间智能核心任务。

title: T-WLA: Bridging Slow Vision and Fast Touch
summary: In contact-rich manipulation, contact conditions can change before a visual policy updates its action plan. Recomputing the plan through the visual policy adds latency, while tactile feedback alone does not specify how the ongoing motion should be revised for the task. We introduce T-WLA, a world-language-action architecture that uses shared visual memory to guide both action generation and tactile correction. At each visual update, the visual branch integrates the current image, task instruction, and retrieved history into a visual memory that conditions base-action generation. The same memory is cached for a lightweight tactile editor, which combines it with the active action chunk and incoming touch to predict residual corrections to unexecuted actions without rerunning the visual branch. Future-image and future-pressure prediction provide training-only supervision, encouraging the visual memory and tactile features to capture interaction dynamics relevant to action generation and correction. We evaluate T-WLA on tactile-conditioned hand-motion prediction using EgoTouch and Tachin, and on four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks. T-WLA reduces finger-joint MPJPE by 30% relative to the strongest reported baseline and achieves an average success rate of approximately 50.0% across real-robot manipulation tasks. Videos and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: T-WLA 是一种世界-语言-动作架构，用共享视觉记忆同时驱动基础动作生成与触觉残差修正，视觉分支每步只跑一次，轻量触觉编辑器复用缓存记忆在动作块内实时纠偏，仅训练期用未来图像与未来压力预测做监督，在 EgoTouch/Tachin 上降 MPJPE 30%，真机四任务平均成功率约 50%。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作中，接触条件可能在视觉策略更新动作计划之前就已改变；重跑视觉策略带来延迟，而仅靠触觉反馈又无法说明如何修改正在进行中的动作。需要一种低延迟机制，在不重跑视觉分支的前提下把触觉信息转化为对未执行动作的具体修正。
AI.method: 以视觉更新周期为节拍：视觉分支将当前图像、任务指令与检索到的历史整合为视觉记忆，用以条件化基础动作块生成；同一记忆被缓存并送入轻量触觉编辑器，结合当前动作块与实时触觉输入预测对未执行动作的残差修正。训练时引入未来图像预测与未来压力预测作为辅助监督（仅训练用），促使视觉记忆与触觉特征编码与动作生成/修正相关的交互动力学。
AI.result: 在 EgoTouch 与 Tachin 的触觉条件手部运动预测基准上，相比最强已报告基线将手指关节 MPJPE 降低约 30%；在四个真实机器人灵巧操作任务上平均成功率约 50.0%，并提供视频与代码。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉策略与触觉修正解耦为"共享记忆 + 轻量编辑器"的两级结构，可在视觉更新间期内实现低延迟触觉纠偏；世界模型式预测作为训练监督是有效但无需推理期开销的设计。局限在于真机成功率仅约 50%，泛化性与高频触觉闭环的收益幅度仍需更多证据。

title: Register Anything Model for Generalizable and Robust Point Cloud Registration
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code and models are available at this https URL
summary: We present Register Anything Model (RAM), a unified model for generalizable 3D point cloud registration that robustly estimates 6-DoF transformations across diverse domains spanning sensors and environments. Existing registration methods are typically tailored to a single domain, with carefully tuned architectures and hyperparameters, and thus degrade markedly when applied to novel domains. We bridge this gap by training a single model on diverse data from indoor, outdoor, and object domains. A central challenge is the severe geometric discrepancy across domains, i.e., differences in scene scale, sensor noise, point density, and structural patterns, which hinders processing with a unified point-based model. To address this, we introduce a geometry-aware normalization strategy that jointly voxelizes and normalizes point clouds into a standardized geometric space, adaptively based on their geometric properties to preserve salient local structures while standardizing resolution. Built on this normalization, RAM follows a hierarchical coarse-to-fine paradigm, and employs an efficient geometric transformer that models local geometric consistency instead of globally over all points. This design mitigates discretization noise introduced by voxelization, and improves computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in terms of inlier ratio and registration recall. Notably, our method outperforms the counterparts trained on each separate domain, showing superior generalization capability.

AI.tldr: RAM：在室内/室外/物体多域数据上训练的通用3D点云配准统一模型，通过几何感知归一化（联合体素化+标准化）解决跨域几何差异，配合粗到细层级与局部几何一致性Transformer，在12个基准上达到SOTA并展现跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有点云配准方法通常针对单一域设计（架构与超参精调），迁移到新域时性能显著下降；跨域存在场景尺度、传感器噪声、点密度与结构模式的严重几何差异，阻碍单一基于点的模型统一处理。
AI.method: 提出几何感知归一化策略：依据点云几何属性自适应地联合体素化与归一化，将点云映射到标准几何空间，在标准化分辨率的同时保留显著局部结构；在此之上构建层级式粗到细配准范式，并采用高效几何Transformer，仅建模局部几何一致性而非全局所有点，从而缓解体素化带来的离散化噪声并提升计算效率；单模型在室内、室外、物体多域数据上混合训练。
AI.result: 在12个基准上于inlier ratio与registration recall指标取得SOTA；超越在各单一域分别训练的对应方法，表现出更优的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 统一的几何归一化+局部几何一致性建模是实现跨域通用点云配准的有效途径，单一多域训练模型可替代域特定定制方案。

title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
summary: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. A hierarchical planner over a typed decision model emits structured decision state: Macro fixes settlement, ecology, transport, and hydrological structure across a group of tiles; Micro specializes that contract into tile semantics under measured terrain and accepted neighbor commitments. Deterministic local code compiles accepted plans into terrain, roads, settlements, vegetation, and entities. Streaming separates their reach: plans run ahead along the predicted corridor, compilation only where movement will soon need it, geometry behind the user released. One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it. The same record grounds interaction: the model acts on existing entities, including stateful NPCs that update as they act, edits the present region, or attaches intent to unplanned regions. Together they yield a world expanding under bounded budgets, connected across independently planned tiles, and interactive.

AI.tldr: WorldStream：一种开放式 3D 世界模型，同时具备无限地形扩展、自然语言驱动交互、以及可带编辑内容回访的三大能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 世界生成模型通常受限于预设地图范围，难以在运行中响应开放语言指令，且无法在用户回访时保留历史编辑；作者希望统一解决"边界扩展性、跨瓦片一致性、交互性"三者的冲突。
AI.method: 提出基于带类型决策模型的层级规划器：Macro 在瓦片组层面确定聚落、生态、交通与水文结构，Micro 在实测地形与已接受邻接承诺约束下细化为单瓦片语义；确定性局部代码将已接受方案编译为地形、道路、聚落、植被与实体。采用流式调度——规划沿预测走廊提前运行，编译仅在紧接着需要处执行，用户身后的几何释放。单一世界记录保存方案、种子、对象身份、可变状态、边界承诺与按属性编辑，随用户推进而修订，回访瓦片据此重编译，并支撑对现存实体（含有状态 NPC）的操作、区域编辑与未规划区意图附加。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；报告在有限预算下实现持续扩张的世界、跨独立规划瓦片的一致性连通，以及可交互性（语言驱动操作、编辑持久化、回访重编译）。
AI.conclusion: 通过"规划—编译—流式—记录"分离的设计，WorldStream 将开放式 3D 世界生成与语言交互、编辑持久化统一在同一世界记录之上，为可无限扩展且可交互的 3D 世界模型提供了系统性框架。

title: HorizonComposer: Spatiotemporally Consistent Driving Video Editing with Enriched Traffic Semantics
summary: Instruction-guided video generative models offer a scalable solution for stress-testing autonomous driving systems by simulating diverse environmental conditions. However, driving scenes operate within a dense Operational Design Domain (ODD) governed by strict traffic semantics. When applied to global driving-condition edits, general-purpose instruction-guided video editors frequently corrupt these semantics, leading to structural hallucinations and ``temporal shock.'' This work distills and protects traffic semantics during video editing at three levels. First, we construct a hybrid dataset by combining temporally aligned real-world videos with synthetic edits, balancing foundational scene structure with unambiguous appearance signals. Second, during training, we adapt advantage conditioning from offline reinforcement learning to align the model using dense rewards. We extract dense, pixel-level rewards from the hybrid data to serve as a localized signal and actively steer generation toward structurally reliable pixels. Finally, our model mitigates temporal shock by introducing thinking frames, a transition mechanism that seamlessly reconciles static image conditioning with dynamic video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method prevents the corruption of multi-actor dynamics, establishing state-of-the-art spatiotemporal consistency, yielding consistent user preference (39% relative improvement in content preservation and 12% in temporal consistency), and achieving a significant 5% gain in downstream road line segmentation and 7% gain in downstream multi-object detection.

AI.tldr: 提出面向自动驾驶场景的指令引导视频编辑方法，通过混合数据、稠密像素级奖励对齐与“思考帧”机制，在全局驾驶条件编辑时保护交通语义，抑制结构幻觉与时序冲击。
AI.motivation: 通用指令引导视频编辑器用于自动驾驶全局工况编辑时会破坏交通语义（ODD 约束下的结构性幻觉、时序冲击），因此需要一种能蒸馏并保护交通语义的编辑方案，以支撑自动驾驶系统的压力测试与仿真数据生成。
AI.method: 三层设计：(1) 数据层——构建时序对齐的真实视频与合成编辑混合数据集，平衡场景结构与外观信号；(2) 训练层——借鉴离线强化学习中的优势条件化，从混合数据提取稠密像素级奖励作为局部信号，引导生成偏向结构可靠的像素；(3) 时序层——引入“思考帧”过渡机制，衔接静态图像条件与动态视频上下文，缓解时序冲击。
AI.result: 避免多主体动态被破坏，取得 SOTA 时空一致性；用户偏好稳定：内容保持相对提升 39%、时序一致性提升 12%；下游道路线分割 +5%、多目标检测 +7%。
AI.conclusion: 将语义保护显式嵌入编辑流程（数据混合 + 稠密奖励对齐 + 过渡帧）可有效维持交通语义与时空一致性，说明面向特定 ODD 的定制化视频编辑优于通用编辑器，可作为自动驾驶仿真数据生成的可扩展手段。

title: Conditional Imaging for Privacy-Preserving Visual Sensing
summary: Conventional visual sensing faces a fundamental dilemma: information that should remain private today may need to be recovered tomorrow. This challenge is becoming increasingly important as cameras become pervasive in our daily surroundings. Existing safeguards either protect visual content only after an image is formed or suppress information during capture in ways that prevent its later recovery. Here, we show through an information-theoretic analysis that privacy and recoverability cannot be achieved simultaneously in static optical systems. Information preserved in a measurement for later reconstruction also remains available to an observer of that measurement, limiting the privacy such systems can provide. To overcome this limitation, we introduce conditional imaging, an imaging approach that changes the optical state for every captured frame. The measurement alone conceals the scene, while knowledge of the corresponding physical system state enables its reconstruction. We analyze how the optical parameters determine the information that can be recovered and use this analysis to guide the design of a camera prototype. We evaluate the system on a captured dataset of human faces using increasingly powerful attempts to recover the scene, from direct visualization and computational inversion to learned reconstruction and identity recognition. Our experiments show that conditional imaging preserves identity in authorized reconstructions while withholding visual information from observers without access to the system state. By making the physical state of the camera part of the information needed for reconstruction, conditional imaging enables visual information to be protected at the point of capture while remaining recoverable for future authorized use.

AI.tldr: 静态光学系统中隐私与可恢复性存在理论冲突；作者提出"条件成像"——每帧改变光学状态，使单帧测量本身 conceal 场景，唯有知晓对应物理状态才能重建。
AI.motivation: 相机无处不在，"今天应保密、明天可能需要恢复"的信息需求无法被现有方案满足：现有方案要么在成像后才保护内容，要么在采集时抑制信息以致永久不可恢复。作者先从信息论上论证这一根本矛盾。
AI.method: 用信息论分析证明静态光学系统无法同时实现隐私与可恢复性（保留用于重建的信息同样对测量观察者可见）。据此提出 conditional imaging：逐帧改变光学状态（如编码孔径/光学参数的时变调制），测量单独无法解读，需结合对应光学参数状态求解逆问题。分析光学参数如何决定可恢复信息量，并据此设计相机原型；在自采人脸数据集上评估直接可视化、计算反演、学习式重建、身份识别等递增强度的攻击。
AI.result: 授权重建中能保持身份信息，而无物理状态访问权的观察者即使在强学习式反演与识别攻击下也难以恢复视觉信息；验证了物理状态作为密钥的信息保护范式在原型相机上可行。
AI.conclusion: 将相机的物理状态纳入重建所需信息，可在采集端即实现隐私保护并保留未来授权恢复能力；隐私-可恢复性的权衡本质上是密码学/状态依赖的，而非纯算法可解。

title: Sketch2Sim: an end-to-end modular framework for hand-drawn circuit analysis
summary: This study proposes a sketch-to-simulation system to solve handwritten circuit diagrams. The system converts raw images into a Simulation Program with Integrated Circuit Emphasis (SPICE)-compatible netlist and automatically calculates the circuit's nodal voltages and currents. Another objective is to propose a holistic framework that benefits students and educators by enhancing the teaching and learning experience of electric circuits and expediting engineering design reviews. This article presents a multistage pipeline that converts raw photographs of handwritten electric circuits into executable SPICE-like netlists, providing a solution. A dataset of 1,000 hand-drawn Resistor-Inductor-Capacitor (RLC) circuits was curated and annotated for components, text regions, and character recognition. The proposed system decomposes a circuit diagram into three stages: (i) dual You Only Look Once (YOLO)-based detectors for components and text regions, (ii) a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-based domain-aware symbol value extraction, and (iii) image processing with thresholding, skeletonization, and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) to automatically identify nodes and map them with corresponding components. The proposed system produces the netlist and solves the circuit. The qualitative and quantitative ablation studies on modular stages, as well as end-to-end tests, demonstrate robust performance across various handwriting styles, lighting conditions, and this http URL study serves as an interactive learning aid and practical tool for professionals, providing a comprehensive user interface (UI), enabling rapid digitization of circuit sketches for study, design, prototyping, or troubleshooting.

AI.tldr: 提出手绘电路图到SPICE网表的端到端管线：双YOLO检测元件与文字区域、CRNN+CTC与OCR领域感知符号取值、基于阈值化/骨架化/DBSCAN的节点识别与元件映射，并自动求解节点电压电流。
AI.motivation: 手绘电路图转可仿真网表依赖人工录入，效率低；希望为教学提供交互式学习工具，并为工程评审与原型设计提供快速数字化手段。
AI.method: 自建1000张手绘RLC电路数据集并标注元件、文本区域与字符；三阶段流水线：(i) 双YOLO检测器分别检测元件与文字区域；(ii) CRNN+CTC结合OCR进行领域感知符号取值提取；(iii) 图像处理（阈值化、骨架化、DBSCAN聚类）自动识别节点并与元件映射，生成网表后调用SPICE求解。含模块级消融与端到端评测。
AI.result: 定性与定量消融及端到端测试显示在不同书写风格与光照条件下表现稳健；系统可输出网表并完成电路求解，配套完整UI。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为电路教学提供交互式辅助工具，也能加速电路草图数字化，用于学习、设计、原型与排障；但方法集中于2D图像解析与符号处理，缺乏物理仿真与机器人/具身场景的关联。

title: Beyond Correct Answers: How Compositional Cues Shape Visual Judgments
summary: Visual question answering requires models to assign attributes and relations to the correct objects, a problem known as visual binding. Structured prompts make these assignments explicit through labeled fields. Yet an improvement from the full prompt does not reveal which labels help or how they interact. First, we isolate field-label effects across ten models and six tasks by holding the image and claim fixed. These comparisons reveal differences that overall accuracy can hide. With a relation label present, adding object-role labels helps Qwen3 but hurts Qwen2 on Spatial. Second, we compare auxiliary hints that preserve or swap the question's role assignments against a no-hint baseline. Across two image sets, Qwen3's advantage with preserving hints mainly reflects errors caused by swapped hints. Preserving hints remain near baseline. Field order further affects the harm. Third, we test clearer hint wording and direct selection of the relation shown in the image. Clearer hints improve text matching but do not consistently improve visual judgments. In contrast, relation selection partly reduces errors for some hints in Qwen3 and GPT-4.1-mini.

AI.tldr: 通过控制图像与陈述不变，系统量化多模态问答中结构化提示的字段标签、顺序、hint 语义及关系选择对视觉绑定（属性/关系归属）的影响，发现提示增益多来自错误提示的对比效应，清晰化措辞与关系选择仅带来有限且模型相关的改善。
AI.motivation: 视觉问答需正确完成实体-属性/关系绑定（visual binding），结构化提示看似有效，但整体准确率提升无法揭示哪些标签起作用、如何交互，因此需要受控的字段级归因分析。
AI.method: 1）固定图像与陈述，在10个模型、6个任务上隔离单个字段标签的效果；2）对比保留与交换角色分配的辅助 hint 与无 hint 基线（两组图像集），并考察字段顺序影响；3）测试更清晰 hint 措辞与直接选择图像中所示关系两种干预。
AI.result: 标签效果高度依赖模型：存在关系标签时，加对象角色标签助益 Qwen3 但在 Spatial 任务上损害 Qwen2。Qwen3 在保序 hint 下的优势主要源于交换 hint 带来的额外错误，保序 hint 基本与基线持平；字段顺序改变有害程度。更清晰措辞提升文本匹配但未稳定提升视觉判断；关系选择在 Qwen3 与 GPT-4.1-mini 上部分降低错误。
AI.conclusion: 结构化提示的收益多为脆弱且模型/任务特异的，聚合指标掩盖字段级差异；提示设计需按模型与任务逐一验证，单纯提高可读性不足以改善视觉绑定，显式关系选择更有前景。

title: Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation for Few-shot Image Classification
comment: This work is accepted by The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Few-shot image classification (FSIC) frequently suffers from visual ambiguity, where background clutter and RGB appearance similarities hinder discriminative feature matching in data-scarce settings. To mitigate this, we propose DAFIC, a geometry-guided framework that incorporates monocular depth into representation learning, episodic adaptation, and dense support-query matching. DAFIC first learns geometry-aware token representations through RGB-D self-supervised pre-training. Subsequently, the Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation (DGA) module uses depth-derived geometry to refine patch representations with geometry-enriched class context while suppressing background interference. Spatial Bidirectional Patch Matching (SBiM) then performs bidirectional dense matching on the refined features, reducing sensitivity to spurious correspondences and background clutter. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks show that DAFIC achieves strong performance against existing methods, with ablation and robustness analyses supporting the effectiveness of coupling geometry-conditioned episodic adaptation with bidirectional matching for few-shot visual recognition.

AI.tldr: DAFIC 将单目深度引入少样本图像分类，通过 RGB-D 自监督预训练、深度引导几何适配（DGA）与空间双向 Patch 匹配（SBiM）抑制背景干扰与外观歧义。
AI.motivation: 少样本图像分类在数据稀缺下易受视觉歧义影响：背景杂乱与 RGB 外观相似导致判别性特征匹配失效；作者希望用单目深度提供的几何线索缓解该问题。
AI.method: 几何引导框架：1) RGB-D 自监督预训练获得几何感知 token 表示；2) DGA 模块用深度几何精炼 patch 表示，注入几何增强的类别上下文并抑制背景；3) SBiM 在精炼特征上做双向稠密匹配，降低对伪对应与背景杂波的敏感度。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上优于现有方法；消融与鲁棒性分析支持"几何条件化 episodic 适配 + 双向匹配"组合的有效性。摘要未给出具体精度数值或推理开销数据。
AI.conclusion: 几何（深度）先验可在少样本稠密匹配中有效抑制背景干扰与外观歧义，但该工作定位于通用 few-shot 图像分类，尚缺乏机器人/具身场景验证与开源代码信息。

title: DualHeads: Reward-tilted few-step diffusion made simple
summary: Distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in a few sampling steps, but aligning them with task requirements and human preferences is difficult. Methods developed for multi-step diffusion models rely on differentiable rewards, or on score fields and stochastic trajectories that distilled generators may lack. We ask whether a few-step generator can be adapted using only external reward evaluations and reference samples, and show that two binary classifiers suffice. Our method, DualHeads, implements them as lightweight heads on a frozen diffusion backbone. The reward head learns which samples of the same prompt score higher, the reference head separates reference images from generated ones, and the generator maximizes a weighted sum of their logits. When the heads are optimal, this objective is KL-regularized maximization of the learned reward, and the ratio of head weights sets the regularization strength. Empirically, with both rule-based and model-based rewards, a few-step DualHeads generator reaches task rewards close to those of 40-step reinforcement learning methods while preserving image quality, at no extra inference cost. We hope that this simple and elegant dual-head formulation will help advance few-step reward-tilted generation.

AI.tldr: DualHeads 用两个冻结主干上的轻量二分类头（奖励头学习同 prompt 内的样本偏序，参考头区分参考图与生成图）对少步蒸馏扩散生成器做奖励对齐，等价于 KL 正则化的奖励最大化，权重比控制正则强度。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏后的少步扩散模型难以用多步方法（可微奖励、score field、随机轨迹）做偏好对齐，因此需要仅依赖外部奖励评估与参考样本的对齐手段。
AI.method: 在冻结扩散主干预训练两个二分类头；奖励头做同 prompt 样本对的优劣判别，参考头做参考图/生成图的判别；生成器最大化两个头 logits 的加权和；最优头下该目标即 KL 正则化的奖励最大化，头权重比决定正则强度。
AI.result: 在规则型与模型型奖励下，几步 DualHeads 生成器的任务奖励接近 40 步 RL 方法，同时保持图像质量，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 双头形式简单且理论解释清晰，可作为少步奖励倾斜生成的通用对齐范式。

title: Real2Sem2Real: 3D Semantic Augmentations for Robot Learning from a Single Human RGB Demonstration
comment: Matthew Strong and Ankush K. Dhawan contributed equally. Project page: this https URL
summary: Human video scales easily and does not need robot hardware, but existing methods require depth sensing, overlay the robot onto 2D video, or generate data only for the demonstrated objects. We present Real2Sem2Real (R2Sem2R), a real-to-semantic-to-real pipeline that turns one monocular RGB video of a human demonstration into thousands of robot demonstrations across the semantic object instances of a category. R2Sem2R tracks the SE(3) pose of each object with DINOv3-distilled Gaussian splats, outperforming existing methods and FoundationPose with estimated metric depth. R2Sem2R then aligns digital cousins, each generated from one or a few photographs, to the demonstrated objects with a semantic alignment. This alignment matches whole objects and the functional regions of target objects, such as a coffee machine's tray. R2Sem2R maps the human hand to a feasible robot grasp that extends to the cousins. Robot demonstrations are generated either in IsaacSim, for photorealistic rendering, or MuJoCo, for contact physics, and R2Sem2R can generate over 2,000 episodes in about two hours. On two real robots and four tasks, we train a vision-language-action policy on data from one human video per task, and policies trained on our data match or exceed policies trained on teleoperation across diverse object instances. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Real2Sem2Real (R2Sem2R)流水线：用DINOv3蒸馏的高斯溅射跟踪单目RGB视频中物体的SE(3)位姿，经语义对齐将"数字表亲"物体实例匹配到演示物体及其功能区域，并把人类手部映射为可行机器人抓取，从单条人类视频合成上千条跨物体实例的机器人演示。
AI.motivation: 人类视频数据易获取且无需机器人硬件，但现有方法要么依赖深度传感，要么把机器人叠加到2D视频上，要么只能针对演示中出现的特定物体生成数据，无法泛化到同类别的其他实例。
AI.method: 1) 基于DINOv3蒸馏的高斯溅射进行多物体SE(3)位姿跟踪，结合估计的度量深度，优于现有方法与FoundationPose；2) 语义对齐：将仅由一至数张照片生成的"数字表亲"物体整体以及功能区域（如咖啡机托盘）对齐至演示物体；3) 手到机器人抓取的映射并泛化至表亲实例；4) 在IsaacSim（照片级渲染）或MuJoCo（接触物理）中生成演示，约两小时生成2000+条episode。
AI.result: 在两种真实机器人与四个任务上，每个任务仅用一条人类视频训练VLA策略，所训练策略在多样物体实例上达到或超过遥操作数据训练的策略；数据生成效率约为2小时内2000+条episode。
AI.conclusion: 单目RGB人类视频经"语义—重定向—仿真"转换可高效扩展为跨实例的机器人演示数据，是替代遥操作采集的可扩展VLA数据放大路径，兼具位姿跟踪精度与语义泛化的优势。

title: inr2action: Encoding Robot Episodes as Neural Implicit Representations for Recall and Action
summary: Long-horizon robotic operation requires memory that scales with essential information rather than execution time. We present a parameter-space memory framework where each episode is stored as a separable object. A neural implicit representation is fitted to episode video from a shared, meta-learned initialization; the resulting weight delta constitutes the memory. Crucially, this delta remains a fixed size regardless of whether the episode spans a hundred or a hundred thousand frames. A learned projector maps the weight delta into token embeddings, conditioning a language model for question answering and a decoder for joint command regression, without frame retrieval at query time. On RoboMME, the language model exceeds chance across all question types, and the decoder achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.51. Replacing the delta with matched noise drops performance by 11.4 points, while random-origin weights are non-decodable, proving the meta-learned initialization is essential for embedding episode content. By representing individual experiences as fixed-size weight deltas in a common parameter space, this approach decouples memory cost from time horizon and provides a basis for scalable streaming memory.

AI.tldr: 将机器人长时程记忆存为"固定尺寸的权重增量"：以元学习初始化拟合episode视频，权重delta即记忆，经学习投影器转为token驱动语言模型问答与指令回归。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作需要记忆，但现有记忆（帧缓冲、视频检索）的存储与计算开销随执行时间或帧数线性增长；作者希望让记忆开销与"关键信息量"而非时间跨度挂钩。
AI.method: 1）共享元学习初始化 + 神经隐式表示，对每个episode视频拟合出权重增量Δθ，作为该episode的可分离记忆对象；2）Δθ维度与episode帧数无关（100帧或10万帧同尺寸）；3）学习一个投影器将Δθ映射为token embedding，用于条件化LLM做问答、条件化解码器做联合指令回归，查询阶段无需帧检索；4）消融：以同维噪声替换Δθ，以及使用无元学习的随机初始权重。
AI.result: RoboMME上：语言模型在所有问题类型上均显著优于随机猜测；解码器联合指令回归平均R²=0.51。将Δθ替换为匹配噪声后性能下降11.4个点；随机初始权重下不可解码，说明元学习初始化是嵌入episode内容的关键。
AI.conclusion: 以公共参数空间中的固定尺寸权重增量表示个体经验，可把记忆成本与时间视界解耦，为可扩展的流式机器人记忆提供基础；但当前验证限于离线基准，尚无真实机器人长时程闭环部署。

title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
summary: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels. In practice, this requires choosing a timestep, a block, and a channel subset. Existing methods either fix these choices by hand or optimize only a few extraction hyperparameters, most often the timestep, then reuse the same rule across inputs and budgets. We introduce Policy-Mask, a budget-conditioned policy trained on the downstream objective that jointly selects all three under a prescribed channel budget. Without normalization, the channel-score contribution grows with the number of selected channels and dominates the timestep and block updates. We normalize it by subset cardinality, keeping the three policy heads on comparable scales and stabilizing joint training. At matched budgets, Policy-Mask improves over fixed extraction and feature-filter baselines across segmentation, classification, and semantic correspondence, reaching 38.9 mIoU on ADE20K, 75.4% top-1 on CIFAR-100 at 128 dimensions, and 76.3 PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k. Component-wise ablations show that block selection materially affects downstream accuracy, and the highest recorded channel-budget score occurs at 256 retained channels, identifying a practical operating point for compact diffusion representations. We further adapt Policy-Mask to diffusion transformers, including PixArt-$\Sigma$ and SD3.5 MMDiT, by replacing U-Net channels with image-token hidden dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Policy-Mask：在冻结扩散模型中用一个预算条件策略联合选择时间步、网络块与通道子集，并以子集基数归一化通道分数以稳定联合训练，在分割/分类/语义对应上优于固定抽取基线。
AI.motivation: 冻结扩散模型中的判别性特征分布沿去噪轨迹、网络深度与通道分散，如何同时选取时间步、块与通道子集是关键；现有方法多手工固定或仅优化单一超参（多为时间步），且在输入与预算之间复用同一规则。
AI.method: 训练一个预算条件的策略（3 个策略头分别输出时间步、块、通道选择），直接以下游任务目标优化；针对未归一化时通道分数贡献随选中通道数增长并压过时间步/块更新的问题，按子集基数归一化通道分数，使三个头尺度可比、联合训练稳定；并扩展到 DiT（PixArt-Σ、SD3.5 MMDiT），以图像 token 隐藏维度替代 U-Net 通道。
AI.result: 同预算下在分割、分类、语义对应上超过固定抽取与特征筛选基线：ADE20K 38.9 mIoU、CIFAR-100 128 维下 75.4% top-1、SPair-71k 76.3 PCK@0.1；消融显示块选择对精度影响显著，256 保留通道处达到最佳通道预算表现。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散特征抽取形式化为预算约束下的联合选择策略并以归一化稳定训练，是提升紧凑扩散表示判别性的一种有效、可迁移（U-Net→DiT）的范式。

title: Flexible Language-Guided Representation Editing for Adaptive Robot Behavior
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin, TX. 25 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables
summary: Trajectory demonstrations show robots how to behave but not why, leaving them to guess which features of the task actually matter. Incorrect guesses produce misaligned internal representations and lead to incorrect robot behaviors. Because task features are often semantically defined, we argue that natural language is better suited for specifying features rather than relying on demonstrations. Although existing representation editing methods have proposed using language to specify new features, only allowing additive edits produces feature sets that are often over-specified or too narrowly scoped, especially in sequential editing tasks. We propose the Flexible Feature Editing Pipeline (FLEX), which uses language models to iteratively refine a robot's internal representation of task features from natural language corrections via three complementary operations: Add missing features, Generalize existing specific features, and Mask irrelevant features. We evaluate FLEX on 2D navigation scenarios, 7DoF Franka tabletop manipulation tasks, and a real-world study using naturalistic human language corrections and real-robot demonstrations. Comparisons against single-operation and unscaffolded baselines show that all three operations are necessary in interactive scenarios, and that FLEX achieves consistently higher normalized reward compared to other feature editing approaches while maintaining compact, transferable representations. Project available at this https URL

AI.tldr: FLEX 用语言模型对机器人内部任务特征表示做三种可组合编辑（添加缺失特征、泛化过细特征、遮蔽无关特征），在多轮自然语言纠错中迭代精化表示。
AI.motivation: 轨迹示范只展示"怎么做"而非"为什么"，机器人难以判断哪些任务特征真正重要，容易形成错位的内部表示；而任务特征多为语义定义的，因此自然语言比示范更适合指定特征。已有表示编辑方法只支持加性编辑，导致特征集过拟合或范围过窄，在序列化编辑任务中尤其严重。
AI.method: 提出 FLEX（Flexible Feature Editing Pipeline）：借助语言模型将自然语言纠正转译为对机器人内部任务特征表示的三类互补操作——Add（补充缺失特征）、Generalize（抽象过于具体特征）、Mask（屏蔽无关特征），形成闭环迭代精化流程。
AI.result: 在 2D 导航、7DoF Franka 桌面操作任务，以及使用自然语言纠错与真实机器人示范的真实世界研究中评估；消融显示三种操作在交互场景中都不可或缺，FLEX 相较单操作与无脚手架基线取得更高归一化奖励，并保持紧凑、可迁移的表示。
AI.conclusion: 语言引导的表示编辑需具备"增/泛化/屏蔽"三种能力才能应对交互式纠错；FLEX 提供了一种紧凑可迁移的机器人特征表示学习范式，并具备真机验证。

title: Data-Driven Glyph Positioning for Handwritten Music Synthesis
comment: 10 pages, 1 biblio page, presented at The 20th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition
summary: Synthesised data is a common strategy to address the lack of annotated handwritten music scores in Optical Music Recognition (OMR). Smashcima is a recent synthesis framework that assembles pages of handwritten scores by sampling glyph images from MUSCIMA++ and positioning them with hard-coded rules. In this work we ask whether these rules are grounded empirically and whether a learned model for context-dependent positioning can further improve synthesis quality. We extract inter-glyph distributions from around 285 thousand annotated relationships across MUSCIMA++ and OmniOMR, finding that several key parameters deviate systematically from real handwriting. Replacing these constants with empirical means reduces positioning RMSE by up to 60%. We then train a Graph Neural Network (GNN) on the Music Notation Graph structure to predict context-dependent offsets, achieving an additional 50 to 85% RMSE reduction on stems and beams by modelling how neighbouring glyphs constrain placement. Cross-dataset analysis shows that spacing differences between the two corpora are explained by note density (3.3), not style, and that duration-proportional spacing does not hold in handwriting (R2 = 0.001). In downstream evaluation, a YOLOv8 detector pretrained on GNN-positioned synthetic data achieves +30% mAP50 over the baseline and +11% over empirical means when fine-tuned on 200 real handwritten staves, showing that positioning accuracy matters for downstream OMR.

AI.tldr: 用 MUSCIMA++ 与 OmniOMR 的 28.5 万条标注关系检验 Smashcima 合成手写乐谱的硬编码排版规则，发现关键参数系统性偏离真实手写；改用经验均值将定位 RMSE 降低最多 60%，再用 GNN 在 Music Notation Graph 上建模上下文相关偏移，对符干与符杠再降 50–85% RMSE；下游 YOLOv8 检测 mAP50 +30%，微调后仍 +11%。
AI.motivation: OMR 领域标注手写乐谱稀缺，合成数据是主流对策，但代表性框架 Smashcima 依赖从 MUSCIMA++ 采样字形加硬编码规则定位，这些规则缺乏实证依据，导致合成分布与真实手写存在偏差。
AI.method: 从 MUSCIMA++ 与 OmniOMR 提取约 285K 条标注的字形间分布并做实证校准；将常数参数替换为经验均值；在 Music Notation Graph 结构上训练 GNN 预测上下文相关的定位偏移（利用相邻字形约束）；跨数据集分析间距差异来源（音符密度，3.3）与时长比例间距假设（R²=0.001）；以 YOLOv8 检测器在下游评估，含 200 个真实手写谱表的微调。
AI.result: 经验均值替代使定位 RMSE 最多下降 60%；GNN 在符干与符杠上再降 50–85% RMSE；跨数据集间距差异主要由音符密度（3.3）解释、非风格差异；手写中不成立时长比例间距（R²=0.001）；预训练检测器 mAP50 较基线 +30%、较经验均值 +11%（微调后）。
AI.conclusion: 手写乐谱合成中的排版规则需实证校准，且上下文相关的学习式定位（GNN）显著优于常数规则；定位精度对下游 OMR 检测性能有实质影响，为合成数据质量提供了可量化的改进路径。

title: Learning Dynamic Games for Cooperative Iterative Tasks
summary: We consider cooperative and iterative tasks involving multiple agents whose interactions are modeled as a dynamic game with shared constraints. We propose a general learning framework applicable to nonlinear and nonconvex dynamic games that uses previously executed feasible trajectories to construct a sampled joint safe set and player-specific cost-to-go functions. At each time step, the agents jointly select a previously sampled terminal state and a Generalized Nash equilibrium used to reach it. A new solution is adopted only if it satisfies a cooperative acceptance rule agreed upon by the players. The framework accommodates individual non-degradation requirements and selection criteria such as weighted costs and Nash bargaining. We show that the proposed framework guarantees recursive feasibility and characterize conditions under which each player's cost is non-increasing across iterations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于非线性非凸动态博弈的多智能体协作迭代学习框架：用已执行的可行轨迹构造采样联合安全集与各玩家的cost-to-go函数，每步联合选择采样终端状态并求解广义Nash均衡，仅在满足协作接受规则时才采纳新解，保证递归可行性与成本非增性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作迭代任务中，交互可建模为带共享约束的动态博弈，但非线性、非凸且含耦合约束的问题难以保证可行性与性能单调改进。现有方法缺乏能在学习循环中同时保证安全性（递归可行性）与个体不退化的一般性框架。
AI.method: 利用历史执行的可行轨迹构建采样联合安全集（sampled joint safe set）及玩家特定的cost-to-go函数；每个时间步智能体共同选取一个已采样的终端状态及到达该状态的广义Nash均衡（GNE）；仅当新解满足玩家共同约定的协作接受规则时才被采纳；框架支持个体不退化要求及加权成本、Nash讨价还价等选择准则。
AI.result: 理论上证明所提框架具有递归可行性，并刻画了各玩家成本在迭代间单调不增的条件（个体不退化保证）。摘要中未给出数值实验或实机验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为带共享约束的非线性非凸多智能体动态博弈提供了一个带可行性保证的迭代学习范式，但其贡献主要为理论框架，缺乏实验验证与可扩展性讨论，对具身多智能体系统有潜在参考价值但非当下核心优先级。

title: Navigation Explainability for Object Avoidance with LLMs for Assistive Robots
summary: Blind and visually impaired individuals face uncertainty when navigating unfamiliar areas. Whether a cane or a guide dog is used for navigation, this may prove to be challenging. To mitigate this challenge, we present the Context-Aware Navigation Explanation framework that explains guide dog movements for obstacle avoidance and navigation using a large language model. This system integrates perceptual context with planned future trajectories to generate natural-language explanations of robot movement. We deploy the system on a Unitree Go2 platform in indoor navigation scenarios and evaluate how different explanation context configurations affect user trust and explanation satisfaction. Results show a strong positive relationship between explanation satisfaction and trust, and suggest that combining obstacle information with future trajectory leads to the most effective explanations. These findings highlight the potential of context-aware language explanations to improve transparency and trust in assistive robot navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于大语言模型的上下文感知导航解释框架，将感知上下文与未来轨迹规划结合，为导盲机器人运动生成自然语言解释，并在Unitree Go2室内场景中评估不同上下文配置对用户信任与解释满意度的影响。
AI.motivation: 视障人士在陌生环境中导航存在较大不确定性，无论使用盲杖还是导盲犬均有挑战；辅助机器人需要提升运动决策的透明性与用户信任，因此需要可解释的导航行为说明。
AI.method: 构建Context-Aware Navigation Explanation框架：融合感知上下文（障碍物信息）与规划的未来轨迹，由LLM生成机器人运动的自然语言解释；在Unitree Go2四足平台上进行室内导航部署，对比不同解释上下文配置的用户研究。
AI.result: 解释满意度与用户信任呈强正相关；将障碍物信息与未来轨迹结合的解释配置效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知的语言解释能提升辅助机器人导航的透明度与用户信任，具备应用潜力；但方法偏工程集成与用户研究，缺少导航性能或具身智能核心方法层面的实质性增益。

title: One Policy, Many Styles: Where to Aggregate Preferences for Steerable Humanoid Control?
summary: Modern robotic agents are increasingly expected to support steerable control, where a single policy can adjust its behavioral style at runtime under changing user preferences. Preference-conditioned reinforcement learning provides this interface, but conditioning alone does not ensure that a requested behavior change is strong, does not leak into unrelated behaviors, and does not compromise task performance. Our evaluation combines Preference Reward Responsiveness (PRR) with coverage and utility metrics. We use these measures to compare reward-level, advantage-level, loss-level, and PCGrad-based aggregation across two humanoid-control frameworks. No aggregation level performs best across all environments and criteria. Experiments show that aggregating objectives early produces a wider range of behavioral responses but greater unintended changes in other objectives, while aggregating them later improves control precision at some cost to responsiveness.

AI.tldr: 在多目标人形控制中系统比较奖励级、优势级、损失级与 PCGrad 级四种偏好条件化聚合方式，提出 PRR+覆盖率+效用的评估体系，发现早聚合响应更宽但串扰大、晚聚合控制更精确但响应弱。
AI.motivation: 偏好条件化 RL 虽提供运行时行为调节接口，但条件化本身无法保证所请求的行为改变足够强、不泄漏到无关行为、且不损害任务性能；需要明确对比不同聚合层级对这三个属性的影响。
AI.method: 在两个人形控制框架上，实现并对比四类偏好聚合层级：奖励级、优势级、损失级、基于 PCGrad 的梯度级聚合；用 Preference Reward Responsiveness（PRR）衡量响应强度，并辅以行为覆盖度与任务效用指标做联合评估。
AI.result: 没有单一聚合层级在所有环境与指标上占优；早聚合（奖励级）带来更宽的行为响应范围但其他目标上的非预期漂移更大，晚聚合（损失/梯度级）提升控制精度但以响应性下降为代价。
AI.conclusion: 聚合位置构成响应性与控制精度之间的权衡，需按应用优先级选择聚合层级；PRR+覆盖+效用的组合指标可作为可操控性策略的实用评测工具。

title: MINER: Modeling Inter- and Intra-Person Variance for Reidentification
comment: Paper accepted to the WACV 2027 Algorithms track
summary: Clothes-Changing Person Re-Identification (CC-ReID) remains challenging due to drastic appearance shifts across outfits. Most prior works devise biometric signal-extraction heuristics to enhance inter-person variance, e.g., using segmentation masks, while leaving intra-person variance uncontrolled. We present MINER, a simple model-agnostic framework that suppresses garment bias by contrasting hard examples and adaptively balancing dataset-dependent intra- and inter-person variance. Extensive experiments show that MINER improves retrieval across CC-ReID benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance on four datasets and ranking among the leaders in all three tracks of the open TVRID RGB-Depth ReID challenge.

AI.tldr: MINER：一个模型无关的框架，通过难样本对比与数据集自适应的类内/类间方差平衡来抑制服装偏差，提升换衣行人重识别（CC-ReID）性能。
AI.motivation: 换衣行人重识别中外观因着装变化而剧烈漂移；现有方法多用分割掩码等生物特征启发式增强类间方差，却忽视类内方差控制，导致服装偏差仍主导检索。
AI.method: 提出 MINER：模型无关框架，包含难样本对比（hard-example contrasting）以压制服装相关捷径特征，并按数据集自适应地平衡类内方差与类间方差。
AI.result: 在多个 CC-ReID 基准上检索性能提升，四个数据集达到 SOTA，并在 TVRID RGB-Depth ReID 挑战赛三个赛道中均位列前列。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比式难例挖掘与方差平衡而非依赖分割等启发式，可有效降低服装偏差；框架可即插即用于多种骨干网络。

title: COWBOY: A Scalable Sim-to-Real Framework for Learning Contextual Whole-Body Manipulation
summary: Mobile manipulators must adapt not only to objects, but also to the spatial context in which they appear: where to position the base, how to manipulate, and where to look while navigating surrounding scene geometry. To address this, we present COWBOY, a scalable sim-to-real framework for learning such contextual whole-body manipulation. On whole-body dexterous grasping, COWBOY transfers zero-shot to hundreds of objects and diverse in-the-wild scenes, spanning cluttered tabletops, shelves, drawers, and other unstructured settings. Rather than learning scene adaptation directly with RL in simulation, a vectorized environment-aware whole-body controller (WBC) handles reaching in thousands of scenes by coordinating base-arm motion, collision avoidance, and active vision. Then, local RL experts are trained in local scenes for object interaction and can be reused across thousands of full-scene layouts. We distill these composed WBC-RL teachers into a single vision policy that controls the mobile base, arm, dexterous hand, and actuated camera from point-cloud observations. The resulting policy exhibits contextual whole-body behavior, automatically adapting base placement, camera viewpoint, arm trajectory, and grasp strategy to observed scene and object geometry. Videos are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: COWBOY：可扩展的仿真到真实框架，用"环境感知全身控制器(WBC)+局部RL专家"组合教师在数千场景中自动生成数据，蒸馏为单一点云视觉策略，控制移动底盘、机械臂、灵巧手与主动相机，零样本迁移到真实杂乱场景完成全身抓取。
AI.motivation: 移动操作不仅需要适应物体，还需适应空间上下文（底盘应置于何处、如何操作、导航中看向哪里）。直接在仿真中用RL学习场景适应代价高、难扩展；因此需要一种可规模化、能利用场景几何与主动视觉的上下文全身操作学习框架。
AI.method: 提出组合式教师-学生蒸馏管线：(1) 向量化环境感知全身控制器(WBC)，在数千场景中协调底盘-臂运动、避障与主动视觉完成"够到"；(2) 在局部场景训练局部RL专家负责物体交互，并可跨数千种全场景布局复用；(3) 将WBC-RL组合教师蒸馏为单一视觉策略，输入点云观测，输出底盘、臂、灵巧手与相机执行器动作。
AI.result: 在全身灵巧抓取任务上零样本迁移到数百个真实物体与多样野外场景（杂乱桌面、货架、抽屉等非结构化环境）；策略涌现上下文全身行为，依据观测到的场景与物体几何自动调整底盘位置、相机视角、臂轨迹与抓取策略。
AI.conclusion: 用"经典控制器+局部RL"的结构化组合教师替代端到端场景RL，可有效获得可扩展、可蒸馏、具备场景上下文感知的移动灵巧操作策略，并在真实世界中零样本泛化。

title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
comment: Accepted at Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators. HyperDrone combines highly optimized multirotor dynamics with HyperLux, a new ray-tracing engine that supports Nvidia OptiX, Vulkan, Apple Metal and WebGPU backends that takes full advantage of modern ray-tracing hardware, capable of running both components entirely on the GPU. HyperLux renders RGB, depth, semantic/instance segmentation, surface normals and optical flow observations at configurable levels of fidelity, including reflections, realistic lighting, motion blur, anti-aliasing, and Physically Based Rendering (PBR). Even in the highest-fidelity settings, HyperLux achieves millions of Frames Per Second (FPS) on consumer-grade GPUs while rendering realistic 3D scenes. We demonstrate the merits of HyperDrone by training a vision-based yaw-control policy purely in simulation and transferring it to a real small-scale quadrotor (Crazyflie) with a camera, running completely onboard.

AI.tldr: HyperDrone：面向高性能批量渲染的超高速四旋翼仿真器，结合优化多旋翼动力学与跨后端光线追踪引擎 HyperLux，全 GPU 运行，较 SOTA 批量仿真器提速 20 倍以上，并完成仿真训练视觉偏航控制策略的 Crazyflie 真机机载部署。
AI.motivation: 现有批量四旋翼仿真器渲染吞吐不足，制约大规模视觉策略训练与高保真域随机化；需要兼顾物理精度、渲染质量与批量吞吐的 GPU 原生仿真平台。
AI.method: 1) 高度优化的多旋翼动力学模块；2) 自研 HyperLux 光线追踪引擎，支持 OptiX/Vulkan/Metal/WebGPU 后端，充分利用硬件 RT 单元；3) 物理与渲染全流程驻留 GPU，避免主机-设备同步开销；4) 多模态观测输出（RGB、深度、语义/实例分割、法线、光流），可配置保真度（反射、PBR、运动模糊、抗锯齿）。
AI.result: 较现有 SOTA 批量仿真器快 20 倍以上；最高保真设置下在消费级 GPU 仍达数百万 FPS；仿真训练视觉偏航控制策略零微调迁移至带相机的小型 Crazyflie 并完全机载运行。
AI.conclusion: HyperDrone 以渲染吞吐与模态丰富度双重优势，为大规模视觉仿真训练-真机迁移提供了实用且高效的物理仿真器基础设。

title: GGraph: A GPU-Accelerated Library for Graph-Based Robot Deployment and Learning
summary: Autonomous mobile robots require spatial representations that capture geometry and semantics while staying sparse enough for planning in large, unknown environments. Graphs provide a natural representation for this purpose and underpin both classical planning methods and a growing class of reinforcement-learning (RL) policies. However, RL training needs hundreds to thousands of parallel environments, each constructing and updating its own graph. Existing graph libraries are typically designed for either single-robot deployment or fixed graphs, and CPU-based graph construction limits scalable training to only a few dozen environments. We introduce GGraph, an open-source GPU-accelerated graph library for both robot deployment and large-scale learning. GGraph supports real robots through ROS 2 interfaces and vectorized GPU-based policy training, with built-in support for tasks including 3-D navigation, exploration, and loop-closure integration. For single-robot operation, GGraph updates graphs in milliseconds. At scale, it enables graph-based exploration policies to train across hundreds of parallel robots, reducing wall-clock training time by one order of magnitude. Across simulation and real-world experiments, these results establish GGraph as a unified graph infrastructure for both large-scale robot learning and deployment.

AI.tldr: GGraph：开源GPU加速图数据结构库，统一支持单机实时更新（毫秒级）与大规模并行向量化RL训练，使基于图的探索策略可在数百个并行机器人上训练，训练墙钟时间降低一个数量级。
AI.motivation: RL训练基于图表示的导航/探索策略需要成百上千并行环境，每环境独立构建更新图；现有图库面向单机部署或固定图，CPU构建使并行规模受限于几十个环境，缺可扩展的图基础设施。
AI.method: GPU加速的图构建与更新、向量化GPU策略训练接口、ROS 2部署接口；内置3D导航、探索、回环闭合融合任务支持。
AI.result: 单机图更新达到毫秒级；可支撑数百并行机器人的图探索策略训练，训练墙钟时间缩短约10倍；含仿真与真实世界实验验证。
AI.conclusion: GGraph为大规模机器人学习与部署提供统一图基础设施，兼具实时性与可扩展性。

title: Pair-Free Coarse-to-Real Video Generation via Real-to-Coarse Image Supervision
summary: Coarse-to-real (C2R) video generation converts coarse animation, simulation, or game-rendered videos into photorealistic videos while preserving scene layout, camera motion, and dynamics. Training such models requires aligned (coarse, realistic) video pairs, which are expensive to create and confine prior systems to narrow synthetic domains. We exploit a simple asymmetry: paired videos are hard to obtain, but paired real-to-coarse images are easy to construct with existing editing and 3D reconstruction tools. Using these image pairs, we train the DINO-R2C model to transfer realistic images to coarse images in DINO feature space, and apply it frame-wise to ordinary real videos to synthesize pseudo-coarse videos. The C2R# model then learns to generate each real video from its pseudo-coarse counterpart, free from needing (coarse, realistic) video pairs. At inference, the DINO-R2C model is discarded and actual coarse videos drive the C2R# model directly. Thus, our pair-free training scales with any real-video corpora rather than with paired synthetic videos. We will release the model and project webpage at this https URL .

AI.tldr: C2R# 以"伪粗视频"替代难以获取的配对视频数据，实现无配对数据的粗到真视频生成。
AI.motivation: 粗到真（C2R）视频生成需要对齐的（粗视频、真实视频）配对数据，这类数据昂贵且难以扩展，导致现有模型只能局限于狭窄的合成域。作者利用一个不对称性：配对视频难获取，但真实→粗粒度的配对图像容易用现有编辑工具与 3D 重建工具构建。
AI.method: 先用编辑/重建工具构造真实-粗粒度图像对，训练 DINO-R2C 模型在 DINO 特征空间把真实图像映射为粗糙图像；逐帧应用到普通真实视频上，合成伪粗视频；再训练 C2R# 模型从伪粗视频重建对应真实视频，从而摆脱对（粗、真）视频对的依赖。推理时丢弃 DINO-R2C，直接由真实粗视频驱动 C2R#。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果，仅声称无配对训练使模型可随任意真实视频语料规模扩展，而不再受限于合成配对视频，并承诺开源模型与项目主页。
AI.conclusion: 通过特征空间的图像级迁移加伪配对视频自监督，绕开配对视频数据瓶颈，为 C2R 视频生成提供可扩展的训练范式；有效性仍需论文实验数据佐证。

title: SLoSa: Small, Low-Power, and Safe Foundation Models for Robotic Task Planning
summary: Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset using classical planners, an advanced teacher LLM, and formal verifiers, followed by two training stages: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning guided by a verification-based reward machine to enforce safety alignment. We evaluate SLoSa across four Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) domains, two household simulation environments, local edge platforms, and a desktop robotic arm. Across the PDDL tasks, verifier-guided post-training raises the success rate of compact 4B-14B planners to 70.5-76.0%, while INT4 deployment on a Jetson Orin requires 17.85-26.41 W of average power. Results in household simulators and on the physical robot further demonstrate the applicability of SLoSa across diverse robotic task settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 SLoSa 神经-符号压缩与微调框架，训练小型、低功耗、安全感知的机器人任务规划基础模型：先用经典规划器+教师LLM+形式化验证器构建安全数据集，再经SFT与基于验证奖励机的RL微调，使4B-14B模型在PDDL域成功率达70.5-76.0%，INT4部署于Jetson Orin功耗17.85-26.41W。
AI.motivation: 经典规划器可提供形式化安全保证但输入格式僵硬、搜索代价随空间爆炸；LLM 接口灵活、泛化强但模型庞大、功耗高、缺乏机器人安全先验，难以在资源受限的机器人平台上本地部署。因此需要兼得形式化安全性与轻量化的规划器。
AI.method: 神经-符号压缩+微调框架：(1) 用经典规划器、先进教师 LLM 与形式化验证器自动构建安全感知数据集；(2) 两阶段训练——有监督微调（SFT）；(3) 以验证器构建的奖励机（reward machine）为引导的强化学习微调，实现安全对齐；(4) 紧凑模型（4B-14B）与 INT4 量化以适配边缘部署。
AI.result: 在四个 PDDL 域上，验证器引导的后训练将 4B-14B 紧凑规划器成功率提升至 70.5-76.0%；INT4 量化在 Jetson Orin 上平均功耗 17.85-26.41 W；在两类家庭仿真环境与真实桌面机械臂上验证了方法在多样机器人任务场景下的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 符号验证器+蒸馏+RL后训练可在保持安全约束满足的同时将 LLM 规划器压缩到边缘可部署规模；轻量级安全感知规划模型具备跨仿真与真实机械臂的实用性。

title: RoPT: Robust 6DoF Object Pose Tracking in Video
summary: Accurate 6-DoF object pose tracking is essential for robotic interaction, yet conventional monocular pipelines frequently suffer from catastrophic divergence under rapid object motion. We present RoPT, a robust tracking framework engineered to overcome this limitation by unifying visual perception, temporal kinematics, and global re-localization into a tightly coupled closed loop. Unlike existing open-loop trackers, RoPT delivers three critical capabilities that fundamentally alter system resilience. First, the visual perception component tracks object masks to robustly handle partial and severe occlusions. Second, a kinematic factor graph regularizes frame-to-frame updates, forecasts forward pose predictions, and drives a parallel multi-hypothesis verification scheme to bypass local minima. Finally, an active re-localization module transforms the pipeline into a closed-loop system, making it failure-aware and capable of deterministic self-recovery. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework across challenging benchmarks alongside real-world robotic demonstrations, achieving significantly higher tracking survivability under rapid motion.

AI.tldr: RoPT: 将视觉感知、时序运动学与全局重定位整合为紧耦合闭环的鲁棒6-DoF物体位姿跟踪框架，显著提升快速运动下的跟踪存活率。
AI.motivation: 单目6-DoF位姿跟踪在物体快速运动时易发生灾难性发散，现有开环跟踪器缺乏失效感知与自恢复能力，难以满足机器人交互需求。
AI.method: 三个组件：（1）基于物体掩码的视觉感知跟踪，可应对部分及严重遮挡；（2）运动学因子图正则化帧间更新、前向位姿预测，并驱动并行多假设验证以跳出局部极小；（3）主动重定位模块将流水线变为闭环系统，具备失效感知与确定性自恢复能力。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性基准与真实机器人演示中验证，快速运动下的跟踪存活率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 紧耦合"感知-时序预测-重定位"闭环设计可有效抑制快速运动下的位姿跟踪发散，为机器人交互提供更可靠的状态估计基础。摘要未给出定量指标与开源信息。

title: Can Quantum Layers offer Performance and Security Advantages in Vision-Language Models?
summary: As quantum computing moves from the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era toward early fault-tolerant quantum computing (EFTQC), quantum-enhanced AI is shifting from a conceptual idea to experimental research. Quantum components are expected to extend the capabilities of existing AI systems, yet it remains unclear how such components will help within large multimodal models. In this study, we try to answer that question for vision-language models (VLMs) using classically simulated quantum layers. With LLaVA-OneVision as the backbone, we evaluate 4- and 8-qubit basic-ring and strongly entangling circuits at four insertion and four replacement locations. Insertion adds quantum layers to the classical model, while replacement substitutes them for classical components. Using the same setup, we compare performance and computational cost between classical and quantum-classical hybrid models. On the Visual Spatial Reasoning dataset, inserting a quantum layer after the visual projector reaches 80.7% development accuracy, 2.28 percentage-points above classical full fine-tuning. Replacing the final decoder feed-forward sublayer retains 79.22% accuracy with 13.07 million fewer trainable parameters. Quantum insertion can thus improve accuracy, and selective replacement can reduce parameters. These benefits depend strongly on where the quantum layer is inserted or which classical component it replaces: earlier replacements lower accuracy, and fewer parameters do not reliably shorten training or reduce computation. To assess potential security benefits, we evaluated the robustness of quantum-classical hybrid models under six attack settings. Overall, our study maps where quantum layers help and hurt within VLMs, offering a starting point for hybrid VLM design; whether these gains generalize remains open. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 在LLaVA-OneVision视觉语言模型中，通过经典模拟的量子线路层进行插入/替换对比实验，考察量子层对VLM性能与参数量的影响及鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 量子计算由NISQ向早期容错（EFTQC）过渡，量子增强AI需从概念走向实验；但量子组件如何在大规模多模态模型中发挥作用尚不明确，缺乏系统性的位置/替换策略研究。
AI.method: 以LLaVA-OneVision为骨干，使用经典模拟的4比特/8比特基础环（basic-ring）与强纠缠（strongly entangling）线路；在4个插入位置和4个替换位置分别实验，比较经典模型与量子-经典混合模型的精度与计算开销；并在6种攻击设定下评估混合模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: Visual Spatial Reasoning数据集上，在视觉投影器后插入量子层取得80.7%验证精度，较经典全量微调高2.28个百分点；替换最后一个解码器FFN子层保留79.22%精度并减少1307万可训练参数。更早位置的替换会降低精度；参数减少并不稳定带来训练时长或计算量下降。
AI.conclusion: 量子层插入可提升精度，选择性替换可减少参数，但收益高度依赖插入/替换位置，安全性与效率优势有限；该工作给出混合VLM设计的初步位置图谱，泛化性仍待验证。

title: TEMPL: A Resource-Efficient and Transparent Model-Free Framework for Pseudo-Label Generation in Material CT Scans
summary: The scarcity of large annotated datasets limits deep learning (DL) segmentation in material CT analysis. DL-based pseudo-labeling can help, but it is often computationally expensive and hard to interpret. We introduce a multi-stage, model-free framework that generates pseudo-labels directly from grayscale CT scans. It combines thresholding, morphological dilation, and a custom breadth-first search region-growing algorithm to produce polygonal annotations without pre-trained weights, labeled data, or a GPU. We compare it against the zero-shot Segment Anything Model (SAM), a fully supervised 3D U-Net, and classical baselines. On a dendrite dataset with ground truth, our method reaches 63.19% IoU versus 10.74% for zero-shot SAM, with four times the instance recall at 0.5 IoU (33.3% versus 8.3%). The supervised 3D U-Net serves as a reference ceiling that requires expert labels. On a silica sand specimen, YOLO models trained on our labels performed comparably to models trained on SAM labels in a qualitative comparison. Across 1,053 extracted grains, the median equivalent diameter was 163.8 micrometers, near the specimen's known 106 to 150 micrometers sieve range, compared with 219.5 micrometers for SAM, whose labels merge adjacent particles and add spurious detections. A sensitivity analysis shows a stable operating range for the key threshold and a sharp, predictable failure point linked to phase contrast. Our method needs 15s per image on a standard CPU versus 28s for SAM on a GPU. These results support our transparent approach as a tool for annotation bootstrapping and microstructural quantification in resource-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多阶段、无需模型的伪标签框架，从灰度CT扫描直接生成多边形标注：阈值化+形态学膨胀+自定义BFS区域生长，无需预训练权重、标注数据或GPU。
