AI.motivation: 材料CT分割缺乏大标注数据集，深度学习伪标签方法计算开销大且可解释性差。
AI.method: 阈值化、形态学膨胀与自定义广度优先搜索区域生长算法组合，直接从灰度切片生成多边形伪标签；与零样本SAM、全监督3D U-Net及经典基线对比；含关键阈值敏感性分析与相衬失效点分析。
AI.result: 枝晶数据集上IoU 63.19%，零样本SAM仅10.74%；IoU=0.5实例召回33.3% vs 8.3%（4倍）。硅砂样本上训练YOLO与原SAM标签可比；1,053颗粒中位等效直径163.8μm，接近筛分区间106–150μm（SAM为219.5μm，存在合并与虚假检测）。CPU单图15s vs SAM GPU 28s。
AI.conclusion: 该透明、免训练、CPU可运行的方法适合作标注自举与受限资源下的微观结构定量分析工具，但适用范围受相衬条件约束。

title: MedBOE: Optimization-Based Estimation of Complete Patient Body Models from Whole-Body Medical Imaging
comment: Hoijoon Jung and Yuhao Wei contributed equally to this work
summary: True whole-body medical imaging captures a patient from head to toe and provides comprehensive anatomical and/or functional information. This coverage enables reconstruction of the external body surface, yielding patient body models. However, scanner geometry (e.g., bore diameter), patient characteristics, and positioning can leave body regions missing (e.g., lateral arms/torso, hands, forearms, elbows), producing incomplete patient body models. Such incompleteness limits downstream medical analyses, including derivation of body-habitus metrics (BHMs), such as body volume and surface area, for injected radiotracer activity regimens, cardiometabolic risk assessment, and computational anatomical modeling for medical imaging simulation and radiation dosimetry. We present the Medical Body model Optimization-based Estimator (MedBOE), an automated, training-free framework for estimating complete patient body models from whole-body images with missing body regions. Our innovation is to leverage the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) template, a parametric body mesh representing a broad range of body shapes and poses, in medical imaging. MedBOE aligns the SMPL template to the incomplete patient body models via attribute-guided optimization and estimates missing body regions through geometrically and volumetrically constrained deformation. We evaluated MedBOE using two public datasets: AutoPET (91 whole-body PET-CT images) and Human Implicit Tissues (HIT; 40 whole-body segmentations from MRI images). MedBOE achieved the best overall volumetric and geometric performance among evaluated methods. BHMs derived from MedBOE were within 2% error, suggesting low percentage errors for downstream analyses. MedBOE offers an automated, training-free method for estimating complete patient body models from whole-body images with missing body regions.

AI.tldr: MedBOE：无需训练的框架，用 SMPL 模板对齐不完整全身医学影像体表模型，通过属性引导优化与几何/体积约束变形补全缺失身体区域（如手臂、手部）。
AI.motivation: 全身医学影像因扫描孔径、患者体型与体位常缺失部分身体区域，导致体表模型不完整，进而影响体成分指标（体体积、表面积）计算、放射性示踪剂剂量方案、心血管代谢风险评估及计算解剖建模等下游分析。
AI.method: 引入参数化人体网格模板 SMPL 作为先验：(1) 属性引导优化将 SMPL 模板对齐到不完整患者体表模型；(2) 在几何与体积约束下进行变形，估计缺失身体区域，实现训练-free 的自动补全。
AI.result: 在 AutoPET（91 例全身 PET-CT）与 HIT（40 例 MRI 全身分割）两个公开数据集上取得最佳的整体体积与几何性能；由此导出的体成分指标误差在 2% 以内。
AI.conclusion: MedBOE 为不完整全身影像提供自动化、免训练的完整患者体模估计方案，若干下游分析误差较小。

title: T-DIG: Text-Conditioned Diversity for Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) platforms typically return several images per prompt so users can explore different visual interpretations and choose one that matches their intent. However, T2I models are usually optimized for single-image quality which comes at a cost of multi-image diversity, limiting this exploration. Diversity is also contextual: one user wants variations in background, while another wants them in artistic style, and the same user may later want variations in clothing. The generated images should differ along whatever axis the user cares about. In this paper, we introduce T-DIG, a text-conditioned diversity framework for image generation and editing. T-DIG is an iterative framework comprising multiple modules that lets users type prompts, inspect default generations, request variations using natural language, and continue refining outputs until they're satisfied. At its core, T-DIG uses an LLM policy that produces K axis-conditioned prompts or edit instructions for a frozen generator or editor. We train this policy with GRPO using a text-conditioned diversity reward and alignment penalties. Because the image generator remains frozen, T-DIG applies to open-weight, distilled, and proprietary models. We also release the first dataset for text-conditioned prompt diversity in image generation, with the training and validation splits built from human-written axes and a test set drawn from real user interactions with T-DIG. T-DIG far exceeds baselines in improving text-conditioned diversity, while preserving base-prompt alignment across a variety of metrics and human judgements. We show that user-directed diversity exploration can be added to a wide range of image generation models, open and closed, without the need to access their weights. Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: T-DIG：基于LLM策略与GRPO强化学习、在冻结生成器上实现"文本条件化多样性"的T2I生成/编辑框架，并发布首个文本条件化提示多样性数据集。
AI.motivation: T2I平台每次返回多张图供用户探索，但模型通常只针对单图质量优化，牺牲了多图多样性；且多样性是"上下文相关"的（用户可能只想在背景、风格或服装某一维度变化），现有方法无法沿用户关心的语义轴生成差异。
AI.method: T-DIG为迭代式人机交互框架：用户输入提示→查看默认生成→用自然语言要求变体→反复细化。核心是一个LLM策略，为冻结的图像生成器/编辑器产生K条"轴条件化"的提示或编辑指令；用GRPO训练该策略，奖励为文本条件化多样性奖励并加入与基础提示对齐的惩罚项。因生成器冻结，可适用于开源权重、蒸馏及闭源模型。同时构建了首个文本条件化提示多样性数据集（训练/验证集来自人工撰写的多样性轴，测试集来自真实用户交互）。
AI.result: 在多项指标与人工评测中，T-DIG大幅优于基线，显著提升文本条件化多样性，同时保持对原始基础提示的对齐度；可即插即用于多种开源与闭源生成/编辑模型而无需访问权重。
AI.conclusion: 用户导向的多样性探索可以作为一种"策略层"附加到广泛的图像生成模型上，无需修改模型权重，为可控生成提供了新的可控性维度。

title: Enhancing Cross-Grade Generalization in Banana Variety Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformers and Knowledge Self-Distillation
summary: In recent years, automated fruit classification systems have become a more critical component in precision agriculture for efficient yield estimation, quality control, and supply chain optimization. However, they still face significant challenges under varying quality, fruit maturity, illumination, texture degradation, morphological attributes, domain shift, and post-harvest handling conditions. In this study, we address the challenging issue of cross-grade banana variety classification. This is a real-world setting where models that have been trained on specific quality grades must generalize to unseen grades to handle significant domain shift. Under a rigorous Leave-One-Grade-Out evaluation protocol, we present a thorough comparative analysis of CNNs, ViTs, and dual-stream hybrid architectures using a large-scale dataset of 31,678 banana images with three varieties and three quality grades. Specifically, to address the drawbacks of single-paradigm frameworks, we present a dual-stream Swin ResNet hybrid framework enhanced with KL-divergence-based self-distillation to align probabilistic feature representations across the CNN and Transformer streams. Comprehensive experimental analyzes show that the presented hybrid framework with KL-divergence based self-distillation achieves better overall performance, i.e., it attains a mean accuracy of 81.25% and significantly surpasses CNN and Transformer baseline models. Qualitative analysis further confirms that the hybrid framework in this study improves discriminative feature transferability, improves attention localization, and stabilizes optimization.

AI.tldr: 针对跨等级香蕉品种分类的域偏移问题，在Leave-One-Grade-Out协议下系统比较CNN、ViT与双流混合架构，提出Swin-ResNet双流混合模型并用KL散度自蒸馏对齐两条流的概率特征表示，平均准确率81.25%。
AI.motivation: 自动化水果分级分类在精度农业中用于产量估计与质量控制，但在品质等级、成熟度、光照、纹理退化与采后处理造成的显著域偏移下泛化能力不足。作者关注真实场景下"训练于特定品质等级、测试于未见等级"的跨等级品种分类难题。
AI.method: 构建31,678张香蕉图像数据集（3个品种×3个品质等级），采用严格的Leave-One-Grade-Out评估协议；对比CNN、ViT及双流混合架构；提出双流Swin-ResNet混合框架，通过KL散度自蒸馏对齐CNN流与Transformer流的概率特征表示，以缓解单一范式的不足。
AI.result: 混合自蒸馏框架获得81.25%的平均准确率，显著优于CNN与Transformer基线；定性分析显示其提升判别性特征迁移能力、注意力定位质量及优化稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 双流CNN-Transformer混合加KL自蒸馏能有效应对跨等级域偏移的水果分类任务，为该类域泛化问题提供了可复用的比较基准与架构设计思路。

title: Single-Image Food Mass Estimators Do Not Transfer Their Gram Scale Across Datasets
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Code, set lists and model weights: this https URL
summary: Estimating food mass from a photograph is central to image-based dietary assessment, but whether trained models transfer to new cameras and foods is unclear. We fine-tuned DINOv2-base on 2,253 weighed Nutrition5k dishes to predict mass from one RGB photograph and compared it with a zero-shot vision-language model, Qwen3-VL-32B, on Nutrition5k and three external datasets: ASA24 studio portions, ECUSTFD whole foods and Food Portion Benchmark meal trays. In domain, the fine-tuned model's mean absolute error was 24.8 g, less than half of Qwen's. On external datasets it did not beat Qwen. For a food it had never seen, it ranked portions by size, but no better than a count of food pixels. Its gram scale was wrong in two ways: it changed with how much of the scene the photograph showed, and it was off by a different factor for each food. Training on other foods or trays from the tested dataset cut the external error by 38 to 65%. DINOv2-large, a larger backbone trained on the same dishes, did not reduce the external error. One labeled photograph of the same food cut the model's ASA24 error to 28.3 g, better than that photograph achieved alone. Prediction intervals that held the true mass for 90% of Nutrition5k dishes held it for at most half of external photographs. Nutrition5k often photographed the same plate several times, so a random test split shared near-identical photographs with training and overstated accuracy. Single-image mass estimators therefore need labeled photographs from the setting where they are used.

AI.tldr: 微调DINOv2-base从单张RGB图预测食物质量，域内MAE 24.8g但跨相机/跨食物不迁移；规模尺度随取景变化且因食物而异，零样本Qwen3-VL外域更稳。
AI.motivation: 图像式膳食评估需要从照片估计食物质量，但训练模型能否迁移到新相机、新食物和新餐具场景缺乏证据，且Nutrition5k常对同一餐盘多次拍摄易导致随机划分泄漏、高估精度。
AI.method: 在2,253份称重的Nutrition5k菜品上微调DINOv2-base（单图RGB→质量），与零样本Qwen3-VL-32B对比；在Nutrition5k及ASA24标准份量、ECUSTFD整体食物、Food Portion Benchmark餐盘三个外域数据集上评估；并检验DINOv2-large换骨干、外域少量标注图适配、按食物/餐盘再训练、预测区间覆盖率。
AI.result: 域内MAE 24.8g（不到Qwen一半），外域均不优于Qwen；未见食物的份量排序不优于像素计数；尺度随取景比例漂移且每种食物偏差因子不同；用测试域其他食物或餐盘训练可降外域误差38–65%；DINOv2-large无改善；同食物一张标注图使ASA24误差降至28.3g（优于该图零样本）；90%区间的真实覆盖在外域至多约50%。
AI.conclusion: 单图质量估计器存在严重的尺度歧义与食物特异偏差，通用骨干放大无益；需在实际部署域采集标注图做适配，并避免同盘多拍的随机划分。

title: PHD-Hand: A Printable Humanoid Dexterous Hand with Linkage-Driven 3-DOA Digits
comment: Submitted and Accepted at IEEE-RAS International Conference on Humanoid Robots (Humanoids 2026). 8 pages. Supplementary video: this https URL
summary: Currently, dexterous humanoid robot hands are widely considered the final hardware bottleneck that hampers generalist robots from physically assisting people at home and work. As conventional tendon-driven designs suffer from high cost, demanding maintenance, poor reliability, and short durability, alternative linkage-driven designs have increasingly gained attention. Despite their potential to avoid the weaknesses of tendon-driven hands, integrating multiple degrees of actuation (DOA) in a single digit with linkage drivetrains is a challenge for design and fabrication. Only a few studies have managed to present functional humanoid hands that are completely linkage-driven and have at least three DOAs per digit without compromising actuator placement and other design preferences. Our work introduces a new linkage-driven hand featuring a unique flexure hinge. Together with elastic drive rods made of spring steel, the linkage drivetrains are significantly simplified. Unlike other linkage-driven designs of similar dexterity, our design does not require many miniature moving parts. As a result, the hand can be fabricated easily with a budget 3D printer. This not only significantly lowers the barrier to entry for using and developing dexterous humanoid robot hand functions, but also allows the hands to be sized much closer to regular human hands. The design offers desirable kinematic advantages as well. A prototype is evaluated for grasping and object manipulation. In addition, this paper presents our latest findings on kinematics and control of the hand.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全连杆驱动灵巧人形手，采用独特柔性铰链与弹簧钢弹性驱动杆，简化传动结构，单指可实现≥3自由度，可用消费级3D打印机制造且尺寸接近人手。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动灵巧手成本高、维护难、可靠性差、寿命短；连杆驱动虽可规避这些缺点，但在单指内集成多自由度执行器（DOA）的设计与制造困难，现有完全连杆驱动且单指≥3 DOA的功能性人形手极少。
AI.method: 设计含独特柔性铰链（flexure hinge）的连杆驱动手，配合弹簧钢制成的弹性驱动杆显著简化连杆传动链，减少微小运动零件数量；降低制造门槛，可用预算级3D打印机加工，并使手部尺寸更接近真人手；同时给出运动学与控制的建模分析，制作样机进行抓取与物体操作评估。
AI.result: 样机在抓取与操作任务中完成评估，验证了设计的可行性与运动学优势；因结构简化而无需大量微型活动部件，制造简便、成本低、尺寸接近人手；论文还报告了运动学与控制方面的最新研究结果（摘要未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 连杆驱动配合柔性铰链与弹性驱动杆是实现低成本、易制造、高灵巧度人形手的可行路线，可显著降低灵巧手功能使用与开发的门槛，为通用机器人家庭/工作场景的物理辅助提供硬件基础。

title: HumanCentric-Scenes-AI: A Human-Curated Multimodal Dataset of AI-Generated Human-Centric Scenes Across Surveillance, Occupational Portraits, AI-Edited Images, and Short-Form Video
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Dataset: this https URL
summary: We introduce HumanCentric-Scenes-AI, a human-curated dataset of 296 AI-generated stimuli that depict people across four contexts in which people encounter AI-generated media. The Surveillance subset contains 85 AI-generated CCTV-style images. The Occupations subset contains 128 AI-generated occupational portraits in a balanced paired design covering 64 occupations with one female and one male version of each. The AI-edited subset contains 27 real photographs in which a region was altered or replaced by a generative model. The Video subset contains 56 AI-generated short videos. We curated the images and videos manually over multiple rounds to make them as photorealistic as possible. For each stimulus we release the file, the generation prompt where recorded, and per-stimulus metadata. We report depicted-gender distributions from an initial set of 134 generations without a specified gender and compare them with U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics occupational gender shares. We report edit-region size and its association with zero-shot detection difficulty for the AI-edited subset. We report image-quality distributions for the Surveillance subset and subject-category coverage for the Video subset. HumanCentric-Scenes-AI is intended first for human-perception research, and also for calibration of AI-detection classifiers and bias analysis of generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 HumanCentric-Scenes-AI：一个人工筛选的 296 条 AI 生成刺激数据集，涵盖监控（85 张）、职业肖像（128 张，64 职业×男女配对）、AI 编辑（27 张真实照片局部篡改）、视频（56 条短视频）四个场景，附文件、生成提示词与逐条元数据，并给出性别分布、编辑区域大小与零样本检测难度关联、图像质量分布等分析。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 生成媒体研究缺乏面向"人类感知"的、经过多轮人工挑选的高真实感刺激集；同时需要可校准 AI 检测器、并可分析生成模型职业性别偏见的受控数据。
AI.method: 人工多轮筛选生成结果以提升照片级真实感；构建四个子集（CCTV 风格监控、64 职业男女配对肖像、局部生成替换的真实照片、AI 短视频）；记录提示词与元数据；统计未指定性别生成下的性别分布并与 BLS 职业性别比例对比；分析编辑区域面积与零样本检测难度的关系。
AI.result: 给出各子集规模与构成、图像质量分布、视频主题覆盖情况；报告生成图像的性别分布与真实职业性别份额的差异，以及编辑区域越大越易被零样本检测器识别的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集主要服务于人类感知研究，并可作为 AI 检测分类器校准与生成模型偏见分析资源；属数据集/基准型工作，未提出新方法。

title: Weakly Supervised Fish Segmentation through Point-Supervised Tracking and Motion-Informed Language
comment: Accepted to IEEE OCEANS 2026 Monterey, 7 pages
summary: Understanding the properties of fish populations is increasingly important. Analyzing fish length, width, and mass is integral to maintaining healthy stock in the aquaculture industry, while counting wild fish populations supports marine conservation and coastal reef restoration efforts. Deep learning-based segmentation models offer a promising means of obtaining such information at scale. Most of these models, however, require costly and time-consuming per-pixel segmentation labels for training, which can take up to two minutes per fish to annotate manually. To address this inefficiency, we propose a weakly supervised segmentation pipeline that requires only point-labeled data (one click per fish) to produce accurate segmentation masks. Our pipeline consists of four stages. First, a point-supervised tracker predicts point annotations for each frame. These points are then converted into motion-informed language expressions, which guide a language-conditioned segmentation model (LMPM++) to capture temporal consistency and produce candidate segmentation masks. Finally, optical flow and background subtraction are applied as post-processing filters to suppress noise from incorrect segmentations. Experiments on the DeepFish dataset show improvement in foreground mean intersection over union (mIoU) as compared to baseline models.

AI.tldr: 提出弱监督鱼类分割流水线：仅需每鱼一次点击的点标注，经点监督跟踪器→运动感知语言表达式→语言条件分割模型(LMPM++)→光流与背景减除后处理，在DeepFish上前景mIoU优于基线。
AI.motivation: 鱼类体长/宽/质量分析支撑水产养殖，野鱼计数支撑海洋保护与珊瑚礁修复；但逐像素分割标注极昂贵（每条约2分钟），需降低标注成本。
AI.method: 四阶段弱监督分割：(1) 点监督跟踪器为每帧预测点标注；(2) 将点转化为运动感知（motion-informed）语言表达式；(3) 语言条件分割模型LMPM++利用时序一致性生成候选掩码；(4) 用光流与背景减除掉误分割噪声。
AI.result: DeepFish数据集上前景mIoU相较基线模型提升（摘要未给出具体数值），标注成本由逐像素降到单点点击。
AI.conclusion: 点监督+语言提示+运动先验的组合可显著降低鱼类分割标注成本并保持精度，但实验局限于单一数据集、缺乏量化指标与跨域/真实部署验证。

title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
comment: 20 pages (8-page main paper + supplementary material). Code: this https URL
summary: Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. The resulting model, OccJEPA (Occlusion-as-masking JEPA), is deterministic and 33.5x faster than the diffusion-based state of the art, and more accurate on SAIL-VOS, on TAO-Amodal, including a held-out test split (+4.00 AP50) and visible masks tracked by SAM2, and on Kubric. Controlled experiments trace the gain to the predictor's pre-trained weights rather than to its capacity, for world models from 87M to 1.85B parameters. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 将遮挡视为掩码：用预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 表示预测器填补被遮挡的时空 token，再由轻量解码头还原 amodal 掩码，实现确定性、比扩散方法快 33.5 倍的 amodal 视频分割。
AI.motivation: 现有 amodal 视频分割依赖微调的视频扩散模型，需要大量去噪步数、额外的深度网络，且每次采样结果随机不一致。作者观察到 JEPA 系自监督视频世界模型的预训练任务（由可见时空区域预测被遮蔽区域的表示）与"补全遮挡部分"高度同构，因此尝试直接复用该预训练能力。
AI.method: 提出 OccJEPA：先用可见掩码（含 SAM2 跟踪的可见掩码）确定物体可见区域，将掩码未覆盖的 token 丢弃，交给冻结/预训练的 V-JEPA 2.1 predictor 进行表示级补全；随后用一个轻量解码头把"观测到的特征 + 预测出的特征"共同解码为 amodal 掩码。整体为单次前向的确定性流程，无需扩散采样与深度估计。
AI.result: 相比扩散式 SOTA 确定性且速度提升 33.5 倍；在 SAIL-VOS、TAO-Amodal（含留出测试划分 +4.00 AP50）以及用 SAM2 跟踪的可见掩码与 Kubric 上均更准确。控制实验表明增益主要来自 predictor 的预训练权重而非模型容量，在 87M–1.85B 参数区间的世界模型上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视频世界模型的表示预测能力可高效替代扩散式生成用于遮挡补全，为 amodal 感知提供了一条简洁、可复现且显著提速的路线；遮挡—掩码等价性是可迁移的通用设计原则。

title: Causal world models under physical parameter shifts
summary: World models predict how embodied systems evolve under actions, but their accuracy can degrade when physical conditions move outside the training distribution. We study two components of causal modeling: which inputs a predictor may use, and how its mechanism computes their effects. In a synthetic benchmark with shortcut features, a frozen dependency mask derived from paired interventions reduces mean out-of-distribution (OOD) RMSE from 1.769 for a fully connected predictor to 0.697, close to the generator-oracle mask (0.694). For robot link-mass extrapolation in CausalWorld, with disjoint training and test mass ranges, we develop finger-local world models in which link masses enter inertia and dynamics-bias terms through explicit affine coefficients, actions act through either a learned torque network or the known PD controller, and learned residuals capture contact-related effects. Compared with a separately trained control whose mass inputs are fixed at training means, the known-PD model turns out-of-range masses into a consistent predictive gain: median time-averaged joint R2 over 150-step rollouts rises from 0.609 to 0.727, with improvement in all ten task-seed runs (exact two-sided sign test, p = 0.002). In a shared 100-step forecast, the learned-torque model is competitive with the strongest recurrent robotic world model (RWM) configuration (median joint R2 of 0.755 - 0.768 versus 0.752), whereas supplying out-of-range masses sharply degrades the MLP and recurrent predictors. These results indicate that how a physical parameter enters the dynamics mechanism determines whether its out-of-range value helps or harms prediction.

AI.tldr: 该文研究世界模型中"因果结构"的两个方面——允许使用的输入与机制如何利用输入——发现把质量等物理参数以显式解析方式嵌入动力学机制，可使分布外泛化显著改善。
AI.motivation: 具身世界模型在物理条件离开训练分布时精度下降；作者想了解因果建模中输入选择（依赖掩码）与机制形式（参数如何进入动力学）各自对OOD泛化的贡献。
AI.method: 1) 合成基准（含shortcut特征）：用配对干预导出的冻结依赖掩码，与全连接预测器对比；2) CausalWorld连杆质量外推：训练/测试质量区间不相交，构建finger-local世界模型，使连杆质量经显式仿射系数进入惯性与动力学偏置项，动作经学习扭矩网络或已知PD控制器，残差学习捕捉接触效应。
AI.result: 合成基准OOD RMSE由1.769降至0.697，接近生成器oracle掩码0.694。CausalWorld中已知PD模型在150步rollout中位时间平均关节R²由0.609升至0.727，10个任务-种子全改进（双侧符号检验p=0.002）；100步预测中学习扭矩模型中位R² 0.755–0.768，与最强RWM配置（0.752）相当，而向MLP/循环预测器直接喂入超范围质量会显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 物理参数如何进入动力学机制，决定其超范围取值是有益还是有害；结构化的因果机制比单纯扩展输入更利于OOD泛化。

title: ReSeg: Retraining-free segmentation of abdominal organs via generalizable semantic representation learning
summary: Abdominal organ segmentation is essential in modern medical applications. While existing deep learning approaches demonstrate promising performance, their heavy reliance on large-scale image data raises concerns over generalization capability and privacy risks. This motivates the development of generalizable segmentation training paradigms based on domain-randomized image synthesis, facilitating generalization across unseen real image domains. However, existing paradigms either suffer from limited segmentation performance when applied to abdominal organs, or require dataset-specific finetuning. To address these limitations, we propose ReSeg, a novel two-stage retraining-free framework for domain-agnostic zero-shot abdominal organ segmentation. At the first stage, our organ-agnostic synthetic data-driven pretraining approach exploits semantically and visually diverse synthetic images generated by a dedicated data engine to optimize a Generalizable Semantic Representation Network (GSRNet). The network is thereby capable of learning semantic features robust against variations in anatomical structure, imaging contrast, resolution and spatial context, which provide universal representation capabilities that serve as a foundation for segmentation learning. Subsequently, in the second stage, we continue to train an Organ-specific Encoder-decoder Segmentation Network (OESNet), whose encoder is initialized with the pretrained weights. This training process is facilitated by another dedicated data engine, which generates diversified visual images while strictly retaining the inherent spatial layout of abdominal organs. Comprehensive evaluation on seven abdominal organ segmentation datasets across three different modalities including CT, MRI, and PET demonstrates that ReSeg consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods while eliminating the need for real training images.

AI.tldr: 提出ReSeg：两阶段、免重训练（retraining-free）的域随机合成数据驱动腹部器官零样本分割框架，第一阶段用器官无关合成数据预训练通用语义表示网络GSRNet，第二阶段用保留器官空间布局的多样化合成数据训练器官特定编解码网络OESNet，在7个数据集、CT/MRI/PET三种模态上超越SOTA且无需真实训练图像。
AI.motivation: 现有腹部器官分割深度学习方法依赖大规模真实图像，存在泛化性差与隐私风险；已有基于域随机化合成图像的训练范paradigm在腹部器官上分割性能有限或需数据集特定微调。
AI.method: 两阶段免重训练框架：(1) 专用数据引擎生成语义与视觉多样化的器官无关合成图像，预训练GSRNet以学习对解剖结构、成像对比度、分辨率与空间上下文变化鲁棒的通用语义表示；(2) 以GSRNet权重初始化OESNet编码器，借助另一数据引擎生成严格保留腹部器官空间布局的多样化视觉图像进行训练，OESNet为器官特定编解码分割网络。
AI.result: 在CT、MRI、PET三种模态共7个腹部器官分割数据集上全面评估，ReSeg一致优于现有SOTA方法，且训练过程完全无需真实影像数据。
AI.conclusion: 域随机化合成数据配合"通用语义预训练+器官特定分割训练"的两阶段设计，可实现域无关、零样本、免微调的腹部器官分割，并具备跨模态泛化能力，为隐私友好、免真实数据的医学分割提供可行范式。

title: UNIVERS: Learning UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis for generalizable one-shot landmark localization
summary: One-shot landmark localization in volume scans with varying fields of view (FOVs) is challenging. While existing self-supervised learning methods have shown promising performance, they rely on contrastive learning built upon augmented views of the same image, which inherently limits their generalization in cross-modality scenarios. This motivates research on cross-modality embedding learning using paired multi-modality images. However, existing methods suffer from not only limited training data, but also the requirement of multi-stage iterative training. To address these limitations, we propose UNIVERS, an end-to-end trainable framework that learns UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis. Our framework leverages diverse pseudo-data synthesized from organ shape templates, with randomization applied to semantic layout, visual appearance, FOV, and spatial pose. Coupled with cross-domain discriminative voxel-wise contrastive learning, this domain randomization strategy forces the network to disregard domain-specific biases and learn features that are robust against variations in imaging contrast, resolution, and spatial context. Consequently, the trained model enables one-shot landmark localization in multi-modality volume scans with arbitrary FOVs. In this study, the efficacy of the proposed method is demonstrated by applying it to the task of localizing the adrenal glands, which are paired, small, and irregular endocrine organs. In particular, comprehensive experiments are conducted on three challenging adrenal gland datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that UNIVERS consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) one-shot landmark localization approaches, with particularly prominent advantages in cross-modality scenarios. The source code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: UNIVERS: 通过随机合成数据的域随机化 + 跨域体素级对比学习，端到端训练通用体素嵌入，实现任意FOV、跨模态体数据的一次性(one-shot)地标定位，并在肾上腺定位任务上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有one-shot地标定位的自监督方法依赖同一图像增强视图的对比学习，跨模态泛化差；改用配对多模态图像做跨模态嵌入学习又受限于训练数据稀缺与多阶段迭代训练。作者希望用可无限合成的伪数据替代配对真实数据，并实现端到端训练。
AI.method: 基于器官形状模板随机合成伪体数据，随机化语义布局、视觉外观、FOV与空间位姿；结合跨域判别式体素级对比学习，迫使网络忽略域特有偏置，学习对成像对比度、分辨率、空间上下文变化鲁棒的特征；整体为端到端可训练框架。
AI.result: 在三个具挑战性的肾上腺（成对、小尺度、形状不规则内分泌器官）数据集上，UNIVERS 一致优于SOTA one-shot地标定位方法，跨模态场景优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 域随机化合成数据可替代配对多模态真实数据，支撑跨模态一次性地标定位；方法面向医学体数据，代码开源。

title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling with Uncertain Forward Models
summary: Diffusion posterior samplers reconstruct signals by combining a pretrained diffusion prior with a measurement likelihood specified by a forward model and a noise model. Calibration and reference data can characterize uncertainty in the forward model's parameters, such as blur kernels or detector responses. Fixing these parameters at estimated values leaves their uncertainty out of the likelihood, and parameter errors are thus absorbed into the reconstruction. We introduce an uncertainty-aware likelihood (UAL), a Gaussian approximation to the marginal likelihood obtained by integrating over the uncertain parameters. For each candidate signal, UAL propagates parameter uncertainty into a structured measurement covariance, reducing the quadratic penalty along residual directions that parameter variation can explain. Existing samplers can use UAL in their data updates while retaining their pretrained diffusion priors and sampling schedules. Under a fixed Gaussian nuisance model, we bound likelihood error from linearization and average divergence between the exact marginal and UAL posteriors. We compare samplers with and without UAL across six inverse problems spanning Gaussian and motion deblurring, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and fluorescence microscopy, and find improvements in reconstruction and ensemble prediction. UAL reduces geometric mean MSE by 9% to 20% across samplers in the main Gaussian-deblurring setting and by 51% to 92% in motion deblurring when non-blind samplers use the population-mean kernel. In motion deblurring, DAPS and PnP-DM with UAL also give 6.2 to 6.4 dB higher ensemble-mean PSNR than published BlindDPS and Fast Diffusion EM. On the ablation set, UAL outperforms trace-matched isotropic inflation for PnP-DM in both deblurring tasks; in motion deblurring, it also exceeds the best-tested fixed scalar data weighting by 3.3 dB for PnP-DM and 4.2 dB for DAPS in average PSNR.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性感知似然（UAL）：对不确定的正演参数（模糊核、探测器响应）做边缘化，用高斯近似得到结构化测量协方差，可直接嵌入现有扩散后采样器的数据更新。理论给出线性化与 KL 散度界，在6类逆问题（高斯/运动去模糊、CT、MRI、超声、荧光显微）上稳定提升重建与集成预测指标。
AI.motivation: 扩散后验采样依赖前向模型与噪声模型给出似然，但模糊核、探测器响应等前向参数通常只有估计值；直接固定这些值会把参数误差吸收进重建结果，导致不确定性未被建模与残差不确定。
AI.method: 构造 UAL：对候选信号把参数不确定性积分/边缘化为结构化测量协方差（Gaussian 近似边际似然），沿参数变化可解释的残差方向降低二次惩罚；保持预训练扩散先验与采样时间表不变，仅替换数据更新项。理论上在高斯 nuisance 模型下给出线性化误差界与精确边际后验和 UAL 后验的平均散度界；消融对比 trace-matched 各向同性膨胀与固定标量数据加权。
AI.result: 高斯去模糊主设定下各采样器几何平均 MSE 降低 9%–20%；运动去模糊中非盲采样器使用总体均值核时降低 51%–92%；运动去模糊中 DAPS/PnP-DM+UAL 的集成均值 PSNR 比 BlindDPS、Fast Diffusion EM 高 6.2–6.4 dB；消融中优于各向同性膨胀，并在运动去模糊平均 PSNR 上比最佳固定标量加权高 3.3 dB（PnP-DM）与 4.2 dB（DAPS）。
AI.conclusion: 将前向参数不确定性显式传播进似然是低成本、即插即用的改进，可提升扩散后验采样在多种成像逆问题中的精度与集成预测校准；仍受限于高斯 nuisance 假设与线性化近似。

title: From Canon to Nikon: Camera Domain Shift and Potential Equity Implications in Retinal AI
summary: Diabetic retinopathy is a leading cause of preventable blindness, yet access to regular screening remains limited worldwide. AI offers a scalable approach, but its performance can be sensitive to image quality and acquisition conditions. In a Brazilian cohort of 8,524 patients, retinal images acquired with the Nikon NF5050 were more than twice as likely to have inadequate image quality compared with those acquired with the Canon CR-2, despite refurbished Canon systems costing more than twice as much as Nikon systems. This potential cost-quality trade-off highlights an important consideration for the reliability of AI systems deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. Using a frozen pretrained retinal foundation model, we systematically evaluate whether camera-associated performance differences persist across 12 retinal disease classification tasks, four input resolutions, and five downstream classifiers. We find that camera-associated performance differences vary substantially across tasks, and that neither higher input resolution nor classifier choice consistently mitigates cross-camera variation. These findings identify camera platform as a potentially overlooked source of performance variability, with implications for the safety and reliability of retinal AI when deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. We release all source code, evaluation scripts, and per-task results on GitHub to support reproducible benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 在8,524名巴西患者队列中比较Nikon NF5050与Canon CR-2眼底图像质量，并用冻结的视网膜基础模型在12个疾病分类任务、4种分辨率、5种下游分类器下系统评估相机平台带来的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变筛查可及性不足，AI虽可规模化但性能对图像质量与采集条件敏感；不同成像硬件之间存在成本-质量权衡，相机平台可能是被忽视的性能变异来源。
AI.method: 回顾性队列统计（图像质量不达标率对比）；使用冻结的预训练视网膜基础模型做特征提取，在12个视网膜疾病分类任务、4种输入分辨率与5种下游分类器上做系统化的跨相机基准评测，并公开代码与逐任务结果。
AI.result: Nikon NF5050采集图像质量不达标的概率是Canon CR-2的两倍以上，而翻新Canon系统价格亦为Nikon的两倍以上；相机相关性能差异随任务显著变化，提高输入分辨率或更换分类器均无法稳定消除跨相机差异。
AI.conclusion: 相机平台是视网膜AI部署中潜在被忽视的性能变异来源，对异构成像系统下的安全性与可靠性有直接影响；作者开源全部代码、评测脚本与逐任务结果以支持可复现基准。

title: DriftNeRF: Cross-Ray Density Drifting for Sparse-View Neural Radiance Fields
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) synthesize photorealistic novel views from dense image collections, but degrade sharply when few views are available. We attribute a specific, measurable defect to the objective itself: the rendering loss is a sum over independent rays and contains no term comparing densities that different rays assign to the same region of space, so nearby 3D points can settle on contradictory densities while every training pixel is reproduced correctly. We make this quantity explicit by measuring cross-ray density disagreement directly during training, and show that it stays high in vanilla NeRF, falls only incidentally under frequency-based regularization, and moves together with held-out quality in the sparse regime. We then close the gap with DriftNeRF, a drop-in regularizer that instantiates the drifting-field template on density samples: a masked exponential kernel aggregates densities from nearby points on other rays into a stop-gradient consensus target, and the resulting drifting field penalizes unsupported disagreement while leaving agreed-upon boundaries intact. The regularizer reads only sampled positions, ray identifiers, and predicted densities, so it requires no pretrained model, external geometry, or additional images, and transfers across field parameterizations. On NeRF-Synthetic it reduces residual disagreement by an order of magnitude, and across NeRF-Synthetic, DTU, and LLFF it improves 3-view PSNR over the strongest MLP-NeRF baseline by 0.42-0.65 dB and remains competitive with sparse-view Gaussian pipelines under a matched protocol without their depth, flow, or covisibility preprocessing.

AI.tldr: DriftNeRF：指出稀疏视图NeRF退化的根因是独立射线求和损失缺少跨射线密度一致性项，提出跨射线密度分歧度量并用以设计即插即用正则器。
AI.motivation: NeRF在稠密视图下效果良好，但少视图时显著退化。作者将这一缺陷归因于优化目标本身：渲染损失是对独立射线的求和，不含比较不同射线对同一空间区域密度赋值的项，导致相邻3D点可在每个训练像素都被正确重建的同时收敛到相互矛盾的密度。
AI.method: 1）显式量化跨射线密度分歧，并证明其在原始NeRF中持续偏高、在频率类正则下仅偶然下降、且在稀疏情形下与留出视图质量同向变化；2）提出DriftNeRF：在密度采样上实例化drifting-field模板，用掩码指数核对其他射线上邻近点的密度做聚合，形成stop-gradient共识目标，惩罚无支撑的分歧而保留一致的边界。仅依赖采样位置、射线ID与预测密度，无需预训练模型、外部几何或额外图像，可跨场参数化迁移。
AI.result: 在NeRF-Synthetic上将残余分歧降低一个数量级；在NeRF-Synthetic、DTU、LLFF上，3视图PSNR比最强MLP-NeRF基线提升0.42–0.65 dB；在匹配协议下与稀疏视图高斯类流水线竞争力相当，且不使用其深度、光流或共视预处理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把稀疏视图NeRF的退化从经验现象提升为可度量的目标函数缺陷，并给出轻量、无需额外监督的一致性正则方案，对稀疏视图前馈/逐场景重建有工具性参考价值。

title: PhyMo: Learning Physical Dynamics with Accurate and Continuous Motion from Multi-View Videos
summary: Recovering dynamic 3D scene geometry, appearance, and the physical motion states that govern scene evolution from multi-view videos is important yet challenging. A key difficulty is that appearance can be deceptive. Under rendering supervision alone, a model may fit the observed images by changing color or opacity to compensate for inaccurate deformation, rather than recovering the true evolving geometry and motion. This issue is especially severe in scenes with fast or locally complex motion, where inaccurate trajectories can still produce plausible images over the observed frames, but lead to unreliable reconstruction and discontinuous future prediction. In this paper, we propose PhyMo, a framework for learning evolving dynamics from multi-view videos. We introduce a Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation that drives the model to recover accurate motion from deformation, rather than relying on appearance shortcuts to explain observed motion. On top of this, we propose a Continuous Motion Evolution module with bidirectional kinematic continuity constraint to promote temporally consistent evolution of displacement, velocity, and acceleration. Together, these designs yield geometrically faithful interpolation and continuous motion extrapolation. Experiments on four dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: PhyMo：用运动感知轨迹表示+连续运动演化（双向运动学连续性约束）从多视角视频学习动态场景的几何、外观与物理运动状态，避免外观"捷径"补偿形变误差，实现几何忠实的插值与连续外推，在四个动态场景基准上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 仅靠渲染监督时，模型可通过改变颜色/不透明度来补偿不准确的形变，从而拟合观测图像，而非恢复真实几何与运动；在快速或局部复杂运动场景中尤为严重，导致轨迹不精确、重建不可靠、未来预测不连续。
AI.method: 提出 Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation，驱动模型从形变中恢复准确运动而非依赖外观捷径；并设计 Continuous Motion Evolution 模块，引入对位移、速度、加速度的双向运动学连续性约束，促进时间一致演化。
AI.result: 在四个动态场景基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，实现几何忠实的插值与连续的运动外推。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模位移-速度-加速度的运动学一致性可有效抑制外观捷径，提升动态场景重建与运动预测的时空可靠性。

title: WaFIR: Wavelet-Fourier Mixture-of-Experts with Subband-Adaptive Routing for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration
comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Blind all-in-one image restoration must adapt a shared model to heterogeneous and sometimes mixed degradations without a task label at test time. We introduce WaFIR, a decoder module that decomposes features into Haar subbands, summarizes each subband with a compact Fourier descriptor, and routes it to prompt-conditioned spectral modulation experts. Unlike image-level frequency conditioning, WaFIR makes routing decisions at the subband level, enabling frequency-specific processing while retaining the task context learned by the backbone. Under a unified training and evaluation protocol for denoising, deraining, and dehazing, WaFIR improves average PSNR over the three tasks by 0.48 dB over the PromptIR baseline and by 0.38 dB over the recent Up-Restorer. Matched-capacity and routing controls show that the gain is not explained by additional parameters alone. On unseen noise intensities, descriptor-based routing is more robust than a discrete label-conditioned alternative and remains on par under compound degradations, while routing analyses show stable subband-dependent expert use across degradation types. These results support subband frequency structure as an interpretable complement to prompt-based conditioning for blind image restoration. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: WaFIR：在解码器中做Haar子带分解+Fourier描述子驱动的频带级专家路由，用于无任务标签的盲一体化图像复原。
AI.motivation: 盲一体化复原需要单一模型在测试时无任务标签地处理异构甚至混合退化；已有prompt方法（PromptIR等）仅在图像级做频率/prompt条件化，缺乏频带特异的处理与可解释的路由依据。
AI.method: 解码器模块：将特征分解为Haar子带 → 每个子带用紧凑Fourier描述子做汇总 → 依据描述子路由到多个prompt条件化的频谱调制专家；路由在子带级别而非图像级别，从而在保留backbone任务上下文的同时实现频带特异处理。统一训练/评测协议覆盖去噪、去雨、去雾。
AI.result: 三任务平均PSNR较PromptIR +0.48 dB、较Up-Restorer +0.38 dB；等容量与路由消融表明增益非单纯来自参数增加；未见噪声强度下描述子路由比离散标签条件化更鲁棒，复合退化下持平；路由分析显示跨退化类型存在稳定的子带依赖专家使用模式。
AI.conclusion: 子带频率结构可作为prompt条件化的可解释补充，提升盲图像复原的泛化与鲁棒性；代码已开源。

title: Learning to Absorb Corrections: Critic-Weighted Residual Flow for Vision-Based Insertion
summary: Vision-based insertion requires correcting alignment errors while retaining useful behavior learned from demonstrations. We present ACT--Flow, an online learning framework that couples an adaptive Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) with a conditional residual flow policy. Following anchor-guided warmup, ACT absorbs successful executed actions through behavioral cloning, while residual targets are recomputed relative to the updated prior. A chunk-level critic learns from successful and failed interactions and evaluates final composed actions. Its estimates weight generated residual candidates for flow matching, complemented by supervision from successful real executions. Candidate scoring is confined to training; deployment uses RGB observations and samples one residual per action chunk. We evaluate the framework on power-plug, USB, and key insertion, together with cable routing and needle threading. Results show a five-task mean success rate of 66% at 20,000 post-initialization interaction steps, exceeding the strongest baseline by 18 percentage points at this checkpoint. Evaluations at matched checkpoints with the residual disabled show ACT's mean success increasing from 16% to 76%. Component ablations further support the complementary roles of behavior absorption, value weighting, and successful-action supervision.

AI.tldr: ACT--Flow：自适应ACT+条件残差流策略的在线学习框架，锚点引导预热后吸收成功动作并重算残差目标，分块critic对组合动作打分以加权流匹配候选，5任务（插电/USB/钥匙/线缆/穿针）20k步平均成功率66%，比最强基线高18个百分点；禁用残差时ACT从16%升至76%。
AI.motivation: 视觉伺服插入任务中存在位姿对齐误差，纯行为克隆（ACT）虽能保留示范行为但缺乏在线纠错能力，而残差强化学习类方法又易破坏已学到的好策略。目标是既保留示范先验，又在真实交互中持续提升细粒度插入精度。
AI.method: 采用分层残差结构：自适应Action Chunking Transformer作为先验基策略，条件残差流策略在动作块级别生成修正候选；通过锚点引导预热稳定初始化；执行成功的动作回灌至ACT（行为吸收/克隆），并按更新后的先验重算残差标签；分块级critic由成功与失败交互学习，其估计用于对残差候选加权（value weighting）以进行流匹配，并辅以成功真实执行监督；候选打分仅在训练期使用，部署时仅依赖RGB观测、每个动作块采样一个残差。
AI.result: 在power-plug、USB、钥匙插入、线缆布线、穿针五个真实任务上，初始化后20,000步交互时平均成功率66%，较最强基线高18个百分点；相同检查点下关闭残差时ACT平均成功率仅16%，启用后达76%。消融实验验证行为吸收、价值加权与成功动作监督三部分互补有效。
AI.conclusion: 将在线残差细化与示范先验解耦并结合值函数加权筛选候选，是在线视觉伺服插入的有效范式；训练期critic、部署期轻量采样（仅RGB+单残差）的设计兼顾了性能与实时性。

title: Two for One: Privileged Learning for Resource-Constrained Screening
summary: Machine learning systems are often developed under data-rich conditions but deployed when only incomplete information is available. A natural example arises in colour fundus photography (CFP), where both eyes are commonly imaged because they can provide complementary information for ocular disease assessment. Prior approaches that exploit bilateral information either fuse both eyes in a single model or use knowledge distillation to compress a dual-eye teacher into a lightweight student that still requires both images at test time. However, bilateral acquisition may not always be feasible. We thus propose a privileged learning framework in which a teacher model has access to bilateral CFP images during training and learns representations informed by information from both eyes, while the student is trained to transfer this knowledge from the bilateral teacher using only a single-eye image as input. At inference, the student operates exclusively on this single-eye input and does not require the contralateral image. Experimental results show consistent improvements in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve over conventional monocular training, with the largest gains observed for left-eye images for the detection of age-related macular degeneration (0.931 vs. 0.966) and diabetic retinopathy (0.789 vs. 0.836).%, while requiring only a single-eye image at inference. By enabling models to benefit from bilateral information during training while requiring only a single-eye image at inference, our approach may support more reliable deployment in resource-constrained clinical and screening environments.

AI.tldr: Privileged learning framework: a bilateral CFP teacher (both eyes during training) distills into a student that uses only a single-eye image at inference, improving AUC for AMD and DR detection over monocular training.
AI.motivation: Bilateral fundus imaging provides complementary cues for ocular disease assessment, but dual-eye acquisition is not always feasible at deployment. Existing dual-eye fusion and dual-eye teacher-to-student distillation still require both images at test time, so the authors seek a student that exploits bilateral knowledge but runs monocularly.
AI.method: Privileged (learning using privileged information) distillation: a teacher is trained on paired bilateral CFP images and learns bilateral-informed representations; a monocular student is trained to transfer this knowledge while taking only one eye image as input. At inference the student uses a single-eye image only, requiring no contralateral image.
AI.result: Consistent AUC gains over conventional monocular training across tasks, largest for left-eye images: AMD 0.931 → 0.966 and diabetic retinopathy 0.789 → 0.836, with only single-eye input at inference.
AI.conclusion: Privileged bilateral-to-monocular distillation lets models benefit from bilateral supervision during training while remaining monocular at deployment, supporting more reliable use in resource-constrained clinical and screening settings.

title: DGCM-SSFA: Dual-Granularity Cross-Modulation and Sparse Strip Frequency Attention for Efficient 3T-to-7T MRI Synthesis
summary: Synthesizing high-fidelity 7T MRI from routinely acquired 3T scans offers a practical pathway to enhanced neuroimaging without the prohibitive cost of ultra-high-field scanners. While existing deep learning approaches have achieved promising results, state-of-the-art methods typically rely on either large-scale architectures exceeding 45 million parameters or computationally intensive ensemble strategies, limiting their practicality in resource-constrained clinical environments. In this work, we propose a compact multi-domain attention framework, termed DGCM-SSFA, that achieves competitive synthesis quality with only 11M parameters. The proposed architecture integrates two complementary modules into a U-Net Transformer backbone. First, a Dual-Granularity Cross-Modulated Feature Modulator (DGCM) is embedded at multiple hierarchical levels to enhance local edge and texture details through Sobel-guided spatial attention and depthwise frequency-aware channel attention with cross-branch gating. Second, a Sparse Strip Frequency Attention (SSFA) module at the bottleneck captures global spatial context via strip-pooled attention with near-linear complexity, while simultaneously performing FFT-based spectral modulation in the frequency domain. These two modules operate synergistically with the backbone's native channel attention, forming a triple-granularity feature refinement pipeline. Extensive experiments on the UNC and BNU 3T-to-7T MRI datasets across T1w and T2w modalities demonstrate that DGCM-SSFA achieves strong structural fidelity, attaining an SSIM of 0.8431 on BNU T2w---approaching the best benchmark value of 0.8624---and 0.8100 on BNU T1w, while using substantially fewer parameters than Transformer-based alternatives such as ResViT (123.4M) and FS-RWKV (45.4M).

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑型多域注意力框架 DGCM-SSFA（11M 参数），在 U-Net Transformer 主干中融合双粒度交叉调制模块与稀疏条带频率注意力，实现 3T→7T MRI 合成，性能接近大规模基准模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 3T→7T MRI 合成方法依赖超过 45M 参数的大模型或计算昂贵的集成策略，难以在资源受限的临床环境部署，因此需要轻量高效的高保真合成方案。
AI.method: 以 U-Net Transformer 为骨干：在多层级嵌入 Dual-Granularity Cross-Modulated Feature Modulator（DGCM），通过 Sobel 引导空间注意力与深度可分离频率感知通道注意力及跨分支门控增强局部边缘纹理；在瓶颈层引入 Sparse Strip Frequency Attention（SSFA），用条带池化注意力以近线性复杂度建模全局上下文，并同时进行 FFT 频谱调制；与主干原生通道注意力协同构成三重粒度特征精炼流程。
AI.result: 在 UNC 与 BNU 的 3T→7T 数据集（T1w、T2w）上验证：BNU T2w 的 SSIM 达 0.8431（最优基准 0.8624），BNU T1w 为 0.8100，参数量仅 11M，显著低于 ResViT（123.4M）与 FS-RWKV（45.4M）。
AI.conclusion: 轻量多域注意力设计可在参数量大幅缩减的前提下接近甚至比肩重型 Transformer 合成模型，为资源受限场景的超高场 MRI 合成提供可行路径；但属于医学影像域适配任务，与通用视觉/具身智能主线关联较弱。

title: State-Dependent Objective Coordination for End-to-End Balance and Navigation
summary: Traditional robotic navigation systems separate mapping, planning, and low-level control through cascaded modules, introducing computational overhead and accumulated latency. End-to-end reinforcement learning offers a compact unified policy that maps onboard observations directly to control actions. However, on inherently unstable platforms such as two-wheeled inverted-pendulum robots, navigation progress and obstacle avoidance can conflict with attitude stabilization in a strongly state-dependent manner. We propose a lightweight state-dependent objective coordination method for integrated navigation and control. A pitch-conditioned scalarization coefficient $\beta(s)\in[0,1]$ adjusts the relative contributions of balance stabilization and navigation objectives during training, without extra control hierarchies or auxiliary attitude-stabilization controllers, such as proportional-integral-derivative (PID) or linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) controllers. To support zero-shot deployment, simulation training models execution delay, action hold, asynchronous and noisy observations, and dynamics uncertainty. Gradient analysis reveals persistent directional interference and state-dependent variation in the objectives' relative scales. Comparisons with alternative reward-weighting, constraint, training, and control-structure strategies show that PPO+$\beta(s)$, where PPO denotes proximal policy optimization, achieves 98% and 95% success rates with small attitude excursions on the fixed obstacle map and the randomly generated high-obstacle-density map, respectively. Zero-shot hardware experiments further demonstrate bounded attitude behavior and consistent obstacle avoidance using only onboard observations. Training and evaluation code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于俯仰角条件化的标量化系数 β(s) 的轻量状态依赖目标协调方法，用单一 PPO 策略统一两轮倒立摆机器人的导航与姿态稳定，无需 PID/LQR 等辅助控制器，并实现零样本实车部署。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人导航将建图、规划与底层控制分级联级，带来计算开销与累积时延；端到端 RL 可给出紧凑统一策略，但在两轮倒立摆等本质不稳定平台上，导航推进/避障与姿态稳定之间存在强状态依赖的冲突。作者希望不引入额外控制层级或辅助稳定器的前提下解决该多目标冲突。
AI.method: 设计俯仰角条件化的标量化系数 β(s)∈[0,1]，在训练时动态调节平衡稳定目标与导航目标的相对权重；仿真训练中显式建模执行延迟、动作保持、异步且含噪观测与动力学不确定性以支持零样本部署；并通过梯度分析刻画两目标的方向性干扰与相对尺度随状态变化的问题，与多种奖励加权、约束式、训练方式及控制结构策略进行对比。
AI.result: PPO+β(s) 在固定障碍地图与随机生成的高障碍密度地图上分别取得 98% 与 95% 成功率，且姿态偏移较小；零样本实车实验仅用机载观测即实现有界姿态与稳定避障。梯度分析显示目标间存在持续的方向性干扰及随状态变化的相对尺度差异。
AI.conclusion: 状态依赖的目标协调可在不增加控制层级或辅助姿态控制器的情况下，让单一端到端策略同时兼顾导航与平衡，并具备零样本真机泛化能力；属于面向不稳定平台的实用 sim-to-real 控制贡献，但平台单一、场景为中低复杂度导航，未涉及复杂操作或多模态感知。

title: From Augmentation to Synthetic Evidence: Evaluating Generated Chest Radiographs at Dataset Intake
summary: A generated chest radiograph can be useful as declared augmentation, but the same image becomes unsupported evidence when submitted as the record of a real examination. We study this problem by separating three questions: whether an image passes an automated quality check, whether an origin classifier flags it as generated, and whether a trusted record supports the claimed acquisition. In our experiments, Qwen selects up to 20 images from pools of 1,000 existing Cheff-identified or SynthCheX candidates. A receiver evaluates quality with MedGemma and predicted origin with a classifier on frozen DINOv3 features. Quality-based selection raises quality passes from 12 to 19 of 20 for Cheff-identified images and from 8 to 17 for SynthCheX. We find no evidence that selection improves passage through both checks: no selected Cheff-identified image passes both, while uniform, quality, and quality-constrained surrogate selection produce 2, 1, and 2 SynthCheX passes. On unprocessed test images, the origin classifier flags 4,677 of 5,000 SynthCheX images, but it also misclassify 110 of 2,297 NIH (real) images and 568 of 957 genuine images from another collection as fake. Our results further show that JPEG compression reduces SynthCheX-versus-NIH AUROC from 0.987 to 0.841. Even without processing, 152 SynthCheX images pass both pixel checks. These checks can filter submissions, but they cannot verify an acquisition claim. We strongly advocate that source and intended use must be recorded and checked separately for admission of chest radiographs in medical datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文区分图像质量检查、生成来源分类与采集记录核验三个问题，实验显示质量筛选无法同时通过来源检测，且生成图像可无处理地通过像素级检查；作者主张医学数据集中须单独记录并核查来源与用途。
AI.motivation: 生成的胸部X线图像作为声明的数据增强是有用的，但若被当作真实检查记录提交则成为无依据的证据。现有自动质量检查与来源分类器是否能共同支撑"采集声明"尚不清楚，需拆解为可分别检验的三个问题。
AI.method: 构建"选择者—接收者"设定：Qwen 从 1,000 张 Cheff 标记图像或 SynthCheX 候选池中挑选至多 20 张；接收方用 MedGemma 评估质量，并在冻结 DINOv3 特征上训练的分类器预测来源。对比均匀、质量优先与质量约束代理三种选择策略，并在未经处理的测试图像上评估分类器（SynthCheX 5,000 vs. NIH 2,297、另一真实集 957），另考察 JPEG 压缩对判别性能的影响。
AI.result: 质量筛选使通过质量检查的比例由 12/20 升至 19/20（Cheff 标记）与由 8 升至 17（SynthCheX）；但无证据表明筛选能提升同时通过两项检查的比率——被选中的 Cheff 标记图像无一同时通过，三种策略下 SynthCheX 分别有 2、1、2 张通过。分类器在未处理图像上标记 4,677/5,000 张 SynthCheX，但误判 110/2,297 张 NIH 真实图像及 568/957 张另一真实集图像为伪造。JPEG 压缩使 SynthCheX-vs-NIH AUROC 由 0.987 降至 0.841。即便未经处理，仍有 152 张 SynthCheX 通过两项像素级检查。
AI.conclusion: 像素级质量检查与来源分类器可用于过滤提交，但本质上不能验证"真实采集"声明（不完备且有假阳性）。医学数据集中应显式记录来源与预期用途，并作为入院门槛单独核查，而不仅依赖图像层面的自动化检测。

title: SICAF: Time-Varying Focus Bottleneck for Self-Supervised Event-Based Optical Flow with Spiking Neural Network
summary: Event-based optical flow estimation achieves high temporal resolution and dynamic range by exploiting asynchronous events, while self-supervised learning provides an effective solution to the absence of ground-truth labels. Spiking neural networks (SNNs), as brain-inspired models, process information through asynchronous spikes, naturally aligning with optical flow events. However, the temporal irregularity across event streams hinders the compact extraction of spatiotemporal features, while the absence of explicit labels leads to spurious correlations, thereby increasing redundancy within latent representations. In this paper, we propose a novel 'Compactly Compress, Time-varying Focus' training strategy. We present SICAF (Spikes Information Compression And Focus) framework that formulates the learning process as a constrained optimization with temporal modulation. It encourages self-supervised SNNs to extract compact latent representations while preventing over-compression that would discard temporal saliency. To better enable feature selectivity across time steps, we design an estimator with learnable temporal attention, achieving context awareness with cross-time dependencies. Experimental results on several datasets demonstrate that SICAF achieves state-of-the-art performance in self-supervised SNNs, with a 8.14% improvement in AEE on the MVSEC dataset and a 13.49% increase in robustness under white-box adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出SICAF自监督脉冲神经网络光流框架，以"紧凑压缩、时变聚焦"约束优化+可学习时间注意力实现紧凑潜在表示与时间显著性保持。
AI.motivation: 事件相机光流依赖自监督学习解决标签缺失，SNN与事件流的异步脉冲天然契合，但事件流的时间不规则性阻碍紧凑时空特征提取，且无显式标签导致伪相关、潜在表示冗余增加。
AI.method: 将学习过程形式化为带时间调制的约束优化：一是信息压缩约束促使潜在表示紧凑，二是时间调制机制防止过度压缩以致丢失时间显著性；并设计含可学习时间注意力的估计器，通过跨时间依赖实现上下文感知与逐时间步特征选择性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上达到自监督SNN光流的最优性能，MVSEC数据集AEE提升8.14%，白盒对抗攻击下鲁棒性提升13.49%。
AI.conclusion: 把信息瓶颈式压缩与时变聚焦结合，可在无标签条件下提升脉冲光流的精度与鲁棒性，为事件驱动感知的自监督训练提供可行范式。

title: RiO-DETRv2: Geometry-Aware Uncertainty Modeling Meets Real-Time Oriented Object Detection Transformer
summary: RiO-DETR is the first real-time end-to-end transformer for oriented object detection, yet further localization gains require a more expressive box representation. Although distributional regression has succeeded in horizontal DETRs, extending it to oriented detection introduces geometry-misaligned boundary modeling and topology-inconsistent orientation refinement. We present RiO-DETRv2, a geometry-aware uncertainty modeling framework for real-time oriented object detection. To resolve the geometry mismatch, Object-Aligned Boundary Distribution Refinement represents box boundaries as probability distributions in an object-aligned coordinate system and progressively refines them across decoder layers. For better orientation topology consistency, we introduce Circular-to-Local Angular Residual Refinement that transitions from global periodic search to local fine-grained estimation. Unified OBB Quality-Aligned Learning further aligns classification, boundary and angular refinement with complete-OBB localization quality. Together, these designs improve localization without compromising efficiency, achieving a better balance between speed and accuracy. Specifically, RiO-DETRv2-l/x achieves 53.7/54.1 mAP50-95 on DOTA, outperforming RiO-DETR-l/x by 1.2/1.5 points with nearly unchanged computational cost. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RiO-DETRv2 提出几何感知的不确定性建模框架，通过对齐物体坐标系的边界分布回归、循环到局部的角度残差细化以及 OBB 质量对齐学习，在几乎不增加计算量的前提下提升实时定向目标检测的定位精度。
AI.motivation: RiO-DETR 是首个实时端到端定向目标检测 Transformer，但进一步提升定位需要更强的框表示。将分布回归从水平框迁移到旋转框时，会出现边界建模与几何不对齐、以及角度细化的拓扑不一致（周期性）两大问题。
AI.method: 1) Object-Aligned Boundary Distribution Refinement：将框边界表示为物体对齐坐标系下的概率分布，并在各解码层中渐进细化；2) Circular-to-Local Angular Residual Refinement：角度回归由全局周期搜索过渡到局部细粒度残差估计，保证拓扑一致性；3) Unified OBB Quality-Aligned Learning：使分类、边界与角度细化与完整 OBB 定位质量统一对齐。
AI.result: 在 DOTA 上，RiO-DETRv2-l/x 达到 53.7/54.1 mAP50-95，较 RiO-DETR-l/x 分别提升 1.2/1.5 点，计算开销基本不变，速度—精度平衡更优。
AI.conclusion: 分布化、几何对齐的定向框回归可在实时端到端框架中有效提升定位性能，且不牺牲推理效率，代码已开源。

title: SimPT: An Automated Simulation Framework for Intervention-Based VLA Post-Training
summary: Human-in-the-loop (HIL) post-training improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies through expert corrections, but costly human supervision and repeated real-robot evaluation limit algorithm exploration and development. We introduce SimPT (Simulation-based Post-Training), a simulation framework that automates intervention-based VLA post-training by integrating policy rollouts, corrective data collection, policy training, and standalone evaluation. To automatically determine intervention timing and recovery strategies, we develop an Agent-Compiled Progress Graph that tracks task progress using privileged simulator state and retains stable snapshots during policy execution. After a rollout fails, a CuRobo-based expert attempts recovery from these snapshots, starting at more advanced task stages and falling back to earlier ones as needed to generate corrective trajectories. We implement and compare four post-training methods, RECAP, HG-DAgger, DPO+SFT, and FlowPRO, across seven RoboTwin manipulation tasks. Relative to a fixed-interval snapshot baseline, the Progress Graph reduces recovery attempts by 75.0% and increases recovery success from 93.4% to 98.9%. Using SimPT, we develop RECAP-CF-LPF, a refinement of RECAP that combines cross-fitting and low-pass filtering of value predictions. This refinement increases the overall success rate from 76.50% to 79.36% in held-out simulation trials. In real-robot HIL post-training, it increases the success rate from 72% to 96% across 25 scenarios of an Ethernet cable-insertion task. These results demonstrate the utility of SimPT for exploring and developing VLA post-training algorithms.

AI.tldr: SimPT：用仿真自动化干预式VLA后训练（rollout—纠正数据采集—训练—独立评测闭环），并提出Agent-Compiled Progress Graph自动决定干预时机与恢复起点；在此基础上改进RECAP为RECAP-CF-LPF，仿真成功率76.50%→79.36%，真机线缆插接25场景72%→96%。
AI.motivation: HIL后训练能显著提升VLA策略，但人力和反复真机评测成本高，限制了后训练算法的快速探索与迭代；缺乏可自动化、可独立评测的仿真HIL框架。
AI.method: 构建SimPT仿真框架，整合策略rollout、纠正数据采集、策略训练与standalone评测。核心是Agent-Compiled Progress Graph：利用特权仿真状态追踪任务进度，在策略执行过程中保留稳定快照；rollout失败后由CuRobo专家从快照出发尝试恢复，优先从更靠后的任务阶段起步，必要时回退到较早阶段，从而自动确定干预时机与恢复策略。在该框架上实现并对比RECAP、HG-DAgger、DPO+SFT、FlowPRO四种后训练方法（7个RoboTwin任务），并提出RECAP-CF-LPF（cross-fitting + value预测低通滤波）。
AI.result: Progress Graph相对固定间隔快照基线将恢复尝试减少75.0%，恢复成功率由93.4%提升至98.9%；RECAP-CF-LPF在留出仿真试验中总体成功率76.50%→79.36%；真机线缆插接25场景HIL后训练成功率72%→96%。
AI.conclusion: 仿真化HIL后训练框架可低成本、可复现地探索与开发VLA后训练算法，进度图驱动的自动干预与恢复策略显著提升数据采集效率，且该框架产出的改进（RECAP-CF-LPF）能有效迁移到真机任务。

title: Carving Radiology Reports at Their Evidential Joints: Anatomical Region Sets as Generation Units
summary: Organizing radiology reports into independently generated units offers a way to generate fine-grained clinical content and bind it to visual evidence. However, existing methods typically adopt generation-unit structures not directly specified in natural reports or their annotations, introducing additional modeling compromises. We propose RadCarve, which instead defines generation units directly from the anatomical region sets in existing statement-region correspondences, unifying unit formation with visual evidence selection. RadCarve's planner uses composition-specialized query banks to jointly predict unit existence and region composition from the image, iteratively refining both with regional evidence aggregated according to current membership predictions. The generator independently produces each unit's text conditioned on the joint visual evidence of its predicted region set. Compared with strong baselines, RadCarve improves CXRFEScore by 9.4% in unit generation given region sets and achieves 2.4 times the end-to-end binding F1. It also achieves leading report-generation results on Chest ImaGenome and PadChest-GR, using fewer than one-sixth as many parameters as large-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: RadCarve 直接在现有 statement-region 对应关系中定义的解剖区域集合上构建生成单元，用组合专用 query bank 联合预测单元存在性与区域组成并迭代细化，再以区域集合的联合视觉证据为条件独立生成各单元文本。
AI.motivation: 既有放射报告生成方法采用的生成单元结构并非来自报告或标注本身，引入额外建模取舍；作者希望把单元形成与视觉证据选择统一起来。
AI.method: 基于 statement-region 对应关系定义生成单元；planner 使用 composition-specialized query banks 从图像联合预测单元存在性与区域组成，并根据当前成员预测聚合区域证据进行迭代细化；generator 以预测区域集合的联合视觉证据为条件独立生成每个单元的文本。
AI.result: 在给定区域集合的单元生成上 CXRFEScore 提升 9.4%，端到端绑定 F1 达到基线 2.4 倍；在 Chest ImaGenome 与 PadChest-GR 上取得领先的报告生成结果，参数量不足大规模基线的 1/6。
AI.conclusion: 将生成单元与解剖区域集合对齐，可在显著降低参数量的同时提升细粒度临床内容生成与视觉证据绑定的效果。

title: How Representational Priors Shape Generalization in World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) are shown to substantially diverge under generalization performance based on their generative backbones. We investigate this gap through the representational geometry that WAMs inherit from their backbones and how policy training reorganizes it. Our central hypothesis is that a useful representational prior would structure geometry that separates nuisance information from the in-distribution manifold in advance of training as a policy. We quantify this with nuisance orthogonality; orthogonality of the feature under visual variation outside the empirical in-distribution manifold. Across various image and video backbones, we show that a higher orthogonality from the representational prior is associated with stronger robustness to visual variations after WAM training, enabling policy generalization measurable prospectively for world models. In addition, analyzing the resulting robust WAMs reveals nuisance suppression; relative suppression of feature displacement caused by such variations and robust action generation of the policy. Together, these findings provide a geometric perspective on how the representational prior of the world model shapes the generalization performance of WAMs.

AI.tldr: 提出"nuisance orthogonality"几何指标，度量世界模型（WAM）骨干表征先验中与分布外视觉扰动正交的程度，并发现该指标可前瞻性预测策略训练后的泛化鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）在不同生成骨干下泛化性能差异巨大，但原因不清；作者希望通过表征几何视角，解释骨干先验如何决定策略泛化，并给出训练前即可预测泛化的指标。
AI.method: 定义nuisance orthogonality：特征对经验分布流形之外视觉变化的正交性，在多种图像与视频骨干上量化；将其作为策略训练前的表征先验指标，并与WAM策略训练后的鲁棒性做关联分析；进一步分析鲁棒WAM中的nuisance suppression（特征位移相对抑制）与动作生成的稳健性。
AI.result: 跨多种图像/视频骨干，表征先验的nuisance orthogonality越高，WAM训练后对视觉变化的鲁棒性越强，可前瞻性预测策略泛化；鲁棒WAM表现出nuisance suppression与更稳健的动作输出。
AI.conclusion: 表征先验的几何结构（nuisance正交性）是决定WAM泛化性能的关键因素，提供了理解与预筛世界模型骨干的几何视角。

title: SMR: Learning streaming motion retargeting for humanoids from human semantic
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Retargeting human motion to humanoids requires preserving motion semantics while accounting for the robot's physical constraints. Kinematic pipelines prescribe a robot trajectory through geometric matching, without establishing whether it can be executed under the robot's dynamics. Prior physics-supervised neural methods train bidirectional full-sequence models on physics-refined kinematic trajectories, remaining tied to prescribed kinematic solutions and requiring noncausal context. We propose SMR, a streaming neural motion retargeter learned from semantic-conditioned physics experts. We convert human motion into robot-aware task-space targets for body landmark positions, orientations, and velocities. Physics experts track these targets directly in simulation under contact, dynamics, and actuator constraints. We train a single strictly causal Transformer on their executed state trajectories that complete the motion and pass semantic and physical validity checks. At each incoming frame, the student uses only current and past human observations to generate a robot motion reference for a downstream whole-body controller. Experiments demonstrate that semantic-conditioned physics experts generate motion with higher semantic fidelity and physical validity than direct optimization-based retargeting, while the resulting streaming retargeter achieves improved closed-loop performance over kinematic and physics-refined baselines under a common whole-body controller.

AI.tldr: SMR：用语义条件化的物理专家生成机器人可执行轨迹，再蒸馏为严格因果的流式 Transformer 重定向器，送入全身控制器闭环执行。
AI.motivation: 人体运动重定向到人形机器人时，运动学流水线只做几何匹配，无法保证动力学可行；已有的物理监督神经方法依赖被规定的运动学解，且需要双向全序列的非因果上下文，不能在线使用。
AI.method: 将人体运动转换为机器人可感知的笛卡尔任务空间目标（关键点位置、朝向、速度）；物理专家在仿真中于接触、动力学与执行器约束下直接跟踪这些目标，并只保留通过语义与物理有效性检查的执行轨迹；用单一严格因果 Transformer 在这些执行状态轨迹上做学生模型蒸馏，每帧仅用当前与历史人体观测输出机器人运动参考，交给下游全身控制器。
AI.result: 语义条件化物理专家相比基于直接优化的重定向产生更高语义保真度与物理可行性的运动；所得流式重定向器在同一全身控制器下，闭环性能优于运动学基线与物理精修基线。
AI.conclusion: 以物理专家生数据、因果学生流式部署的范式可兼顾语义保持、物理可行与实时性，为人体到人形机器人的在线运动重定向提供可行方案。

title: LocalAgent: Collaborative Agentic Verification for Fine-Grained Instance-Level Consistency
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in general visual understanding, yet they still struggle with fine-grained instance-level consistency verification, where the goal is to determine whether two images depict the exact same physical object under varying viewpoints, illumination, and backgrounds. This task requires both global semantic perception and precise examination of subtle local evidence, since semantically similar objects may differ only in small suspicious regions. To address this challenge, we propose LocalAgent, a collaborative agentic framework that integrates the complementary strengths of a generalist MLLM and lightweight specialist verifiers. The MLLM first reasons globally to identify suspicious local regions, which are then delegated to a Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) toolkit for fine-grained appearance and geometric matching. LEV comprises Local Appearance Consistency (LAC), which estimates appearance similarity under illumination and color changes, and Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC), which estimates spatial correspondence under viewpoint changes. LEV returns structured scalar evidence that the MLLM integrates for the final decision. We further introduce an auxiliary-capped reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) strategy, in which answer correctness dominates auxiliary tool-use and format signals, enabling the policy to learn when verification is necessary. Experiments show that LocalAgent improves mean accuracy by 4.9% over the strongest CoT-RFT baseline while invoking a verifier on only 12.13% of samples and preserving the general multimodal capabilities of the underlying MLLM. The open-source repository is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LocalAgent：用通用MLLM做全局推理定位可疑局部区域，再调用轻量专家验证器（局部外观一致性LAC + 局部几何对应LGC）返回结构化标量证据，MLLM融合做实例级一致性判定；辅以辅助信号上限约束的RFT学习"何时需要验证"。
AI.motivation: MLLM在通用视觉理解上进展迅速，但在细粒度实例级一致性验证（判断两张图是否为同一物理物体，跨视角、光照、背景变化）上仍不足；该任务既需全局语义感知，又需对细微可疑局部做精确检验。
AI.method: 协作式智能体框架：通用MLLM全局推理并检测可疑局部区域；委派给Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) 工具集，含Local Appearance Consistency (LAC，光照/颜色变化下的外观相似度)与Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC，视角变化下的空间对应)；LEV返回结构化标量证据由MLLM整合决策。训练采用auxiliary-capped RFT：答案正确性主导，工具使用与格式信号被上限约束，使策略学会何时调用验证器。
AI.result: 平均准确率较最强CoT-RFT基线提升4.9%，仅在12.13%样本上调用验证器，同时保持底层MLLM的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 以"按需调用局部专家验证器"的方式弥补MLLM细粒度实例一致性短板，兼顾精度、效率与通用能力保持；代码开源。

title: Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention and Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion for Video Action Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling (MMM 2027)
summary: In video action detection, modeling the temporal dependencies in continuous video streams is crucial. Previous methods based on deep neural networks can perform frame-level video recognition tasks. However, these methods struggle to model dynamic temporal patterns, facing challenges such as redundant frame information, difficulty balancing global and local features, and insufficient fusion of visual and textual features. To address these issues, we propose a video temporal attention module based on the Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention, which aggregates continuous temporal sequences into feature representations across diverse temporal scales while efficiently reducing redundancy. We also introduce a Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion module that leverages cross-attention at both latent and standard feature levels, achieving fine-grained fusion between video and textual features to enhance semantic alignment and feature interaction. Experimental results across multiple video recognition benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed methods achieve superior performance compared to existing methods, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度潜在时序压缩注意力模块与视频-文本交叉注意力融合模块，用于视频动作检测中的时序建模与多模态融合。
AI.motivation: 现有深度网络方法难以建模动态时序模式，存在帧信息冗余、全局与局部特征难平衡、视觉与文本特征融合不足等问题。
AI.method: 多尺度潜在时序压缩注意力（Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention）聚合连续时序序列为多尺度特征以减少冗余；视频-文本交叉注意力融合模块在潜在层与标准特征层进行跨注意力细粒度融合。
AI.result: 在多个视频识别基准上优于现有方法，验证有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该双模块设计可提升视频时序建模与跨模态语义对齐效果，属通用视频理解改进。

title: ROCOCO: Robust Outline Completion of Occluded Curvilinear Objects
summary: We propose a learning-based generative model for completing curvilinear features under occlusion by environmental obstacles. To this end, we adopt a flow matching-based approach that supports the inpainting of occluded regions with the appropriate curvilinear features. To eliminate the reliance on privileged information about the occlusion a priori, we also train a UNet-based mask prediction model, which can identify regions for inpainting given only the occluded observation. The components of our approach are validated via experiments using procedurally-generated test cases, and the complete pipeline is validated using large public datasets for curvilinear objects. Against off-the-shelf inpainting baselines, ROCOCO is the strongest method by a wide margin when no occlusion mask is given, and is competitive with mask-supervised inpainting when one is, achieving best on full-image error and second only to LaMa on the occluded region, while using a completer of $7.7$M parameters against LaMa's $51$M and Stable Diffusion's $860$M.

AI.tldr: ROCOCO：基于flow matching的曲线特征遮挡补全生成模型，并配套UNet掩码预测器以摆脱对先验遮挡掩码的依赖。
AI.motivation: 环境障碍物遮挡导致曲线状特征（如线缆、道路、结构边缘）断裂，现有inpainting方法要么依赖特权遮挡掩码，要么模型庞大且效果有限。
AI.method: 采用flow matching式生成模型对遮挡区域进行inpainting以补全曲线特征；另训练UNet掩码预测模型，仅由被遮挡观测即可预测需修补区域，从而去除对先验掩码的依赖。以程序化生成的测试用例验证各模块，并用大型公开曲线物体数据集验证整体流程。
AI.result: 无掩码时ROCOCO大幅优于现成inpainting基线；提供掩码时与掩码监督方法相当：全图误差最优、遮挡区域仅次于LaMa。补全器仅7.7M参数，远小于LaMa的51M与Stable Diffusion的860M。
AI.conclusion: 轻量、免先验掩码的曲线特征遮挡补全方案可行且具参数效率优势，属amodal completion相关生成方法，但缺乏与机器人/3D场景任务结合的实证。

title: A Unified Evaluation Framework of Physical Adversarial Robustness in the Edge VLM Era
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD). 16 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable end-to-end visual grounding via language prompts and generative decoding, demonstrating largely improved zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection capabilities. As a result, VLMs are rapidly being deployed at the edge in safety-critical real-world systems. However, the physical adversarial robustness of edge VLMs has not been systematically studied, and the fundamental differences in output with modern object detectors create methodological challenges for fair evaluation. To compare the two families directly, we evaluate every selected representative model on one outcome: whether an adversarial patch worn on a person evades detection of the model. We report this by introducing a unified metric, conditional attack success rate (cASR), counted only on images the model still localizes under a matched gray occluder, and partition every failure into omission (no box), substitution (a box on the patch), and displacement (a box on neither). We benchmark the physical adversarial vulnerability of compact grounding VLMs against a range of object detectors, and find that the VLMs can be as vulnerable as the detectors. We disclose that failure mode is largely associated with the output format of a model rather than its architecture family. Of the three, only omission is visible to a downstream system; displacement and substitution return confident, well-formed boxes, making them potentially more dangerous failures. Further, we find that, under distribution shift, VLMs that primarily failed by omission instead shift to failing more by displacement/substitution. Thus, a grounding VLM can inherit the detector's vulnerability while showing the possibility to adopt more dangerous failure modes. Our code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了紧凑型grounding VLM在物理对抗补丁攻击下的鲁棒性，提出统一指标cASR，并将失败模式分解为omission/substitution/displacement三类，发现VLM可与传统检测器同样脆弱，且失败模式主要由输出格式而非架构族决定。
AI.motivation: VLM正被快速部署到边缘安全关键系统中，但其物理对抗鲁棒性尚未被系统研究；同时VLM与现代目标检测器的输出形式根本不同（生成式解码 vs. 框回归），导致公平比较存在方法论障碍。
AI.method: 在统一的物理攻击设定下（人身上佩戴对抗补丁是否使模型漏检）比较紧凑grounding VLM与多种目标检测器；引入条件攻击成功率cASR（仅在匹配灰色遮挡物下模型仍能定位的图像上统计），并将失败细分为omission（无框）、substitution（框落在补丁上）、displacement（框落在两者之外）三类。
AI.result: 基准测试显示grounding VLM的物理脆弱性可与检测器相当；失败模式与模型输出格式高度相关而非架构族；三类失败中仅omission对下游系统可见，displacement与substitution会返回高置信度、格式良好的框；在分布偏移下，原本以omission为主的VLM会转向更多displacement/substitution失败。
AI.conclusion: grounding VLM可继承检测器的脆弱性，并有可能呈现更危险的失败模式，提示边缘部署需针对输出格式与失效语义做专门评估与防护。

title: NeuralSRender: G-Buffer Guided Video Diffusion for Sim-to-Real Rendering
summary: The scarcity of high-quality annotated visual data remains a critical bottleneck for autonomous-driving perception. Simulators provide training data at scale, but the limited realism of synthetic videos compromises perception performance in real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose NeuralSRender, a sim-to-real video translation framework that enhances the photorealism of synthetic videos while maintaining geometric consistency with the source scenes. Built on a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT), NeuralSRender uses a lightweight projector to inject geometric and material priors from G-buffers, and LoRA enables parameter-efficient adaptation. The model is trained in two stages: it first learns G-buffer conditioning from synthetic videos with accurate G-buffers, then adapts to real-world appearance using real videos with estimated G-buffers. During the second stage, an additional LoRA module is trained while the projector and first-stage LoRA remain frozen to reduce interference from estimation noise. NeuralSRender introduces only 1.45\% parameter overhead and can be trained on consumer-grade GPUs with 24 GB of memory. To support training and evaluation, we introduce GenReal, a large-scale driving video dataset comprising synthetic and real-world videos with corresponding G-buffers. Experiments demonstrate improved photorealism with competitive geometric consistency. Training perception models on our translated videos instead of raw simulator renders improves detection $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ on nuImages from 35.1 to 40.6 and segmentation mIoU on Cityscapes from 32.4 to 40.8. Our code, data, and model weights are available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 NeuralSRender，一种基于预训练视频扩散 Transformer 的 sim-to-real 视频翻译框架，通过 G-buffer 几何条件注入与两阶段 LoRA 训练提升合成驾驶视频的真实感并保持几何一致性，同时发布 GenReal 数据集；翻译后视频训练感知模型在 nuImages 检测 AP50 35.1→40.6、Cityscapes 分割 mIoU 32.4→40.8。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知受限于高质量标注视觉数据稀缺；仿真器可大规模生成数据，但合成视频真实感不足导致 real-world 感知性能下降。现有 sim-to-real 翻译难以在提升照片真实感的同时保持与源场景的几何一致性，且通常训练代价高。
AI.method: 基于预训练视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）：用轻量 projector 将 G-buffer 的几何与材质先验注入网络，LoRA 做参数高效适配。两阶段训练：(1) 在带精确 G-buffer 的合成视频上学习 G-buffer 条件控制；(2) 在带估计 G-buffer 的真实视频上适配真实外观，此时冻结 projector 与第一阶段 LoRA，仅训练第二个 LoRA 模块以抑制估计噪声干扰。额外参数开销仅 1.45%，可在 24 GB 消费级 GPU 上训练。另构建 GenReal 大规模驾驶视频数据集（合成+真实，含对应 G-buffer）。
AI.result: 照片真实感提升且几何一致性具竞争力；用翻译后视频替代原始仿真渲染训练感知模型，nuImages 检测 AP50 由 35.1 提升至 40.6，Cityscapes 分割 mIoU 由 32.4 提升至 40.8。代码、数据与权重开源。
AI.conclusion: G-buffer 条件化的扩散式 sim-to-real 视频翻译可在低参数/算力开销下有效缩小仿真-真实域差距，并直接转化为下游感知精度收益，为自动驾驶数据合成提供可复用方案。

title: NavBind: Diagnosing Instruction-Action Binding at Route Forks in Navigation VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) navigation models translate visual observations and instructions into actions. Navigation success assesses whether an agent reaches the goal. However, reaching the goal successfully does not establish whether the model genuinely follows the instructions or relies on visual cues or navigation history. We introduce NavBind to diagnose instruction-action binding: whether changing the instruction influences the probabilistic distribution of the actions, with the navigation context fixed. We construct 3,252 route-fork contexts by recombining route-aligned instruction segments from R2R-CE and RxR-CE. Each context pairs full instructions that share the description of the route already traveled but specify different branches. Both are evaluated under the same agent state and navigation history. We compare generated local action sequences, the likelihoods of fixed reference action sequences under both instructions, and changes in visual attention and attribution. Across the evaluated models, higher reported navigation success does not imply that the model more faithfully follows the instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出 NavBind 诊断框架，在固定导航上下文下改变指令，检验 VLA 导航模型是否真正实现"指令-动作绑定"，发现导航成功率与指令遵循度不相关。
AI.motivation: 传统导航成功率只能说明智能体是否到达目标，无法区分模型是真正遵循指令，还是依赖视觉线索或导航历史惯性。因此需要一种诊断方法，在控制变量下直接检验指令对动作分布的影响。
AI.method: 从 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 中重组路线对齐的指令片段，构造 3,252 个"路径分叉"上下文：两条完整指令共享已走过路径的描述、仅分支不同，且在相同智能体状态与导航历史下评估。比较三项指标：生成的局部动作序列、固定参考动作序列在两种指令下的似然、以及视觉注意力与归因的变化。
AI.result: 在所评估的模型中，更高的报告导航成功率并不意味着模型更忠实地遵循指令；成功率与指令-动作绑定程度之间缺乏一致性。
AI.conclusion: 导航成功率作为评价指标存在误导性，需引入指令-动作绑定诊断来补充评估 VLA 导航模型的指令遵循能力。

title: DetM-Tracker: Deterministic and Memory-Efficient VIS for Autonomous Industrial Inspection
summary: Autonomous industrial inspection requires strictly deterministic real-time inference under tight memory and computational constraints. However, existing Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) models suffer from prohibitive scaling: dense temporal memory grows with spatial resolution and sequence length, while fixed-capacity decoders fail to exploit the inherent sparsity of industrial scenes, creating a practical memory wall on resource-constrained edge platforms. We present DetM-Tracker, a streamlined VIS framework for autonomous industrial inspection, where target objects often exhibit highly similar appearance under constrained "micro" fields of view. DetM-Tracker eliminates architectural redundancy through three synergistic components: (1) Compact Scalar Memory, which condenses high-dimensional instance features into four-scalar descriptors, reducing temporal memory complexity from $O(T \cdot N \cdot R)$ to $O(T \cdot \hat{N})$. This mechanism effectively compresses frame-level representations into a bank of active instances, where $R$ denotes resolution, $N$ and $\hat{N}$ represent global and window-specific instance counts, respectively and $T$ the temporal window size; and (2) Dynamic Instance Channels, which adaptively allocate query capacity according to the actual number of visible objects; and (3) Entropy-Gated Skip Connection, which concentrates computational budget on high-uncertainty spatial regions to refine object boundaries in a single forward pass without auxiliary refinement heads. Our approach effectively bridges the gap between modern VIS models and the practical demands of industrial edge deployment, reducing inference latency by approximately 20$\times$ and VRAM consumption by 6$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art dense-feature baselines.

AI.tldr: DetM-Tracker: 面向工业边缘部署的轻量视频实例分割框架，用四标量紧凑记忆、动态实例通道和熵门控跳连替代密集时序记忆，延迟降低约20倍、显存降低6倍。
AI.motivation: 自主工业检测需在严格确定性的实时约束、紧内存与算力下推理；现有VIS模型的密集时序记忆随分辨率和序列长度线性膨胀，固定容量解码器又浪费在工业场景的稀疏性上，形成边缘平台上的"内存墙"。
AI.method: 三个协同组件：(1) Compact Scalar Memory——将高维实例特征压缩为4标量描述子，把时序记忆复杂度从 O(T·N·R) 降到 O(T·N̂)，形成活跃实例记忆库；(2) Dynamic Instance Channels——按可见目标数自适应分配查询容量；(3) Entropy-Gated Skip Connection——将算力集中到高不确定度空间区域，单次前向完成边界细化，无需辅助精修头。
AI.result: 相比SOTA密集特征基线，推理延迟降低约20×、显存占用降低6×，且面向"微视场"下外观高度相似的工业目标仍保持可用精度（摘要未给出量化精度指标）。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除架构冗余与利用场景稀疏性，该工作把现代VIS模型拉近工业边缘部署的实际需求；但缺乏公开基准精度与真实产线部署证据，属效率导向的工程化贡献。

title: Cache Locally, Recompute Selectively for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires video-LLMs to process incoming video continuously while answering user queries with low latency. Recent methods reduce query-time cost by prefilling frames into KV caches during idle time and reusing the cached KVs at query time. To bound per-frame computation over unbounded video streams, these methods restrict the context available during prefill. This creates a fundamental context mismatch: the restricted context may omit information needed to properly contextualize video tokens, yet, still contain information irrelevant to the eventual query, which is unknown during prefill. We propose FrameBlend, a simple yet effective plug-and-play method to address this mismatch through selective KV recomputation, without requiring any additional training. At query time, FrameBlend re-prefills selected video tokens using query-relevant context and replaces their cached KVs with recomputed ones. Crucially, this recomputation enables shorter attention windows during idle-time prefill, substantially reducing prefill cost while improving accuracy.
