Experiments across three SVU frameworks and five streaming and offline benchmarks demonstrate accuracy gains of up to 3.9 pp. On RVS-Ego, FrameBlend reduces per-frame prefill FLOPs by over 20% and total processing time by 14-59% for retrieval-based frameworks, including the cost of query-time recomputation. These results demonstrate that a simple change in how contextualization is distributed between idle time and query time can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off for SVU.

AI.tldr: FrameBlend: 无需训练的可插拔方法，在查询时用与查询相关的上下文对选定的视频 token 重新 prefill 并替换其 KV cache，从而缓解流式视频理解中"空闲期预填充上下文受限"与"查询需求未知"之间的上下文错配，同时缩短预填充注意力窗口以降低开销。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解要求视频-LLM 在低延迟下持续处理视频并回答查询。现有方法在空闲期把帧预先填充进 KV cache 以降低查询时开销，但为控制无界流的逐帧计算需限制预填充时的上下文长度。这造成根本性的上下文错配：受限上下文可能缺失正确语境化视频 token 所需的信息，同时又混入与最终查询无关的信息（而查询在预填充时未知）。
AI.method: 提出 FrameBlend，一种简单、可插拔、免训练的方法，通过选择性 KV 重计算解决上述失配。查询时刻，选取部分视频 token，在包含查询的相关上下文下重新 prefill，并用重算的 KV 替换其缓存 KV；由此允许空闲期 prefill 使用更短的注意力窗口。
AI.result: 在三个 SVU 框架与五个流式/离线基准上，精度最高提升 3.9 pp；在 RVS-Ego 上，逐帧预填充 FLOPs 降低超 20%，基于检索的框架总处理时间降低 14–59%（已计入查询时重算开销）。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，只需改变"语境化在空闲期与查询期之间的分配方式"，即可改善 SVU 的精度-效率权衡，是一种低成本、易集成的改进。

title: DisasterRoute: Evidence-Guided Dual-System Routing for Visual Disaster Question Answering
summary: Visual question answering from low-altitude UAV imagery must deliver timely and accurate judgments to support disaster response under limited edge computing resources. Routine questions may be answered through direct decisions, whereas more challenging questions may benefit from step-by-step reasoning. However, existing research primarily focuses on improving models' visual understanding and generative reasoning capabilities, with limited exploration of efficient direct decision-making and its adaptive coordination with generative reasoning. We develop Disaster-S1 based on a vision-language model adapted to the disaster domain. Trained for option discrimination, it outputs a probability distribution over answer options in a single multimodal forward pass for fast decision-making. We further propose DisasterRoute, a dual-system routing framework that combines prediction confidence with disaster evidence to decide whether to accept the initial answer or invoke the disaster reasoning model DisasterVL for review. By allocating inference computation on demand, the framework retains the efficiency of direct decision-making and improves overall question-answering accuracy through selective review. Experiments on DisasterBench show that Disaster-S1 achieves superior accuracy with low latency, while DisasterRoute further improves accuracy through selective review at substantially lower latency than full reasoning.

AI.tldr: Disaster-S1+DisasterRoute：面向无人机低空灾情VQA的"快慢双系统"路由框架，直接决策+选择性复核以省算力。
AI.motivation: 无人机灾情VQA需在边缘算力受限下快速准确判断；现有工作偏重视觉理解与生成式推理增强，缺少高效直接决策及其与生成推理的自适应协同研究。
AI.method: 基于灾情领域适配的VLM构建Disaster-S1，以选项判别为目标训练，单次多模态前向即输出答案选项概率分布，实现快速直接决策；提出DisasterRoute双系统路由，融合预测置信度与灾情证据，决定接受初答或调用灾情推理模型DisasterVL进行复核，按需分配推理算力。
AI.result: 在DisasterBench上，Disaster-S1取得较高准确率且延迟低；DisasterRoute通过选择性复核进一步提升准确率，延迟显著低于全量推理。摘要未给出具体数值提升。
AI.conclusion: "轻量判别+置信度/证据驱动路由"是边缘部署下性价比可观的推理加速范式，可迁移到其他受限算力具身感知问答场景，但需补充定量指标与跨域泛化验证。

title: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Think-Capture：查询条件化的“按需取几何”框架，将零样本掩码经3D工具包提升到统一坐标系，用符号化3D状态抽象压缩为结构化文本，并以分层GRPO训练VLM判断何时采信工具几何、何时回退视觉线索。
AI.motivation: VLM在2D识别强但跨稀疏视角难保3D关系一致，遮挡与视角变化下产生空间幻觉；现有“全帧稠密几何融合”计算与上下文开销大，且导致模型盲目依赖不完美的几何估计器。
AI.method: (1) 先由VLM识别任务关键物体，再按需获取其几何；(2) 3D工具包把零样本分割掩码升维到公共坐标系统一表达；(3) Symbolic 3D State Abstraction 把物体与相机状态压缩为结构化文本；(4) 分层GRPO在“几何有帮助/几何误导”两类样本上训练，学习工具证据与视觉先验的取舍策略。
AI.result: Think-Capture-4B：MindCube-Tiny 54.4%（较骨干+21.5），MMSI-Bench位置子集39.1%（+7.9），ViewSpatial 42.8%（+5.2）；在坐标与掩码扰动下保持鲁棒；全栈可装入单张24GB GPU，并在Agibot G1上作为异步高层推理器运行。
AI.conclusion: 以“查询条件化+按需几何+符号状态抽象+带反例的强化学习”替代稠密全帧融合，可显著缓解VLM空间幻觉并降低开销，具备边缘部署与真机落地的可行性。

title: Encoded but Unused: Bounding the Sources of VLM Errors
summary: In this paper, we investigate why vision-language models (VLMs) produce errors by decomposing them into two sources: visual-representation failures, in which the visual evidence required for the correct answer is not encoded, and visual-utilization failures, in which this evidence is encoded but not successfully used. We propose to estimate the visual-utilization failure rate using lightweight probes and derive theoretical bounds on the true rate that account for probe imperfections. We introduce VELens (Visual Evidence Lens), a rank-based probe that traces visual evidence for both a target object and its ground-truth attribute, such as color, material, or shape, across VLM layers. We evaluate VELens on over 6,000 images using LLaVA-1.6-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Our method achieves ROC-AUC scores of 0.95 and 0.91, respectively, and outperforms alternative probes in both low-resource and unseen-attribute settings. Using it to diagnose errors, we estimate that visual-utilization failures account for 84.4% of LLaVA errors and 70.0% of Qwen errors, with conservative lower bounds of 77.5% and 61.0%, respectively. Overall, our study identifies visual utilization as the dominant bottleneck in VLMs and suggests that a central opportunity for improvement lies in developing better mechanisms to locate, route, and use the visual information they already encode.

AI.tldr: 将VLM错误分解为"视觉表征失败"与"视觉利用失败"，提出基于排序的轻量探针VELens追踪目标物体及其真实属性的视觉证据在各层的编码情况，估计视觉利用失败率并给出考虑探针不完美性的理论下界。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多笼统归因VLM错误，缺少区分"没看到"与"看到但没用上"的定量手段，因而难以定位真正的瓶颈。
AI.method: 定义两类错误源；用轻量线性探针估计视觉利用失败率并推导受探针噪声影响的真实率边界；提出VELens秩相关探针，跨层追踪目标物体与GT属性（颜色/材质/形状）的视觉证据；在6000+图像上用LLaVA-1.6-7B与Qwen2.5-VL-7B评测，并与替代探针在低资源与未见属性设定下对比。
AI.result: ROC-AUC分别达0.95与0.91，优于替代探针且泛化更好；诊断显示视觉利用失败占LLaVA错误的84.4%、Qwen错误的70.0%，保守下界为77.5%与61.0%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉利用而非视觉表征是VLM主导瓶颈，改进重点应放在定位、路由与使用已编码视觉信息的机制上。

title: Failure Modes of Vision-Language Models for Human Activity Understanding in Thermal HRI
summary: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning. They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.

AI.tldr: 评估7个可在本地部署的VLM（含面向物理AI/机器人的模型）在两个人本中心热成像数据集上的表现，诊断细粒度动作识别、活动时间线重建与"拒答"能力，并用配对的RGB数据作参照。
AI.motivation: 热成像相机能在暗光下感知人体活动，且比RGB泄露更少身份与环境细节；VLM正被嵌入具身系统做场景理解与高层规划，但VLM在热成像人体活动理解（HRI场景）中的失效模式尚不清楚。
AI.method: 诊断性基准评测：7个本地可部署VLM × 2个person-centric热成像数据集；任务包括细粒度动作识别、时间线重建、无依据答案的抑制（abstention）；RGB配对作性能参照；控制变量包括帧采样、热输入呈现方式与推理（reasoning）设置，以检验误差是否可缓解。
AI.result: 模型能识别粗粒度活动类别，但细粒度动作（咳嗽、打喷嚏、打哈欠）表现差；事件时间线不准确，并对涉及物体的动作产生幻觉。简单的热输入预处理与额外推理仅带来有限且依赖于模型的增益；即使明确指示，各模型拒答行为也差异明显。
AI.conclusion: 热成像VLM人体活动理解的可信度尚不足支撑实际机器人应用，主要瓶颈在细粒度动作、时间定位、物体幻觉与弃权行为；需要更强的输入表示与可靠的不确定性机制。

title: DepState-JEPA: Learning Depth-Grounded State Representation for Visual Perception and Manipulation
summary: Predictive representations for robot manipulation should connect scene geometry with the state changes induced by actions. Our intuition is that understanding what an action will change starts with understanding where things are: complementary RGB and depth observations ground a common scene representation from which to infer those changes. Guided by this intuition, we introduce \textbf{DepState-JEPA}, a dual-stream RGB--Depth joint-embedding predictive architecture that connects spatial understanding with action-conditioned prediction through a shared latent state, \textbf{DepState}. Built on V-JEPA~2.1, the framework uses depth both as a complementary observation stream and to ground both modalities in metric 3D space, aggregating shared information into DepState while retaining modality-private features for decoding. Ray-conditioned readouts predict local features without target depth; after an action-conditioned transition, the same decoders predict future RGB and depth features using the predicted state and fixed initial private features. Robot-state readouts provide recursive proprioceptive inputs; object-trajectory supervision and calibrated forward kinematics shape state learning through motion targets and joint--TCP consistency. Comparisons show stronger RGB-encoder transfer after RGB-D adaptation, feature completion, conditioned visual forecasting, and manipulation success. Within-model ablations identify contributions from depth content, metric coordinates, and future-state matching, with additional control gains from FK regularization.

AI.tldr: DepState-JEPA提出双流RGB-D联合嵌入预测架构，用共享潜状态DepState连接空间理解与动作条件预测，并在V-JEPA 2.1上用射线条件读出与任务监督塑造状态学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作的预测表征需将场景几何与动作引起的状态变化关联；作者直觉是"理解动作将改变什么"始于"理解东西在哪里"，RGB与深度可互补地奠定统一场景表征。
AI.method: 基于V-JEPA 2.1的双流RGB-D JEPA：深度既作为互补观测流，又将两模态锚定到度量3D空间；共享信息聚合到DepState，同时保留模态私有特征用于解码；射线条件读出无需目标深度即可预测局部特征；经动作条件转移后，同一解码器用预测状态与固定初始私有特征预测未来RGB/深度特征；机器人状态读出提供递归本体感受输入，物体轨迹监督与标定正运动学（关节-TCP一致性）正则化塑造状态学习。
AI.result: 实验显示RGB-D适配后RGB编码器迁移更强，并具备特征补全、条件视觉预测与更高的操作成功率；模型内消融确认深度内容、度量坐标、未来状态匹配的贡献，FK正则带来额外控制增益。
AI.conclusion: 将深度作为观测流与度量几何锚点的共享潜状态预测架构可有效统一空间理解与动作条件预测，提升表征迁移与操作性能。

title: ER-Chord: Spatially Consistent One-Step Image Editing via Equal-Energy Reliability Redistribution
summary: One-step generative models enable fast text-guided image editing, yet they often introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain unchanged. Temporal aggregation stabilizes editing fields across noise levels, but leaves their spatial allocation insensitive to local variations in reliability. Consequently, temporal stability alone does not ensure spatially consistent editing. To address this lim- itation, we propose ER-Chord, a training-free and inversion-free framework for reliability-guided spatial redistribution. Our key insight is that agreement between editing fields at neighboring noise levels provides a local reliability signal for allocating editing strength. We formulate this allocation as an equal-energy op- timization that redistributes control energy according to local reliability while preserving the original editing directions and total control energy. This formu- lation admits a unique global solution that can be efficiently computed using existing field evaluations, requiring no additional denoiser calls. Experiments on two benchmarks, PIE-Bench and TEdBench, demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art one-step editing baselines, achieving superior source preservation alongside consistent gains across multiple generative this http URL project page is at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ER-Chord：免训练、免反演的单步扩散图像编辑框架，将编辑场按"相邻噪声层一致性"估计的局部可靠性做等能量空间重分配，以减少无意区域改动。
AI.motivation: 单步生成模型虽能快速做文本引导编辑，但会改坏本应保持不变的区域。已有的时间聚合（temporal aggregation）只在不同噪声层间稳定编辑场，却使其空间分配对局部可靠性无感知，时间稳定≠空间一致。
AI.method: 以相邻噪声层编辑场的一致性作为局部可靠性信号；将该分配问题形式化为等能量优化：按局部可靠性重分配控制能量，同时保持原编辑方向与总能量不变；该式有唯一全局最优解，可直接复用已有的场评估高效求解，无需额外去噪器调用；整体无需训练与反演。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 与 TEdBench 上，相较 SOTA 单步编辑基线在源图保真度（source preservation）上更优，并在多种生成器上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 空间可靠性感知的能量重分配是对时间聚合的有效补充，可在不增加推理开销的前提下提升单步编辑的空间一致性与背景保持能力。

title: CRAB: Cuboid-based Representation for As-built BIM from Point Clouds
summary: As-built BIM reconstruction from point clouds demands semantic, volumetric, parametric, and editable building components, beyond 2D layouts or planar abstractions. Yet existing scan-to-BIM pipelines often rely on handcrafted rules, heuristic optimization, or manual correction, while learning-based methods fall short of recovering wall thickness, opening geometry, and component-level BIM structure. We introduce CRAB, a BIM-ready cuboid reconstruction framework that encodes walls, doors, windows, beams, and columns as compact architectural cuboids with IFC-compatible semantics and parameters. CRAB bridges point clouds and editable BIM by combining ProposalNet, which predicts coarse component cuboids, with AssemblyNet, a relation-aware Flow Matching model that refines geometry, predicts structural relationships, and enables automatic structural correction and human-guided editing. To address limited cuboid-level supervision, we extend Structured3D with component-wise cuboid annotations and construct cuboid-based procedural scenes. Experiments show CRAB surpasses floor plan and plane-based alternatives in component completeness, geometric accuracy, and generalization. For interior wall thickness estimation, CRAB achieves a mean error of 2.80 cm, with 79.50% of matched walls within 3 cm. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CRAB：基于点云的BIM cuboid重建框架，用ProposalNet预测构件粗cuboid，再用关系感知的Flow Matching模型AssemblyNet精修并在IFC语义下输出墙/门/窗/梁/柱参数化构件，并扩展Structured3D的cuboid级标注与程序化场景。
AI.motivation: 现有scan-to-BIM流程依赖手工规则、启发式优化或人工修模；学习方法难以恢复墙厚、洞口几何和构件级BIM结构。作者希望从点云直接得到语义化、体量化、参数化且可编辑的BIM构件。
AI.method: CRAB为两阶段框架：ProposalNet生成构件的粗cuboid提议；AssemblyNet基于关系感知的Flow Matching进行几何精修、构件间结构关系预测，并支持自动结构纠正与人工引导编辑。为缓解cuboid级监督缺失，扩展Structured3D加入构件级cuboid标注，并构建基于cuboid的程序化场景。
AI.result: 实验表明CRAB在构件完整性、几何精度和泛化性上优于基于平面图或平面基元的方法；内墙厚度估计平均误差2.80 cm，79.50%的匹配墙体误差在3 cm以内。
AI.conclusion: 以cuboid为统一表示并在其上做关系感知生成式精修，是连通点云与可编辑IFC-BIM的有效路径，兼顾精度、结构一致性与可编辑性；未来可扩展到更复杂构件与真实扫描的鲁棒性。

title: Training in Deployment: Human-in-the-loop Online Post-Training for Robot Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Large pretrained robot foundation models provide strong priors for manipulation, yet adapting them to target tasks with offline teleoperated demonstrations often fails to cover the contact-rich, recovery, and precision-critical states encountered during deployment. Existing methods mitigate this issue by augmenting offline demonstrations with human-in-the-loop data or online reinforcement learning. Despite this, offline post-training adapts slowly because it cannot immediately absorb deployment experience, while online RL typically relies on value functions or auxiliary actor-critic models, increasing both training complexity and instability. We present TIDE (Training In DEployment), a human-in-the-loop online post-training system. TIDE introduces a provenance-conditioned supervised learning framework that updates the policy online from human interventions and policy-generated rollouts collected during deployment, without a learned critic, reward model, or action scorer. Across four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, TIDE improves milestone-normalized task progress and binary full-task completion over the warm-start policy and matched additional offline demonstrations, and performs comparably to the fixed-policy collection baseline while making updated checkpoints available during deployment. Each task-specific online post-training session, from the start of deployment rollouts until the final checkpoint is available, completes in less than one hour while learning and checkpoint handling run asynchronously.

AI.tldr: TIDE 提出一种基于"来源条件"(provenance-conditioned)的监督学习框架，在部署过程中用人类干预与策略自采样轨迹在线更新机器人基础模型策略，无需 critic、奖励模型或动作打分器；四项真实双臂任务中一小时内在部署期完成适配并优于热启动与额外离线示教。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人基础模型虽有强先验，但用离线遥操作示教适配时难以覆盖部署中出现的接触丰富、恢复与精度关键状态；离线后训练无法即时吸收部署经验，在线 RL 又依赖价值函数或辅助 actor-critic，增加复杂度与不稳定性。
AI.method: 人类在环的在线后训练系统：部署期间采集人类干预与策略自生成 rollout，采用来源条件化（provenance-conditioned）监督学习直接在线更新策略，区分数据来源（人工干预 vs 策略执行）以替代显式奖励/价值信号；训练与 checkpoint 管理异步进行。
AI.result: 四个真实双臂操作任务中，相较热启动策略和等量额外离线示教，提升里程碑归一化任务进度与二值全任务完成率；与固定策略收集基线性能相当，且 checkpoint 可在部署中实时更新；每个任务的在线后训练会话在1小时内完成。
AI.conclusion: 以来源条件监督学习替代在线 RL 的价值学习，可实现轻量、稳定、部署期内的机器人策略在线适配，为 VLA/基础模型的实际落地提供可行的人机协同后训练范式。

title: Clinical radar heart sounds with echocardiographic phenotypes of ventricular dysfunction and valvular disease
summary: Radar heart sounds capture cardiac mechanical activity without contact, while echocardiography characterizes ventricular and valvular function. Paired measurements connect these signals to structural heart disease, yet such data remain sparsely represented in public resources. Here we present 537 radar heart-sound recordings paired with one echocardiographic report for each of 162 patients. The cohort covers three overlapping phenotypes: left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) below 50%, regional wall-motion abnormality and at least moderate valvular regurgitation, present in 38, 43 and 39 patients, respectively. Original complex signals, processed radar heart sounds and temporal quality segmentation support signal-to-phenotype analysis. Technical validation retains 95.93% of signal duration and confirms reproducible waveform reconstruction. Patient-level five-fold evaluation achieves a mean outer-test AUROC of $0.770\pm0.138$ for reduced LVEF, identifying mechanical information associated with ventricular systolic dysfunction. This resource supports research linking non-contact cardiac mechanical signals to echocardiographic structural and functional phenotypes.

AI.tldr: 发布162名患者、537条雷达心音与超声心动图报告配对的数据集，含原始/处理信号与质量分段，并以五折评估实现LVEF减低检测AUROC 0.770±0.138。
AI.motivation: 非接触雷达心音可反映心脏机械活动，与超声结构/功能表型配对的数据在公共资源中稀少，阻碍信号到表型的建模研究。
AI.method: 构建配对数据集（537条雷达心音记录 × 162名患者，每个患者对应一份超声报告），覆盖LVEF<50%、节段性室壁运动异常、中度及以上瓣膜反流三类重叠表型（各38/43/39例）；提供原始复数信号、处理后的雷达心音与时间质量分段；技术验证保留95.93%信号时长并确认波形重建可复现；采用患者级五折交叉验证评估表型分类。
AI.result: 信号质量技术验证通过（保真度95.93%、重建可复现）；LVEF减低检测的患者级外测平均AUROC为0.770±0.138。
AI.conclusion: 该资源为连接非接触心脏机械信号与超声结构/功能表型的研究提供基础支撑，但样本量有限、仅三类表型、缺少公开代码与跨中心验证。

title: Certified Abstention for Provably-Unidentifiable Index-Phase Recovery in Image Registration
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Image registration underpins measurement across scanning, camera, and microscopy imaging, yet a fundamental question is rarely posed: when is the sample-to-position map recoverable at all, and when does any estimator that reports a position necessarily fabricate one? We show that in reference-perturbed sampled imaging, where samples are localized through a perturbed reference, position fidelity (where samples land) and phase fidelity (which reference index becomes each block's origin) are logically independent: no policy acting on position information alone can guarantee phase fidelity. We derive a tight resolution threshold separating recoverable from provably-unidentifiable registration, and a recovery framework that certifies identifiable regions--recovering them exactly--while abstaining on provably-unidentifiable regions rather than hallucinating structure. On a deployed scanning system we measure a direction-bimodal registration offset consistent with the theory. Against classical and learned restoration baselines, certificate-free offset estimators fabricate structure on the unidentifiable regime, whereas the certified method abstains rather than fabricating. Finally, the certified-abstention mechanism carries across scanning, rolling-shutter, and cryo-electron-microscopy imaging--declining rather than fabricating on the regime it flags--though how completely it abstains and how tightly it bounds kept-region risk stay modality-specific (at extreme SNR the cryo-EM certificate abstains only partially): a structural-versus-statistical boundary in registration reliability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出参考扰动采样成像中“位置保真”与“相位保真”逻辑独立的观点，给出可恢复/不可辨识的紧致分辨率阈值，并提出可认证区域精确恢复、不可辨识区域弃权的配准框架。
AI.motivation: 图像配准广泛用于扫描、相机与显微成像，但“样本到位置映射何时可恢复、何时任何估计器都只能捏造位置”这一根本问题很少被提出。
AI.method: 在参考扰动采样成像中把配准分解为位置保真与相位保真，证明仅依赖位置信息的策略无法保证相位保真；推导紧致分辨率阈值划分可恢复与可证不可辨识区域；构建带认证的恢复框架，对可辨识区域精确恢复、对不可辨识区域弃权。
AI.result: 在部署的扫描系统上测到符合理论的方向双峰配准偏移；相比经典与学习型复原基线，无认证的偏移估计器在不可辨识区捏造结构，认证方法则弃权；弃权机制可迁移到扫描、卷帘快门与冷冻电镜成像，但弃权完备性与保留区域风险界依模态而异（极端SNR下冷冻电镜认证仅部分弃权）。
AI.conclusion: 配准可靠性存在结构性—统计性边界：位置与相位保真不可由位置信息单独桥接，认证弃权是可跨模态推广的通用原则。

title: Relational Geometry Forcing for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robot manipulation by jointly learning visual dynamics and executable actions. However, their video and action objectives do not explicitly constrain the 3D geometry that is crucial for precise manipulation. Recently, geometry-aware WAMs introduce depth or 4D prediction branches, whereas representation alignment methods supervise intermediate WAM features with pretrained 3D foundation models. Yet we find that such pointwise alignment benefits the video features but degrades action learning, since dense geometric feature targets overly restrict compact action features. To address this limitation, we propose Relational Geometry Forcing (RGF), which transfers geometric priors from a frozen 3D foundation model by aligning pairwise feature relations instead of pointwise features. Specifically, RGF applies three complementary relational objectives, where intra-frame and cross-view relations transfer scene geometry and multi-view correspondence to the video features, while action-temporal relations couple action dynamics to geometric scene evolution. Applied only during training, RGF requires no explicit geometry branch or extra inference module. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the effectiveness of Relational Geometry Forcing, showing consistent gains across diverse manipulation scenarios and WAM paradigms.

AI.tldr: 提出Relational Geometry Forcing (RGF)：不添加几何分支，仅在训练时用冻结3D基础模型对齐"成对特征关系"（帧内、跨视角、动作-时序三类关系），把几何先验注入WAM的视频特征，避免逐点对齐对紧凑动作特征的过度约束。
AI.motivation: WAM的视频/动作目标缺乏显式3D几何约束；已有几何感知WAM需加深度或4D预测分支，成本高；而用3D基础模型做逐点特征对齐虽提升视频特征却损害动作学习，因为稠密几何目标对紧凑动作特征限制过强。
AI.method: 从冻结3D基础模型迁移几何先验，采用关系对齐替代逐点对齐：(1) 帧内关系迁移场景几何；(2) 跨视角关系迁移多视角对应；(3) 动作-时序关系将动作动力学与场景几何演化耦合。仅在训练阶段使用，推理零额外模块。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验显示一致增益，跨多种操作场景与多种WAM范式均有效。
AI.conclusion: 关系式（而非逐点）几何蒸馏是向WAM注入3D先验的更优途径：既保留几何收益，又不牺牲动作表征的紧凑性与可学性，且不增加推理开销。

title: Computer Vision and Knowledge-Grounded Language Models for Intelligent Beekeeper Assistance
summary: Managed and wild bees sustain roughly a third of the global food products, yet colonies face mounting stress from climate-change including extreme weather patterns, altered parasite and disease patterns. Timely assessment of colony condition such as understanding colony strength, brood area, honey and pollen storage, comb usage, is essential to adaptive management. However, manual hive frame inspection is slow, costly, and quality depends on scarce expertise. We present an artificial targeted intelligent system framework focusing on edge deployable pipeline that turns hive frame photographs into interpretable and action-oriented inspection report. The pipeline includes an object detector to detect biologically-meaningful comb-cell classes; detections are distilled into structured fact schema; facts are converted into constrained factual text; the text triggers a grounded knowledge-base for interpretations and recommendations. Knowledge-base entries are required to be triggerable by evidence expressed in the fact schema. We built our system based on open source FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset and favour reproducible, edge-deployable models over large general purpose frontier models. We additionally release FAIRHiveText-1K dataset that turns FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset into interchangeable facts and text interpretation of the facts, making it easy for further LLM-based research into this area. We also propose a pathway to develop the grounded knowledge-base that will be helpful in providing interpretable and actionable reports from the facts.

AI.tldr: 提出面向蜂巢框图像的可边缘部署智能巡检流水线：目标检测识别生物语义巢脾单元→结构化事实schema→受约束文本生成→触发式知识库给出解读与建议；发布FAIRHiveText-1K数据集。
AI.motivation: 蜜蜂授粉支撑约三分之一的全球食品，蜂群面临气候变化、极端天气及病虫害模式变化的压力，需及时评估蜂群强度、子脾面积、蜜粉储量与巢脾利用等状态以支持适应性管理；人工巢框检查慢、成本高且依赖稀缺专家经验。
AI.method: 基于开源FAIRHiveFrames-1K数据集构建端到端流水线：目标检测器检测具有生物学意义的巢房类别（子脾、蜜、粉、空巢房等）；检测结果蒸馏为结构化事实schema；事实经受约束生成转为可核查的事实文本；文本触发有依据（grounded）的知识库条目，产出可解释、可行动的巡检报告。强调可复现、可边缘部署的小模型，优先于大型通用前沿模型；知识库条目须能被schema中的证据触发。
AI.result: 构建并验证了检测-事实-文本-知识库的可解释流水线；额外发布FAIRHiveText-1K数据集，将FAIRHiveFrames-1K转为可互换的事实与文本解读对，便于后续LLM研究；提出有据知识库的构建路径。摘要未给出定量精度或现场部署指标。
AI.conclusion: 将巢框图像检查自动化并转化为可解释、可操作的报告，是蜂群适应性管理的可行技术路线；结构化事实作为中间表示是连接感知、语言生成与领域知识的关键，该范式可迁移至其他边缘端农业/生物监测场景。

title: Latent space configuration for neural network finetuning, fast ranking, and embedding dimensionality reduction
summary: Finding K most similar elements for a query in a large gallery of neural network (NN) embeddings is essential in various areas of computer science and industrial applications of artificial intelligence. This paper proposes search algorithms for structured latent spaces (LS) of NNs which allow to speed up top K item retrieval owing to O(1) complexity small candidate gallery subset search. ArcFace-pretrained IResNet50 models are finetuned using Latent Space Configuration (LSC) methodology to obtain new distribution of embeddings with desired geometric properties. Applying the proposed algorithms to embeddings obtained from finetuned models leads to several times speed-up over baseline exhaustive search. Specifically, we report up to 3 times speed-up on GPU and 40% speed-up on CPU compared to the baseline method GPU speed. These results are obtained for the original and reduced numbers of LS dimensions. The results show that LS dimensionality reduction allows to further accelerate the search and even improve rank-N metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出面向神经网络结构化隐空间的近似最近邻检索算法，利用O(1)复杂度的候选子集搜索加速Top-K检索，并通过Latent Space Configuration微调获得几何性质有利的嵌入分布，相比穷举搜索在GPU上最高3倍、CPU上40%加速，降维还能进一步提升rank-N指标。
AI.motivation: 大规模NN嵌入库上的Top-K相似元素检索是计算机视觉与AI工业应用的关键环节，穷举搜索代价高，需要利用嵌入空间的结构特性来加速检索。
AI.method: 以ArcFace预训练的IResNet50为基础，采用Latent Space Configuration(LSC)方法微调，使嵌入分布具备所需的几何性质；在此结构化隐空间上设计O(1)复杂度的小候选子集搜索算法，先快速定位候选再精确排序，实现Top-K加速。
AI.result: 在原始与降维的隐空间维度上，相比基线穷举搜索，GPU上最高3倍加速、CPU上40%加速；隐空间降维可进一步加速检索，甚至改善rank-N检索指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过微调重塑嵌入的几何结构并结合候选子集搜索，可在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著加速大规模Top-K检索，为工业级检索系统提供可行方案。

title: Compressing Onboard Language Models for Space Robots under a Behavioral-Fidelity Requirement
summary: Language models are being explored as the interface through which space robots interpret operator commands and select among verified skills. Running them onboard calls for low-bit compression, and flight use adds requirements that generic post-training quantization leaves implicit: a fixed memory budget and storage format, a static artifact under configuration control, and behavior close to the full-precision model validated on the ground. We treat compression as a ground-segment step and study QSelect, which composes one static low-bit model from compatible AWQ, GPTQ, and AutoRound checkpoints by assigning each linear module to one quantizer family and scoring every substitution at the final next-token distribution. The default fidelity mode needs no labels or tuned thresholds and accepts a substitution only when the forward KL divergence from the BF16 reference decreases; an optional target-adapted mode adds answer likelihood on a small labeled set. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Llama-3.2-3B at 3 and 4 bits, composed models reach lower mean held-out perplexity than every single-family model in all six settings, and the fidelity mode lowers perplexity and KL further. In a matched scaffold, final-output scoring gives lower held-out KL than representation-similarity scoring in all 12 paired runs. With labels from training or development splits of the evaluated task families, the target-adapted mode raises 3-bit pooled accuracy on the two Llama models by 4.3 and 4.5 points over the best single-family model. At 3 bits, unquantized embedding and output layers make up 43-46% of the packed artifact. All evaluations use general-domain benchmarks on a ground GPU; space-domain tasks and flight hardware are left to future work.

AI.tldr: QSelect: 在ground段将AWQ/GPTQ/AutoRound按线性模块粒度组合为单一静态低比特模型，以最终next-token分布的forward KL为打分准则选择替换，用于空间机器人机载LM压缩。
AI.motivation: 空间机器人用语言模型作指令接口并选择已验证技能，机载部署需要固定显存预算/存储格式、受配置管理的静态工件以及与全精度模型行为一致的ground验证；通用PTQ未显式处理这些飞行级约束。
AI.method: 将压缩视为地面段步骤：对每个linear模块从兼容的AWQ/GPTQ/AutoRound检查点中指派一个量化器族，逐替换在最终next-token分布上打分；默认fidelity模式无需标签、仅当相对BF16参考的forward KL下降时接受替换；可选target-adapted模式在小规模有标签集上加入答案似然。
AI.result: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B 在3/4 bit六种设置下，组合模型held-out平均困惑度均低于任何单一方法族，fidelity模式进一步降低困惑度与KL；12组配对实验中最终输出打分均优于表示相似度打分；有标签时3-bit池化准确率较最佳单族分别提升4.3与4.5点；3-bit下未量化embedding与输出层占打包工件43-46%。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种可工程落地的、静态可复现的多族量化组合流程，短期为空间机器人LM部署的准备工作；空间域任务与飞行硬件验证留待后续。

title: Asking What a Director Sees Can Change What Vision-Language Models Choose
summary: Vision-language models are now routinely tested on theory of mind: whether they can work out what another person sees, knows, and means. A common design asks the model to report that perspective and then to act for the person, and reads a correct report beside a wrong action as a failure to use the perspective. That reading rests on a quiet assumption: that asking for the report leaves the action unchanged. We show that it does not. In a rendered Director Task, a partition hides the largest block from a director who asks for "the largest block". Asking first which blocks the director can see raises the share of replies that choose this hidden block by 12 to 88 percentage points on six GPT models and by 17 on Qwen3.8-27B, even though the models mostly report correctly which blocks the director sees. Reasoning traces and prompt rewordings suggest why: the question shifts how the request is read, from the director's view toward the model's own. When the prompt states what the director knows and refers to, fewer than 1% of replies pair a correct report with a hidden-block choice. Any evaluation that elicits a perspective report before the action it scores needs a baseline without the question, and we deliver one: paired prompts that differ only in that question, a design any perspective-taking benchmark can adopt.

AI.tldr: 在渲染版Director Task中，先要求模型报告"导演能看到哪些积木"再提问行动，会使选择被遮挡最大积木的比例上升12–88个百分点（六个GPT模型）和17个百分点（Qwen3-27B），尽管报告本身大都正确；加入不含该问题的配对基线后，正确报告配错误行动的比例降至<1%。
AI.motivation: 现有心智理论（ToM）评测范式假定"先问视角报告不会改变随后行动"，据此把"报告正确、行动错误"判为未能利用视角信息。作者质疑这一隐含假设，并指出该范式可能人为制造虚假的ToM失败结论。
AI.method: 构造渲染版Director Task：隔板遮挡最大的积木，导演请求"最大的积木"。设计配对提示词，仅在一处差异上区分"是否先询问导演能看到哪些积木"，在多个GPT模型与Qwen3-27B上对比作答分布；同时分析推理轨迹与提示改写，并测试显式陈述导演知识与指称的提示条件。
AI.result: 先问视角报告使选择被遮挡积木的比例在六个GPT模型上提高12–88个百分点，Qwen3-27B提高17个百分点，而报告准确率仍较高；推理轨迹显示提问把请求的解读从"导演视角"偏移到"模型自身视角"；当提示直接陈述导演所知与所指时，正确报告+错误行动的组合低于1%。
AI.conclusion: "报告+行动"式ToM评测存在提问诱发的行为污染，须引入不含该问题的基线；作者给出仅差一句提问的配对提示设计方案，可被通用视角采择基准采纳。

title: OpenMAP-HIE: Pathology Informed Score-based Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Lesion Segmentation
summary: Accurate localization of neonatal hypoxic--ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) lesions on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images is clinically important but is limited by scarce expert annotations and substantial variation in lesion appearance. We propose OpenMAP-HIE, a pathology-informed score-based diffusion model for unsupervised HIE lesion localization without voxel-wise lesion supervision. A denoising diffusion model learns the healthy neonatal ADC distribution, while a ControlNet-based conditional branch preserves patient-specific anatomy. At inference, anomaly evidence is derived directly from differences between conditional and unconditioned noise predictions at independently evaluated diffusion noise levels, avoiding dependence on a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction or sequential reverse-diffusion chain. Based on the characteristic ADC reduction associated with acute HIE, only discrepancies consistent with the expected pathological direction are retained and aggregated across noise levels using a geometric mean. Spatial mean filtering further suppresses isolated responses. The framework was evaluated on the BONBID-HIE dataset. The ADC-only method achieved a Dice score of $0.283\pm0.244$, average precision of $0.505$, Hausdorff distance of $25.45\pm15.63$ mm, mean average surface distance of $9.40\pm8.49$ mm, and normalized surface distance of $0.355\pm0.236$, providing the best overlap and surface-distance performance among the evaluated unsupervised methods and Dice performance comparable to supervised ADC-only models. Optional population-derived ADC $Z$-map refinement further increased Dice to $0.602\pm0.269$. These findings support pathology-informed score discrepancies as a useful signal for neonatal HIE lesion localization, while highlighting remaining challenges in detecting small and low-contrast lesions.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMAP-HIE：基于score-based扩散模型+ControlNet条件分支的无监督新生儿HIE病灶定位方法，从条件与非条件噪声预测的差异直接导出异常证据，并结合ADC降低方向先验与几何平均聚合。
AI.motivation: 新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶在ADC图上的精确定位有临床价值，但专家标注稀缺、病灶外观变化大，有体素级监督的方法受限。
AI.method: 用去噪扩散模型学习健康新生儿ADC分布，ControlNet条件分支保留病人个体解剖；推理时在独立采样的多个噪声水平上比较条件与非条件噪声预测之差作为异常证据，避免依赖最终伪健康重建或顺序反向扩散链；只保留符合急性HIE ADC降低方向的偏差，按几何平均跨噪声级聚合，并加空间均值滤波抑制孤立响应；可选用群体ADC Z-map精修。
AI.result: BONBID-HIE上仅用ADC的版本Dice 0.283±0.244、AP 0.505、HD 25.45±15.63mm、MASD 9.40±8.49mm、NSD 0.355±0.236，在无监督方法中重叠与表面距离指标最佳，Dice与有监督ADC-only模型相当；加Z-map精修后Dice升至0.602±0.269。
AI.conclusion: 病理先验约束的score差异是新生儿HIE病灶定位的有效信号，但小尺寸、低对比病灶的检测仍是主要挑战。

title: OACap: Caption-Guided Active Observation for Detailed Video Captioning
summary: Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.

AI.tldr: OACap: a caption-centered agent that converts unsupported/missing info into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies/revises captions; plus FSCap-Bench with CSFS and CSRS metrics.
AI.motivation: Open-ended detailed video captioning requires deciding what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description, unlike query-specified QA; existing captions lack diagnostics for what factual/semantic info they preserve.
AI.method: Agentic iterative loop: identify unsupported or missing claims in a draft caption, issue targeted observation requests, call spatiotemporal video tools to gather evidence, then verify and revise. Evaluation via general video-understanding benchmarks with a fixed text-only reader; new FSCap-Bench with Core-Support Factuality Score (claim precision + importance-aware fact coverage) and Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (video-caption-video-caption atomic-fact matching).
AI.result: OACap captions consistently improve performance on general video-understanding benchmarks with a fixed text-only reader; CSFS responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0–98.3% of valid caption pairs.
AI.conclusion: Caption-centered agentic evidence acquisition yields better captions as textual memory, linking downstream utility to measurable factual and semantic preservation.

title: Plan First, Act Later: Streaming Reasoning for Executable Memory in Robot Control
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to remember task-relevant information beyond its short observation window. Existing memory-augmented policies typically retrieve relevant information from history and reason over it at execution time, placing a heavy reasoning burden on the high-level model. To address this challenge, we propose PAL (\textbf{P}lan first, \textbf{A}ct \textbf{L}ater), a hierarchical memory framework for vision-language robot manipulation. It maintains a short-term visual buffer, a semantic-event memory, and an executable \texttt{subtask\_list}. A high-level vision-language model (VLM) converts streaming visual observations into the \texttt{subtask\_list}. At execution time, the VLM selects the currently relevant subtask from the \texttt{subtask\_list} and passes it to a low-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy. To teach the model what to write to memory and when to update it, we introduce a two-stage data generation procedure that first expands sparse update supervision and then uses self-labeling with task-grounded verification to generate training data that better match the state distribution encountered during execution. We evaluate our approach on memory-dependent benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. On RoboMME, PAL achieves a \textbf{56.05\%} success rate, outperforming the strongest baseline, FrameSamp-Modul, at 44.51\%. In real-world experiments across four manipulation tasks, \pal{} reaches \textbf{60.83\%} overall success, surpassing MemER (45.00\%) and FrameSamp-Modul (28.33\%). These results show that proactively writing future-relevant subtasks into hierarchical memory improves long-horizon visual reasoning and robot control. Code and videos can be found on our website: this https URL

AI.tldr: PAL提出分层记忆框架（短期视觉缓冲+语义事件记忆+可执行subtask_list），高层VLM主动将未来相关子任务写入记忆，执行时仅需选择当前子任务并交由低层VLA策略执行，显著降低推理负担。
AI.motivation: 长时序机器人操作超出观测窗口，现有记忆增强策略需在执行时从历史中检索并推理，给高层模型带来沉重推理负担。
AI.method: 分层记忆：短期视觉缓冲、语义事件记忆、可执行subtask_list；高层VLM把流式视觉观测转成子任务列表，执行时选当前子任务传给低层VLA。两阶段数据生成：先扩展稀疏更新监督，再用任务接地验证的自标注生成更贴近执行状态分布的训练数据。
AI.result: RoboMME成功率56.05%，超过最强基线FrameSamp-Modul（44.51%）；真实世界四项操作任务总体成功率60.83%，超过MemER（45.00%）与FrameSamp-Modul（28.33%）。
AI.conclusion: 主动将未来相关子任务写入分层记忆可提升长时序视觉推理与机器人控制性能。

title: Payload generalization on feedforward control actions for trajectory tracking in robots with rigid and elastic joints
comment: 18 pages, 17 figures. Accepted for publication in Control Engineering Practice
summary: Industries employ robots for repetitive tasks due to their high precision and performance, typically achieved through feedforward control actions based on an accurate robot description. However, an exact dynamic model can be difficult to obtain, especially for robots with elastic elements or when the payload changes. Learning-based feedforward approaches are promising for trajectory tracking under model uncertainties, but typically face generalization issues when task parameters vary. This paper proposes a novel method to generalize the feedforward control action with respect to payload parameters, independently of the underlying controller. Firstly, the minimal number of example objects needed for payload generalization is derived. Then, an algorithm is proposed to execute the same trajectory with a new payload, given only its parameters, without knowledge of the robot's dynamic model and even in the presence of elastic joints. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated in simulations and experiments on tracking tasks with different robots and controllers. Two sets of experiments are performed: on a standard Franka Emika Panda robot, and on a Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an elastic wrist.

AI.tldr: 提出一种与底层控制器无关的前馈控制泛化方法：只需给出新负载参数，即可在新负载下复现同一轨迹，并推导了负载泛化所需的最小示例物体数量，在Franka Panda及带弹性手腕的Panda上验证。
AI.motivation: 精确机器人动力学模型难以获得，尤其在存在弹性关节或负载变化时；学习型前馈方法在任务参数变化时泛化能力差。
AI.method: 先理论推导负载参数泛化所需的最小示例物体数，再提出算法：仅依据新负载参数，在未知动力学模型、甚至存在弹性关节条件下，用同一轨迹生成可泛化的前馈控制量；方法独立于底层控制器，仿真与实验验证。
AI.result: 在标准Franka Emika Panda与加装弹性手腕的Panda上完成两组轨迹跟踪实验，验证了跨负载前馈泛化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 负载参数化的前馈控制可在无需动力学模型与控制器知识的情况下泛化，对弹性关节与变负载场景具实用价值。

title: Reading the Mask: Descriptor-Grounded BI-RADS Rationale Generation for Breast MRI Segmentation
summary: Deep learning based models accurately delineate tumours on dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI), but segmentation masks alone do not provide the rationales or reasoning used by radiologists to assess the lesion suspicion. This limits the explainability as well the clinical integration. We investigate whether clinically relevant descriptors can instead be derived from the segmentation masks and their dynamic contrast-enhancement series. We have used Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) guidelines as a structured framework. Using these guidelines we designed a BI-RADS decision tree with eight quantitative measurements using radiomics, together with the lesion size and component count, that determine the descriptors at eight nodes. Using these descriptors we generate natural-language rationale using a large language model. The model was constrained to express only the derived records from the decision tree. After applying this framework to the expert and automatic masks of each of the 1,506 cases in the MAMA-MIA dataset, we generated a reproducible corpus of 3,012 BI-RADS grounded rationales. We obtained a faithfulness score of 99.98% and a counterfactual accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that the generated rationales faithfully verbalises the measured descriptors and correctly reflects changes in the underlying record. Agreement between the descriptors from expert and automatic masks falls from 0.832 to 0.549 as mask quality falls from Good to Missed. The generated rationales are intended as draft representations for radiologist review and final sign-off rather than autonomous clinical reports.

AI.tldr: 从DCE-MRI分割掩膜出发，用BI-RADS决策树结合放射组学测量生成八类临床描述符，再由大语言模型受限地转写为可溯源的自然语言诊断依据，在MAMA-MIA 1,506例上生成3,012条理由，忠实性99.98%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习分割只给出肿瘤掩膜，缺乏放射科医生评估病灶可疑性时所用的描述依据，可解释性与临床整合受限。作者希望直接从掩膜及其动态增强序列中推导出临床相关描述符。
AI.method: 以BI-RADS指南为结构化框架，设计含八个节点的决策树，每个节点由放射组学得到的八个定量测量加上病灶大小与成分计数决定描述符；随后用大语言模型将决策树导出的结构化记录受约束地转写为自然语言理由，模型被限制只能表述已导出的记录。在MAMA-MIA数据集的1,506例专家掩膜与自动掩膜上分别应用该框架。
AI.result: 生成3,012条可复现的BI-RADS依据文本，忠实性得分99.98%、反事实准确率99.3%，说明生成文本忠实转述了测量描述符并能正确反映底层记录变化。专家掩膜与自动掩膜描述符一致性随掩膜质量由Good到Missed从0.832降至0.549。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可溯源的掩膜级BI-RADS解释路径，定位为供放射科医生审阅与签字的草稿表示，而非自主临床报告；描述符一致性对掩膜质量高度敏感。

title: Seeing through Denoising: Frequency-guided One-step Denoising for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) is a challenging task due to the extremely small size of targets, low signal-to-noise ratios, and heavy background clutter in infrared imagery. While the progress of deep learning has advanced this field, existing methods primarily adopt discriminative paradigms that directly map images to target masks, overlooking the potential of generative modeling. In this paper, we propose DiffIRSTD, a novel generative framework that reformulates infrared small target detection as a background reconstruction problem. Instead of explicitly predicting target regions, we reinterpret small targets as noise-like signals and leverage a diffusion-based model to recover a clean, target-free background from a perturbed input image. The residual between the reconstructed background and the original image is then exploited to highlight candidate target regions, providing explicit cues for subsequent detection. To address the computational cost typically associated with diffusion sampling, we introduce a one-step denoising strategy that enables efficient background reconstruction while maintaining practical inference speed. Furthermore, we present a frequency-guided perception loss to preserve high-frequency background details and focus more on the reconstruction quality of target regions. More importantly, our DiffIRSTD operates as a plug-and-play framework, compatible with existing IRSTD models without increasing the computational complexity of detectors. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1K, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method, achieving state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: DiffIRSTD 将红外小目标检测改写为"背景重建"生成式问题：把小目标视为类噪声扰动，用扩散模型从受扰图像重建无目标干净背景，以残差凸显候选目标区域。
AI.motivation: 现有 IRSTD 深度方法多为判别式范式，直接图像→掩码映射，忽视了生成式建模的潜力；而小目标在扩散模型中天然类似噪声信号，适合用"去噪即去目标"的角度重新表述任务。
AI.method: 提出扩散式背景重建框架：将小目标视作噪声，训练扩散模型从含目标图像重建无目标背景；用重建背景与原图之差作为目标线索。为降低扩散采样开销，引入一步去噪策略实现高效推理；并提出频率引导感知损失以保留高频背景细节并侧重目标区域重建质量。框架即插即用，与现有 IRSTD 检测器兼容且不增加其计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在 IRSTD-1K、NUAA-SIRST、NUDT-SIRST 三个基准上取得 SOTA 性能，并保持实用推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 生成式背景重建 + 残差线索是 IRSTD 的有效替代范式，且以插件方式与判别式检测器互补，具备实际部署价值。

title: AOV-GS: Active Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping with 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Published at AIST 2026
summary: Robots deployed in human-centered environments need maps that support both geometric navigation and open-vocabulary semantic queries beyond a fixed label set. A key challenge is enriching such maps with semantic information without relying on manually annotated segmentation masks or closed-set semantic categories. Existing geometry-driven active mapping maximizes coverage but treats semantics as a passive by-product of the collected trajectory, whereas active semantic mapping typically depends on supervised semantic segmentation. We present AOV-GS, an active 3D Gaussian mapping system that guides exploration using frozen foundation models. During coarse exploration, AOV-GS re-ranks geometrically promising candidate views according to CLIP mask-embedding novelty computed from SAM instance segmentation, biasing exploration toward semantically informative regions. Frozen SAM and CLIP provide instance masks and language-aligned embeddings throughout mapping, while a lightweight scene-specific language field is fitted offline directly to the collected CLIP embeddings rather than manually annotated masks, enabling open-vocabulary text-query segmentation on novel views. In a controlled comparison using the same SAM-CLIP perception stack, AOV-GS improves average language-field mIoU over geometry-only active planning by 1.3 percentage points on Replica (34.6% on eight scenes) and by 1.8 points on Matterport3D (23.1% on five scenes). With CorrCLIP, AOV-GS reaches 35.6% on Replica, 2.0 points above the matched Geometry-based + CorrCLIP baseline. Novel-view PSNR remains comparable to the geometry-only baseline on both datasets while depth L1 improves on Replica. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 AOV-GS：用冻结 SAM+CLIP 指导主动探索的 3D 高斯建图系统，实现开词表语义查询。
AI.motivation: 机器人在人本环境中需要同时支持几何导航与开词表语义查询的地图；现有几何驱动主动建图把语义当作轨迹副产品，而主动语义建图依赖监督分割掩码与闭集类别，难以扩展。
AI.method: 粗探索阶段：用 SAM 实例掩码计算 CLIP 掩码嵌入新颖度，对几何可行的候选视角重排序，使探索偏向语义信息丰富区域；全程使用冻结 SAM/CLIP 提供实例掩码与语言对齐嵌入；离线拟合轻量场景特定语言场到采集的 CLIP 嵌入（而非人工掩码）。
AI.result: 相同 SAM-CLIP 感知栈对照下，语言场 mIoU 较纯几何主动规划在 Replica 提升 1.3 点（8 场景均值 34.6%）、Matterport3D 提升 1.8 点（5 场景 23.1%）；配 CorrCLIP 在 Replica 达 35.6%，高出匹配基线 2.0 点；新视角 PSNR 与基线相当，Replica 上深度 L1 改善。
AI.conclusion: 语义新颖度驱动的视角重排序可在不牺牲几何重建质量的前提下，以极低成本（无需分割标注）提升开词表语义建图质量；但增益幅度（1–2 点）仍属增量。

title: Integrating Flow Matching and Model Predictive Control for Safe Robot Navigation
summary: Learning-based path planners based on diffusion and flow matching can generate diverse trajectories from demonstrations but typically lack mechanisms for constraint satisfaction and collision avoidance during deployment. This work proposes a framework that combines flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive path-following control to integrate data-driven path generation with real-time, constraint-aware execution. The flow-matching model captures multimodal path distributions, while the predictive controller adapts motion online to satisfy state and input constraints and avoid obstacles using updated local sensor information. An event-triggered re-planning scheme incorporates predictive control solutions into subsequent path generation, promoting collision-free navigation in environments with previously unseen obstacles. Simulation results for mobile robot navigation demonstrate robust performance across cluttered environments. The framework provides a systematic approach to combining flow matching with predictive control for adaptive, data-driven navigation.

AI.tldr: 将flow matching多模态路径生成与模型预测路径跟踪控制结合，并以事件触发重规划引入MPC解，实现满足约束与避障的数据驱动导航。
AI.motivation: 扩散/flow matching路径规划能从示范生成多样轨迹，但部署时缺乏显式约束满足与实时避障机制。
AI.method: Flow matching模型学习多模态路径分布；MPC路径跟踪控制器在线调整运动以满足状态/输入约束并基于最新局部传感避障；事件触发重规划把MPC解回注到后续路径生成中，提升对未知障碍的适应。
AI.result: 移动机器人仿真在杂乱环境中表现出稳健导航性能，未见障碍场景下亦保持无碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 提出flow matching与预测控制结合的系统性框架，实现自适应、数据驱动且约束感知的导航；仅有仿真验证。

title: AdvFidelity: Unifying Preference Alignment and Few-Step Image Generation within Reinforcement Learning
summary: Practical image generation requires both human preference alignment and few-step efficiency, yet combining reinforcement learning (RL) with distillation is often multi-stage and may erode RL gains We observe that few-step RL progressively improves structural coherence, even with specialized rewards, but leaves low-level artifacts that these rewards may fail to penalize. To address this gap, we propose AdvFidelity, which integrates artifact-sensitive fidelity supervision into RL through an online adversarial reward. This enables joint reward alignment and high-fidelity few-step generation within a single RL stage, without distribution matching distillation (DMD) or other explicit distillation objectives. We train a discriminator to rank high-quality references (positives) above content-matched reconstructions (negatives) produced by the current generator. Reconstructing moderately noised references largely preserves style and scene layout while exposing low-level degradations. This encourages the discriminator to assess artifacts rather than content differences. With negatives reconstructed online, alternating updates adapt fidelity supervision to the generator's evolving failure modes. References can come from existing target-domain data or full-step model samples. Built on LeapAlign, AdvFidelity backpropagates gradients from both rewards through the few-step sampling trajectories used at inference. Across two model backbones and three task settings, AdvFidelity matches full-step LeapAlign in alignment, task performance, and overall generation quality and remains highly competitive with other evaluated full-step RL methods, using only 4 or 8 steps without CFG.

AI.tldr: 提出AdvFidelity，将对抗性保真度监督（在线判别器奖励）整合进单阶段少步强化学习，实现偏好对齐与高保真少步生成的统一，无需DMD等显式蒸馏，4/8步无CFG即可媲美全步RL方法。
AI.motivation: 少步图像生成需同时满足人类偏好对齐与推理效率，但RL+蒸馏的多阶段流程易削弱RL收益；且少步RL虽改善结构一致性，却残留低频/低层伪影，专用奖励难以惩罚这些伪影。
AI.method: 构建判别器，将高质量参考（正样本）排在当前生成器对中度加噪参考的重建结果（负样本）之上；重建大致保留风格与场景布局，从而迫使判别器关注低层伪影而非内容差异；负样本在线重建，交替更新使其适配生成器演化中的失败模式；参考可来自目标域真实数据或全步模型采样。基于LeapAlign，在推理所用的少步采样轨迹上同时反传两类奖励梯度。
AI.result: 在两个模型骨干、三种任务设置下，仅用4或8步且不使用CFG，AdvFidelity在对齐度、任务表现与整体生成质量上与全步LeapAlign持平，并与其他全步RL方法保持强竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 在线对抗保真度奖励可作为通用补偿项嵌入少步RL，单阶段完成对齐与去伪影，避免多阶段蒸馏的收益损失。

title: FM-Occ: Feature-Diverse Upsampling and Memory-Aware Decoding for 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction estimates voxel-wise occupancy and semantic labels throughout a scene. Our experiments reveal that conventional sparse transposed-convolution upsampling yields poorly differentiated voxel responses and that successive decoder layers discard previously correct semantic predictions. To address these issues, we present Feature-Diverse Upsampling and Memory-Aware Decoding for 3D Occupancy Prediction (FM-Occ), comprising two components. First, 3D Sparse Subvoxel Shuffle (3S) mitigates feature homogenization by constructing candidate child features in the channel dimension, jointly transforming and normalizing them, and then rearranging them onto a finer sparse grid with explicit feature-coordinate correspondence. Second, Entropy-Regulated Layer-wise Memory (ER-LM) retains semantic information across decoder layers by maintaining a layer-wise memory for each query through gated recurrent updates and using prediction entropy to regulate the historical information propagated to the next layer. During training, a class-weighted entropy loss Lcwe provides label-guided regularization for matched semantic queries. On SemanticKITTI, 3S increases the spatial coefficient of variation of normalized voxel-wise root-mean-square (RMS) responses from 0.41% to 4.03%, while ER-LM reduces semantic degradation and improves error correction across decoder layers. The combined FM-Occ improves mIoU from 12.16% to 12.73% with negligible memory overhead. ER-LM further improves mIoU in the BEV-based DISC framework from 16.78% to 17.17%, supporting its applicability across 3D voxel-based and BEV-based architectures.

AI.tldr: FM-Occ 针对 3D 语义占用预测中稀疏转置卷积上采样特征同质化与解码器逐层丢弃正确语义的问题，提出 3D Sparse Subvoxel Shuffle（3S）与 Entropy-Regulated Layer-wise Memory（ER-LM）两个模块，并配合类加权熵损失 Lcwe；在 SemanticKITTI 上提升空间变异系数与 mIoU，并可迁移至 BEV 框架 DISC。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 占用预测方法存在两点实证缺陷：(1) 常规稀疏转置卷积上采样产生的体素响应区分度低（归一化体素 RMS 响应的空间变异系数仅 0.41%），特征趋于同质化；(2) 逐层解码过程中，后续层会丢弃先前层已正确的语义预测，造成语义退化。
AI.method: 提出 FM-Occ，包含两个组件。其一为 3D Sparse Subvoxel Shuffle（3S）：在通道维构造候选子体素特征，联合变换与归一化后重排至更细的稀疏网格，并保持显式的特征—坐标对应关系，以缓解特征同质化。其二为 Entropy-Regulated Layer-wise Memory（ER-LM）：为每个 query 维护逐层记忆，通过门控循环更新保留跨解码层的语义信息，并利用预测熵调控向下一层传播的历史信息。训练时使用类加权熵损失 Lcwe 对匹配到的语义 query 提供标签引导正则。
AI.result: SemanticKITTI 上，3S 将归一化体素 RMS 响应的空间变异系数由 0.41% 提升至 4.03%；ER-LM 减轻语义退化并改善跨层错误纠正；组合模型 FM-Occ 将 mIoU 由 12.16% 提升至 12.73%，内存开销可忽略。ER-LM 亦可将 BEV 框架 DISC 的 mIoU 由 16.78% 提升至 17.17%。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏上采样中的特征同质化与逐层解码中的语义遗忘是两个可量化、可独立修复的模块级瓶颈，3S 与 ER-LM 分别对症且即插即用，可跨体素式与 BEV 式架构复用。但整体增益幅度有限（mIoU +0.57），属工程性增量改进，无开源或实机/实时证据。

title: Progressive Permutation Alignment with Temperature-Controlled Spectral Sharpening
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: In implicit neural representations (INRs), 3D signals are encoded directly in network weights, making stable weight-space operations essential. However, permutation symmetry causes independently trained yet functionally equivalent models to appear distant in weight space, often inducing large loss barriers under linear interpolation. Existing neuron alignment methods either commit early to discrete matches and become trapped in inconsistent local optima or rely on computationally expensive gradient optimization over continuous relaxations, both of which are unreliable in challenging cases such as NeRF. We adopt progressive alignment, a layer-wise strategy that follows inter-layer dependencies from input to output. At each layer, a correlation matrix is estimated and aligned with a discrete anchor obtained by the Hungarian algorithm, after which temperature-controlled spectral annealing gradually sharpens the correlation structure toward a permutation matrix. This update is deterministic and lightweight, avoiding the inner-loop gradient optimization required by continuous relaxation methods. A final refinement stage further optimizes the network layer-by-layer via weight matching, starting from the aligned solution. Experiments on MLPs, CNNs, and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) show that the proposed method reliably recovers neuron correspondences and achieves stable alignment across architectures. In practical experiments aligning independently trained NeRF models, our method reduces the loss barriers under weight interpolation compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出逐层渐进式神经元对齐方法：每层估计相关矩阵，用匈牙利算法给出离散锚点，再以温度控制的谱退火逐步锐化为置换矩阵，最后逐层权重匹配精修，从而在MLP、CNN与NeRF上稳定恢复神经元对应关系。
AI.motivation: INR将3D信号直接编码于网络权重，但置换对称性使独立训练的等价模型在权重空间相距甚远，线性插值出现大损失壁垒。现有神经元对齐方法要么过早确定离散匹配陷入局部最优，要么依赖连续松弛上的昂贵梯度优化，在NeRF等困难场景不可靠。
AI.method: 渐进式逐层对齐：沿输入到输出方向遵循层间依赖；每层估计相关矩阵并与匈牙利算法得到的离散锚点对齐，通过温度控制的谱退火将相关结构逐步锐化至置换矩阵；该更新确定性强、计算轻量，无需内层循环梯度优化；最后以权重匹配逐层精修已对齐的解。
AI.result: 在MLP、CNN和NeRF上的实验表明该方法能可靠恢复神经元对应关系并在不同架构上稳定对齐；在对独立训练的NeRF模型进行对齐时，相较现有方法降低了权重插值下的损失壁垒。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式逐层对齐结合离散锚点与谱退火，为INR权重空间提供了确定性、轻量且跨架构稳定的对齐方案，有效缓解置换对称导致的插值损失壁垒，为后续权重空间编辑与合并奠定基础。

title: Region-Aware Multi-View Inspection Using Deep Learning and Domain-Informed Decision Fusion
summary: Automated optical inspection of precision components with tiny surface defects remains challenging when different regions of the same component exhibit different defect characteristics and, therefore, different acceptance criteria. This paper presents a region-aware, dual-model inspection framework that combines instance segmentation of localized seat-region defects with image-level classification of global shaft-region anomalies. Rather than treating these two model detections as sufficient evidence for component rejection, a deterministic decision fusion layer that formalizes industrial Standard Operating Procedures is applied to the model outputs to make the final component level decision. A PLC-synchronized imaging system acquires 18 seat and 18 shaft images over a full 360-degree rotation to provide multi-view circumferential coverage. The framework was evaluated on 380 automotive fuel injector needles, covering representative operational defect types, using identical model predictions in all configurations. Direct model-output aggregation via simple union logic (where any single-view detection flags a rejection) identified all 104 non-conforming components but produced a component level false rejection rate of 57.6%. Inclusion of a complete decision layer maintained the observed non-conforming (NOK) recall of 100% while reducing the false rejection rate to 10.9%, corresponding to an 81.1% reduction in false-positive component decisions. The results demonstrate that formalized manufacturing acceptance criteria can complement sensitive visual models by translating frame-level detections into practical and traceable component-level decisions.

AI.tldr: 面向汽车燃油喷嘴针的区域感知双模型检测框架：座区用实例分割、轴区用图像级分类，并以形式化SOP的确定性决策融合层将多视角检出转化为组件级判定，383件(380件)评估中NOK召回100%且组件级误拒率由57.6%降至10.9%。
AI.motivation: 同一精密零件不同区域缺陷特征与验收标准不同，单一/全局阈值式检测难以兼顾灵敏度与误拒率；工业上需将逐帧检测结果转化为可追溯的组件级验收决策。
AI.method: PLC同步成像，360°旋转采集18张座区+18张轴区图像；座区局部缺陷用实例分割、轴区异常用图像级分类；两模型输出经确定性决策融合层（编码工业SOP规则）给出组件级接收/拒收；各配置使用相同模型预测以隔离决策层贡献。
AI.result: 380件燃油喷嘴针、覆盖代表性缺陷类型：简单并集聚合（任单视角检出即拒收）检出全部104件不合格品，但组件级误拒率57.6%；加入完整决策层后NOK召回维持100%，误拒率降至10.9%，组件级假阳性减少81.1%。
AI.conclusion: 形式化的制造验收准则可补充敏感视觉模型，把帧级检测映射为实用、可追溯的组件级决策；区域差异化标准与决策融合是提升工业检测实用性的关键。

title: VideoGen Model 1: Prompt Expansion Versus Formatting in Audiovisual Generation
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Model page: this https URL ; VideoGen: this https URL
summary: Creative prompt expansion improved overall audiovisual quality scores over raw prompts in a controlled pilot of VideoGen Model 1, our post-trained version of MiniMax H3. We compared the raw, reformatted, and expanded versions of 30 prompts, holding the generator, seed, and sampling settings fixed. Each clip was rated separately on five dimensions. Their mean formed an overall score on a 1-10 scale. Compared with formatting alone, overall scores increased by 0.63 points (95% interval: [+0.11, +1.15]) under VA-Judger and 0.15 points (95% interval: [-0.03, +0.35]) under Gemini 3.8 Flash, whose overall change remained uncertain. Prompt-alignment scores increased by 0.97 points under VA-Judger and 0.50 under Gemini. VA-Judger also showed higher audio quality; visual-quality ratings changed little under either judge.

AI.tldr: 在VideoGen Model 1（MiniMax H3后训练版）上做受控试点，比较30个提示词的raw/reformatted/expanded三版本，固定生成器、种子与采样设置；由VA-Judger与Gemini 3.8 Flash分别按五维度1-10分打分取均值。创意提示词扩展使总分较仅格式化提升0.63（VA-Judger，95%区间[+0.11,+1.15]）与0.15（Gemini，区间跨零、不确定）；提示词对齐分提升0.97/0.50；VA-Judger下音频质量提升，视觉质量基本不变。
AI.motivation: 探究"创意式提示词扩展"（而非仅格式重排）能否在冻结模型与采样设置的前提下系统性提升视频生成的整体视听质量，并量化两种自动评测器之间的分歧。
AI.method: 小规模受控消融：30个提示词×3种形式（raw / reformatted / creative-expanded），生成器、随机种子、采样参数全部固定；逐片段按五个维度独立打分，取均值为1-10总分；用VA-Judger与Gemini 3.8 Flash双评审并给出95%区间。
AI.result: VA-Judger下总分+0.63（[+0.11,+1.15]，显著）；Gemini下+0.15（[-0.03,+0.35]，不显著）；对齐分分别+0.97、+0.50；音频质量仅在VA-Judger下提升；视觉质量两者均变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 创意提示词扩展带来的增益集中在提示词对齐与音频维度，视觉质量提升有限，且增益大小高度依赖评审模型（VA-Judger更敏感、Gemini结论不确定），提示评测器偏差可能主导结论；样本量小（30条）仅为试点，需扩大规模与人工评测验证。

title: LiveAct: Towards Real-Time Multi-Agent World Models with Heterogeneous Action Interfaces
summary: Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under user actions, but most existing systems assume one controlled agent and one task-specific action interface. We study multi-agent video world modeling, where one model generates a joint visual future for multiple controlled agents while interpreting heterogeneous controls ranging from binary game buttons to continuous robot commands. This task presents two complementary challenges. First, every agent-indexed action stream must control its intended visual entity independently. Second, the model must adapt the meaning of each control variable across different tasks, where the same tensor dimension may denote an attack, steering command, or robot command. We introduce LiveAct, centered on a Heterogeneous Action Interface (HAI) whose two components mirror this decomposition. To support independent control, Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation uses language-driven spatial gates and agent-specific attention to bind each action stream to its intended visual agent. To accommodate heterogeneous controls, Schema-Guided Action Adaptation describes each control variable in language and modulates its semantic token with the synchronized numerical value. We further transfer the complete interface to a blockwise causal generator through teacher forcing and rollout-aware distribution matching, enabling efficient streaming generation while retaining agent-specific control and action semantics. We instantiate the formulation on six multi-agent sources spanning games and multi-robot manipulation, and evaluate visual quality, action following, agent attribution, and latency. Across games and robot manipulation, LiveAct reaches 0.898 and 0.942 agent-attribution accuracy without agent locations or identity crops, and the causal generator attains 17.70 FPS at $512\times 448$.

AI.tldr: LiveAct：多智能体交互式视频世界模型，用"智能体感知空间调制"和"语言模式引导的动作适配"统一异构动作接口，可因果流式生成。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型多为单受控智能体、单一任务专用动作接口，无法支持多智能体联合未来预测与游戏按钮、机器人连续指令等异构控制。
AI.method: 提出异构动作接口HAI：一是Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation，用语言驱动空间门控与智能体专属注意力，将每条动作流绑定到对应视觉实体；二是Schema-Guided Action Adaptation，用语言描述每个控制变量并用同步数值调制其语义token，实现跨任务动作语义迁移；再通过teacher forcing与rollout-aware分布匹配将接口迁移到分块因果生成器，实现高效流式生成。
AI.result: 在六个多智能体源（游戏＋多机器人操作）上评估视觉质量、动作跟随、智能体归因与延迟；无位置/身份裁剪条件下归因准确率0.898与0.942，512×448下因果生成器达17.70 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 统一异构动作接口的多智能体视频世界模型可行，且可迁移到因果生成器实现实时流式推演，为多智能体具身世界模型提供可复用接口设计。

title: LLMSeg: Training-Free Text-Prompted Image Segmentation with B-Splines
summary: Promptable segmentation models such as SAM 3 achieve remarkable open-vocabulary performance but require dedicated architectures, large-scale annotation engines, and task-specific training. We ask a different question: can a general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) segment images directly, without an added segmentation head, mask decoder, or training? We present LLMSeg, a training-free pipeline that turns a vision-capable LLM into a text-prompted image segmenter. LLMSeg decomposes segmentation into three LLM-driven stages. First, detect localizes all instances matching a free-form text query and describes their coarse morphology. Next, segment traces each instance using closed periodic B-splines confined to its detected box. These splines define an outer boundary and optional hole loops. Finally, refine iteratively proposes focus boxes around residual errors and retraces confined splines. The process ends when the mask stabilizes or the pass budget is exhausted. The output is a binary mask with inspectable intermediate geometry. We evaluate LLMSeg across ten referring and reasoning segmentation splits (ReasonSeg and RefCOCO/+/g). We also evaluate open-vocabulary instance segmentation (LVIS, COCO, and SA-Co), semantic segmentation, and zero-shot detection (ODinW13 and RF-100VL). With an off-the-shelf Gemini-3.7-Flash backend, LLMSeg is competitive with and often surpasses the specialist SAM 3 model on identical items. It reaches 71.5 cIoU on ReasonSeg val without additional segmentation-specific training. Backend model updates can improve accuracy without retraining the pipeline. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LLMSeg: 免训练的视觉语言大模型（MLLM）提示分割流程，将分割拆为 detect→segment(B样条)→refine 三阶段，仅用 Gemini-3.7-Flash 后端即在 ReasonSeg/RefCOCO 与 SA-Co 等任务上媲美甚至超过 SAM 3。
AI.motivation: 现有可提示分割模型（SAM 3 等）依赖专用架构、大规模标注引擎与任务特定训练，部署与迭代成本高；作者提出能否让通用 MLLM 无需分割头、掩码头或任何训练即可直接完成分割。
AI.method: 训练-free 流水线：（1）detect——MLLM 定位匹配自由文本查询的所有实例并描述粗形态；（2）segment——在检测框内用闭合周期 B 样条追踪每个实例，包含外边界与可选孔洞环；（3）refine——针对残余误差提出聚焦框并重新在受限框内描摹样条，直至掩码稳定或轮次预算耗尽。输出为可检查中间几何（样条）的二值掩码。
AI.result: 在 10 个 referring/reasoning 分割划分（ReasonSeg、RefCOCO/+/g）及开放词汇实例分割（LVIS、COCO、SA-Co）、语义分割、零样本检测（ODinW13、RF-100VL）上评测；Gemini-3.7-Flash 后端下 ReasonSeg val 达 71.5 cIoU（无分割专用训练），在相同样本上常超过专用模型 SAM 3；后端模型升级可直接提升精度而无需重训练流水线。
AI.conclusion: 通用 MLLM 可作为即插即用的分割器，几何参数化（B 样条）+ 迭代自校验是替代专用分割头的可行路线，具有可解释中间产物与随基座模型升级而自然获益的可扩展性。

title: CCG Diffusion: Combinatory Categorial Grammar-Driven Compositional and Syntactically Disambiguated Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image generation models do not explicitly receive the syntactic structure of the prompt, i.e., which word modifies which and where each phrase attaches. Consequently, they often struggle to bind attributes to the correct objects, to depict spatial relations and counts correctly, and to render syntactically ambiguous prompts in the intended interpretation. Existing syntax-based control methods mainly address attribute binding and have limited ability to control spatial relations and counts or to specify the interpretation of syntactically ambiguous prompts. They rely on phrase-structure or dependency grammars and require additional rules or constraints on the tree structure to extract modification relations between words or to specify a syntactic interpretation. We propose CCG Diffusion, a training-free method that controls image generation using Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG). In CCG, the category of each word carries rich syntactic information: it specifies what the word combines with and what phrase it forms. Modification relations between words can therefore be read directly from a CCG parse. Moreover, prepositional phrase (PP) attachment ambiguity, a representative syntactic ambiguity, can be resolved simply by fixing the preposition's category. CCG Diffusion applies the same two CCG-based mechanisms, prompt rewriting and attention guidance, both to controlling attribute binding, spatial relations, and counts and to resolving PP ambiguity. On two architecturally different backbones, Stable Diffusion and Sana, CCG Diffusion achieves the highest scores among the compared methods in attribute binding and 2D spatial relations and significantly outperforms all of them in PP ambiguity resolution.

AI.tldr: CCG Diffusion：训练无关的文本到图像控制方法，用组合范畴语法（CCG）解析提示，通过提示重写与注意力引导同时控制属性绑定、空间关系、数量，并用固定介词范畴直接消除PP附着歧义，在SD与Sana上均取得最佳或显著领先结果。
AI.motivation: 扩散/文生图模型不显式接收提示的句法结构，导致属性错绑、空间关系与数量描述失败、句法歧义提示无法按意图渲染。现有句法控制方法多仅处理属性绑定，且依赖短语结构/依存语法并需额外规则来抽取修饰关系或指定句法解读，扩展性差。
AI.method: 采用CCG作为控制接口：每个词的范畴本身编码其组合方式与所构成的短语，修饰关系可直接从CCG解析树读出；介词短语附着歧义可通过固定介词范畴来指定解读。基于同一套CCG机制实现两种控制手段——提示重写（prompt rewriting）与注意力引导（attention guidance），统一用于属性绑定、空间关系、数量控制及PP歧义消解，全程训练无关，可插拔于现有骨干。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion与Sana两个架构不同的骨干上，属性绑定与2D空间关系指标在对比方法中得分最高，PP歧义消解上显著优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 轻量句法（CCG）信号即可作为通用、免训练的文生图可控性接口，同时覆盖语义绑定、空间/数量与句法歧义三类问题，且跨骨干泛化。

title: Look Beyond the Question: Preserve-Focus-Fuse for Whole-Slide Image Question Answering
summary: A question about a whole-slide image rarely names every morphological finding needed to answer it. Question-guided patch selection can therefore overlook supporting morphology, while slide-level compression can dilute focal evidence. Inspired by how pathologists combine broad slide review, question-directed examination, and integration of their findings, we introduce BEYONDPATH, a Preserve-Focus-Fuse framework for whole-slide image question answering. Preserve learns a question-agnostic Morphology Bank through answer supervision across multiple questions about each training slide. Focus retrieves questionspecific evidence from all foreground patches, including regions outside the Bank. Fuse integrates the preserved morphology at the retrieved evidence positions through Morphology-on-Visual-Evidence Fusion, producing a fixed 96-token visual prefix. On WSI-Bench, BEYONDPATH achieves an Avg-9 of 0.769 and leads all eight reported report-generation metrics using the same checkpoint. It also achieves 0.639 zero-shot overall accuracy on SlideBench-BCNB. Controlled ablations show complementary benefits from morphology preservation and question-directed retrieval, and support cross-question supervision and fusion at the evidence positions. These results support looking beyond the question's explicit cues: preserving broader slide morphology while retaining the ability to seek evidence for each question.

AI.tldr: BEYONDPATH 提出 Preserve-Focus-Fuse 框架解答全切片病理图像问答：保留无关于问题的形态学 Morphology Bank，检索问题相关证据，并在证据位置融合，输出固定 96-token 视觉前缀。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像（WSI）问答中，问题往往不会点明所有必要的形态学线索；仅按问题做 patch 选择会漏掉支撑性形态，而整片压缩又会稀释局部证据。作者受病理学家"全局浏览—问题导向检查—整合发现"流程启发，试图同时保留广泛形态与保留按问题检索的能力。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：（1）Preserve：通过同一训练切片上多问题的答案监督，学习与问题无关的 Morphology Bank；（2）Focus：从全部前景 patch（含 Bank 之外区域）中检索问题特定证据；（3）Fuse：用 Morphology-on-Visual-Evidence Fusion 在检索到的证据位置上整合被保留的形态，生成固定 96-token 视觉前缀供下游 LLM 使用。
AI.result: 在 WSI-Bench 上取得 Avg-9 = 0.769，并以同一 checkpoint 在全部八项报告生成指标上领先；在 SlideBench-BCNB 上零样本总体准确率 0.639。受控消融显示形态保留与问题导向检索具有互补收益，并支持跨问题监督与证据位置融合两项设计。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明应超越问题中的显式线索：在保留更广泛切片形态的同时维持为每个问题检索证据的能力，这种"保留—聚焦—融合"思路对 WSI 问答有效。

title: PRISM: Learning Realistic Depth via Physics-Grounded Noise Disentanglement with Semantic-Geometric Collaboration
summary: Real-world physical sensing exhibits complex, heterogeneous noise patterns that deviate significantly from idealized simulation, posing a fundamental bottleneck for sim-to-real transfer. Existing sensor modelings typically treat depth noise as a monolithic black-box process, overlooking the distinct physical mechanisms that govern different error modalities. In this work, we introduce a physics-grounded paradigm that disentangles monolithic noise into two complementary modalities: \textbf{sensing invalidation} and \textbf{measurement inaccuracy}, enabling a tailored treatment of noise sources based on their physical origins. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{PRISM}, a tripartite framework that distills 3D Visual Foundation Model features as rich spatial-semantic priors for physics-based reasoning. To address the inherent sparsity and class imbalance of invalidation regions, we develop Hierarchical Positive-Prioritized Supervision, integrating multi-scale positive-weighted objectives with a positive-preserving dynamic hard mining strategy to enforce precise artifact delineation. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art fidelity in noisy depth synthesis. Furthermore, downstream robotic experiments show that PRISM facilitates a \textbf{92.1\%} average success rate in the real world, marking a significant improvement over monolithic baselines. Our project page is available at: \resizebox{\linewidth}{!}{\href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.}

AI.tldr: 论文提出PRISM：将真实深度传感器噪声解耦为“感知失效(invalidation)”与“测量不准(inaccuracy)”两种物理模态，并借助3D视觉基础模型特征进行物理驱动推理，实现高保真噪声深度合成，下游真实机器人任务平均成功率92.1%。
AI.motivation: 真实物理传感噪声异质且复杂，与理想仿真差距大，是sim-to-real的核心瓶颈；现有深度噪声建模把噪声当作单一黑箱过程，忽略了不同误差模态背后的物理机制，导致噪声合成保真度不足、下游迁移效果受限。
AI.method: 提出以物理为依据的噪声解耦范式，将整体噪声拆为感知失效与测量不准两类互补模态并分别建模；构建三分支框架PRISM，蒸馏3D视觉基础模型特征作为空间-语义先验支撑物理推理；针对失效区域的稀疏性与类别不平衡，设计分层正样本优先监督：多尺度正样本加权目标 + 保正动态困难样本挖掘，用于精确刻画伪影边界。
AI.result: 在多项基准上实现噪声深度合成的SOTA保真度；下游真实机器人实验取得92.1%平均成功率，相较单体式噪声基线有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 把深度噪声按物理成因解耦建模优于单体黑箱建模，基础模型先验与不平衡感知监督是有效关键设计；该工作可作为sim-to-real中传感器仿真的实用新范式。

title: A2I-Calib++: A Kinematics-Driven Anti-noise Active Calibration Framework for Whole-Body Multi-IMU Systems on Legged Robots
summary: Recently, multi-node inertial measurement unit (multi-IMU) systems have shown promise for robust odometry in legged robots. Multi-IMU fusion can improve legged robot odometry but requires accurate spatiotemporal calibration among the sensors. Existing multi-IMU calibration methods, designed for aerial or handheld platforms, face challenges on legged robots because routine locomotion may provide insufficient excitation, while foot slips, impacts, and vibrations introduce measurement disturbances. To address these challenges, we propose A2I-Calib++, a kinematics-driven anti-noise active calibration framework for body-mounted IMUs covered by the robot kinematic model. It estimates temporal offsets, extrinsic rotations and translations, and inertial biases through temporal correlation search followed by analytic spatial and bias estimation, without artificial calibration targets or complex parameter tuning for the target IMU. A2I-Calib++ comprises three core modules: 1) a Noise-Isotropy-Inspired Trajectory supported by a finite-horizon conditioning proposition that generates sufficient excitation to limit noise sensitivity; 2) a constraint-aware Adversarial Motion Priors controller that combines the anti-noise excitation with a rolling-contact reward for contact-aware execution; and 3) a contact-constrained virtual IMU that fuses pre-calibrated calf IMUs and joint kinematics under a rolling-contact model to construct the calibration reference. Furthermore, evaluations on both simulation and real-world quadruped platforms demonstrate notably reduced noise sensitivity and simulation calibration errors compared to conventional methods, together with repeatable real-world calibration and improved proprioceptive odometry accuracy for legged robots.

AI.tldr: A2I-Calib++ 提出面向足式机器人本体多IMU的抗噪主动标定框架，通过激发充分运动、对抗运动先验控制器与接触约束虚拟IMU，实现时偏、外参旋转平移与零偏的联合估计。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人多IMU融合可提升里程计鲁棒性，但需精确时空标定；现有面向空中/手持平台的方法在足式机器人上因常规运动激励不足、足滑/冲击/振动引入干扰而失效。
AI.method: 三模块：1) 基于有限时域条件性命题的噪声各向同性启发轨迹，产生充分激励以降低噪声敏感性；2) 约束感知的对抗运动先验（AMP）控制器，结合抗噪激励与滚动接触奖励实现接触感知执行；3) 接触约束虚拟IMU，在滚动接触模型下融合预标定小腿IMU与关节运动学构建标定参考。流程为时域相关搜索+解析空间与零偏估计，无需人工标定靶标或目标IMU复杂调参。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实四足平台上，相较传统方法噪声敏感性显著降低、仿真标定误差明显减小；真实标定具备可重复性，并提升本体感知里程计精度。
AI.conclusion: 运动学驱动的主动激励+接触约束参考可有效解决足式平台多IMU标定中的激励不足与噪声干扰问题，兼具解析求解和实用性。

title: Sparsity Should Be ALLOTted by Output: Training-Free Allocation of Block-Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Full 3D attention is costly in video Diffusion Transformers. Block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only selected attention blocks. However, existing methods either overlook the potential to optimize sparsity allocation or rely on heuristic rules or local metrics to guide it. In this work, we observe that sparsifying attention in different layers and at different denoising steps affects final-video fidelity to substantially different degrees. Yet the identities of the most sensitive layer-step pairs remain nearly unchanged across inputs. Building on these findings, we propose Allocating Layer-step Latency by Output Tests (ALLOT), a training-free sparsity allocation method. Treating each layer-step pair as a cell, ALLOT estimates each cell's contribution to final-video error through (i) cell probing and (ii) trajectory calibration, then jointly optimizes cell densities under a measured-latency budget. It preserves existing selection strategies and kernels, replacing only the allocation component. At equal or shorter wall-clock time, ALLOT outperforms every compared allocation strategy with XAttention, with an 11.8 dB PSNR gain on HunyuanVideo. Extensive experiments across four additional published pipelines on Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo show that ALLOT outperforms or ties the default in all nine settings.

AI.tldr: ALLOT：训练免费的稀疏注意力分配方法，用"单元探测+轨迹校准"估计每个 layer-step 对最终视频误差的贡献，在实测延迟预算下联合优化块稀疏密度，等或更短延迟下优于所有对比分配策略。
AI.motivation: 视频 Diffusion Transformer 的 3D 全注意力代价高；块稀疏注意力只计算部分注意力块，但现有方法未优化稀疏分配，或依赖启发式规则/局部指标。作者观察到不同层与不同去噪步的稀疏化对最终视频保真度影响差异极大，且最敏感层-步对的身份在不同输入间几乎不变，说明可做输入无关的高效分配。
AI.method: 训练免费的稀疏分配替换模块：将每个 (layer, step) 对视为一个 cell，(i) cell probing 与 (ii) trajectory calibration 估计该 cell 对最终视频误差的贡献，再在实测延迟预算约束下联合优化各 cell 的稀疏密度；保持现有 token 选择策略与 attention kernel 不变，仅替换分配组件。
AI.result: 在相同或更短墙钟时间下，ALLOT 配合 XAttention 优于所有对比分配策略，HunyuanVideo 上 PSNR 提升 11.8 dB；在 Wan2.1、Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo 上四个额外已发布流水线共九种设置中全部优于或持平默认配置。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力的收益主要取决于 layer-step 级分配，而非仅选择策略；基于输出误差的分配可插拔、免训练地带来稳定收益，具有较强实用性但属推理加速类工作，与具身/3D 重建核心主题关联较间接。

title: Beyond Shortcut Learning: Hierarchical Spatial Prototype Regularization for Face Forgery Detection
summary: Recent advances in generative models have enabled highly realistic face forgeries, yet generalizing deepfake detectors to unseen manipulation pipelines remains a major challenge. One critical yet underexplored issue is that the learned forensic representation itself may fail to remain stable across different manipulation sources. In this paper, we provide new evidence that naively fine-tuned vision models suffer from severe \textit{forensic representation collapse}: their extracted cues are often entangled with unstable, dataset-specific artifacts, resulting in structurally fragile representations and poor cross-domain generalization. Leveraging this insight, we propose \textbf{H}ierarchical \textbf{S}patial \textbf{P}rototype (\textbf{HSP}) regularization, which explicitly models the forgery manifold by learning a structured prototype subspace over spatial features.
