We further introduce prototype orthogonality and second-order assignment balance, which jointly preserve the geometric independence of latent forgery factors and promote high-effective-rank utilization of the forensic representation, thereby reducing reliance on dataset-specific shortcuts. Empirical results demonstrate that our method substantially improves generalizability, yielding average frame-level AUC gains of 5.6\% and 5.3\% in the cross-dataset and cross-manipulation settings, respectively. Moreover, when used as a plug-in module, HSP boosts the average video-level AUC of existing state-of-the-art detectors to 95.3\% (+1.8\%). These results demonstrate the practical value of HSP as an easy-to-adopt regularization module for enhancing deepfake detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文指出朴素微调的视觉模型存在"取证表示坍缩"，提出分层空间原型（HSP）正则化，通过原型子空间建模伪造流形，结合原型正交性与二阶分配平衡提升跨数据集/跨篡改泛化。
AI.motivation: 生成模型使伪造人脸极度逼真，deepfake检测器难以泛化到未见篡改流程；作者发现取证表示本身跨源不稳定，特征与数据集特有的不稳定伪影纠缠，导致表示结构脆弱。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Spatial Prototype (HSP)正则化：在空间特征上学习结构化原型子空间以显式建模伪造流形；引入原型正交性约束保持潜在伪造因子的几何独立性，以及二阶分配平衡促进取证表示的高有效秩利用，降低对数据集特异的捷径依赖。可作为插件模块接入现有检测器。
AI.result: 跨数据集与跨篡改设置下平均帧级AUC分别提升5.6%和5.3%；作为插件时使现有SOTA检测器平均视频级AUC达95.3%（+1.8%）。
AI.conclusion: HSP是一种易采纳的正则化模块，可有效提升deepfake检测器的泛化性，验证了表示结构正则化在人脸取证中的实用价值。

title: Distance Field Driven Reinforcement Learning for Reactive and Robust Collision Avoidance
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: Robust and reactive collision avoidance remains a central challenge for deploying Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies on real robotic manipulators, particularly when transferring behaviours learned in simulation to the physical world. This paper presents an RL framework that integrates the Euclidean Distance Field (EDF) directly into the observation space, providing the agent with continuous geometric cues that support stable and responsive avoidance behaviours. By leveraging the rich spatial information encoded in the EDF, the method enables a streamlined reward formulation that achieves effective obstacle avoidance both with and without Artificial Potential Field guidance. The proposed approach is validated on a 7-DoF redundant manipulator, demonstrating zero-shot transfer from simulation to real hardware. Despite being trained exclusively with randomised static objects, the deployed policy generalizes to previously unseen real environments and exhibits robust online avoidance of dynamic obstacles. These results highlight the potential of EDF-based representations to mitigate the sim-to-real gap and support reliable and real-time collision-aware behaviour in complex and changing environments.

AI.tldr: 将欧氏距离场（EDF）直接嵌入强化学习观测空间，实现7-DoF冗余机械臂的零样本仿真到真实避障迁移。
AI.motivation: 在真实机械臂上部署RL策略时，稳健且反应式的碰撞规避仍是核心难题，尤其是仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的行为迁移；现有方法依赖人工势场（APF）等手工设计或复杂奖励塑形，易陷局部极小且对未见环境泛化差。
AI.method: 把欧氏距离场（EDF）作为连续几何线索直接写入观测空间，使智能体能获得丰富的空间距离信息，从而简化奖励设计；方法在有无APF引导两种设定下均可有效避障，并在7-DoF冗余机械臂上训练与验证。
AI.result: 仅用随机静态物体训练的策略实现零样本sim-to-real迁移，在未见的真实环境中泛化良好，并能在线稳健规避动态障碍物。
AI.conclusion: EDF式几何表征可有效缓解sim-to-real鸿沟，支撑复杂动态环境下的实时、可靠碰撞感知行为。

title: BlazeVGGT: 13x Faster VGGT at 2,000 Frames via Camera Token without Training
summary: Feed-forward visual geometry models, exemplified by VGGT, have demonstrated strong multi-view reconstruction capabilities through dense global attention. However, the resulting all-to-all cross-view computation scales quadratically with the number of input views, making long-sequence inference particularly expensive due to substantial frame-level redundancy among highly overlapping observations. We uncover a topology-first, geometry-later evolution in VGGT camera tokens: shallow-layer tokens reliably capture local view neighborhoods, whereas deeper-layer tokens progressively encode globally organized inter-view geometry. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BlazeVGGT, a training-free framework for structure-aware frame-level key--value sparsification. At each global-attention block, BlazeVGGT constructs a view-level similarity kernel from camera-token relations and employs greedy determinantal point process inference to select a compact set of mutually complementary views. The selected views constitute the key--value context, while all input frames are retained as queries. This asymmetric attention design preserves dense per-frame predictions while eliminating redundant cross-view computation, allowing our method to be directly integrated into pretrained VGGT as a plug-and-play module without parameter updates. Its advantages become increasingly pronounced with sequence length: at 2,000 frames, BlazeVGGT achieves approximately 13$\times$ faster inference than VGGT while reducing the Chamfer Distance from 0.41 to 0.32. Extensive experiments demonstrate a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off in point-cloud reconstruction and camera-pose estimation, compatibility with existing VGGT accelerators such as FastVGGT and LiteVGGT, and transferability to VGGT-based models including StreamVGGT and PAGE-4D. Codes are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: BlazeVGGT：基于"拓扑先行、几何后到"的相机token演化规律，对VGGT全局注意力的KV做结构感知的帧级稀疏化（视图相似核+贪心DPP选互补视图），免训练即插即用，2000帧下约13×加速且Chamfer距离0.41→0.32。
AI.motivation: VGGT等前馈多视角几何模型依赖稠密全局注意力，all-to-all跨视图计算随视图数二次增长，长序列推理代价高昂；高重叠观测带来大量帧级冗余，需要在不损失稠密逐帧预测的前提下削减冗余计算。
AI.method: 发现VGGT相机token呈"浅层捕获局部视图邻域、深层编码全局organized几何"的演化规律；据此在每个全局注意力块用相机token关系构造视图级相似核，通过贪心行列式点过程(DPP)推理选出紧凑且互互补的视图集作为KV上下文，而全部帧仍作为Query保留（非对称注意力）。全程免训练、无需参数更新，可作为plug-and-play模块嵌入预训练VGGT，并与FastVGGT、LiteVGGT等加速器及StreamVGGT、PAGE-4D兼容。
AI.result: 在2000帧输入下推理速度约为VGGT的13×，Chamfer Distance由0.41降至0.32；点云重建与相机位姿估计均呈现良好的精度-效率折中，且可迁移至多个VGGT衍生模型。
AI.conclusion: 视图级KV稀疏化是提升前馈多视图几何长序列效率的有效且低成本路径，注意力不对称设计可在保持稠密预测的同时消除冗余跨视图计算，并可与其他加速方案叠加。

title: Linear Twisting Sidewinding Gaits for Twistable Snake Robot Motion Planning on Complex Terrains
summary: Sidewinding is an efficient gait for snake robots to locomote on various terrains, by undulating the backbone curve and shifting the contact segments along it. However, relying solely on undulatory motion limits the locomotive capability of snake robots, and combining it with twisting motion can improve their speed and robustness. This hypothesis has recently been verified by the rolling vector approach, which locomotes the robot like a differential-drive car. Yet its twisting is concentrated in a short buffer segment, imposing most of the workload on the two twist joints in the middle, which can often overburden the motors and limit its locomotion. With that in mind, this paper develops a new family of twisting sidewinding gaits that distribute the workload over the entire body with our proposed linear twisting function. Under matched turning speed and total output power, our gaits reduce the peak output power of a single twist joint by 42%. Real-robot experiments show that, with the reduced workload, our new gaits can locomote the robot in various terrains that the existing rolling vector approach cannot. Besides, our new gaits can move up to 49% faster than conventional sidewinding without twisting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一族"扭转侧行"(twisting sidewinding)步态，利用线性扭转函数将扭转负载沿整条蛇体分布，而非集中于中段缓冲段，从而显著降低单关节峰值输出功率并提升地形适应性与速度。
AI.motivation: 已有 rolling vector 方法证明将侧行(undulation)与扭转(twisting)结合可提升蛇形机器人速度与鲁棒性，但其扭转被压缩在很短的缓冲段中，负载集中在中部两个扭转关节上，易使电机过载并限制运动能力。
AI.method: 设计新一族 twisting sidewinding 步态，核心是提出的线性扭转函数(linear twisting function)，将扭转位移沿全身骨架均匀分布；在匹配转向速度与总输出功率的条件下与传统方案对比，单关节峰值功率评估，并进行真实机器人多地形实验验证。
AI.result: 在转向速度与总输出功率匹配的条件下，单扭转关节峰值输出功率降低 42%；真实机器人实验显示新步态可穿越 rolling vector 方法无法通行的多种地形；相较无扭转的传统 sidewinding，速度最高提升 49%。
AI.conclusion: 通过全身分布扭转负载的步态设计，可缓解电机过载瓶颈，兼顾速度、能效与地形鲁棒性，拓展了蛇形机器人的运动能力边界。

title: Extending Affordance Segmentation for Wearable Robots to Multi-Object Images
summary: This paper proposes a refinement to existing vision-based portable pipelines for the recognition of graspable object parts. Such pipelines can effectively support automatic grasp selection and preshaping in upper-limb prosthetic devices. However, realistic scenarios in which multiple objects are present still represent a challenge. The proposed method exploits a minor modification to the conventional hardware setup and a custom training approach to extend the applicability of vision-based pipelines. A laser pointer is introduced in the setup as an effective mechanism for object disambiguation. Accordingly, a suitable retraining of the deep convolutional neural networks supporting recognition of graspable parts is implemented. A mixed reality strategy allows the reuse of available high-quality segmentation masks to generate realistic images procedurally, extending the range of scenarios supported by the final device. Experimental results confirm that the proposed pipeline improves target disambiguation accuracy by up to 9% compared with existing solutions, while preserving the computational cost.

AI.tldr: 在视觉假肢抓取部件识别流水线中引入激光指针辅助消歧，并用混合现实策略程序化生成逼真合成图，重训练CNN以提升多物体场景下的目标消歧精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的便携式抓取部件识别流水线可支持假肢手的自动抓取选择与预成形，但在多物体共存的真实场景中目标消歧困难，易误抓。
AI.method: 对常规硬件做小幅改动（加装激光指针作为物体指示/消歧线索）；采用混合现实策略复用已有高质量分割掩码，程序化合成逼真图像扩充训练分布；对识别可抓取部件的深度CNN进行定制化重训练。
AI.result: 实验显示目标消歧准确率较现有方案最高提升约9%，且计算开销保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 激光指针+混合现实合成数据是一套低成本、可部署的硬件-数据协同方案，可显著增强假肢视觉流水线在多物体场景中的可用性，且不增加算力负担。

title: S-Rolling: Steerable Rolling Gaits for Twistable Snake Robots in Low-Clearance Environments
summary: Snake robots can traverse complex environments with limbless locomotion, but maneuvering in low-clearance environments remains challenging because a gait must maintain a small swept height while also providing planar steering. Existing rolling gaits preserve a low swept height body configuration but generally provide limited steering, whereas steering gaits often introduce vertical undulation and require additional clearance. With that in mind, this paper develops S-rolling, a steerable rolling gait that combines low swept height locomotion with planar maneuverability for twistable snake robots. S-rolling is designed using an S-shaped planar backbone curve, whose head and tail segments roll with independently controlled angular velocities, producing different motion modes. We derive its joint space gait equation, in which a central twist joint realizes the relative rotation between the two segments. We also develop a quasi-static kinematic model relating the segment rolling speeds to the linear and angular velocities of the robot. Real-robot experiments demonstrate the various motion modes, traversal through a 10 cm clearance test track, and maneuvering tasks beneath a large workpiece and a car chassis. In these low-clearance scenarios, S-rolling successfully performs approximately 90$^\circ$ and 180$^\circ$ heading changes, whereas the baseline rolling arc gait cannot change the robot heading.

AI.tldr: 提出S-rolling可转向滚动步态，用S形平面骨干曲线使头尾段独立滚转，实现低净空下的平面转向，并在10cm净空赛道及车底盘下完成约90°/180°航向改变。
AI.motivation: 蛇形机器人虽能无肢穿越复杂环境，但低净空场景要求同时满足"小扫掠高度"与"平面转向"：现有滚动步态保持低姿态却几乎不能转向，而转向步态往往引入竖直起伏、需要更大净空。因此需要一个兼具低扫掠高度与平面机动性的步态。
AI.method: 针对可扭转蛇形机器人设计S-rolling步态：基于S形平面骨干曲线，头段与尾段以独立控制的角速度滚转，产生多种运动模式；由中央扭转关节实现两段间相对旋转。推导关节空间步态方程，并建立准静态运动学模型，将两段滚转速度映射为机器人线速度与角速度。
AI.result: 实机实验展示了多种运动模式，机器人可在10cm净空测试赛道中通行，并能在大工件下方与汽车底盘下方执行机动任务；在这些低净空场景中S-rolling成功实现约90°与180°的航向改变，而基线滚动圆弧步态无法改变航向。
AI.conclusion: S-rolling通过分段独立滚转+中央扭转关节的平面S形布置，在保持低扫掠高度的同时提供了平面转向能力，扩展了可扭转蛇形机器人在低净空受限空间的作业范围。

title: Balancing Foundation Models and Trait-Specific Learning for Forehead-Crease Recognition
summary: Biometric recognition often degrades under partial facial vis- ibility, where conventional facial cues are occluded. The forehead region remains consistently visible and contains distinctive crease patterns that can serve as a complementary biometric trait. We present a unified eval- uation of forehead-crease recognition across explainable zero-shot rea- soning, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific modeling. FIRE en- ables interpretable zero-shot verification using multimodal large language models, while pretrained face-recognition models are adapted to the fore- head domain through margin-based learning. Under open-set evaluation, the best zero-shot model GPT-4o+FIRE achieves 18.22% EER, while Edge-Forehead achieves 8.30% EER and 54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR. The results show that although MLLMs offer interpretable zero-shot verifi- cation, trait-specific learning remains more effective for robust forehead- crease biometric recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出额头皱纹（forehead crease）作为部分面部遮挡下的互补生物特征，统一评估零样本可解释推理（GPT-4o+FIRE）、边缘域自适应学习（Edge-Forehead）与特定性状建模三条路线；开集评测中FIRE的EER为18.22%，Edge-Forehead为8.30% EER、54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR。
AI.motivation: 常规人脸识别在部分面部遮挡（如口罩、头盔、护目镜）时性能显著下降，而额头区域通常持续可见且含有具判别性的皱纹纹理，可作为互补生物特征；同时多模态大模型提供的可解释零样本能力与专用模型精度之间的取舍尚缺系统性对比。
AI.method: 构建统一评估框架：(1) FIRE——基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的可解释零样本验证流程；(2) 将预训练人脸识别模型通过margin-based（度量/边际）学习迁移到额头域，得到Edge-Forehead专用模型；(3) 与性状特定建模进行对照，在开集协议下统一评测。
AI.result: 开集评测下，最佳零样本模型GPT-4o+FIRE达到18.22% EER；Edge-Forehead达到8.30% EER与54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR，精度显著优于零样本方案。
AI.conclusion: 虽然MLLM能提供可解释的零样本验证，但针对特定性状（额头皱纹）的专门学习在鲁棒性上仍远优于零样本方案；额头皱纹是遮挡条件下有效的互补生物特征。

title: Make it Walk: Computational Design of LEGO Walkers
summary: LEGO walkers are walking automata constructed from modular LEGO Technic bricks. They exhibit intriguing locomotion and are also highly reconfigurable through the modular Technic bricks, making them widely applicable in education, recreation, and robotics research. However, existing LEGO walkers are designed mostly by reusing existing single-actuator walking mechanisms. Although the locomotion is stable, their fixed walking gaits limit their adaptability and versatility. This paper presents the first computational solution capable of designing LEGO walkers that not only walk stably, but also support a variety of walking gaits. Our idea is twofold. First, we control the foot motion trajectory of each leg mechanically via a specifically-designed gear-linkage mechanism, in which we incorporate a pair of 3D-printed non-circular gears to work with a LEGO Technic mechanism. Second, we drive each leg by an independent motor and synchronize the timings of multiple leg motions via a simple yet adaptable control algorithm, enabling stable and versatile locomotion. Importantly, we take this modeling as a foundation to co-design the morphology and control of the LEGO walkers to meet the target locomotion and appearance. Leveraging our approach, we created a variety of LEGO walkers, demonstrating various walking gaits and appearances, and fabricated some of them to show their locomotion capability in the real world.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可计算设计LEGO步行机器人的方法：用含3D打印非圆齿轮的齿轮-连杆机构机械生成足端轨迹，每腿独立电机驱动并用简单控制算法同步时序，进而联合优化形态与控制，实现稳定且多步态行走。
AI.motivation: 现有LEGO步行体多复用单一驱动器机构，步态固定，适应性与通用性不足；作者希望在不牺牲稳定性的前提下获得多种步态。
AI.method: 1) 每腿采用专门设计的齿轮-连杆机构（LEGO Technic件+一对3D打印非圆齿轮）在机械层面决定足端轨迹；2) 每腿由独立电机驱动，用简单可扩展的控制算法同步多腿时序；3) 以该建模为基础，对LEGO步行体的形态与控制进行co-design，以满足目标步态与外观；4) 制作实物体验证。
AI.result: 生成多种具有不同步态与外观的LEGO步行体设计；部分被实物制造，展示出真实世界中的行走能力。
AI.conclusion: 机械式轨迹整形加独立驱动时序控制，配合形态-控制联合设计，是构建稳定、多步态可重构LEGO步行体的可行计算范式，适用于教育、娱乐与机器人研究。

title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
comment: 36 pages. Project page: this https URL
summary: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出文本条件驱动的物理参数预测框架 AutoPhyX，用部件可控数据生成流水线构建监督数据，并通过跨模态调制在体素场中预测空间变化的物理属性，单次前向即可完成物理可信的材质参数赋值。
AI.motivation: 高保真4D物理仿真需要与材质属性匹配的准确物理参数，而现有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的逐场景优化，要么仅从纯视觉输入预测参数，存在本质歧义（如仅凭外观无法区分橡胶刚度）。文本条件可提供视觉难以表达的物理先验，从而弥合该鸿沟。
AI.method: 1）构建部件可控的数据生成流水线：将复杂3D资产分解为语义独立的部件，并为每部件配对物理合理、多样的参数及对应文本描述，提供细粒度监督；2）AutoPhyX 采用跨模态调制机制，用文本特征动态调制视觉特征以实现精确物理接地；3）将属性预测表述在体素场中，保证与网格、点云、Gaussian Splatting、NeRF 等多种3D表示兼容。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法可在单次前向传播中实现物理可信、文本驱动的参数赋值，精度较高，并对 in-the-wild 物体具备稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件+部件级监督+体素物理场预测可有效解决视觉歧义下的物理属性推断问题，为物理密集型具身智能与机器人应用提供可行性路径。摘要未给出量化指标与实机验证，主要贡献在数据生成与跨模态表示层面。

title: Supervision-Adaptive Curriculum and Guarded Anti-Curriculum Learning for Dense Prediction
summary: Curriculum learning orders samples by difficulty, but difficulty alone does not establish supervision reliability for dense prediction. Easy samples can expose shortcuts, hard samples can be informative, and noisy or ambiguous samples can mislead training. Building on our conference method CurriSeg, we present PaceShift, a stabilize-then-challenge paradigm combining supervision-adaptive curriculum selection with guarded spectral post-training. A learning-dynamics view motivates separating supervision reliability from temporal update value and applying spectral challenges after stabilization. The first phase estimates reliability from available supervision, augmentation consistency, model disagreement, and prediction certainty. Temporal statistics guide sample weighting, while pixel-uncertainty weights reduce the early influence of uncertain regions. The second phase ranks predictions from multiple spectral views using supervision agreement, robustness, reference consistency, and penalties. A pairwise preference objective measured against the frozen Phase-I reference, together with an anchor, refines the prediction. The framework supports full, weak, semi-supervised, and model-derived supervision. Experiments across context-entangled content segmentation (CECS), broader dense-prediction tasks, and foundation-model and cross-modal adaptations show accuracy gains. Targeted diagnostics indicate improved pooled calibration and corruption robustness in the evaluated settings. PaceShift preserves the deployed architecture and adds no inference computation. Code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: PaceShift 提出“先稳定后挑战”的两阶段密集预测训练范式：第一阶段用监督可靠性自适应课程选择（可靠度由监督一致性、增广一致性、模型分歧、预测确定性估计）结合时序统计加权与像素不确定性加权抑制早期不可靠监督；第二阶段在冻结的 Phase-I 参考下，对多谱视角预测用配对偏好目标+锚点进行受约束的谱后训练。
AI.motivation: 课程学习仅按难度排序样本，无法刻画密集预测中监督的可靠性：简单样本可能触发捷径，困难样本可能有益，噪声/歧义样本会误导训练。作者据此主张将“监督可靠性”与“时序更新价值”解耦，并在训练稳定后再施加谱域挑战。
AI.method: 两阶段框架（扩展自会议方法 CurriSeg）：Phase-I 基于可用监督、增广一致性、模型分歧与预测确定性估计样本可靠度，用时序统计指导样本加权，并以像素级不确定性权重削弱不确定区域的早期影响；Phase-II 对多个谱视角的预测按监督一致性、鲁棒性、参考一致性与惩罚项排序，采用相对冻结 Phase-I 参考的配对偏好目标与锚点约束精修预测。支持全监督、弱监督、半监督与模型衍生监督四种设置。
AI.result: 在上下文纠缠内容分割（CECS）、更广泛密集预测任务以及基础模型与跨模态适配上的实验均显示精度提升；诊断实验显示在评估设置中池化校准与损坏鲁棒性有所改善；保持部署架构不变，推理零额外计算，代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 论文把可靠监督筛选与训练后期谱域挑战组合为通用训练范式，但因属密集视觉预测任务，对具身/机器人场景的迁移证据尚缺，属相邻可借鉴方法。

title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.

AI.tldr: Melange：基于BBQ扩展的七类合成视觉社会偏见基准，用VQA自动筛查+人工两阶段验证图像，在23个开源MLLM上对齐比较text-only/image-only/image+context三种设置，揭示模态切换使公平性平均下降0.291且与模型家族而非规模相关。
AI.motivation: MLLM已广泛部署，但其社会偏见研究远落后于纯文本LLM，可能带来现实社会危害；既有跨模态偏见分析要么只覆盖少数偏见类别，要么未保证被比较群体在图像中有明确视觉线索，导致结论不可靠。
AI.method: 以BigBench的BBQ文本数据集为语义基底，通过受控生成构造目标属性在视觉上清晰可辨的合成场景，形成覆盖七类偏见的视觉基准；图像经VQA自动筛查与人工标注两阶段校验；在text-only、image-only、image-with-context三种匹配设置下系统评测23个开源MLLM，并做感知对照实验与极性感知的刻板印象对齐分析。
AI.result: 从文本切换到视觉使公平性平均下降0.291，该差距由模型家族而非规模决定；感知对照显示模型对图像属性识别准确率达90–95%，并非视觉理解不足所致，只是拒绝作答失败；在模型给出有偏答案时，约四分之三选择人类刻板印象方向。
AI.conclusion: MLLM的公平性问题主要源于模态切换而非视觉感知能力欠缺，且不随参数规模自然改善；Melange提供了可控、类别广泛且经验证的诊断工具，提示需针对视觉输入单独做偏见缓解与拒答校准。

title: Hyperspherical Simplex Representations for Backward-Compatible Retrieval
summary: Training modern AI models has become increasingly expensive, and updating deployed models can alter their internal feature representations, affecting applications built upon them. In retrieval systems, such updates often require complete gallery re-indexing, a computationally expensive process at scale. Existing backward-compatibility methods enable direct comparison of representations from updated and earlier models, avoiding re-indexing. However, they typically require compatibility-specific training, learned mapping functions, or architectural modifications, and often depend explicitly on the previous model. We propose hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits for backward-compatible retrieval across independently trained models. They leverage the simplex structure induced by softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot labels as a common geometric reference across model updates. Since this reference depends on the number of classes, adding new ones expands the simplex, misaligning existing class prototypes with their earlier counterparts. We therefore derive a deterministic linear transformation to restore their alignment. Our theoretical analysis of the formal backward-compatibility definition identifies two geometric conditions under which its inequalities hold in expectation, assuming von Mises--Fisher class distributions with increasing concentration across updates. Aligned regular-simplex representations satisfy these conditions, providing a theoretical basis for the proposed representations under the stated assumptions. Without using additional compatibility-specific losses, learned mappings, or architectural modifications, the proposed representations achieve competitive results on standard compatibility benchmarks, including expanded class sets, more expressive architectures, and independently trained models from public repositories.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 softmax 输出的超球单纯形表示，可在不重新索引、无兼容性训练、无映射函数的前提下实现独立训练模型间的后向兼容检索，并推导对齐变换与几何条件理论分析。
AI.motivation: 模型更新会改变内部特征表示，导致检索系统需对整库重新索引，代价高昂；现有后向兼容方法依赖专门的兼容性训练、学习到的映射函数或结构修改，且常显式依赖旧模型。
AI.method: 利用 one-hot 交叉熵训练诱导的单纯形结构作为跨模型更新的公共几何参照，从 logits/softmax 构造超球单纯形表示；针对新增类别导致单纯形扩张、类原型错位问题，推导确定性线性变换恢复对齐；在 von Mises–Fisher 类分布且集中度随更新递增的假设下，给出后向兼容定义成立的两个几何条件。
AI.result: 在标准兼容性基准上（含扩展类别集、更强表达能力架构、来自公开仓库的独立训练模型）取得有竞争力的结果；对齐后的正则单纯形表示在所述假设下满足理论条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明无需兼容性专用损失、学习映射或结构改动，仅凭 softmax 几何即可实现后向兼容检索，并有形式化理论支撑；但不涉及机器人/3D/世界模型等核心领域。

title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
summary: Fine-grained multimodal intelligence requires models to both understand a designated region and localize it from language. Existing methods learn these directions with separate objectives and task-specific annotations. We present Generalized CycleGRPO, the first unified reinforcement learning framework coupling region understanding and localization across spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal domains. Given a region, a multimodal large language model generates candidate descriptions and then localizes each description to reconstruct the input region. Reconstruction overlap provides a verifiable reward for captioning, while individual localization rewards improve the inverse mapping. A common region-space formulation extends this cycle from image masks and boxes to video intervals and timestamped spatial evidence, without reference captions or an external language-model judge during reinforcement learning. In videos, the cycle encourages descriptions that distinguish a target event from similar recurrences. We introduce DOVE (Distinctive Occurrence-level Video-caption Evaluation), a human-verified contrastive benchmark for this temporal distinctiveness. CycleGRPO improves SAMTok's overall gIoU from 57.5% to 68.2% on GroundingSuite and average gIoU from 71.2% to 78.7% on GRES. For temporal tasks, it achieves 51.9% tIoU on Charades and 33.3% Temporal Evidence Coverage on DOVE, compared with 45.6% and 14.8% for the Qwen3-VL initialization. These results establish region-text cycle consistency as a general self-evaluation principle for multimodal understanding and localization. Models, code, and DOVE are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CycleGRPO：用区域-文本循环一致性作为可验证奖励统一强化学习，耦合区域理解与定位，覆盖图像掩码/框、视频区间与时空证据。
AI.motivation: 细粒度多模态智能需同时"理解指定区域"和"从语言定位区域"。现有方法分别用独立目标和任务专用标注学习两个方向，缺乏统一、无需人工caption的监督信号。
AI.method: 给定区域，MLLM生成候选描述，再将每条描述重新定位以重建输入区域；重建重叠度作为可验证奖励用于captioning，各描述自身的定位奖励改进逆映射。以统一"区域空间"形式扩展到图像掩码/框、视频区间与带时间戳空间证据，RL过程无需参考caption或外部LLM裁判。另外提出DOVE对比基准评估时间区分性。
AI.result: GroundingSuite上SAMTok整体gIoU 57.5%→68.2%；GRES平均gIoU 71.2%→78.7%；Charades tIoU 51.9%（Qwen3-VL初值45.6%）；DOVE时间证据覆盖率33.3%（初值14.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 区域-文本循环一致性可作为多模态理解与定位的通用自评估原理，统一GRPO框架在空间、时间与时空任务上均带来显著提升。

title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. Existing work has begun to address these challenges by augmenting foundation-model policies with memory and by introducing hierarchical architectures that separate high-level planning from low-level execution. We organize the high-level VLM as a robotic agent through an editable harness to maintain task context and improve planning through execution experience. We instantiate this approach as SERA (Self-Evolving Robotic Agent), with a fixed VLA executor providing low-level control. The harness maintains and updates task context using observations and execution feedback to guide subsequent planning. Self-evolution uses environment rollouts to propose and evaluate harness revisions, with the selected configuration fixed before held-out testing. On RoboMME, SERA achieves 51.38% overall success with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution. Our exploration suggests that agentic planning is a promising direction for history-dependent robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: SERA：把高层VLM组织为可编辑harness的机器人智能体，用观测与执行反馈维护任务上下文，并通过环境rollout自我进化harness配置，低层由固定VLA执行器控制；RoboMME上51.38% vs 44.38%。
AI.motivation: 长时序操作任务存在非马尔可夫依赖：需保留任务进度与历史交互结果，而部分可观测性与执行误差会随时间累积。现有记忆增强与分层规划方案仍未系统利用执行经验改进规划器本身。
AI.method: 分层架构：高层VLM作为机器人智能体，运行在可编辑的harness中（维护/更新任务上下文，依据观测与执行反馈指导后续规划）；低层为固定的VLA执行器。自进化阶段利用环境rollout提出并评估harness修订，选定配置后在留出测试集上固定使用。
AI.result: RoboMME基准上，自主选择配置的SERA达到51.38%整体成功率，无自进化时为44.38%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式规划是解决历史依赖型机器人操作的有前景方向；harness层面的自进化能有效把执行经验转化为规划能力提升。局限在于证据主要来自单一基准且低层执行器固定。

title: Preserving Operator Intent Under Actuation Constraints: Teleoperation of Manipulators with Coupled Transmissions
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Contribution to the IROS 2026 workshop "5th Sensorimotor-Augmented Teleoperation: Human-Interaction-Oriented Paradigm and Real-World Concerns"
summary: Teleoperation enables intuitive control of remote engineering robots for precision tasks. Existing direct joint-mapping methods have two limitations: independent motor saturation disrupts pitch-roll coordination in differential wrists, while fixed mappings struggle with abrupt tracking changes caused by gravitational loads and actuation constraints. We propose an actuator-constraint-aware leader-follower teleoperation method that jointly models leader gravity compensation, leader-follower joint mapping, and follower differential-wrist control. Specifically, we perform coordinated saturation in motor space according to the available gravity margin and integrate continuous angle unwrapping, feedback-state monitoring, and feasible-reference updates. This preserves the operator's motion direction, reduces coordination distortion, and suppresses recovery transients during saturation or brief communication failures. Real-robot experiments demonstrate smoother wrist trajectories and more continuous recovery than direct mapping.

AI.tldr: 提出一种考虑执行器约束的主从遥操作方法，联合建模主端重力补偿、关节映射与从端差动腕控制，在电机空间按重力裕度做协调饱和，并配合连续解缠、状态监测与可行参考更新，实现更平滑的腕部轨迹与连续恢复。
AI.motivation: 直接关节映射存在两大缺陷：各电机独立饱和会破坏差动腕的俯仰-滚转协调；固定映射难以应对重力负载与驱动约束引起的突变跟踪。目标是保留操作者运动方向、降低协调畸变并抑制饱和或短暂通信故障下的恢复瞬态。
AI.method: 将主端重力补偿、主从关节映射与从端差动腕控制纳入统一框架；依据可用重力裕度在电机空间执行协调饱和，并集成连续角度解缠、反馈状态监测与可行参考更新。
AI.result: 真实机器人实验显示，相比直接映射方法，腕部轨迹更平滑，饱和与通信中断后的恢复更连续。
AI.conclusion: 约束感知的协调饱和与参考可行性管理可有效改善差动腕遥操作的协调性与连续性，属于遥操作控制层的工程性改进。

title: Mixture of Flow Matching and Particle Filter for Proprioception-Based Online Contact Estimation
comment: Author accepted manuscript; 21 pages (including a cover page), 21 figures, 5 tables
summary: In this article, we propose ContactFlowFilter, a novel approach for contact estimation that determines the number of active contacts, their locations, and the associated force vectors. We consider a robot manipulator equipped with joint torque sensors and a base force/torque sensor; such a proprioceptive-only setup presents a challenging inverse problem characterized by (i) multi-modality from non-unique solutions, (ii) temporal dependencies in state evolution, and (iii) discrete contact events involving contact addition/removal. Existing approaches, such as particle filters (PFs) and learning-based methods, often struggle to address these challenges simultaneously. To overcome this, ContactFlowFilter integrates a generative model into the PF framework. The recursive structure of the PF captures temporal dependencies, while the flow matching model serves as an auxiliary proposal distribution to track multi-modal beliefs and detect contact events. Extensive validation in both simulation and real-world experiments confirms the effectiveness of the proposed method. In real-world settings, ContactFlowFilter achieves the lowest dissimilarity from the target distribution, with errors of only 0.36 cm and 0.88 cm for single- and dual-contact scenarios, respectively, while operating at 0.69 ms and 2.69 ms.

AI.tldr: ContactFlowFilter将流匹配生成模型嵌入粒子滤波框架，仅用关节力矩与基座力/力矩传感器实现多接触数量、位置与力向量的估计，实机单/双接触误差0.36/0.88 cm，耗时0.69/2.69 ms。
AI.motivation: 纯本体感知的多接触估计是病态逆问题，存在多模态非唯一解、时序依赖和接触事件离散切换三重困难，粒子滤波与纯学习方法难以同时应对。
AI.method: 以粒子滤波的递归结构建模时序依赖，将条件流匹配模型作为辅助提议分布以跟踪多模态后验，并借生成分布漂移检测接触增删事件；结合关节力矩传感器与基座六维力/力矩传感器做接触状态推断。
AI.result: 仿真与实机验证有效；实机上与目标分布差异最小，单接触误差0.36 cm、双接触0.88 cm，运行时间分别为0.69 ms与2.69 ms。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式提议分布与贝叶斯滤波耦合，可同时处理多模态信念、时序演化与离散接触事件，为无外部视觉的本体感知接触估计提供实时可行方案。

title: Rethinking Underwater Image Enhancement: Learning through Text-Guided Degradation Curriculum
summary: Existing paired clean-degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的退化感知训练框架用于水下图像增强：文本条件扩散生成多样退化样本+渐进式退化课程学习+传输引导单步扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有成对清洁-退化水下数据集规模有限、获取困难，难以覆盖真实水下环境的多样化退化，导致增强模型泛化性受限，亟需可控且逼真的退化建模。
AI.method: 1) 文本条件退化增强管线：用文本引导扩散模型合成语义一致、多样的退化样本，提供成对数据；2) 渐进式退化课程：按多属性、多难度分级组织训练以平衡学习；3) 传输引导单步扩散模型：利用课程渐进过程处理退化程度跨度大与恢复歧义问题。
AI.result: 在多个水下图像基准上实验，性能优于现有方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 可控退化合成+课程学习可有效提升水下增强模型的泛化与鲁棒性；代码与模型将随论文发表开源。

title: Joint-Angle Invariance of Jacobian-Based Performance Indices for Serial Robotic Manipulators
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: This article investigates the joint-angle invariance (JAI) of Jacobian-based performance indices for serial robotic manipulators. We identify kinematic conditions under which representative performance indices, including manipulability, stiffness, and other Jacobian-derived indices, remain independent of the first and last joint angles. This property allows a systematic reduction in the effective configuration-space dimensionality, thereby simplifying the performance evaluation. The utility of JAI is demonstrated through two application scenarios: workspace performance map construction and task layout optimization. Comparative results show that the proposed JAI-based strategy reduces computational effort and storage requirements without compromising the effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究串联机械臂Jacobian类性能指标（可操作度、刚度等）对首末关节角的无关性，据此降低构型空间维度以简化性能评估与任务布局优化。
AI.motivation: 工作空间性能图构建与任务布局优化需遍历高维构型空间，计算与存储开销大；若能识别指标对部分关节角的无关性，可系统性降维。
AI.method: 推导串联机械臂Jacobian类指标与首、末关节角无关的运动学条件；将有效构型空间降维后用于工作空间性能图构建和任务布局优化，并与常规全维遍历策略做对比。
AI.result: 在代表性指标上验证了JAI成立的运动学条件；基于JAI的策略显著降低计算量与存储需求，性能图与布局优化效果不下降。
AI.conclusion: JAI为Jacobian性能指标的评估提供了可解析的降维工具，适合用于性能图构建与任务布局优化，但属于运动学分析与工程加速，尚缺真实机器人实验验证。

title: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
summary: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现flow-matching模型中SNR分布决定空间定位能力，将训练重点移向高噪声阶段可将布局遵循率从25.9%提升到80.8%，仅通过噪声分布调参即可达到接近VAE重建上限的布局控制。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在图像合成上成功，但细粒度空间控制仍困难，通常需要辅助结构适配器或复杂推理时引导；现代VLM文本编码器具备表示空间坐标的潜在能力，生成模型却难以利用，论文希望揭示这一失效的机制性原因。
AI.method: 使用几何图元的合成基准隔离结构机制与纹理复杂度，提出颜色感知布局度量量化空间保真度；分析flow-matching模型的SNR分布对空间定位的影响，识别高噪声区为"关键学习阶段"，并调整训练噪声权重分布；在COCO上验证发现可迁移至真实图像。
AI.result: 中心化SNR训练布局遵循仅25.9%；偏向高噪声训练提升至80.8%，接近VAE重建上限83.6%；该需求随分辨率和宽高比方差增大而增强，FLUX.1的保守噪声调度不足以实现精确布局；COCO上平均精度从1.0提升到57.3，无需架构改动即达SOTA布局遵循。
AI.conclusion: SNR分布是flow-matching空间定位的关键决定因素，仅通过训练噪声分布调参即可实现强布局控制，为可控生成提供了免架构修改的简洁途径，对几何结构敏感的生成任务具指导意义。

title: End-to-End Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Jumping in Lunar Gravity
summary: Legged robots can extend planetary exploration to rugged and discontinuous terrain that is inaccessible to conventional rovers. In lunar gravity, jumping further expands this mobility by enabling robots to cross obstacles and gaps that cannot be traversed by walking alone. We present a multistage reinforcement-learning approach that produces a single end-to-end control policy for commanded point-to-point jumping under lunar gravity. The resulting policy has a simple architecture and relies exclusively on mission-compatible onboard sensing, making its deployment on a real lunar mission plausible. In simulation, the learned policy performs accurate point-to-point jumps with landing errors smaller than the robot's body size. We analyze the torque and power demands of lunar jumping and characterize performance degradation under extreme outlier events, including control-update freezes of up to \SI{1}{s} during flight. Hardware transfer demonstrates that the policy can successfully execute a vertical jump under lunar-gravity offloading. Furthermore, the measured torque and power profiles are consistent with the simulation results and remain within the robot's hardware limits.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段强化学习方法，为月球重力下的足式机器人学习单一端到端跳跃控制策略，仅依赖机载感知，实现低着陆误差的定点跳跃并完成硬件迁移验证。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人可拓展行星探测至崎岖不连续地形，月球重力下跳跃能进一步跨越无法步行通过的障碍与沟壑，但需要任务可行、可部署的机载端到端控制策略。
AI.method: 多阶段强化学习训练单一端到端策略，输出指令化的点到点跳跃控制；策略结构简单且仅使用任务兼容的机载传感；分析力矩/功率需求，并在控制更新冻结1s等极端异常下评估鲁棒性；通过月球重力卸载装置完成硬件迁移。
AI.result: 仿真中着陆误差小于机器人本体尺寸；给出月球跳跃的力矩与功率特性；飞行中控制更新冻结达1s时性能退化可被刻画；硬件实验成功执行垂直跳跃，实测力矩/功率曲线与仿真一致且未超硬件极限。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段RL可得到结构简单、机载感知即可运行的月球重力跳跃策略，具备实际月球任务部署潜力；但硬件验证仅限于垂直跳跃，位移性点到点跳跃与真机地形泛化仍待验证。

title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出CineEvolve，将导演(Director)与评论家(Critic)统一于单一视觉-语言策略，通过交替强化学习自演化生成电影级多镜头视频，并引入E-GRPO稳定协同训练。
AI.motivation: 现有多镜头视频生成方法要么缺乏叙事推理，要么仅用前馈流程而无策略更新，无法模拟真实电影制作中"迭代指导+批判反馈"的闭环。
AI.method: 单一VLM策略内嵌Director与Critic角色，交替强化学习：Director暴露缺陷以锐化Critic，更新后的Critic指导Director定向修订；提出Evolutionary GRPO，用历史锚定与修订保护抑制优势膨胀；构建CineTraj（40K电影化轨迹数据集，覆盖创作/批判/修订）。
AI.result: 大量实验显示CineEvolve优于现有方法（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 用自演化智能体策略统一叙事规划与迭代精修，可作为智能体驱动多步创作-评估-修订范式参考；但任务为电影叙事视频，非3D/具身核心问题。

title: No Frames, Just Frequencies: Bandwidth-Efficient Deployment-Time Adaptation for Smart Glasses
summary: Deep neural networks deployed on smart glasses must adapt to changes in the distribution of incoming data while adhering to strict privacy and device constraints. We present No Frames, Just Frequencies, a bandwidth-efficient source-assisted adaptation framework that characterizes distribution shifts using compact frequency descriptors computed on-device. Rather than transmitting camera frames, the glasses compute and send frequency descriptors to a host device that contains a replica of the model. The host device maps the received frequency descriptor to a distribution shift operator that synthesizes out-of-distribution data and adapts a model replica using a pre-defined adaptation protocol. We evaluate the framework on mixtures of ImageNet-C corruptions using convolution-based (ConvNeXtV2-Femto), self-attention-based (DeiT-Tiny), and hybrid (TinyViT-5M) vision models, on person classification (Visual Wake Words), and on object detection (MS-COCO). Our results reveal that adaptation driven solely by the transmitted descriptors recovers $93-95\%$ of the supervised oracle adaptation gain on all three architectures, $82\%$ on Visual Wake Words and $94$--$98\%$ on MS-COCO. Notably, adaptation quality degrades gracefully as the descriptor resolution decreases from $224 $ to $28$ pixels, consistently across architectures, enabling bandwidth reductions from $213\times$ to $784\times$ across the frequency descriptors.

AI.tldr: 提出"仅频率、无帧"的源端辅助域适应框架：智能眼镜端仅计算紧凑频率描述子并传给主机，主机由描述子映射出分布偏移算子、合成OOD数据并适配模型副本。
AI.motivation: 智能眼镜等端侧部署的深度网络需适应数据分布漂移，但受带宽、隐私与算力约束，无法上传原始图像帧。
AI.method: 端侧对图像计算多分辨率的频域描述子（无帧传输），主机端持有模型副本，将描述子映射为分布偏移算子以合成伪OOD数据，按预设适应协议（如BN统计/参数适配）更新副本；描述子分辨率可从224降至28像素。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C混合损坏、Visual Wake Words人物分类和MS-COCO检测上，纯描述子驱动的适应分别恢复监督式oracle增益的93–95%（ConvNeXtV2-Femto/DeiT-Tiny/TinyViT-5M）、82%、94–98%；分辨率降低时性能平缓退化，带宽压缩达213×–784×。
AI.conclusion: 极低频域描述子即可承载足够的分布偏移信息，实现隐私友好的高效端云协同适应，适用于资源受限的视觉终端。

title: Diff-IrisPAD: Modeling Bona Fide Iris Distributions for Unsupervised Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Iris recognition systems are vulnerable to presentation attacks (PAs), including textured contact lenses, print replays, and synthetic irises. Existing PAD methods rely on supervised learning with attack data, limiting generalization to unseen attacks and new sensors. We propose Diff-IrisPAD, an unsupervised framework based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion that models bona fide iris distributions without using attack samples. The method reconstructs clean iris textures from degraded inputs and detects attacks via reconstruction inconsistency using ViT scoring and pixel-level measures. Experiments on a large-scale multi-sensor dataset (125K+ images, NIR and VIS, 8 attack types) show that Diff-IrisPAD achieves an overall ACER of 30.52, significantly outperforming diffusion-based baselines while demonstrating strong generalization to unseen attacks. These results highlight the effectiveness of diffusion-based bona fide modeling for robust and scalable iris PAD.

AI.tldr: Diff-IrisPAD：基于布朗桥扩散的无监督虹膜呈现攻击检测框架，仅用真实样本建模，通过重建不一致性检测攻击，多传感器大规模数据集上ACER 30.52。
AI.motivation: 现有虹膜PAD依赖带攻击标签的监督学习，难以泛化到未见攻击类型与新传感器；需摆脱攻击数据的无监督方案。
AI.method: 采用Brownian Bridge Diffusion仅对bona fide虹膜分布建模；对退化输入重建干净虹膜纹理，并以ViT评分与像素级度量量化重建不一致性作为攻击判据。
AI.result: 在125K+图像、NIR与VIS、8类攻击的多传感器数据集上总体ACER为30.52，显著优于扩散基线，并对未见攻击展现较强泛化。
AI.conclusion: 扩散式真实样本建模可作为可扩展、鲁棒的无监督PAD范式；但ACER绝对值仍偏高，实用部署尚需改进。

title: Watch Your Step: Anticipated Perception for Humanoid Locomotion
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Perceptive locomotion policies typically observe a dense robot-centric elevation map, although only the terrain beneath and around the next footsteps informs the control decision. Learned encoders compress the whole visual input, leaving the policy to work out which inputs matter while learning the baseline locomotion task. Learning both at once slows training and, without computationally expensive attention mechanisms, makes generalization to new terrain harder. We instead remove redundant inputs from the elevation map before the policy sees it. A lightweight foothold prediction model (FPM) predicts future footholds from proprioception and the velocity command alone, and we sample the elevation map only in small patches around these predicted footholds. We train the prediction model alongside the locomotion policy, periodically retraining it on new policy rollouts as the robot's gait matures. This allows the perception to anticipate where the policy will step, while the policy learns to leverage terrain information around those steps. With the proposed lightweight preprocessing, the policy reaches a given terrain difficulty in roughly a third of the training iterations required with the complete map. It outperforms policies that observe the complete map where footholds are sparse, including in narrow walled corridors, and on unseen terrain, and it matches an attention-based encoder trained at several times the cost. The policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 humanoid traversing various obstacles, stairs, gaps, and step-downs beyond the training distribution in both indoor and outdoor environments.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量落脚点预测模型（FPM），仅用本体感知与速度指令预测未来落脚点，再在高程图上只采样落脚点周围小patch送入策略，与locomotion策略联合周期性重训练，显著降低训练迭代数并提升稀疏落脚与未见地形泛化。
AI.motivation: 稠密机器人中心高程图中大部分信息对控制决策冗余；学习式编码器需同时学习压缩与locomotion任务，训练慢且泛化差（除非用昂贵注意力机制）。作者希望在看图之前先剔除冗余输入。
AI.method: FPM由本体感知与速度指令预测未来落脚点；在高程图上以预测落脚点为中心采样小patch作为感知输入；FPM与locomotion策略联合训练，并随步态成熟定期用新rollout重训练FPM，使感知能预判策略的落足位置。
AI.result: 达到同等地形难度约只需全图方案的1/3训练迭代；在稀疏落脚地形（如窄围墙走廊）与未见地形上优于全图策略；性能与数倍成本训练的注意力编码器相当；零样本迁移至Unitree G1人形机器人，完成训练分布外的障碍、楼梯、壕沟与下台阶（室内外）。
AI.conclusion: 以任务相关的稀疏采样替代稠密感知是高效且可泛化的感知locomotion范式，落脚点预测可作为感知与控制的轻量接口。

title: An interpretable deep learning method for early hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis on multiphase CT
summary: Early diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma is critical to preserve access to curative treatment options. The Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) provides a standardized framework for non-invasive diagnosis on multiphase computed tomography, based on major visual imaging features. However, these features may be difficult to assess consistently, particularly in small liver lesions. We developed dLI-RADS, an interpretable artificial intelligence method designed to estimate the probability of hepatocellular carcinoma from multiphase computed tomography images of manually segmented liver lesions, while remaining aligned with LI-RADS-related imaging concepts. dLI-RADS combines neural network-derived predictions with handcrafted quantitative imaging measurements reflecting LI-RADS major features and integrates these inputs using logistic regression. In this multicenter retrospective study, patients with multiphase computed tomography and at least one liver lesion were included, while lesions larger than 40 mm were excluded. Histology served as the reference standard for hepatocellular carcinoma, and a composite reference standard was used for non-hepatocellular carcinoma lesions. The lesion-level accuracy of dLI-RADS and LI-RADS were compared on the internal evaluation set using 10,000-repetition bootstrap non-inferiority tests, with 5% margins and significance levels. On the external test set, sensitivities were similarly compared. dLI-RADS was non-inferior to LI-RADS for lesion-level accuracy in the internal evaluation set, achieving 80% accuracy compared with 74% for LI-RADS (p = 0.04)...

AI.tldr: dLI-RADS：将神经网络预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的定量影像手工特征结合，经逻辑回归融合，从多期CT手动分割病灶估计HCC概率的可解释AI方法，内外部多中心验证其病灶级准确率不劣于LI-RADS。
AI.motivation: LI-RADS基于视觉主要特征的标准化非侵入诊断在小肝病灶上难以一致评估，需要既保持与LI-RADS概念对齐又可解释的量化方法。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性研究，纳入有多期CT且至少一个肝病灶（>40mm排除）的患者；dLI-RADS融合神经网络预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的手工定量影像测量，用逻辑回归整合；以组织学为HCC参考标准、复合标准为非HCC参考；内部集用10,000次bootstrap非劣性检验（5%界值）比较病灶级准确率，外部集比较敏感性。
AI.result: 内部评估集上dLI-RADS病灶级准确率80% vs LI-RADS 74%（p=0.04），达到非劣性；外部测试集敏感性亦作比较（摘要截断）。
AI.conclusion: dLI-RADS在保持与LI-RADS影像概念对齐和可解释性的前提下，病灶级诊断准确率不低于专家使用的LI-RADS，可作为小肝病灶辅助诊断工具。

title: TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code and experimental results: this https URL
summary: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit $\times$ 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.

AI.tldr: TernScope 通过模型–硬件协同设计，构建全三值权重、8-bit 激活的轻量医学分割网络，并以分通道大核块、分支融合与三值渐进量化训练（TPQ）兼顾精度与效率，最终在 45nm Gemmini 上显著降低计算阵列面积。
AI.motivation: 边缘医学分割需同时满足小模型、高精度与快推理；低比特算子既能压缩模型又能简化硬件实现，但直接在深度分割网络上做三值量化会导致精度显著下降，因此需要结构与训练策略的协同设计。
AI.method: (1) 分通道大核块（split-channel large-kernel block）：在有限算力下保留大感受野空间上下文；(2) 分支融合（branch fusion）：消除冗余推理分支以降低延时；(3) 三值渐进量化感知训练 TPQ：先在深层、再经解码器、最后到浅层及输入/预测层逐层适配三值化；(4) 全部 25 个卷积采用三值权重 + 8-bit 激活，支持打包存储与无乘法器（multiplier-free）计算，并配合 systolic-array 加速器 Gemmini 的面积评估。
AI.result: 模型规模 0.2483 M 参数、0.0949 GMACs，在同域与外部数据集上保持有竞争力的分割精度；同 45nm 工艺下，相比采用 8-bit×8-bit 乘法器的原始 Gemmini，计算阵列面积减少 88.46%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了从高精度轻量医学分割走向紧凑低比特硬件实现的可落地路径，模型–硬件协同设计是边缘医疗部署的有效范式。

title: FogTTA: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Transformer-based Object Detection in Foggy Weather
comment: Published in Proceedings of the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence (Canadian AI 2026), PMLR 318:13-24. Available at this https URL
summary: Object detection models for autonomous driving commonly experience substantial performance drops when deployed under adverse weather due to the domain shift between training data and real-world operating conditions. This degradation is especially evident when models trained on clear-weather images encounter foggy environments with reduced visibility and contrast. To address this challenge, we introduce FogTTA, an online test-time adaptation framework designed to improve the robustness of Transformer-based object detectors in fog. Using RF-DETR as the underlying object detector, FogTTA enables real-time adaptation to the streaming target domain without requiring source data or retraining. The framework follows a teacher-student design, where the deployed model serves as the teacher and generates pseudo labels from weakly augmented target inputs. These predictions are subsequently refined through non-maximum suppression and confidence filtering. The student model then learns from strongly augmented target sample using the Varifocal loss to mitigate pseudo-label noise. The teacher is updated via exponential moving averaging to ensure stable and continuous adaptation. Experiments show that FogTTA outperforms prior baselines, delivering improved detection accuracy and stability while maintaining real-time performance.

AI.tldr: FogTTA：面向雾天场景的在线测试时自适应框架，用RF-DETR检测器+教师-学生伪标签+EMA更新，无需源数据或重训练即可实时提升Transformer检测器鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶目标检测模型在晴天数据上训练后部署到雾天时因域偏移出现显著性能下降；现有方法需要源数据或离线重训练，难以应对流式目标域。
AI.method: 教师-学生在线TTA：部署模型作教师，对弱增强目标输入生成伪标签，经NMS与置信度过滤；学生模型在强增强样本上用Varifocal loss学习以抑制伪标签噪声；教师以指数滑动平均(EMA)更新，保证稳定连续适应；基座检测器为RF-DETR。
AI.result: 实验表明FogTTA优于已有基线，在保持实时性能的同时提升检测精度与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 无源数据的在线TTA可有效缓解雾天域偏移下的检测退化，实现实时鲁棒适配。

title: OpenEarth-OVS44: A Multimodal Remote Sensing Dataset for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: In remote sensing, open-vocabulary segmentation is particularly important for flexible and scalable land-cover understanding across diverse regions, as it improves generalization to novel categories without requiring exhaustive pixel-level annotations. Despite its great promise, progress in this area remains largely constrained by existing datasets with limited category coverage and overly coarse taxonomies, and therefore struggles to support fine-grained semantic understanding required in real-world applications such as urban functional zoning, carbon accounting, and post-disaster assessment. To address these challenges, we present OpenEarth-OVS44, a multimodal benchmark with 290,587 expert-verified segments from 2,832 RGB images and 1,341 strictly registered RGB-SAR pairs at sub-meter spatial resolution, covering 40 cities across France, Japan, and the United States under a unified 44-class taxonomy organized into 9 base categories. Three evaluation tracks are provided: an RGB-only fine-grained benchmark, a multimodal track with diverse synthetic cloudy conditions for weather-robust evaluation, and a held-out cross-region track. Extensive experiments on representative open-vocabulary segmentation models demonstrate that training on OpenEarth-OVS44 substantially improves fine-grained segmentation performance over the strongest training-free baseline, with improvements of up to 7.1 mIoU points on unseen categories and 27.6 mIoU points on seen categories. The dataset and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenEarth-OVS44，一个覆盖法、日、美40城、亚米级分辨率的多模态开放词汇遥感分割基准（290,587个专家核验标注、2,832张RGB、1,341对严格配准的RGB-SAR影像），采用9大类下44类统一细粒度分类体系，并提供RGB-only、合成多云多模态鲁棒性、跨区域泛化三条评测赛道。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感开放词汇分割受限于数据集类别覆盖不足、分类体系过于粗糙，难以支撑城市功能区划、碳核算、灾后评估等应用所需的细粒度语义理解；同时缺少多模态与跨区域泛化的标准化评测。
AI.method: 构建专家核验的多模态基准：亚米级RGB与严格配准的RGB-SAR对，统一44类/9大类分类体系；设计三条评测赛道（RGB细粒度、多云合成条件下的多模态鲁棒性、留出跨区域）；在代表性开放词汇分割模型上进行训练与训练免（training-free）基线对比实验。
AI.result: 在该基准上训练可显著提升细粒度分割性能，相较最强training-free基线，未见类别mIoU最高提升7.1点，已见类别提升27.6点；多模态与跨区域赛道验证了鲁棒性与泛化性评测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、多模态、跨区域的标准化基准是推动遥感开放词汇分割实用化的关键，OpenEarth-OVS44可作为该方向的评测基础设施；但其贡献主要为数据集与基准，未提出新的分割方法。

title: Joint Semantic-Channel Coding and Modulation for Generative Image Transmission
summary: Digital image transmission typically optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately, limiting how source representations adapt to channel impairments. We propose SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation scheme for generative image transmission converting source to modulated symbols, such as standard QAM symbols. Channel impairments create two challenges: they can corrupt the latent representation at the receiver, and this corruption can compound through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction quality. First, SemQAM represents latent features with vector quantization (VQ), maps each VQ index to a QAM symbol, and updates the codeword corresponding to the detected symbol so that channel impairments directly affect codebook learning. Moreover, SemQAM uses the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction and reduce error propagation during autoregressive coding. SemQAM supports multiple SNRs and CBRs in a unified model, while also supporting conventional source coding through SemQAM-C. Experiments show that (i) under the same LDPC and QAM settings, SemQAM-C outperforms OneDC in LPIPS and DISTS with substantially lower complexity, showing that the unified model retains competitive capability for source coding. (ii) Compared with this separated counterpart, SemQAM reduces channel uses by 18.57% at matched LPIPS and outperforms the compared JSCC methods, demonstrating the benefit of joint coding.

AI.tldr: SemQAM is a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation scheme that maps VQ indices directly to QAM symbols, letting channel impairments shape codebook learning and using conditional expectation of received codewords to curb autoregressive error propagation.
AI.motivation: Separate source coding, channel coding, and modulation prevent source representations from adapting to channel impairments; latent corruption at the receiver also compounds through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction.
AI.method: VQ-compress latent features, map each VQ index to a QAM symbol, update the codeword of the detected symbol so impairments enter codebook learning, and use the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate receiver reconstruction; one unified model covers multiple SNRs/CBRs, plus a SemQAM-C variant compatible with conventional source coding.
AI.result: Under identical LDPC/QAM settings, SemQAM-C beats OneDC in LPIPS and DISTS at substantially lower complexity; versus the separated pipeline, SemQAM cuts channel uses by 18.57% at matched LPIPS and outperforms compared JSCC methods.
AI.conclusion: Directly coupling quantization indices with modulation symbols and modeling receiver-side codeword uncertainty yields a simple, unified generative JSCC framework that gains both efficiency and quality.

title: Reading the Room: Scale-ambiguous Semantic Registration of Sparse VSLAM Maps to Floor Plans in Partially Built Environments
summary: Many robotic construction applications, such as progress tracking, require registering a sensor trajectory to a prior 2D floor plan. Visual capture is attractive for its low cost and availability, but aligning a visual simultaneous localization and mapping (VSLAM) map to a floor plan is difficult; VSLAM recovers geometry only up to an unknown similarity transform, the sparse point cloud is cross-modal to the symbolic floor plan, sites are only partially built during capture, and construction sites are visually repetitive, degrading map quality while removing distinctive features. Existing methods address at most two of these challenges. We thus introduce Reading the Room(RR), a global-local approach to register scale-ambiguous, sparse, semantic VSLAM maps to partially built floor plans. Our key idea is to define a single robust, differentiable, class-balanced semantic-geometric energy function that governs all stages of the pipeline. We develop two global initialization schemes, leveraging a single inaccurate user-provided correspondence if provided, or estimating the initialization globally using a cross-modal matching network. Both schemes are designed to find initial candidates with respect to the energy function, which is then directly optimized for local refinement. We evaluate RR on 33 sequences across three active construction sites against classical and learning-based baselines, achieving a 4.5x improvement in mean absolute trajectory error over the strongest baseline in the general unconstrained setting, which increases to 7.6x when an anchor is provided.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reading the Room (RR)，一种全局-局部框架，将尺度未知、稀疏、语义化的 VSLAM 地图配准到部分建成的 2D 楼层平面图；核心是单一鲁棒、可微、类别平衡的语义-几何能量函数贯穿全局初始化与局部精化。
AI.motivation: 施工进度追踪等机器人建造应用需要把传感器轨迹配准到既有 2D 楼层平面图；视觉方案成本低易部署，但 VSLAM 地图与平面图的对齐面临四重困难：仅恢复至相似变换（尺度未知）、稀疏点云与符号化平面图跨模态、拍摄时建筑仅部分建成、工地视觉重复导致地图质量差且缺乏显著特征。已有方法至多解决其中两项，因此需要一个统一处理全部挑战的方案。
AI.method: 定义统一的语义-几何能量函数，兼具鲁棒、可微、类别平衡特性，驱动全流程所有阶段。全局初始化两种方案：(1) 若用户提供单个不精确对应点，则据此求解候选；(2) 无对应时用跨模态匹配网络进行全局估计。两种方案都旨在产生关于能量函数的初始候选，随后直接对该能量函数做局部优化精化。
AI.result: 在三个真实在建施工场地的 33 条序列上，与经典及学习型基线对比：一般无约束设置下平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）较最强基线提升 4.5 倍；提供锚点（anchor）时提升至 7.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 以单一可微语义-几何能量统一全局初始化与局部精化的全局-局部配准策略，可有效应对尺度歧义、跨模态稀疏、部分建成与视觉重复等复合挑战，在真实工地数据上显著优于现有基线，适合施工机器人定位与进度追踪部署。

title: MS2CAST: A Video Anomaly Detection Framework via Multi-Scale Spatial Cross-Attention and Efficient Spatiotemporal Networks
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a challenging task for surveillance systems due to the scarcity and diversity of anomalous events. While semi-supervised VAD approaches have advanced the field, many rely on computationally intensive optical flow networks to capture motion dynamics. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are also widely used for spatial encoding, but their effective receptive field is highly local. To address these limitations, we introduce MS2CAST, an end-to-end semi-supervised predictive VAD framework. For spatial encoding, we employ a multi-scale cross-attention encoder that fuses the hierarchical feature representations from a vision transformer (MViTv2-S) and a CNN (ConvNeXt-T) to exploit their distinct receptive fields. To model spatiotemporal dynamics without optical flow estimation, we integrate two interchangeable spatiotemporal modules in the latent space. One module (SwinLSTM) incorporates a Swin Transformer, while the other (VMRNN) integrates Vision Mamba blocks. Our objective function combines L1 loss, Gradient Difference Loss (GDL), and Multi-Scale Structural Similarity Index Measure (MS-SSIM) to ensure pixel-wise accuracy, sharpness, and structural integrity. Evaluations across the UCSD Ped2, CUHK Avenue, and ShanghaiTech datasets demonstrate frame-level Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) Area Under the Curve (AUC) scores that are competitive with top-tier techniques while maintaining a peak GPU memory usage of under 1 GB.

AI.tldr: MS2CAST：端到端半监督预测式视频异常检测框架，用多尺度交叉注意力编码器融合MViTv2-S与ConvNeXt-T，并以SwinLSTM或VMRNN在隐空间建模时空动态，替代光流；结合L1+GDL+MS-SSIM损失，在三个数据集上AUC具竞争力且显存占用<1GB。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督VAD方法依赖计算昂贵的光流网络获取运动信息；CNN空间编码的有效感受野偏局部，难以覆盖多尺度上下文。因此需要一种无需光流、且兼具全局与局部感受野的轻量高效VAD方案。
AI.method: 1）空间编码：多尺度交叉注意力编码器，融合ViT（MViTv2-S）的层级表征与CNN（ConvNeXt-T）特征，兼顾大/小感受野；2）时空建模：在隐空间集成两个可互换模块——SwinLSTM（Swin Transformer+LSTM）与VMRNN（Vision Mamba块+RNN），避免显式光流估计；3）预测式目标函数：L1 + 梯度差分损失GDL + 多尺度SSIM，分别约束像素精度、边缘锐度与结构一致性；4）整体为端到端半监督训练，推理阶段以预测误差作为异常分数。
AI.result: 在UCSD Ped2、CUHK Avenue、ShanghaiTech三个基准上，帧级ROC-AUC与当前最优方法相当，同时峰值GPU显存占用低于1GB，体现出显著的效率优势。摘要未给出具体AUC数值与消融数据。
AI.conclusion: 以"ViT+CNN多尺度交叉注意力 + 隐空间时空模块"替代光流与纯CNN编码，可在低显存开销下取得有竞争力的VAD性能；Swin与Mamba两条时空分支的可互换设计提供了灵活性。局限在于评测集中于监控场景的帧级指标，缺少像素级定位（如MICRO指标）与开放场景泛化验证，且属监控视频异常检测这一专门领域。

title: Spatially Gated Demographic Steering for Debiasing Multi-Person Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene. In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image. Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline. Text- and latent-projection approaches shift the aggregate skew with only marginal gains in intra-image diversity. We present Spatially Gated Steering (SGS), which steers the demographics of each person independently by extracting per-person masks from the Diffusion Transformer's (DiT) internal attention maps at a critical denoising timestep and applying a distinct demographic vector within each mask for the remaining steps. SGS needs no fine-tuning, inversion or layout specifications, and uses a lightweight segmentor over frozen DiT attention features to localize subjects at early timesteps. On skewed occupational prompts, SGS reaches high intra-image racial and gender diversity while keeping aggregate balance competitive and image quality near baseline, a result we validate on two architecturally distinct diffusion transformers, FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large. Codebase and model weights are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: SGS利用DiT内部注意力图在关键时间步提取逐人掩码，对多人物场景中各人物独立施加不同的人口统计学引导向量，无需微调、反演或布局指定，从而兼顾聚合平衡与图内多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图去偏见方法对整幅场景施加统一的人口统计校正，在多人物生成中造成"聚合平衡"与"图内多样性"的权衡：全局引导（如嵌入算术）会牺牲图内多样性，文本/潜空间投影方法图内多样性提升有限。
AI.method: Spatially Gated Steering：在冻结的DiT注意力特征上训练轻量分割器，于早期关键去噪时间步从注意力图中提取每个人物掩码；随后在剩余去噪步骤内，在各掩码区域内分别施加不同的人口统计引导向量，实现空间门控的独立引导。无需微调、反演或布局输入。
AI.result: 在偏斜的职业提示词上，SGS达到较高的图内种族与性别多样性，同时聚合平衡具竞争力、图像质量接近基线；在架构不同的FLUX.1-Dev与SD3.5-Large上均验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 多人物文生图去偏见应转向空间选择性引导而非全局校正，DiT注意力图可作为无需额外布局输入的可靠个体定位信号，且方法具跨架构可迁移性并已开源。

title: Learning to Reason Like a Cytopathologist:Clinically Grounded Multiscale Evidential Learning for Cervical Cytology
summary: Cervical cytology presents a fundamentally ambiguous diagnostic landscape, where equivocal categories such as Atypical Squamous Cells of Undetermined Significance (ASC-US) occupy a morphological grey zone that is definitional. For clinical decision support, the goal extends beyond assigning a definitive label to every sample: cases must also be distinguished by whether the available evidence supports a confident decision or warrants further consideration, a distinction conventional classification models are not designed to explicitly represent. We propose a multiscale evidential framework that models cervical cytology along an ordinal disease continuum using clinically grounded soft anchors, representing progression from benign reactive changes to precancerous lesions and malignancy. Three biologically motivated spatial contexts--nuclear morphology, cytoplasmic characteristics, and neighbourhood cellular architecture--are independently encoded using a shared frozen DINOv2 backbone, preserving inter-scale disagreement that early fusion may obscure. Calibrated predictions are transformed into Dempster--Shafer belief masses and fused with reliability discounting, allowing conflicting evidence and insufficient support to remain explicitly uncommitted rather than forcing a decision. The fused belief state drives interpretable routing that separates confidently classified cases from those with irreducible evidential insufficiency, enabling clinically meaningful triage. Across two independent publicly available conventional cytology datasets, RIVA and CRIC Cervix, the framework generalises consistently, with uncertainty strongly associated with diagnostic difficulty: incorrect predictions carry 1.94x-4.13x higher uncertainty than correct ones.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度证据（Dempster–Shafer）框架用于宫颈细胞学序数分级，以三个生物学motivated空间上下文独立编码、可靠性折扣融合，实现"确诊/证据不足"的可解释分流。
AI.motivation: 宫颈细胞学存在定义性的形态学灰区（如ASC-US），临床决策支持不应强制给每个样本下确定性标签，而需区分"证据充分可确诊"与"需进一步检查"；常规分类模型无法显式表达这种"未决"状态。
AI.method: 以临床依据的软锚点将宫颈细胞学建模为序数疾病连续谱（良性反应性改变→癌前病变→恶性）；用共享冻结的DINOv2主干分别独立编码核形态、胞质特征与邻域细胞架构三个尺度，保留早期融合会掩盖的尺度间分歧；将校准预测转为Dempster–Shafer信度质量，并以可靠性折扣进行融合，使冲突或支持不足的证据保持显式未承诺；融合信度驱动可解释路由，分离高置信分类与不可约减的证据不足样本。
AI.result: 在RIVA与CRIC Cervix两个独立公开常规细胞学数据集上表现一致泛化；不确定性与诊断难度强相关，错误预测的不确定性为正确预测的1.94–4.13倍。
AI.conclusion: 证据式不确定性建模可将"未决"作为一等输出，支撑临床上有意义的分流与triage，具备跨数据集泛化性。

title: From Acceptance and Avoidance to Affective Viscosity: Designing Social Agents Intermediating in Human Relationships
comment: The 2nd International Workshop on Trust and Blame in Multi-Person Multi-Agent Societies (TBSA_2nd) in HAI 2026, 5 pages, 2 figures
summary: As social agents become embedded in human relationships, they are expected not only to provide smooth assistance but also to handle rejection, discomfort, jealousy, persistence, and other forms of social tension. This paper connects two research directions: acceptance and avoidance in response to an agent's gaze, approach, and contact, and affective viscosity as a model of how negative affect accumulates, persists, is suppressed, and is expressed over time. We argue that avoidance should not be treated merely as a failure of interaction, but as a relational signal that indicates boundaries between humans and agents. Building on this view, affective viscosity provides a design perspective for agents that maintain, suppress, or express negative states depending on social relationships and interaction histories. We discuss several ongoing design cases, including triadic jealousy, discomfort suppression, patience timing, and spatiotemporal stickiness, and consider how these cases lead to broader questions of blame and accountable intervention. Rather than designing agents as simple scapegoats or artificial villains, we ask how agents can intermediate in problematic social situations while making their intervention traceable, limited, contestable, and repairable.

AI.tldr: 将“对社会智能体注视、接近与接触的接受/回避”与“情感黏度”（负性情感随时间累积、持续、抑制与表达）两条研究线索相连，主张回避是标示人—智能体边界的关系性信号，并据此提出依社会关系与交互史而维持、抑制或表达负性状态的设计视角。
AI.motivation: 社交智能体进入人际关系后，不仅需提供顺畅协助，还须应对拒绝、不适、嫉妒、纠缠等社交张力；现有工作多把回避简单视为交互失败，缺乏对负性情感随时间演化及其关系含义的建模。
AI.method: 概念性/设计研究（非算法方法）：以接受—回避的双向框架与“情感黏度”模型为理论工具，结合若干进行中的设计案例——三元嫉妒、不适抑制、耐心计时、时空黏着——展开分析，并进一步讨论责任归因与可问责干预的设计问题。
AI.result: 摘要未报告量化或实证结果，仅呈现设计案例与由此引出的开放问题；结论侧重设计原则而非性能评估。
AI.conclusion: 智能体不应被设计为替罪羊或“人工反派”，而应作为问题社交情境的中介者，使其干预具备可追溯、有限、可争议与可修复的属性。

title: DriveMLP: When Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at 2026 Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL)
summary: Learning motion planning policies that remain reliable under closed-loop execution is a central challenge in Autonomous Driving (AD). Imitation Learning (IL) scales well to large AD datasets but suffers from distribution shift, causal confusion, and compounding errors under closed-loop execution. In contrast, Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically requires handcrafted rule-based rewards and massive simulation. We study a simple closed-loop IL framework that uses RL purely as an optimization tool, guided by a trajectory-distance reward derived from logged expert data. We refer to this training strategy as Expert-Guided RL (EGRL). Through a controlled empirical study we find evidence that the training procedure, rather than model size and complexity, accounts for a substantial part of the performance gains. We then introduce DriveMLP, a lightweight MLP policy trained with EGRL, as a simple instantiation of these findings. It achieves a score of 86.51 on the nuPlan Val14 Reactive benchmark, a +3.2 point improvement over the previous best IL planner (Flow Planner), with >15x faster inference. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 以“专家数据轨迹距离奖励 + RL 优化”为核心的闭环模仿学习策略 EGRL，并据此提出轻量 MLP 规划器 DriveMLP，在 nuPlan Val14 Reactive 上取得 86.51 分。
AI.motivation: 闭环执行下 IL 存在分布偏移、因果混淆与误差累积，而 RL 依赖手工规则奖励与大规模仿真；作者希望验证性能提升主要来自训练流程而非模型规模/复杂度。
AI.method: 简单闭环 IL 框架，用来自专家日志数据的轨迹距离作为奖励，将 RL 仅作为优化工具（EGRL）；通过受控实验对比模型规模与训练过程的影响，并用该策略训练一个轻量 MLP 策略 DriveMLP。
AI.result: DriveMLP 在 nuPlan Val14 Reactive benchmark 上得分 86.51，较此前最佳 IL 规划器 Flow Planner 提升 3.2 分，推理速度提升 15 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 闭环性能提升的关键在于训练过程（专家引导的 RL 优化）而非模型规模，轻量 MLP 即可在闭环规划基准上取得领先且推理高效。

title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
comment: 93 pages, 15 figures, 21 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.

AI.tldr: 该文将"递归自我改进"(RSI)概念引入机器人学习领域，梳理从改进能力到改进"改进过程"的路径，提出收益可延续的四项条件与评估原则。
AI.motivation: 数字智能体已能通过重写自身代码并用可执行测试验证来自我改进，但物理世界中的机器人需依赖部分观测、昂贵试验、变化工况与不可逆后果；现有研究缺少对RSI在机器人学习中适用边界与证据的系统梳理。
AI.method: 立场/综述性论文：以RSI为框架定位机器人学习研究，沿"能力改进—学习过程改进—改进机制自身改进"层级追踪路径，提出收益可延续的四条判据（反馈针对剩余学习需求、接收组件能利用该变化、价值在任务/硬件变化下仍成立、持续练习安全且可负担），并归纳评估原则与研究议程。
AI.result: 现有研究集中于操作任务，支持行为层面改进、对后续学习的增益以及流程（procedure）改进；部分系统改进了改进者的知识或工具，但尚无物理研究能把增益单独归因于"递归"本身。
AI.conclusion: RSI在机器人领域仍处于概念与证据分离阶段，需建立可分离递归贡献的评估范式，并围绕安全性、成本与工况漂移开展逐次试验的稳健自我改进研究。

title: Rethinking Post-hoc Debiasing of Large Pretrained Models
summary: Large pretrained models such as CLIP are widely used as frozen feature extractors. However, their embeddings inherit spurious correlations from training data, introducing bias into the features. A growing body of research has sought to address this issue through post hoc debiasing, leaving the backbone untouched. We discover that despite differing mechanisms, these methods require the bias feature to be identified and expressed in text. This dependency is not innocuous. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that this requirement incurs an unforeseen penalty in certain scenarios. For example, on the UrbanCars benchmark, having two co-occurring bias attributes, the recent methods underperform a vanilla classifier on biased frozenbackbone features, and even providing ground-truth bias identities does not close the gap. We show that the pattern that such methods seek is readily observable in the frozen geometry. Specifically, cross-class training pairs placed closest together by the frozen encoder almost always share a spurious attribute, regardless of the bias type, without requiring access to the bias labels. Based on this, we propose a novel approach to identify such pairs and learn a single linear map that transforms the features to perform post-hoc debiasing. The proposed approach achieves competitive performance across all datasets without access to bias attribute annotations or any LLMs.

AI.tldr: 揭示事后退偏（post hoc debiasing）方法对"偏置特征需被文本表达"的隐性依赖，并提出无需偏置标注与LLM的线性映射去偏方法。
AI.motivation: CLIP等大规模预训练模型常被当作冻结特征提取器，但其嵌入继承训练数据中的虚假相关（spurious correlation）。现有后处理去偏研究普遍保持骨干网络不变，作者发现这些方法虽机制各异，却都隐含要求"偏置特征可被识别并用文本表达"，该依赖在某些场景下带来未被察觉的性能损失。
AI.method: 实验表明：在UrbanCars（存在两个共现偏置属性）上，近期去偏方法在带偏置的冻结特征上甚至不如普通分类器，即使提供真实偏置身份也无法弥合差距。作者进一步观察到该模式在冻结几何中可直接观察：被冻结编码器放到最近的跨类训练样本对，几乎总共享同一虚假属性（与偏置类型无关，且无需偏置标签）。据此提出识别此类样本对并学习单一线性映射对特征进行事后退偏。
AI.result: 在全部数据集上取得有竞争力的性能，且无需偏置属性标注、也不依赖任何LLM。
AI.conclusion: 后处理去偏的瓶颈在于偏置的文本可表达性依赖；利用冻结特征空间中的跨类最近邻结构可无监督地定位虚假相关，并以单个线性变换实现有效去偏，为免标注、免LLM的去偏提供简洁方案。

title: Efficient Generative Image Compression with Quantized Latents Refinement
summary: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.

AI.tldr: GR-GIC：面向轻量生成式图像压缩的熵上下文引导潜变量精化与重组并行P-RVQ，在低码率下兼顾感知质量与低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有高质量生成式图像压缩（GIC）依赖预训练扩散模型、推理延迟高；轻量GIC虽快，但低码率下粗粒度确定性量化会把不同细节的编码器潜变量坍缩到同一点，细节不可恢复，感知质量下降。
AI.method: 提出GR-GIC。其一为Guided Refinement（GR）：用熵上下文引导潜变量精化，并配合自适应扰动做训练正则化；其二为重组投影残差向量量化（P-RVQ）：将残差更新等价重组为低维查表，暴露更大并行度、减少串行计算，从而加速推理。
AI.result: Kodak上相对OneDC，LPIPS/DISTS/PSNR/FID的BD-rate分别节省23.19%、37.71%、22.30%、22.14%；A100上编解码4.60/5.98 ms；重组P-RVQ在同FP32设置下平均加速3.14×；Jetson Orin NX上延迟与轻量GIC相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过潜变量精化与量化流程的并行重组，轻量GIC可在不牺牲速度的前提下显著提升低码率重构与感知质量，具备边缘部署可行性。但属于图像压缩方向，与物理AI/VLA/3D重建等核心领域无直接关联。

title: FlowVLA: Learning Flow-Aware Physical Completion for Quantitative Robotic Pouring
summary: During steady pouring, images and robot pose may remain nearly unchanged while transferred mass accumulates, making the return decision ambiguous for a whole-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy. We present FlowVLA, which separates motor generation from physical-completion estimation. A shared $\pi_{0.5}$ action expert learns approach, pour, and return with boundary-aware supervision. A target-independent estimator fuses visual, joint, wrist-wrench, and recurrent force-belief histories to maintain an estimate of transferred mass. The controller initiates return when this estimate plus predicted residual outflow reaches the requested mass. In coffee-pot/water experiments, FlowVLA achieves 13.1 g goal-balanced mean absolute error (MacroMAE), lower than all tested VLA baselines. Across all attempts, 53.7% both complete the task and finish within +/-10% of the requested mass. The same model interpolates to held-out 150/250-g targets without retraining. Independently trained models further evaluate the formulation in three additional container-fluid settings.

AI.tldr: FlowVLA将VLA策略的电机动作生成与"任务物理完成度估计"解耦：共享π0.5动作专家在边界感知监督下学习接近/倾倒/返回三类动作，独立的、与目标无关的估计器融合视觉、关节、腕部力/力矩及循环力信念历史来估计已transfer质量，当估计质量加上预测残余流出量达到目标值时触发返回。
