AI.motivation: 稳态倾倒期间图像与机器人位姿几乎不变，而被transfer质量持续累积，导致全任务VLA策略难以判断何时返回，返回时机模糊；同时，整任务VLA也缺乏对"物理完成度"的显式建模。
AI.method: 双流解耦架构：(1) 共享π0.5动作专家在边界感知监督下统一学习approach/pour/return；(2) 目标无关的completion estimator融合视觉、关节、腕部wrench与循环force-belief历史，在线估计transfer质量；(3) 控制器以估计质量+预测残余流出量≥用户指定质量作为返回触发准则。支持无需重训练的数值目标插值。
AI.result: 咖啡壶/水实验中MacroMAE=13.1 g，优于全部测试VLA基线；全部尝试中53.7%既完成任务又落在目标±10%误差带内；同一模型在未训练过的150/250 g目标上可零重训练插值；独立训练的多个模型在另外三种容器-流体场景中验证了该形式化框架。
AI.conclusion: 将"动作生成"与"物理完成度估计"分离，并以目标无关的估计器加残差流出预测驱动返回决策，是提升VLA在准静态、渐进式物理任务（如倾倒）中定量精度与目标泛化的有效途径，且可跨容器-流体场景迁移。

title: Forward-Only Learning for Shared-Kernel Wavelet Neural Networks without Backpropagation
summary: Backpropagation remains the dominant training paradigm, using backward gradients and local updates that can suffer from vanishing or exploding gradients in deep networks. Although the Forward-Forward algorithm avoids conventional backpropagation, it remains mainly local or layer-wise, motivating global whole-network learning using forward evaluations only. For shared-kernel wavelet neural networks, we therefore propose a CMA-ES-based global forward-only learning framework. We further introduce structure-aware parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment, factorizing the search into three subspaces. On BSDS500, our method reduces test MSE from 4.1783 to 4.0130 and improves PSNR from 42.621 to 42.787~dB over Adam/BP without backward propagation. Beyond these gains, training requires only 6 training-set coverages, compared with 1500 epochs for BP. Ablations show that structural decomposition and aligned credit assignment are more important than increasing population size, demonstrating the feasibility of whole-network forward-only learning for compact reconstruction networks. These results suggest a potential route toward forward-only optimization of compact reconstruction models for resource-constrained imaging and edge or near-sensor systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于CMA-ES的全局前向学习框架，用于共享核小波神经网络，通过结构感知参数分解与通道级信用分配替代反向传播。
AI.motivation: 反向传播依赖反向梯度与局部更新，深层网络中易出现梯度消失/爆炸；Forward-Forward算法虽避免反向传播，但仍主要停留在局部或逐层学习层面，缺乏全网级的前向学习能力，因此需要一种仅用前向评估的全局整网学习方案。
AI.method: 面向共享核小波神经网络，构建CMA-ES驱动的全局前向优化框架；引入结构感知的参数分解，将搜索空间因子化为三个子空间，并设计通道特定的信用分配机制，使群体搜索与网络结构及通道贡献对齐。
AI.result: 在BSDS500上，测试MSE由4.1783降至4.0130，PSNR由42.621 dB提升至42.787 dB（对比Adam/BP，且无反向传播）；训练仅需6次训练集覆盖，而BP需1500个epoch。消融表明结构分解与对齐的信用分配比增大种群规模更关键。
AI.conclusion: 验证了紧凑重建网络中全网前向学习的可行性，为资源受限成像及边缘/近传感器系统提供了一条无需反向传播的优化路径。

title: AirPlayground: Benchmarking Aerial Navigation across Diverse Reconstructed Environments
summary: Large-scale aerial resources provide a foundation for learning navigation across diverse environments. However, existing resources remain limited in providing (1) densely sampled flight demonstrations for learning different policy formulations and (2) broad environment coverage for standardized closed-loop evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce AirPlayground, a unified benchmark for training and evaluating aerial navigation policies across diverse environments. We first construct 94 photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) environments spanning indoor, urban outdoor, and vegetation settings, with aligned collision geometry. Building on these environments, we develop a scene-adaptive pipeline for automated expert flight collection, yielding 94K demonstrations and 46.5M synchronized observation-state-action samples at 50 Hz. We further provide an extensible API that supports training different policy formulations on this shared corpus and evaluating them under unified protocols in the corresponding environments. We benchmark seven baselines spanning four policy paradigms across three navigation settings in seen and unseen environments, and further examine scaling behavior with ACT. Scaling ACT's training corpus from 5 to 70 scenes raises median success rates on seen and unseen environments from 30.6% and 16.8% to 41.2% and 29.4%, respectively. Through this shared training and evaluation framework, AirPlayground supports analysis of how offline prediction errors relate to closed-loop outcomes. Our analyses highlight the roles of prediction errors, execution protocols, and scene interactions in closed-loop performance.

AI.tldr: AirPlayground：94个3DGS真实感环境+自动专家飞行采集（94K演示、46.5M同步样本@50Hz）构成的统一空中导航训练与评测基准，支持多范式策略在统一协议下的训练与闭环评测。
AI.motivation: 现有空中资源缺少(1)面向不同策略范式的稠密飞行演示，(2)覆盖广泛环境、可标准化闭环评测的基准，导致离线指标与闭环表现关系难以分析。
AI.method: 构建94个带对齐碰撞几何的真实感3DGS环境（室内/城市室外/植被）；提出场景自适应自动专家飞行采集流水线，产出94K演示、46.5M 50Hz同步观测-状态-动作样本；提供可扩展API，支持多种策略形式在共享语料上训练并在对应环境中按统一协议闭环评测；在3种导航设置、已见/未见环境上评测4类范式的7个基线，并考察ACT的训练规模扩展性。
AI.result: ACT训练场景数从5增至70，已见/未见环境中位成功率分别由30.6%/16.8%提升至41.2%/29.4%；分析揭示预测误差、执行协议与场景交互对闭环性能的作用，并关联离线预测误差与闭环结果。
AI.conclusion: AirPlayground提供共享训练-评测框架，可系统研究离线预测误差到闭环表现的传导机制，并暴露空中导航策略在未见环境泛化上的明显差距。

title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world. These preconditions and effects are environment-dependent and often not captured by MLLMs, making adaptation challenging. Yet existing approaches either require costly environment-specific training or rely on unstructured interaction experience that is difficult to reuse. Therefore, we introduce CausGround, a non-parametric causal interaction grounding framework that distills interaction experience into reusable action-centered causal knowledge. CausGround identifies action preconditions and effects and organizes them in a factorized world-state representation capturing object attributes and inter-object relations. At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in current observations to support backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for action selection and multi-step planning. We evaluate CausGround on simulated high-level planning, interaction reasoning, and real-world robot manipulation. On adapted VirtualHome and RoboCasa benchmarks, CausGround improves vision-based high-level planning across MLLM backbones, increasing average task success from 24.9% to 53.3% on VirtualHome and closed-loop planning success from 43.0% to 57.0% on RoboCasa. On SWITCH, average interaction reasoning accuracy increases from 25.8% to 31.9%, indicating improved action selection, recovery, and verification. Moreover, real-world experiments show that CausGround reasons backward from MLLM-interpreted goals to derive executable high-level action sequences for sequential manipulation. These results demonstrate that reusable action preconditions and effects support long-horizon embodied planning across diverse environments without parameter updates.

AI.tldr: CausGround：将交互经验蒸馏为可复用的、以动作为中心的前置条件与效果因果知识，用因子化世界状态表示组织，并在规划时把任务相关因果依赖接地到当前观测，实现后向推理前置条件+前向推理效果的多步规划；无需参数更新（非参数化）。
AI.motivation: MLLM具备推理能力，但缺乏对动作可执行性（前置条件）与动作影响世界（效果）的环境依赖知识；现有方案要么需昂贵的环境特定训练，要么依赖难以复用的非结构化交互经验。
AI.method: 非参数化因果交互接地框架：从交互经验中抽取动作前置条件与效果，组织为因子化世界状态表示（对象属性+对象间关系）；规划时把任务相关因果依赖接地到当前观测，用后向推理验证前置条件、前向推理预测效果，指导动作选择与多步规划。
AI.result: VirtualHome视觉高层规划平均成功率24.9%→53.3%；RoboCasa闭环规划43.0%→57.0%；SWITCH交互推理准确率25.8%→31.9%（动作选择、恢复、验证改善）；真实机器人实验显示可从MLLM解析的目标后向推导可执行高层动作序列，完成顺序操作。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的动作前置条件与效果知识可在不更新参数的前提下支撑跨环境的长时间域具身规划。

title: Reconstruction-Augmented Visuomotor Pre-Training of 3D-Grounded Bimanual Dexterity from RGB-Only Human Videos
summary: We present SpatialDex, a framework that learns 3D-grounded bimanual dexterity from RGB-only human videos through reconstruction-augmented visuomotor pre-training. The central idea is to learn human behavior together with its spatial context. From each video, we reconstruct the scene geometry and estimate the hand motion, align them at a shared video-level scale using the hand-size prior of 3D hand estimates. We retain the reconstructed geometry as both a policy input and a prediction target. The policy grounds the token grid of a pre-trained vision-language model in this geometry through gated residual fusion, is trained to predict future scene geometry alongside wrist and finger actions, and generates finger motion conditioned on the predicted trajectories of both wrists. Pre-trained on 1M human-video clips and fine-tuned with a small number of robot demonstrations, SpatialDex outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by 16.5 points on nine simulated dexterous tasks across two embodiments and by 38.3 points on six real-world bimanual dexterous tasks. Under a matched comparison, pre-training with reconstructed geometry improves success by 14.2 points over pre-training on hand motion alone.

AI.tldr: SpatialDex 仅用 RGB 人类视频，通过重建增强的视觉-运动预训练学习具身于 3D 几何的双臂灵巧操作策略。
AI.motivation: 人类视频缺乏空间几何与尺度一致的手部运动标注，难以直接迁移为机器人灵巧操作策略；作者希望让策略"同时学习行为与其空间上下文"。
AI.method: 从每个视频重构场景几何并估计手部运动，利用 3D 手部尺寸先验在视频级共享尺度上对齐两者；把重建几何同时作为策略输入与预测目标；策略通过门控残差融合将预训练 VLM 的 token 网格锚定到该几何上，在学习腕部与手指动作的同时预测未来场景几何，并以双腕预测轨迹为条件生成手指动作；在 1M 人类视频片段上预训练后用少量机器人示教微调。
AI.result: 在两种本体、九个仿真灵巧任务上比 SOTA 高 16.5 点，六个真实双臂灵巧任务上高 38.3 点；匹配对比下，几何重建预训练比仅手部运动预训练提升 14.2 点成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将场景几何重建作为输入与预测目标，可有效把人类视频中的空间上下文注入 VLM 策略，实现从人类视频到真实双臂灵巧操作的强迁移，且几何预训练目标本身是关键增益来源。

title: Sufficient and Necessary Causal Explanations for the Analysis of Autonomous Systems
summary: Understanding failures of autonomous systems is challenging, particularly when their behavior depends on black-box components such as neural networks. In this work, we make a distinction between two objectives of failure analysis: reproduction, which seeks to identify conditions sufficient to reproduce an observed failure, and avoidance, which seeks to identify the changes required to prevent it. Previous work on causal explanations of system failures is based on the concept of sufficient explanations and naturally supports reproduction. Nevertheless, we observe that it does not address the problem of avoiding the failure. In this paper, we introduce and formalize the concept of necessary explanations for system analysis as the correct formalism for failure avoidance. We place necessary explanations in the framework of actual causality and show that, together with sufficient explanations, they provide a unified causal framework for addressing both objectives of failure analysis. We present an efficient approximation algorithm for generating necessary explanations based on the notion of causal responsibility. We evaluate the efficiency of our approach across multiple environments. We demonstrate the practical utility of necessary explanations for failure avoidance through counterfactual generation and show that it outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 该文区分故障分析的"复现"与"避免"两个目标，提出"必要解释"（necessary explanations）概念，并将其纳入actual causality框架，与充分解释共同构成统一因果分析框架；基于causal responsibility给出高效近似算法，并通过反事实生成验证其在故障避免上的优越性。
AI.motivation: 自主系统依赖神经网络等黑盒组件，故障难以理解。既有因果解释工作基于"充分解释"，只能支持复现观测到的故障，无法回答"需要改变什么才能避免故障"这一问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义necessary explanations作为故障避免的正确形式化刻画；在actual causality框架下与sufficient explanations统一；基于causal responsibility提出高效近似生成算法；在多个环境评测效率，并以counterfactual generation展示实用性。
AI.result: 算法在多个环境中具备良好效率；基于必要解释的反事实生成在故障避免任务上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 充分解释与必要解释共同构成覆盖复现与避免两类目标的统一因果框架，为黑盒自主系统故障分析提供可行工具。

title: Post-hoc Epistemic Uncertainty for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies need to recognize gaps in their training knowledge to request useful demonstrations or assistance in new situations, especially when failures are costly. Disagreement within an ensemble of independently trained policies can guide these decisions, but requires training and running multiple policies. We propose post-hoc kernel-variance heads that estimate epistemic uncertainty from the embeddings of a single policy. Each head computes the conditional variance of a Gaussian process conditioned on embeddings from the training demonstrations. Fitting requires no regression targets or gradient updates and leaves the policy unchanged. In experiments with SmolVLA on LIBERO-10, the kernel variance heads perform competitively with two-policy ensemble scores in task-level correlation with task success, in demonstration acquisition during active learning, and in referral to a stronger supervisor policy as a proxy for human assistance. For SmolVLA, the head on the vision-language backbone reduces uncertainty-scoring time by up to approximately a factor of 50 compared with ensemble scores, while also substantially reducing setup costs. We also show that the established evaluation protocol on LIBERO-10 primarily rewards recognition of coverage differences between tasks, while execution variability weakens assessment of within-task rankings. Thus, controlled perturbations provide a complementary evaluation: modality-specific heads identify unfamiliar camera, instruction, or state inputs, while fused heads can detect unfamiliar combinations of individually familiar inputs. With a supervisor proxy trained on the evaluated perturbation families, the decoder head improves within-task referral over ensemble disagreement. These findings show that useful uncertainty estimates for adaptive robot learning can be obtained from a single policy.

AI.tldr: 提出 post-hoc kernel-variance head，用单一 VLA 策略的嵌入与训练示范计算高斯过程条件方差，无梯度训练即可估计认知不确定性，在 LIBERO-10 上与双策略集成分数相当，评分速度快约 50 倍。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略在新情境下需识别自身知识缺口以请求示范或协助（失败代价高）。集成分歧虽有信号但需训练并运行多个策略，成本高；希望从单一策略事后获得可用不确定性估计。
AI.method: 在 SmolVLA 的视觉-语言主干/解码器嵌入上训练 kernel-variance head：以训练示范嵌入为条件集，计算高斯过程条件方差作为认知不确定性；拟合无需回归目标、无梯度更新，不改动原策略。另设计受控扰动（相机、指令、状态、组合）作为互补评测协议。
AI.result: LIBERO-10 上任务级与成功率的相关性、主动学习中示范获取、以及向更强监督策略转介，均与双策略集成分数竞争力相当；视觉-语言主干头将不确定性评分时间缩短约 50 倍并大幅降低配置成本。分析显示 LIBERO-10 协议主要奖励任务间覆盖差异识别，执行变异削弱任务内排序评估；扰动实验中模态特异头识别陌异单模态输入，融合头检测“单模态熟悉但组合陌异”的情形，解码器头在任务内转介上优于集成分歧。
AI.conclusion: 单一策略即可获得对自适应机器人学习有用的不确定性估计，替代多策略集成，并揭示了现有评测协议的评估偏差。

title: Learning to Measure and Diagnose: A Clinical-Dictionary Radiomic Bottleneck Model for Thyroid Nodule Classification
summary: Thyroid ultrasound supports the assessment of nodule malignancy, but classification predictions often lack evidence linked to familiar clinical descriptions. Radiomics provides explicitly defined measurements that can support such explanations through a clinical dictionary. However, using these measurements as interpretable evidence requires reliable estimation from ultrasound images and preservation of measurement fidelity when optimizing classification performance. We propose a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model for thyroid nodule classification. Within this model, Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL) estimates measurements with balanced supervision across feature families. Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM) constructs a fixed bottleneck, followed by joint optimization of measurement estimation and classification under fidelity guidance. Decision evidence decomposition then traces feature contributions through a linear classifier and organizes them by clinical dictionary categories. Experiments on ThyroidXL and TN3K show competitive classification performance, while case studies illustrate feature contributions for benign and malignant nodules. These findings indicate interpretable classification with inspectable quantitative evidence informed by clinical knowledge. Code is available online.

AI.tldr: We propose a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model that estimates ultrasound measurements with family-balanced supervision and then tracks each one's contribution to the classification decision.
AI.motivation: Thyroid ultrasound nodule classification is black-box and lacks clinical justification. Radiomics offers explicitly defined measurements that could provide such justification, but doing so requires reliable estimation from ultrasound images and faithful preservation of those measurements while optimizing classification accuracy.
AI.method: A clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model with three components: (1) Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL), which estimates measurements with balanced supervision across feature families; (2) Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM), which constructs a fixed bottleneck and jointly optimizes measurement estimation and classification under fidelity guidance; (3) Decision evidence decomposition, which traces feature contributions through a linear classifier and organizes them by clinical dictionary categories.
AI.result: On ThyroidXL and TN3K, the model achieves competitive classification performance. Case studies visualize per-feature contributions for benign and malignant nodules, showing inspectable quantitative evidence.
AI.conclusion: A radiomic bottleneck tied to a clinical dictionary enables thyroid nodule classification whose decisions can be inspected through quantitative, clinically meaningful measurements, without sacrificing accuracy.

title: APED-CXR: Adaptive Privileged Evidence Distillation for Chest X-Ray Grounding with Image-Only Inference
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027
summary: Compact chest X-ray (CXR) models that localize findings suit deployment, but box annotations are limited and report-aware multimodal models are expensive at inference. We introduce APED-CXR, which distills report-informed spatial evidence from a frozen multimodal teacher into a student with 11.1M parameters that predicts diseases and boxes from shared evidence maps and requires the image alone at test time. During training, the teacher uses the radiograph, report, and queried class to evaluate regions proposed from the student's current evidence maps, and its support scores serve as training targets for the student's pooled evidence scores within these regions. Trained on PadChest and evaluated on held-out PadChest-GR, refreshing the student's proposals for teacher evaluation improves box-level localization F1 from 0.302 with fixed warm-up proposals to 0.338 (IoU >= 0.5; gain 0.036, 95% CI [0.022, 0.049]), while maintaining diagnostic AUC. This gain depends on the teacher checking current proposals: with equally many random boxes, a fixed dense box set, teacher-generated boxes, or report rules instead of the teacher, F1 stays near the fixed-proposal level, and proposals two refreshes old recover only part of the gain. On NIH ChestX-ray14, a secondary test set, box recall also rises from 0.423 to 0.447.

AI.tldr: APED-CXR 将冻结的多模态教师（图像+报告+类别查询）对候选区域的支撑分数蒸馏为学生模型（11.1M），学生仅用图像推理，同时输出疾病预测与证据图导出的检测框；训练中刷新学生当前提案供教师评估可提升框级定位。
AI.motivation: 紧凑型胸部X光模型需要具备病灶定位能力以便部署，但框标注稀缺，而报告感知的多模态模型推理代价高。目标是获得单图像输入即可同时诊断与定位的轻量学生模型。
AI.method: 教师为冻结的多模态模型，输入X光片、报告与查询类别，对由学生当前证据图生成的候选区域打分；教师对各区域的支持分数作为学生在该区域池化证据分数的监督目标。学生共享证据图完成疾病分类与框预测，测试时仅需图像。消融比较固定热身高提案、随机框、固定稠密框集、教师生成框、报告规则等替代方案。
AI.result: PadChest训练、留出PadChest-GR评估：刷新提案使框级定位F1从0.302提升至0.338（IoU≥0.5，+0.036，95% CI [0.022,0.049]），诊断AUC保持；随机框、固定稠密框、教师生成框或报告规则替代均回落到固定提案水平，滞后两轮的提案仅恢复部分增益。NIH ChestX-ray14上次要测试框召回从0.423升至0.447。
AI.conclusion: 以学生当前提案驱动的教师区域核查是获得定位增益的关键机制，而非简单增加监督密度；该方法在保持诊断性能的同时以极小参数量实现可部署的单模态定位。

title: LEAF-Mamba: Feature Adaptation and Fusion for Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis enables computational diagnosis and prognosis, but gigapixel images and limited annotations make slide-level learning challenging. Multiple instance learning addresses this task by aggregating patch representations from frozen pretrained encoders. Recently, Mamba has enabled efficient modeling of long patch sequences. However, task supervision alone does not explicitly constrain information recovery during feature adaptation, while Mamba couples local processing with long-range propagation rather than retaining separate representations for fusion. Motivated by these challenges, we introduce LEAF-Mamba, a framework that jointly addresses latent evidence adaptation and fusion for frozen-feature WSI analysis. A reconstruction-regularized adapter learns compact, task-specific representations while reconstructing the input features. Parallel Mamba and convolutional streams then capture long-range dependencies and sequence-local interactions, with an input-dependent gate modulating their joint representation before slide-level pooling. Experiments across feature extractors demonstrate improved average performance over strong MIL baselines in both diagnostic classification and survival prediction. Component analyses further support the contributions of adaptation and fusion. These findings highlight the value of jointly designing feature transformation and contextual aggregation to translate pretrained representations into effective slide-level predictions.

AI.tldr: LEAF-Mamba：在冻结特征的WSI分析中联合设计"潜证据适配"（重建正则化Adapter）与"融合"（并行Mamba+卷积流，输入依赖门控），再经slide级池化输出诊断/生存预测。
AI.motivation: WSI千兆像素、标注稀缺，MIL+Mamba虽高效建模长patch序列，但任务监督未显式约束特征适配中的信息保留，且Mamba将局部处理与长程传播耦合，缺乏可分离的表示用于融合。
AI.method: 框架包含：(1) 重建正则化适配器，学习紧致任务特定表示同时重建输入冻结特征；(2) 并行Mamba流与卷积流分别建模长程依赖与序列局部交互；(3) 输入依赖门控调制两路联合表示，随后进行slide级池化。多特征提取器下评测诊断分类与生存预测。
AI.result: 跨多种特征提取器，在诊断分类与生存预测上平均性能优于强MIL基线；消融支持适配与融合两部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 联合设计特征变换与上下文聚合，可有效将预训练表示转译为slide级预测，为计算病理MIL提供通用即插即用式改进。

title: OMAR: Open-World Multi-Attribute Reasoning for Scene-Conditioned Shelf Organization
summary: With the advent of foundation models, robots are increasingly capable of understanding and executing explicitly specified human tasks. Extending these capabilities to open-ended tasks, however, requires robots to infer appropriate actions from the observed scene. Household organization exemplifies this challenge, as robots must often act without detailed instructions, predefined object vocabularies, or known object-receptacle associations. While robots may follow instructions or learn organization preferences from demonstrations, inferring the latent organization of an occasionally changing scene and placing a novel object consistently with it remains challenging. We propose an open-world multi-attribute reasoning pipeline that grounds unknown objects across views and constructs an instance-level 3D scene graph for placement reasoning. First, a vision-language model proposes labels together with attributes such as content and packaging type, which are grounded through segmentation, depth, and multi-view association. Then, an LLM reasons over this representation to infer the latent shelf organization and rank scene-consistent object placements without explicitly user-provided preferences. The resulting placement rankings guide subsequent geometric and kinematic feasibility checks for execution. Our experimental evaluation shows that our approach leads to improved instance mapping and placement coherence over single-view language-grounding and geometry-only baselines, enabling autonomous placement of previously unseen objects without predefined object-receptacle mappings or class-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出开放世界多属性推理流水线：VLM 生成物体标签与内容/包装等属性，经分割、深度与多视角关联接地，构建实例级 3D 场景图，再由 LLM 推理隐含的货架组织规律并排序场景一致的放置位姿，最后做几何与运动学可行性校验。
AI.motivation: 家庭整理等开放式任务中，机器人需在无详细指令、无预定义物体词表、无已知物体-容器关联的条件下，从场景中推断隐含的组织规律，并将新物体一致地摆放；现有指令跟随或示范学习方法难以应对偶变场景的隐式组织。
AI.method: 1) VLM 输出标签与内容/包装类型等属性；2) 通过分割、深度估计与多视角关联实现跨视角未知物体接地；3) 构建实例级 3D 场景图表征；4) LLM 在该表征上推理潜在货架组织逻辑，为候选放置打分排序（无需用户偏好）；5) 排序结果驱动几何与运动学可行性检查后执行。
AI.result: 实验表明实例映射与放置一致性优于单视角语言接地与纯几何基线；可在无预定义物体-容器映射、无类别特定重训练的情况下自主放置未见物体。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将开放词表感知、3D 场景图与 LLM 常识推理结合，形成可执行的开放式物体放置流程，具备一定泛化性，但实验中未体现大规模真机部署与量化成功率细节。

title: UniRAP: Towards Unified Part-level Physical Affordance Reasoning and Actionable Perception
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Webpage: this https URL
summary: Vision-language perception has achieved impressive progress in aligning natural language with visual observations, yet grounding high-level semantics into part-level physical interaction remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose UniRAP, a unified model for inferring part-level physical affordances and mapping language instructions to actionable geometric representations. UniRAP formulates this problem as a conditional multimodal generation task, integrating visual inputs, textual instructions, and optional prompts into a shared spatiotemporal representation space through a unified interface token mechanism. To predict executable contact geometry, we introduce a Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD), which jointly performs object detection, part-level affordance segmentation, and 4-DoF interaction pose estimation by leveraging intermediate segmentation features. In addition, we propose a curriculum-based transfer training strategy that progressively adapts the model from general visual parsing to interaction-aware perception, improving data efficiency under limited textual annotations. Experiments show that UniRAP achieves state-of-the-art performance on referring expression segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction pose estimation, while maintaining strong spatiotemporal consistency in dynamic video scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UniRAP as a unified perception framework for language-guided physical manipulation.

AI.tldr: UniRAP 将部件级可供性与 4-DoF 交互位姿推理统一为一个条件多模态生成任务，用统一 token 接口 + UAD 解码器 + 课程式迁移训练，在指代分割、可供性接地和交互位姿估计上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言对齐模型能理解高层语义，但难以将其落地为部件级的物理交互几何（哪里可以抓、以什么位姿接触）。作者希望用一个统一框架把语言指令直接映射为可执行的操作几何。
AI.method: 提出 UniRAP：把问题建模为条件多模态生成，通过"统一接口 token"机制将视觉输入、文本指令和可选提示融合到共享时空表示空间；提出统一可供性解码器 UAD，复用中间分割特征联合完成目标检测、部件级可供性分割与 4-DoF 交互位姿估计；并设计课程式迁移训练策略，从通用视觉解析逐步过渡到交互感知，以缓解文本标注稀缺下的数据效率问题。
AI.result: 在指代表达分割、可供性接地和交互位姿估计三类任务上达到 SOTA，并在动态视频场景中保持较强的时空一致性。
AI.conclusion: UniRAP 可作为面向语言引导物理操作的统一感知框架，验证了将语义理解与部件级交互几何联合建模的可行性。摘要未披露真实机器人实验与代码开源情况，实际可操作性仍有待验证。

title: Key Findings for Small UAS for Post-Disaster Damage Assessment from the CURSE'26 Exercise
summary: The CLARKE building and road damage assessment AI classifier was incorporated into the Catastrophic Unmanned Remote Sensing Exercise (CURSE) 2026, which trained 23 small uncrewed aerial systems (sUAS) teams from state and local agencies and non-governmental organizations in Florida and Missouri on how to collect imagery for an incident command Remote Sensing Cell. Although CLARKE has been operationally deployed to two hurricanes (Debby and Helene), CURSE'26 presented an opportunity to evaluate the machine learning model with a larger set of never-before-seen orthomosaics. The results show that building and road damage assessment together ran in 3.5 minutes on average, and that building damage assessment achieved a Micro F1 of 0.834 with no manual adjustments to correct spatial misalignment and delivered that performance in both Florida and Missouri, demonstrating good geographic transfer. It also showed that road damage assessment performed poorly due to sensitivity to misalignment between road maps and the images, and to lighting and environmental conditions in an urban setting. The analysis of CURSE'26 presents five other findings of value to the sUAS community: that the use of sUAS and machine learning is now operationally normalized and accepted, sUAS teams in the field can improve classification accuracy by timing their flights, exercises are good operational tests but their value for evaluating learning models is less clear, edge computing is needed to overcome the wireless upload barrier, and the application of sUAS and AI to disaster response has ethical and legal ramifications for pilots and data managers.

AI.tldr: CLARKE 建筑/道路损毁评估 AI 分类器在 CURSE'26 演习中，对 23 支 sUAS 队伍在佛州与密苏里采集的全新正射影像进行评测：建筑评估 Micro F1 0.834 且无需空间对齐后处理，具备良好地理迁移；道路评估因路网配准与光照环境敏感表现差。
AI.motivation: CLARKE 已在两次飓风（Debby、Helene）中实战部署，但缺乏在大规模、未见过的正射影像上的模型泛化性验证；CURSE'26 提供了跨州、跨团队的新数据评测机会，并检验 sUAS+ML 在事件指挥遥感单元中的可操作性。
AI.method: 将 CLARKE 建筑与道路损毁分类模型嵌入 CURSE'26 演习流程，训练来自佛州与密苏里的 23 支州/地方机构及非政府组织 sUAS 队伍按遥感单元要求采集影像；对演习生成的全新正射镶嵌图直接推理（不做空间错位手工校正），统计推理耗时、Micro F1，并分析失败模式与社区层面的实践发现。
AI.result: 建筑+道路评估平均耗时 3.5 分钟；建筑损毁评估 Micro F1 = 0.834，且在佛州与密苏里两地一致，显示较好的地理迁移性；道路损毁评估表现差，主要受路网地图与影像间配准误差、城市光照与环境条件影响。另给出五项社区发现：sUAS+ML 已常态化被接受、飞行时段安排可提升精度、演习适合操作测试但对模型评测价值有限、需边缘计算突破无线回传瓶颈、以及飞行员与数据管理者的伦理法律问题。
AI.conclusion: CLARKE 的建筑损毁分类在面向真实应急流程的多源、跨州新数据上具备可用精度与零后处理鲁棒性；道路损毁任务仍需解决地图-影像配准与辐射条件鲁棒性问题；论文以操作演习形式为 sUAS 灾害响应的工程化落地提供了实证与部署经验。

title: JointLight: Human-Centric Video Relighting with Asynchronous RGB-Irradiance Joint Modeling
summary: Understanding and modeling light transport in human-centric scenes is a longstanding challenge. While recent progress in diffusion models has boosted research in relighting, precise illumination control still lags, primarily due to the scarcity of diverse, high-quality, precisely labeled video relighting datasets. Existing end-to-end relighting approaches model light transport implicitly through neural networks, which substantially complicates controllability. In contrast, some works resort to path-traced irradiance cues as an explicit blueprint for light transport. However, such constructed irradiance cues are prone to artifacts and hinder generative quality when directly used as control signals. With the key observation that noise corruption removes high-frequency artifacts and preserves low-frequency light transport, we introduce an asynchronous joint-modeling paradigm that facilitates fine-grained illumination control. During two-stage training, we force the model to jointly denoise RGB and ground-truth irradiance frames with separate timesteps scheduling. A domain matching strategy is applied to the second stage to bridge the domain gap between irradiance cues and ground-truth irradiance maps. At inference time, we introduce an asynchronous hijacked generation pipeline that facilitates flexible illumination control. For training data, we develop a multi-illumination high-quality synthetic video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model exhibits robust generalization to real- world scenarios and outperforms prior approaches in both lighting fidelity and generative quality. The code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出异步联合建模范式：两阶段训练中让扩散模型以不同时间步同时去噪RGB与GT辐照度帧，并以域匹配策略弥合辐照度线索与GT之间的域差；推理时用"异步劫持"生成管线实现细粒度光照控制，并发布基于游戏引擎构建的多光照配对辐照度视频数据集。
AI.motivation: 人体场景重光照的精确光照控制受限于高质量、精确标注的视频重光照数据集稀缺；端到端方法隐式建模光传输导致可控性差，而直接用路径追踪辐照度线索作为控制信号会引入伪影、降低生成质量。
AI.method: 关键观察：噪声破坏可去除高频伪影而保留低频光传输。据此设计两阶段训练：联合去噪RGB帧与GT辐照度帧，采用分离的时间步调度；第二阶段引入域匹配以对齐辐照度线索与GT辐照度的分布。推理阶段提出异步劫持生成管线以支持灵活的光照操作。训练数据为游戏引擎渲染的多光照高质量合成视频数据集，含配对辐照度图。
AI.result: 仅在该合成数据集上训练，模型即展现对真实场景的稳健泛化能力，并在光照保真度与生成质量两方面优于既有方法；代码与数据集将公开。
AI.conclusion: 以"噪声去伪影、保留低频光传输"为切入点，将显式辐照度线索与扩散生成异步结合，为人体视频重光照提供了兼顾可控性与生成质量的方案，合成数据到真实场景的迁移亦被验证有效。

title: Open-Vocabulary Models and Label Propagation for Uncertainty-aware Pseudo-Labeling of Object Detection Datasets
summary: Object detection models rely on large-scale annotated datasets that require substantial manual annotation effort. The labeling costs further increase when annotation uncertainty is captured through soft labels, as multiple annotations must be collected for each object. We address this challenge by introducing a semi-supervised framework for the uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets. Our approach leverages open-vocabulary object detectors to generate region proposals and semantically meaningful object representations. Based on these representations, we construct an object-level similarity graph and propagate probabilistic label information. Our framework assigns soft labels to previously unlabeled objects, quantifying both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. We evaluate our method on four object detection benchmarks with soft-label annotations and demonstrate that high-quality annotations can be obtained with only a small fraction of manually labeled objects. Furthermore, we show that detectors trained on semi-automatically annotated data achieve performance comparable to models trained on fully manually annotated data. We achieve state-of-the-art downstream detection performance for the task of semi-supervised object detection on the COCO dataset, with 40.5% AP virtually matching the performance of the model trained on fully manually constructed data (40.9%) at only 1% of labeling costs. These results highlight the potential of open-vocabulary models and graph-based label propagation for efficient, accurate and uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling.

AI.tldr: A semi-supervised framework uses open-vocabulary detectors to generate region proposals and object-level embeddings, builds a similarity graph, and propagates probabilistic soft labels (aleatoric + epistemic uncertainty) to unlabeled objects; achieves 40.5% AP on COCO with only 1% labeled data, nearly matching 40.9% AP from full manual annotation.
AI.motivation: Soft-label (uncertainty-aware) object detection annotation requires multiple annotations per object, making dataset construction costs prohibitive; the authors aim to reduce manual labeling while preserving annotation quality and uncertainty information.
AI.method: Two-stage pipeline: (1) an open-vocabulary object detector produces region proposals plus semantically meaningful object representations; (2) an object-level similarity graph is constructed over these embeddings, and probabilistic label information is propagated across the graph to assign soft labels to unlabeled objects, jointly quantifying aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. Evaluated on four soft-label detection benchmarks and on semi-supervised object detection (COCO).
AI.result: High-quality soft annotations obtainable from a small fraction of manually labeled objects; detectors trained on semi-automatic annotations match those trained on fully manual data; on COCO SSOD, 40.5% AP vs. 40.9% AP for fully manually annotated training at only 1% of labeling cost — state-of-the-art for this setting.
AI.conclusion: Combining open-vocabulary detectors with graph-based label propagation is an effective, cost-efficient route to uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling; the approach shifts annotation effort rather than sacrificing downstream detection performance. Applicability is chiefly in dataset construction/labeling infrastructure rather than embodied perception or 3D/robot learning.

title: Compositionality with Primitives: A Unified View from Euclidean to Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027 Main Conference, 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables
summary: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel combinations of previously observed objects and attributes. Prior work showed that large-scale vision-language models encode decomposable semantic structures that can be recomposed to enable generalization. The Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework formalizes this by identifying directions in the tangent space at the Frechet mean of the embedding distribution, which encode primitive visual concepts. Unseen attribute-object compositions can be synthesized through vector addition of these primitives. We revisit the assumption that compositional generalization requires explicit attribute-object pair re-composition. By means of new compositional scoring functions and extensive evaluations, we show that directly using the decomposed primitives suffices for recognizing unseen compositions. In that, we gain insights on how the geometry of the embedding manifold (Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic) and dataset structure affect compositional reasoning. Across models (CLIP, DINOv2, MERU, HyCoCLIP), we show that compositional structure consistently emerges as primitive representations, enabling inference on CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos50K, Clothing16K) and group robustness on Waterbirds and CelebA. Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 新提出的组合评分函数表明,在CLIP/DINOv2/MERU/HyCoCLIP等模型的嵌入流形上,分解得到的原始概念向量本身即可直接用于零样本识别未见属性-物体组合,无需显式的配对重组步骤;并分析了欧氏/球面/双曲几何与数据集结构的影响。
AI.motivation: 既有Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE)框架假定组合泛化必须通过属性-物体对的显式向量相加重组来实现。作者质疑这一假设,希望验证分解后的原始表示是否已足够支持组合推理,并厘清嵌入流形几何与数据分布对组合泛化的作用。
AI.method: 以Frechet均值处切空间方向表征原始视觉概念,设计新的组合评分函数(compositpositional scoring functions),在欧氏、球面与双曲三类嵌入流形上对多个视觉语言模型(CLIP、DINOv2、MERU、HyCoCLIP)做系统性消融与对比评估。
AI.result: 直接在原始分解表示上推理即可匹配或超越显式重组方案;在MIT-States、VAW-CZSL、UT-Zappos50K、Clothing16K上取得CZSL基准结果,并迁移到Waterbirds、CelebA的群体鲁棒性任务;不同流形几何与数据集结构对组合推理影响显著。
AI.conclusion: 组合结构在大规模视觉语言模型中普遍以原始表示形式涌现,显式的属性-物体重组并非组合泛化的必要条件;流形几何选择应依据数据集结构而定。

title: GuidedSAM-Plume: An Expert-Guided Segmentation Framework for Volcanic Plumes
summary: Quantitative analysis of environmental phenomena increasingly relies on image-based measurements. In volcanology, the geometric characterization of volcanic plumes and clouds from RGB images remains hindered by the scarcity of dedicated segmentation solutions and partially handcrafted annotations remain widely prevalent. We present GuidedSAM-Plume, an open-source expert-guided framework tailored for the interactive segmentation of volcanic plumes and clouds. It leverages the zero-shot, spatial prompt-based capabilities of SAM2. The framework was thoroughly validated on a challenging dataset through dedicated segmentation metrics and field-relevant volcanological descriptors. From minimal user inputs, it is able to significantly increase performance compared to fully automatic dedicated solutions while preserving the reliability of derived volcanological parameters. The absence of retraining requirements lowers adoption barriers within the volcanological community, and the framework's demonstrated suitability for complex, diffuse plume-shaped phenomena extends its applicability to broader environmental science domains. The re-annotated dataset, produced under the guidance of expert volcanologists within the proposed framework, ultimately yields a more standardized release. The framework and accompanying dataset are made available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GuidedSAM-Plume: an open-source expert-in-the-loop framework using SAM2's zero-shot spatial-prompt segmentation for interactive segmentation of volcanic plumes and clouds from RGB imagery, validated with segmentation metrics and volcanological descriptors, plus a re-annotated standardized dataset.
AI.motivation: Volcanological geometric characterization of plumes/clouds from RGB images lacks dedicated segmentation solutions, and annotations are largely handcrafted/partially manual, limiting quantitative environmental analysis.
AI.method: Build on SAM2's zero-shot, spatial prompt-based capability; introduce expert-guided interactive prompting workflow; no retraining; evaluation via dedicated segmentation metrics and field-relevant volcanological descriptors; dataset re-annotation under expert guidance.
AI.result: With minimal user inputs, significantly outperforms fully automatic dedicated solutions while preserving reliability of derived volcanological parameters; re-annotated dataset yields a more standardized release; framework and dataset open-sourced.
AI.conclusion: Retraining-free expert-guided SAM2 prompting lowers adoption barriers and generalizes to complex diffuse plume-shaped phenomena in broader environmental science.

title: Early versus Late RGB-Infrared Fusion for Counter-UAV Detection: A Comparative Study
comment: This version differs from the article published in IEEE Access. It includes revisions requested by the reviewers during the final review round that could not be incorporated into the published version
summary: This paper presents a novel strategy for UAV detection through visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) fusion, in order to improve accuracy and precision in harsh environments and weather conditions. In this research, two opposite approaches have been studied and implemented: the first concerns image-level (early) fusion, which merges two different spectra into a single image to which one detector is applied. On the other hand, the second approach, called decision-level (late) fusion, focuses on blending together the output bounding boxes of two different detection pipelines, aiming to create a common result that can be applied to both spectra simultaneously. Both strategies have been extensively tested in a dedicated environment, which included alternating low and high brightness scenes, different backgrounds (sky and ground), distances (5, 25 and 60 m), altitudes and zoom levels (1X, 2X and 4X). These tests allowed for the assessment of actual detection capabilities and system reliability in real-world applications. Furthermore, the two fusion strategies were evaluated and compared over a set of aligned images in order to highlight the better approach of the two. The results indicate that early fusion achieves better raw performance, since it incorporates the thermal information from the beginning of the training process. However, late fusion presents an innovative and useful detection workflow that can be applied in cases of sensor or frame misalignment. Both positive and negative aspects have also been pointed out and discussed, in order to give a more comprehensive overview. Finally, the paper outlines implementation considerations and practical recommendations based on operational priorities. Overall, the findings contribute to the research in RGB-IR fusion modalities, with the goal of enhancing UAV detection capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该文在可见光(RGB)与红外(IR)对齐图像上系统比较无人机检测的两类融合范式:图像级(早期)融合与决策级(后期)融合,在明暗交替、天空/地面背景、5/25/60 m距离、不同高度与1X/2X/4X变焦条件下评测。结论为早期融合原始精度更优,后期融合在传感器或帧未对齐时更具鲁棒性与实用价值。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气与光照条件下单一模态(可见光或红外)检测可靠性不足,需明确RGB-IR融合在何时、以何种层级进行才能兼顾精度与工程鲁棒性;作者希望给出面向实际部署的选型依据。
AI.method: 构建专用测试环境,分别在图像级融合(两光谱合成单图后接单一检测器)与决策级融合(两路检测框融合输出统一结果)两条流水线上实现并进行大规模对比实验;测试变量包括亮度(高/低)、背景(天空/地面)、距离(5/25/60 m)、高度与变焦(1X/2X/4X);在两路已对齐图像集上做定量评估,并额外讨论未对齐情形下的融合行为。
AI.result: 早期融合取得更优的原始检测性能,原因在于热信息自训练初始即参与特征学习;后期融合精度略逊,但提供了一套可应对传感器错位与帧不同步的创新工作流。
AI.conclusion: 两种融合策略各有取舍:精度优先选早期融合,鲁棒性与异构/未对齐传感器部署优先选后期融合;论文进一步给出实现考量与按操作优先级取舍的实践建议,丰富了RGB-IR融合用于无人机检测的研究。

title: Robot Generalization Beyond Volume: The Diversity Path via Zero-Shot Capabilities
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables, including supplementary material
summary: General-purpose robots must handle tasks, objects and environments they were never trained on, yet zero-shot generalization remains one of the least solved problems in physical AI. In digital AI, zero-shot capability grew with the volume and, above all, the diversity of training data, much of it sourced from the crowd. Robotics instead relies on paid collection by a few well-funded teams, which yields volume without diversity. We formulate zero-shot generalization in physical AI as coverage of the deployment distribution, and show that more samples from the same collectors shrink the unseen region only slowly, while each new contributor can extend it. Building on this and on zero-shot learning, we propose a shared latent space for robot actions that combines multi-modal alignment, generative augmentation, and noisy-label learning. As a scalable source of diverse data, we propose a community of developers building applications on one standard, approachable robot, Origami. We close with a testable hypothesis and an evaluation protocol relating real-robot zero-shot success to the diversity of contributed data.

AI.tldr: 将零样本泛化重新表述为"对部署分布的覆盖"，论证数据多样性（贡献者数量）比数据量更关键，并据此提出共享动作隐空间方法（多模态对齐+生成式增广+噪声标签学习）与社区化低成本机器人 Origami 的数据众包方案。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域依赖少数资金充裕团队付费采集数据，得到的是"体量"而非"多样性"，导致零样本泛化长期未解；数字AI的零样本能力主要来自众包的多样化数据。作者希望解释并解决这一结构性瓶颈。
AI.method: 以"部署分布覆盖"为形式化框架，分析采样来源多样性对未见区域收缩速率的影响；方法上构建机器人动作的共享隐空间，融合多模态对齐、生成式数据增广、噪声标签学习；系统层面提出基于统一易用机器人 Origami 的开发者社区作为可扩展的多样数据来源。
AI.result: 摘要为立场/展望型论文：给出理论直觉（同源采集者增加样本仅缓慢缩小未见区域，新贡献者可扩展覆盖），并提出与数据多样性关联真实机器人零样本成功率的可检验假设与评测协议，未报告实际实验数值。
AI.conclusion: 零样本泛化的关键在于数据来源的多样性而非单纯规模，众包式社区数据+共享动作隐空间是可行路径；论文以假设与评测协议收尾，属于议程设定型工作，需后续实证验证。

title: Revealing Hidden Failure Modes in Chest X-ray Classification via Spectral Domain Analysis
summary: Deep learning models for chest X-ray anomaly detection remain vulnerable to subtle distributional shifts (e.g., acquisition technique, patient-related factors, and preprocessing). Traditional error analysis often relies on semantic metadata or model embeddings, which can mask low-level signal variations that degrade performance. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework for automated failure mode discovery using spectral analysis. We project images into the frequency domain and extract a compact profile summarizing the distribution of signal energy across frequency bands. By performing unsupervised clustering on these spectral profiles, we demonstrate that model failures are not randomly distributed, but are strongly concentrated within specific spectral clusters. This method effectively isolates "blind spots", enabling the prediction of model reliability and the discovery of performance-degrading data slices without requiring ground-truth failure annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出以数据为中心、基于频谱分析的自动化失效模式发现框架：将胸片投影到频域提取紧凑频谱能量分布剖面，无监督聚类后证明模型错误强烈集中在特定频谱簇，可在无失败标注下预测可靠性并定位性能退化数据切片。
AI.motivation: 胸片异常检测的深度学习模型对低层分布偏移（采集技术、患者因素、预处理）敏感，而传统基于语义元数据或模型嵌入的错误分析会掩盖这些导致性能下降的低层信号变化，缺乏直接、无需标注的失效模式发现手段。
AI.method: 数据为中心框架：图像变换至频域，提取跨频带信号能量分布的紧凑频谱剖面；对频谱剖面向量进行无监督聚类，将模型失败关联到具体频谱簇，从而隔离"盲区"并发现性能退化数据切片。
AI.result: 实验显示模型失败并非随机分布，而是高度集中于特定频谱簇；该方法可在不使用真实失败标注的前提下预测模型可靠性并识别导致性能退化的数据切片。
AI.conclusion: 频谱剖面聚类是一种有效的无标注失效模式诊断工具，可作为语义元数据与嵌入分析的补充，为医学影像模型的可靠性评估与数据切片发现提供可操作路径。

title: Spacetime Splines for Adaptive Robot Motions
summary: Movement primitives commonly represent robot mo- tions through basis functions indexed by time or phase. Inspired by spacetime representations employed in physics, we propose a spline-based formulation in which spatial geometry and temporal progression are represented within a common set of continuous variables. The proposed method jointly estimates a shared Bezier curve, while allowing spatial and temporal model complexity to be adapted independently (e.g., demonstration-specific phase modulation). As use case, we consider an alternating optimization process that simultaneously estimates path intervals observed in partial demonstrations. Simulation experiments demonstrate accurate joint recovery, refinement through modifications in model complexity and continuity, and improved robustness to variance in the demonstration set. Finally, we demonstrate online retiming and synchronization capabilities in a patient-turning task assisted by a robot, evaluated with a physical manikin.

AI.tldr: 提出基于样条的时空统一运动基元:用共享Bezier曲线同时表征空间几何与时间进程,空间与时间复杂度可独立自适应,并通过交替优化从部分演示中联合估计路径区间。
AI.motivation: 经典运动基元(如DMP、ProMP)依赖以时间或相位索引的基函数,空间与时间耦合,难以让模型复杂度按演示单独调节,也难处理仅含部分轨迹片段的演示。
AI.method: 受物理时空表示启发,将轨迹写成同一组连续变量上的样条(Bezier)形式,空间控制点与时间/相位映射解耦;采用交替优化联合估计共享曲线与各演示对应的路径区间(时间参数化),并支持逐演示的相位调制。
AI.result: 仿真显示可准确恢复联合估计问题中的曲线与区间;通过调整模型复杂度与连续性可精化表示;对演示集方差具有更好鲁棒性;在机器人辅助翻身(人体模型)任务中实现在线重定时与多机器人/人机同步。
AI.conclusion: 样条式时空联合表示为运动基元提供更简洁的参数化,支持空间/时间复杂度独立调节与部分演示学习;作为轨迹级技能表示与重定时工具有效,但尚未与视觉或端到端策略学习结合。

title: RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027; under review
summary: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: RangeNav: 183k参数的全景LiDAR距离图像编码器，纯合成数据预训练，用于密集人群/杂乱场景下的360°移动机器人导航，仿真与真实四足机器人零样本部署均显著优于仅重建基线。
AI.motivation: 密集人群与杂乱环境中运行的自主移动机器人需要360°感知以应对周围危险；全景LiDAR虽提供全向覆盖，但RL在稀疏奖励下样本效率低，而现有3D预训练点云编码器内存开销过大，难以支撑大规模并行RL仿真。
AI.method: 提出紧凑的距离图像编码器（183k参数）：采用各向异性卷积与循环填充处理距离图像的极端长宽比与方位角接缝；在纯合成数据上以导航对齐目标预训练，联合距离重建、语义分割与BEV预测，随后冻结编码器用于策略学习。
AI.result: 仿真中，相比仅重建基线，加入语义与BEV监督使成功率在程序化生成训练环境与分布外真实感测试环境分别平均提升32.03pp与23.73pp；在Unitree B2-W四足机器人上零样本真机部署，可在密集人群、低光照与施工区域中稳健导航，而有限视场深度策略表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 轻量化的导航对齐自监督表征加上全景距离图像，可在低算力下获得样本高效的RL导航策略，并具备良好的仿真到真实零样本迁移能力；轻量编码器设计值得在并行仿真规模化的具身导航中推广。

title: How Do DiTs Denoise? An Aggregator-Predictor View of Attention and MLPs
summary: How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.

AI.tldr: 将 DiT 解释为“聚合器—预测器”：注意力承担输入自适应的上下文聚合，MLP 承担逐 token 的 patch 预测，并在 GMRF 理论框架与 CelebA64 实验上验证该分工。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer 已成为主流生成骨架，但其如何表征图像内容、如何复用规则以实现泛化缺乏组件级（分析粒度到 QK/VO/MLP）的解释。作者希望为注意力与 MLP 提供明确的功能角色，从而指导架构设计与微调。
AI.method: 在 GMRF 先验下证明全局 Bayes 去噪器可仅用部分上下文 patch 逼近且误差随上下文半径指数衰减；进一步证明在足够信息量的聚合下，逐 patch 线性去噪器可恢复经验局部去噪器。据此把 AdaLN 调制的注意力解释为输入与噪声相关的聚合器，MLP 解释为学习的 key-value 逐 token 预测器。实验包括：真实图像 DiT 的噪声相关去噪上下文与注意力质量展宽模式分析；CelebA64 上用共享记忆 patch 预测器替换 DiT MLP 的受控实验；跨数据集组件移植（QK / VO / MLP）。
AI.result: 理论上给出局部上下文近似的指数收敛保证；真实图像 DiT 表现出与 GMRF 解析解相似的噪声依赖上下文及相应的注意力展宽趋势；共享记忆 MLP 替代方案在去噪与生成上具竞争力；跨数据集移植显示 QK（空间加权）、VO（特征搬运）、MLP（patch 预测）的兼容性模式与所提角色一致。
AI.conclusion: 给出 DiT 去噪的组件级解释框架，为架构特异的微调与可控干预（如针对性替换或改造 MLP/QK）提供依据；局限在于主要证据来自合成先验分析与小规模图像设定。

title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

AI.tldr: GeoMem-VLA 将冻结几何基础模型通过几何流匹配监督得到的 GeoPlan token 与观测记忆融合，作为持久任务几何表征驱动动作生成，推理时无需 3D 教师或重建。
AI.motivation: 主流 VLA 依赖 2D 当前观测或多需额外 3D 输入；逐帧独立推断的几何信息被丢弃而未累积为持久任务表征。作者主张动作生成只需可持续更新的紧凑、任务相关几何抽象，而非每步完整可渲染重建。
AI.method: 用冻结几何基础模型对可学习 GeoPlan token 施加点图与未来末端轨迹上的几何流匹配监督，不直接对齐 VLM 原生视觉嵌入与教师特征空间；token 与观测表征记忆集成，历史信息检索、自适应融合并保留事件帧；推理时仅检索并融合历史表征预测动作。
AI.result: 经基准特定下游适配后 LIBERO 平均成功率 98.9%，RoboTwin 干净/随机 91.10%/91.24%，五个真实任务平均 78.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将 3D 场景理解内化并记忆化是机器人控制的有效路径；但对比基线、真实任务细节与消融未在摘要中给出。

title: Stochastic Nonlinearities Improve Uncertainty Estimation
comment: Accepted to the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. 33 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important across visual recognition tasks, providing information about the confidence and reliability of model predictions. Many uncertainty estimation methods obtain predictive diversity through mechanisms that can suppress intermediate features, perturb the input, or require substantial additional computation. Stochastic activation functions, where network units randomly select between multiple nonlinearities during a forward pass, have previously been used to improve optimization behavior, mitigate limitations of fixed ReLU activations, and increase output diversity. In this work, we reframe stochastic activation switching as a lightweight mechanism for uncertainty estimation. The proposed method samples between nonlinear activation functions, inducing predictive diversity while keeping intermediate feature pathways active. This enables uncertainty estimation from a single trained model without the training cost of ensembles, task-specific uncertainty heads, or architectural redesign. We evaluate the proposed approach across classification, semantic segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection using convolutional and transformer-based architectures on diverse datasets. Across these settings, stochastic activation switching improves uncertainty quality while preserving competitive primary-task performance, showing that stochastic nonlinearities provide an effective and information-preserving source of predictive variation for visual recognition.

AI.tldr: 将"随机激活函数切换"框定为一种轻量级不确定性估计机制：在前向传播中于多个非线性函数间采样，在不抑制中间特征通路的前提下诱导预测多样性，从单一训练模型即可估计不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性估计方法依赖抑制中间特征、扰动输入或大量额外计算（如深度集成、不确定性专用头、架构改造），成本高且可能损失信息。作者希望利用已有的随机激活思想，将其重新定位为一种信息保持、低成本的预测多样性来源。
AI.method: 在训练好的网络中，于前向计算时对每个单元的激活函数进行随机采样（在多个非线性之间切换），保持特征通路活跃以获得多样本预测分布；由该分布直接计算不确定性，无需集成训练、任务专属不确定性头或结构重设计。在CNN与Transformer架构上验证于分类、语义分割、OOD检测等任务。
AI.result: 跨分类、语义分割与OOD检测，在卷积与Transformer架构及多数据集上，随机激活切换提升了不确定性质量，同时主任务性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 随机非线性可作为一种有效且信息保持的预测变异来源，为视觉识别提供单模型、低开销的不确定性估计方案。但评测限于通用视觉任务，未涉及具身/机器人场景与真实部署证据。

title: Expandable Modality Experts for Medical Vision-Language Learning
comment: 11 pages (main text), 42 pages (supplementary material), 2 main figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Learning across medical imaging modalities requires making use of images without paired text and accommodating new domains while retaining existing representations. We propose a medical vision-language technique built around an expandable bank of modality experts. Its Multiway Transformer combines shared visual computation with deterministically routed feed-forward experts and a separate text pathway. A modality-aware visual tokenizer supplies targets for masked pretraining on 19.4 million unpaired image rows across seven modalities; contrastive alignment then uses 3.23 million image-text pairs. Additional fundus and optical coherence tomography experts learn from paired data while the original image and text embedding paths remain frozen. With a ViT-Large backbone, the proposed technique achieves the best or tied-best result in 24 of 25 benchmark settings across nine modalities: 10 of 11 zero-shot classification benchmarks, all 10 linear probes, and all four retrieval benchmarks. Mean balanced accuracy is 0.674 for zero-shot classification and 0.856 for linear probing, and mean bidirectional retrieval recall is 20.70%. A separate three-seed sequential experiment with matched adaptation data yields fundus and OCT retrieval gains of 14.95 and 9.31 percentage points, with no measured loss on preceding fundus or pathology tasks. The preservation argument requires unchanged existing computation paths and inference conditions, and feature-identity checks verify retention on evaluated inputs. The proposed technique provides a modular approach to learning and expanding medical vision-language representations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可扩展“模态专家库”的医学视觉-语言模型：Multiway Transformer共享视觉计算、确定性路由的FFN专家与独立文本通路，先用模态感知分词器在19.4M无配对图像上做掩码预训练，再用3.23M图文对做对比对齐，并可冻结原有路径增设眼底/OCT专家。
AI.motivation: 医学影像跨模态学习既需要利用无配对文本的图像数据，又需要在引入新模态时保留已有表征；现有方法难以在可扩展性与旧任务保持之间兼顾。
AI.method: ViT-Large骨干；Multiway Transformer含共享视觉注意力、确定性地路由到模态专家的FFN，以及独立文本通路；模态感知视觉分词器提供掩码建模目标，在7个模态19.4M无配对图像上预训练，再用3.23M图文对做对比对齐；扩展时冻结原图像与文本嵌入路径，仅新增眼底与OCT专家（含三随机种子顺序实验、匹配适配数据），并用特征恒等性检查验证保留。
AI.result: 25项基准中24项最优或并列最优（9个模态）：11个零样本分类中10项、全部10个线性探针、全部4个检索基准最佳；零样本平均平衡准确率0.674，线性探针0.856，双向检索平均召回20.70%；顺序适配实验眼底与OCT检索分别提升14.95与9.31个百分点，先前眼底与病理任务无损失。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供一种模块化、可扩展的医学视觉-语言表征学习与扩张范式，但“无遗忘”结论依赖运算路径与推理条件不变及特征恒等性，属工程性保持而非普遍性持续学习保证。

title: HuMiT: Low-Latency Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation via Compact Reference Tracking
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Real-time whole-body humanoid teleoperation remains challenging due to the computational latency introduced by optimization-based retargeting pipelines and future-frame conditioning. Existing motion tracking policies typically require dense reference targets including full joint positions, body-part transformations, and even future frames, which tightly couples the controller to expensive upstream modules. In this work, we present HuMiT, a whole-body teleoperation system built on a unified tracking policy that requires only a compact reference target, consisting of root height, root velocity, and the SE(3) poses of four sparse keypoints at the current frame, yet achieves competitive tracking fidelity compared to methods relying on more diverse reference states including complete joint positions, dense body-part transformations, and even future frames. Experiments show that our policy achieves a communication-to-inference latency of $\sim$20 ms measured between headset streaming and policy output and a video-based optical flow latency of 65 ms (median) across different motion types. We validate the system on a Unitree G1 humanoid, showcasing split-second reactive responses such as catching a tossed ball, as well as coordinated loco-manipulation capabilities. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: HuMiT：一种仅需紧凑参考目标（根高度、根速度、4个稀疏关键点SE(3)位姿，当前帧）的统一全身人形机器人遥操作跟踪策略，端到端延迟约20ms，可实现接球等秒级反应动作。
AI.motivation: 优化式重定向管线与未来帧条件化带来计算延迟，且现有跟踪策略依赖稠密参考目标（全关节位置、密集部件变换、未来帧），使控制器与昂贵上游模块强耦合，难以实时全身遥操作。
AI.method: 提出统一全身跟踪策略，将参考目标压缩为根高度、根速度与4个稀疏关键点的SE(3)位姿（仅当前帧），解耦控制器与上游重定向模块；结合VR头显流式输入与基于视频的光流估计。
AI.result: 头显流式到策略输出延迟约20ms，光流延迟中位数65ms；在Unitree G1上完成抛球接取等秒级反应动作及协调的移动操作，跟踪精度与使用稠密参考（含未来帧）的方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑稀疏参考目标足以支撑高质量实时全身遥操作，显著降低系统延迟与模块耦合，为人形机器人低延迟反应式遥操作提供可行方案。

title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages. Existing brain MRI-report resources are still dominated by English reports, translated clinical text, or datasets adapted from task-specific imaging benchmarks, leaving routine low-resource clinical reporting and heterogeneous multi-sequence MRI protocols insufficiently represented. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViBMR, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, comprising 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences. Building on ViBMR, we establish a comprehensive evaluation setup for brain MRI report generation, covering representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies. The results provide key insights into dataset characteristics and model behavior, while demonstrating the necessity of native low-resource clinical datasets for reliable Vietnamese-origin brain MRI report generation. Our dataset and baseline models will be released for non-commercial research.

AI.tldr: ViBMR：首个大规模多序列脑MRI（T1/T2/FLAIR/CE-T1）与越南语常规临床报告配对数据集，含3,649名患者、11,875个序列，并建立了脑MRI报告生成的多模型、多序列输入与特征聚合策略评测基准。
AI.motivation: 脑MRI报告自动生成可减轻放射科医生负担，但现有资源以英文报告、翻译文本或由任务型影像基准改造的数据集为主，缺乏原生低资源语言（如越南语）的常规临床报告数据；多序列体数据与低资源语言标注稀缺的双重挑战未被充分覆盖。
AI.method: 构建原生越南语临床报告配对的多序列脑MRI数据集（3,649患者/11,875序列，覆盖T1、T2、FLAIR、增强T1）；在此基础上设计系统性评测框架，比较代表性医学视觉-语言模型、不同多序列输入组合及特征聚合策略，并给出基线模型。
AI.result: 通过多组基线实验揭示了数据集自身特性与模型行为（多序列输入价值、聚合策略差异），并表明原生低资源临床数据集对可靠的越南语脑MRI报告生成具有必要性。
AI.conclusion: 数据集与基线模型将开源（限非商业研究）；工作重心在于填补低资源临床语言与异构多序列协议的数据空白，而非提出新方法。

title: Asking a Multimodal LLM Whether Someone Fell: Zero-Shot Screening of Low-Resolution Thermal Video in a Laboratory and an Occupied Home
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures. Data: this https URL
summary: Thermal cameras can watch over older people living alone without capturing faces, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) can judge a short video without task-specific training. We evaluate a production multimodal LLM, Gemini 3.8 Flash at temperature 0, as the decision stage of an event-triggered fall screener, used exactly as a deployed prototype uses it: one request per short thermal clip, with its sound track when there is one, and its predecessor Gemini 3.7 Flash on the same requests. On 438 staged falls and 563 non-fall windows that we located by hand in a public 32x24 thermal dataset, the deployed request called 69% of the held-out subjects' falls (67% over all subjects; bed falls excluded) and none of 499 non-fall windows, including people lying on the floor and getting up. Over 76 h of ordinary life in an occupied room, recorded at 160x120 with sound, it called none of 395 clips a fall (95% upper bound 1.2 false alarms per day) and caught 4 of the 9 staged falls the camera could see. One cautionary sentence in the prompt ("a person who goes out of view ... is not a fall") accounted for many of the misses: removing it raised sensitivity on the held-out subjects from 69% to 83% on 3.8 Flash and from 80% to 92% on Gemini 3.7 Flash, and in the home from 4 to 9 of the 9 visible falls, with no false call in ordinary living but at the price of calling deliberate lie-downs a fall. Sensitivity collapsed at 8x6 pixels (34%); identical requests disagreed on 4% of windows; and when the model called a fall, its explanation placed it within a second of the annotated landing 99% of the time. Two conventional detectors trained on the laboratory data caught nearly every held-out laboratory fall but raised 14.2 and 23.9 false alarms per day in the home. We release the frame-level fall annotations of the public dataset and every model answer on it.

AI.tldr: 评估生产级多模态大模型 Gemini 3.8 Flash（及前代 3.7 Flash）作为事件触发式热成像跌倒检测器决策阶段的实际部署表现，并与在实验室数据上训练的两个传统检测器对比，同时公开逐帧跌倒标注与全部模型回答。
AI.motivation: 热成像相机可在不采集人脸的前提下监护独居老人，多模态 LLM 无需任务特定训练即可判断短视频，但"按部署方式直接使用"的真实敏感性、虚警率与提示词/分辨率敏感性缺乏系统证据。
AI.method: 在公开 32x24 热数据集中手工定位 438 段摆拍跌倒与 563 个非跌倒窗口；以温度 0、每段短热成像片段一次请求（含音轨）的方式调用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 并与 3.7 Flash 同请求对比；另在有人居住房间以 160x120 带声音连续录制 76 小时做居家虚警评估；做提示词消融（删除"走出视野不算跌倒"一句）、分辨率消融（降至 8x6）、请求一致性与解释时间定位分析，并对比两个实验室数据训练的传统检测器。
AI.result: 留出受试者跌倒召回 69%（全受试者 67%，排除床上跌倒），499 个非跌倒窗口零误报（含躺地与起身）；居家 76 小时 395 段零误报（95% 上界 1.2 次/天），9 段可见摆拍跌倒仅捕获 4 段。删除提示词中一句警示后，留出受试者召回 3.8 Flash 69%→83%、3.7 Flash 80%→92%，居家 4/9→9/9 且日常零误报，但会把故意躺下判为跌倒。8x6 分辨率下召回崩至 34%；相同请求 4% 窗口判断不一致；判为跌倒时解释落点与标注着地时刻误差在 1 秒内占 99%。传统检测器几乎检出全部实验室留出跌倒，但居家虚警 14.2 与 23.9 次/天。
AI.conclusion: 生产级多模态 LLM 以零样本方式作为跌倒筛查决策器可在热成像下实现极低居家虚警和良好的时间定位，但召回对提示词措辞与输入分辨率高度敏感，且低于实验室训练检测器；提示词工程是部署中的主要可调杠杆，但其取舍（误判故意躺下）需显式管理。

title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
summary: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.

AI.tldr: CausalAlign：用线性探针与因果干预诊断扩散视频模型中的相机自运动表征（去噪中呈先升后降），并在对应层通过与3D基础模型在delta-token空间的表征对齐来强化自运动状态，提升几何一致性与下游世界动作模型成功率。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视频生成模型能生成视觉合理的视频，但长时序相机自运动（ego-motion）漂移严重；自运动决定帧间视角变化，是几何与轨迹一致性的关键，需要显式诊断并修复其内部表征。
AI.method: 两阶段：(1) 机制诊断——用线性探针和因果干预分析VGM中自运动信息的表示、使用与保持，发现去噪过程中呈“先升后降”模式；(2) 因果对齐——在识别出的层，通过delta-token空间（编码相邻帧变化，聚焦动态而非静态场景内容）将VGM表征与3D基础模型对齐。在Wan2.2上基于DL3DV与RealEstate10K微调。
AI.result: 相比基座模型，几何一致性提升超过20%，运动精度与时间平滑性显著改善且保持视觉质量；微调后的VGM使RoboCasa365移动操作任务上世界动作模型（WAM）成功率提升10个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过可解释诊断定位并因果性地强化自运动表征，可有效缓解扩散视频模型的相机漂移，并向下游具身智能（WAM）传导增益。

title: DewHand: Direct Metric World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
summary: Recovering metric world-space hand motion from egocentric video supports understanding human interactions and transferring them to embodied agents. Three challenges complicate this task: multi-stage pipelines propagate errors from independently estimated hand and camera motion; monocular observations leave physical scale ambiguous; and occlusion and out-of-view hands admit multiple plausible motion trajectories. We present DewHand, a unified model for direct joint reconstruction of world-space hand and camera motion. To avoid compounding errors from multi-stage estimation, DewHand jointly predicts hand and camera motion in a shared world coordinate system within a single-stage pipeline. To resolve metric-scale ambiguity, it combines scene-level geometric features from VGGT-$\Omega$ with metric-space supervision, while hand-specific features preserve fine-grained articulation. To handle occlusion and out-of-view hands, we formulate reconstruction as conditional motion generation with flow matching. Under the same architecture, this generative formulation outperforms direct regression in both accuracy and temporal smoothness with only two sampling steps. Experiments on HOT3D and ARCTIC demonstrate improved world-space accuracy and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods. DewHand reduces rigid-aligned world-space error relative to StableHand from 32.9 to 28.4 mm on HOT3D and from 76.2 to 36.2 mm on ARCTIC. It also recovers camera scale within 10% on two thirds of HOT3D clips, versus about a quarter for SLAM. Moreover, in zero-shot evaluations on HoloAssist, H2O, and TACO, captured with different devices, DewHand achieves the lowest rigid-aligned world-space error (WA-MPJPE) on each dataset.

AI.tldr: DewHand是一个单阶段统一模型，从第一视角视频直接联合重建世界坐标系下的手部运动与相机运动，结合VGGT-Ω场景几何特征与度量尺度监督，并以flow matching条件生成建模遮挡/出画手部的多解性，在HOT3D、ARCTIC上显著降低世界空间误差并具备零样本跨数据泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 从第一视角视频恢复度量世界空间的手部运动对理解人-物交互并迁移至具身智能体很重要，但存在三大难点：多阶段流水线中手部与相机估计的误差累积；单目观测下物理尺度不确定；遮挡与出画导致多条合理轨迹。需要单阶段联合估计、度量尺度约束与生成式多解建模。
AI.method: DewHand在共享世界坐标系内单阶段联合预测手部与相机运动，避免多阶段误差传播；融合VGGT-Ω的场景级几何特征与度量空间监督以消除尺度歧义，同时保留手部专用特征以刻画细粒度关节；将重建表述为条件运动生成，用flow matching在仅两步采样下完成推理。
AI.result: 在HOT3D与ARCTIC上，刚性对齐世界空间误差相对StableHand由32.9降至28.4 mm、由76.2降至36.2 mm；HOT3D中三分之二片段相机尺度恢复误差在10%以内（SLAM约四分之一）；同架构下生成式建模在精度与时序平滑性上优于直接回归；在HoloAssist、H2O、TACO零样本评估中均取得最低WA-MPJPE。
AI.conclusion: 单阶段联合世界空间手-相机重建加flow matching条件生成是有效范式，可同时提升度量精度、时序一致性并具备跨设备零样本泛化，为第一视角手-物交互理解与具身迁移提供可靠世界空间接口。

title: Existence of Minimizers for the Gaussian Mumford-Shah Model via Covariance Floors on the Value Distribution
summary: The Gaussian Mumford-Shah model segments an image into regions by minimizing a continuous multivariate Gaussian negative log-likelihood term plus a perimeter penalty. It is used for scalar- and vector-valued images, in particular hyperspectral images, but the existence of a minimizer in general is not guaranteed. The energy is unbounded below whenever the covariance of a single region degenerates, regardless of the perimeter of the regions. A quantitative covariance floor on the covariances of all regions, or equivalently uniform Hölder continuity with exponent at most one of all one-dimensional marginals of the histogram, guarantees a lower bound on the energy and the existence of a minimizer. Our approach therefore shows that existence follows from a property of the histogram of the image, and we furthermore argue that scale-independent covariance floors cannot exist. Admitting a quantitative covariance floor is generic: it holds almost surely for all images with suitable noise. As applications of our theory, we show the convergence of regularized models used in practice and of numerical methods.

AI.tldr: 该文研究高斯 Mumford-Shah 分割模型的适定性：证明当所有区域协方差有统一下界（等价于直方图的各一维边缘分布具有指数不超过 1 的一致 Hölder 连续性）时能量有下界且极小元存在，并论证尺度无关的协方差下界不可能存在，最后给出正则化模型与数值方法的收敛性。
AI.motivation: 高斯 Mumford-Shah 模型将图像分割视为"连续多元高斯负对数似然 + 周长惩罚"的极小化问题，广泛用于标量与矢量图像（尤其高光谱图像），但当某区域协方差退化时能量可无下界，一般情形下极小元的存在性并无保证，缺乏理论基础。
AI.method: 对区域协方差施加定量的协方差下界（covariance floor），证明其等价于直方图的各一维边缘分布满足指数 ≤ 1 的一致 Hölder 连续性，由此给出能量的下界并证明极小元存在；进一步反证说明尺度无关（scale-independent）的协方差下界不可能存在；并证明该假设是"泛型"的——对带有合适噪声的图像几乎必然成立。
AI.result: 建立了存在性由图像直方图性质直接推出的充要式刻画；给出尺度无关协方差下界不存在的否定结论；证明在实践中使用的正则化模型（近似模型）及相应数值算法在该条件下收敛到原模型的解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高斯 Mumford-Shah 分割提供了严格的适定性理论：存在性可归约为直方图的条件，而正则化与数值实现具有可证明的收敛保证，为变分分割模型的实践用法提供了理论支撑。

title: Training-free Acceleration for Blind Compressed Image Restoration via Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition
comment: 12 pages. Accepted for publication in IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems
summary: Transformer-based models achieve strong performance on blind compressed image restoration (CIR) under unknown compression settings, but their densely stacked projection operators make deployment costly. We study training-free acceleration for such models through an empirical, operator-level analysis. Specifically, we profile where computation is concentrated, characterize channel-wise activation distributions under compressed inputs, and examine the singular-value decay of representative projection weights. These measurements identify the recurring projections in the attention, feed-forward, convolutional, and prompt-conditioning pathways as effective low-rank replacement targets that preserve the original inference graph. They further establish truncated SVD (TSVD) as a principled training-free baseline for blind CIR and reveal why a uniform low-rank objective is mismatched to the channel-imbalanced feature distributions of compressed images. Accordingly, we formulate Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition (ASVD) for this restoration setting, deriving low-rank factors entirely offline from pretrained weights and lightweight activation statistics gathered from only a few compressed calibration images. By weighting the decomposition with channel-wise activation magnitudes, our ASVD assigns larger penalties to errors on more active channels, requiring neither retraining nor online calibration and leaving the restoration pipeline intact. When instantiated on PromptCIR at rank 64, ASVD consistently improves PSNR-B over TSVD across four standard benchmarks under identical parameter and MAC budgets. At this operating point, the factorized model cuts parameters by 59% (34.75M to 14.34M) and computation by 16.1% (258.79 to 217.16 GMACs for a 256 x 256 input), enabling acceleration without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练低秩压缩方法 ASVD，用通道激活幅度加权的截断 SVD 替换 PromptCIR 中重复投影算子，在同等参数量与 MAC 预算下优于 TSVD。
AI.motivation: 盲压缩图像复原（CIR）中的 Transformer 模型密集堆叠投影算子，导致部署成本高；作者希望在保持原推理图、无需重训练的条件下实现加速，并解决统一低秩目标与压缩图像通道不均衡特征分布不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 算子级经验分析：profiling 计算集中位置、刻画压缩输入下的通道激活分布、分析投影权重奇异值衰减；据此确定 attention、feed-forward、卷积、prompt-conditioning 路径中的重复投影为低秩替换目标。以 TSVD 为免训练基线，提出 ASVD：离线从预训练权重与少量压缩标定图的轻量激活统计中导出低秩因子，按通道激活幅度加权分解，对高活跃通道的误差施加更大惩罚。
AI.result: 在 PromptCIR 上取 rank 64，ASVD 在四个标准基准上于相同参数与 MAC 预算下 PSNR-B 一致优于 TSVD；参数减少 59%（34.75M→14.34M），计算减少 16.1%（256×256 输入 258.79→217.16 GMACs）。
AI.conclusion: ASVD 是一种无需重训练、无需在线标定、不破坏复原流程的免训练加速方案，适用于盲压缩图像复原模型的实际部署。

title: Object- and Task-Aware Active Perception for Safe Navigation of Mobile Manipulators in Semi-Static Environments
summary: Mobile manipulators must navigate safely in cluttered, partially unknown environments across logistics, manufacturing, and service applications. Semi-static changes between robot visits can lead to outdated scene knowledge and increased collision risk. We propose an active perception framework that enables a high degree-of-freedom (DoF) mobile manipulator to inspect uncertain or safety-critical regions with its hand camera during navigation. A probabilistic, object- and task-aware next-best-view (NBV) formulation prioritizes observations near the desired path and around uncertain or potentially changing objects. The perception objective is integrated into hierarchical-task model predictive control (HTMPC), exploiting kinematic redundancy for viewpoint adjustment while preserving the higher priority of base-trajectory tracking. The system unifies navigation, map maintenance, and active perception in a closed loop. Real-world tests show improved map consistency, reduced task-dependent map entropy, and lower navigation risk than passive or non-task-aware baselines. Additional simulation and real-world sequences demonstrate responses to controlled semi-static scene changes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种主动感知框架：高自由度移动机械臂在导航过程中用手部相机巡检不确定或安全关键区域，以概率化、物体与任务感知的NBV目标融入分层任务MPC（HTMPC），在保持基座轨迹跟踪最高优先级的前提下利用运动学冗余调整视角，实现导航-建图-主动感知闭环。
AI.motivation: 移动机械臂在杂乱、部分未知环境中导航时，两次访问之间的半静态变化会使场景知识过时，导致碰撞风险上升；被动或与任务无关的感知无法把有限的观测资源集中到路径周边与易变物体上。
AI.method: 1）概率化、物体与任务感知的next-best-view公式化，优先观测期望路径附近及不确定/可能变化对象；2）将感知目标作为低优先级任务集成进HTMPC，利用高DoF冗余在保持基座轨迹跟踪高优先级的前提下调整手部相机视角；3）导航、地图维护与主动感知统一为闭环系统。
AI.result: 真实世界实验显示地图一致性提升、任务相关地图熵降低、导航风险低于被动与任务无关基线；额外仿真与实机序列验证了对受控半静态场景变化的响应能力。
AI.conclusion: 将任务与物体不确定性驱动的主动感知以分层优先级方式嵌入MPC，可在不牺牲导航主任务的前提下提升动态环境下移动操作的安全性与建图质量。

title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.

AI.tldr: 提出Future Chunk Prediction (FCP)辅助目标，与teacher-forced去噪联合优化，通过预测时间上相隔较远的chunk（不访问中间视觉上下文）来迫使自回归视频扩散模型建模场景演化而非依赖时序冗余的捷径。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成视频，teacher forcing下强时序冗余使模型可用局部视觉连续性作为当前chunk去噪的捷径，削弱了对视觉演化（世界如何变化）建模的压力；生成看似合理的续帧并不等于真正捕捉了场景演化。
AI.method: FCP作为辅助目标：在teacher forcing去噪之外，额外预测时间间隔较远的未来chunk，且不提供中间视觉上下文，从而切断局部连续性捷径；监督信号直接取自训练视频，无需额外预训练视觉编码器，推理阶段保持不变（不增加自回归推理开销）。
AI.result: 相比标准teacher-forced自回归训练，在更低的总训练计算预算下取得更优的物理合理性（physical plausibility）；可视化显示FCP促使表征空间更具结构性，可能有利于构建自回归世界模型。
AI.conclusion: future-chunk监督是一种有效且高效的手段，可迫使自回归视频扩散模型学习视觉演化，并为自回归世界模型提供更好的表征基础；抽象未给出定量指标、基线细节与代码。

title: DONIC: Generalist Dexterous Bimanual Tracking Control from Human Demonstrations
summary: Despite recent progress in dexterous reference tracking, existing models focus primarily on single-hand manipulation and a limited range of interactions, leaving the bimanual dexterous behaviors common in real life unaddressed. The scarcity of contact-rich bimanual manipulation data and the increased complexity of coordinating contacts make developing a generalist bimanual tracker particularly challenging. Therefore, we present 1) DONIC, the first generalist bimanual tracker jointly trained across operation categories and human-motion sources, together with 2) BiHOI, a multi-view dataset of 1,575 sequences spanning 229 objects and emphasizing sustained bimanual interaction, where reconstructed interactions are retargeted into robot references. DONIC combines proximal policy optimization with behavioral cloning in a feedback loop that recycles verified successful executions into training demonstrations. An object-centered per-hand reward maintains object-motion feedback while supervising each hand according to its reference contact role. Clip-Centered Advantages remove reference-dependent advantage offsets while preserving within-trajectory differences. Together, these designs enable one single policy to learn coordinated manipulation across heterogeneous references.
