Without finetuning, a single checkpoint achieves 86.79% success on unseen trajectories of training objects and 57.32% on held-out objects, surpassing the state-of-the-art bimanual tracking baselines by 77.36 and 45.73 percentage points.

AI.tldr: DONIC：首个跨操作类别与人体动捕源联合训练的通用双手灵巧跟踪器，配套BiHOI多视角数据集（1575序列/229物体）；用PPO+行为克隆闭环、物体中心逐手奖励与Clip-Centered Advantage，单一策略无需微调达86.79%（训练物体新轨迹）/57.32%（新物体）成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧参考跟踪工作集中于单手操作与有限交互类型，真实场景中常见的双手灵巧行为尚未被覆盖；接触丰富的双手数据稀缺、双手协调接触的复杂度更高，使通用双手跟踪器难以构建。
AI.method: 1) 构建BiHOI多视角数据集（1575序列、229物体、强调持续双手交互），将重建交互重定向为机器人参考轨迹。2) DONIC通用双手跟踪器：PPO与行为克隆构成反馈闭环，将验证成功的执行轨迹回收为训练示范；提出物体中心逐手奖励，在保持物体运动反馈的同时依据各手参考接触角色进行监督；提出Clip-Centered Advantages，消除依赖参考的优势偏移，保留轨迹内差异。
AI.result: 单一checkpoint、无微调：训练物体未见轨迹成功率86.79%，留出物体57.32%，分别超越SOTA双手跟踪基线77.36与45.73个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 统一策略可在异构参考（不同操作类别与人体动捕源）下学习协调双手操作，验证了数据构建＋奖励设计＋优势归一化对通用双手灵巧跟踪的有效性。

title: Multiclass Boundary Refinement with Neural Cellular Automata for Remote Sensing Land Cover Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery often places class boundaries a few pixels away from where they truly lie, and this position error is concentrated in the thin band measured by Boundary IoU (BIoU). We treat boundary refinement as the iterated application of a small learned local rule: the Boundary Refinement Neural Cellular Automaton (BRNCA), that starts from the class probabilities of a frozen, pre-trained segmenter and corrects them cell by cell. We generalise the binary rNCA to the multiclass case by keeping the visible channels on the probability simplex through an Aitchison (log-space) update and by adding free hidden channels. The best configuration improves the mean BIoU over the base segmenter by 2.36 points (from 46.63 to 48.99). The gain is concentrated on the irregular woodland class (+8.5 points BIoU); this suggests that position error is correlated with the fractal dimension of the class boundaries.

AI.tldr: BRNCA：将边界精化视为小型学习局部规则的迭代应用，基于冻结分割器的类别概率逐像素修正，用Aitchison对数空间更新保持概率单纯形并加隐藏通道，mean BIoU +2.36。
AI.motivation: 遥感影像语义分割的类别边界常偏离真实位置数像素，误差集中在Boundary IoU测量的细窄带内；需在冻结预训练分割器之上做轻量后处理式精化。
AI.method: 把二值rNCA推广到多类：BRNCA在概率上迭代应用学习到的局部规则；通过Aitchison（log-space）更新使可见通道保持在概率单纯形上，并引入自由隐藏通道；输入为冻结分割器的类别概率。
AI.result: 最佳配置将mean BIoU从46.63提升至48.99（+2.36）；增益集中于不规则林地类（+8.5 BIoU），提示位置误差与类别边界分形维数相关。
AI.conclusion: 轻量神经细胞自动机可作为通用边界精化后处理，显著改善边界定位指标；边界误差与几何复杂度（分形维数）相关，为后续按类别复杂度分配精化能力提供线索。

title: ClunoGS: Compact Language 3D Gaussian Splatting via Unified Optimization
summary: Language 3D Gaussian Splatting enables open-vocabulary scene understanding by associating Gaussian primitives with language features. These semantic attributes increase model storage, while most existing 3DGS compression methods are designed mainly to preserve RGB rendering quality. One straightforward approach is to apply sparsification and quantization sequentially. However, pruning based only on rendering quality can remove Gaussians that have small RGB contributions but are important for semantic prediction. Once removed, their semantic information cannot be recovered by later quantization. We propose ClunoGS, a compact framework for Language 3DGS that combines semantics-aware Gaussian sparsification and vector quantization in a unified constrained objective. Semantic supervision is used during sparsification, and the objective jointly considers rendering quality, semantic accuracy, and compactness. We optimize the unified objective with alternating primal, sparsification, quantization, and dual updates. We evaluate ClunoGS on open-vocabulary localization and segmentation using the LERF and ScanNet-10 benchmarks. Under aggressive compression, our unified, semantics-aware formulation substantially alleviates the degradation of semantic representations caused by sequential compression and semantics-agnostic Gaussian sparsification. Ablations further show that jointly coordinating sparsification and quantization better preserves semantic accuracy than applying them independently.

AI.tldr: ClunoGS是一个面向Language 3DGS的紧凑压缩框架，将语义感知高斯稀疏化与矢量量化统一到一个受约束目标中联合优化，以在激进压缩下保持开放词汇语义精度。
AI.motivation: Language 3DGS通过给高斯基元绑定语言特征实现开放词汇场景理解，但这显著增加存储；现有3DGS压缩方法主要针对RGB渲染质量，若先按渲染贡献剪枝再量化，会不可逆地丢失对语义预测关键但RGB贡献小的高斯。
AI.method: 提出统一约束目标，同时考虑渲染质量、语义准确性与紧凑度；稀疏化阶段引入语义监督，避免仅依据渲染误差剪枝；用交替的原变量、稀疏化、量化与对偶变量更新求解该统一目标，将稀疏化与矢量量化协同而非顺序执行。
AI.result: 在LERF与ScanNet-10的开放词汇定位与分割基准上，激进压缩条件下统一语义感知方案明显缓解了顺序压缩及语义无关剪枝导致的语义表示退化；消融表明联合协调稀疏化与量化比独立执行更好地保持语义精度。
AI.conclusion: 压缩Language 3DGS必须把语义监督纳入剪枝与量化的联合优化，否则语义信息被不可逆破坏；统一约束+交替优化是一种有效且紧凑的解决方案。

title: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. To appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. Project page: this https URL
summary: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.

AI.tldr: RealMe：以高分辨率视频扩散模型统一增强稀疏低分辨率多视角采集，生成2K、4D一致的视频用于体积视频重建。
AI.motivation: 密集多视角重建质量高但采集成本高；现有生成式松弛方案仍受限于分辨率低与4D不一致。
AI.method: 从采集视频构造辅助数据，与布局感知位置编码一并编码为latent；视频扩散模型将分解式时空注意力适配到多视角布局，跨视角跨时间去噪并解码为增强视频以精化4D表示；另引入latent频域损失缩小生成与真实视频的域差。
AI.result: 在DNA-Rendering基准与自采RealVV数据集上，视觉保真度与4D一致性均优于SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 扩散先验+布局感知注意力可有效放宽体积视频采集条件，实现沉浸式高质量体积视频生成。

title: Plausible but Unimplantable: A Trustworthiness Audit of Shape Completion Foundation Models for Cranial Defect Reconstruction
summary: A patient who has lost part of the skull vault needs an implant that fits the defect exactly, and such implants are still drawn by hand in CAD by specialists, which makes each case slow and expensive. The task can be considered as a shape completion problem, so pretrained completion models, and now the first shape completion foundation models, look like a way to remove that manual step. We audited three publicly released pretrained shape completion models, two of them foundation models, applied zero-shot to 239 cranial defects, some carved from public skull datasets and some real post-craniectomy cases. Each output was compared with simply returning the patient's own remaining bone, and tested for whether the predicted material could be placed without intersecting the bone that is still there. On the 210 carved defects none of the three improved on doing nothing, and on the 29 real cases only one did so beyond chance. Yet not one output, from any model in any configuration, was implantable: none managed both to stay clear of the bone the patient still has and to place more material than doing nothing, where a task-specific volumetric model, trained for this task and selected on these cases, was implantable on all but one. The output that most convincingly resembles a skull is no more placeable than the rest, and at these point densities implant thickness cannot be read off the emitted points at all, which is a property of the output representation rather than of any one model. On this evidence the shape completion foundation models we could obtain cannot be trusted and, used as released, are not usable in clinical practice. Substantial research towards trustworthy foundation models for shape completion is still needed.

AI.tldr: 该文审计了三个公开的预训练形状补全模型（两为foundation model）在239例颅骨缺损上的零样本表现：210例雕刻缺损中无一优于"直接返回剩余骨"，29例真实颅骨切除病例中仅一个超过随机；且所有输出均无法真正植入（既要避开现存骨又要补出更多材料），而任务专用体积模型几乎全部可植入。
AI.motivation: 颅骨植入物目前依赖专家手工CAD绘制，耗时昂贵；作者希望检验"形状补全基础模型零样本可用"这一假设，以判断是否能去除人工环节。
AI.method: 对三个公开预训练形状补全模型（含两个基础模型）在公共颅骨数据集雕刻缺损与真实颅骨切除术后病例上做零样本推理；将每个输出与"直接返回患者剩余骨"的平凡基线比较，并检验预测材料是否与现存骨相交、体积是否增益、厚度是否可读取。
AI.result: 210例雕刻缺损上零改善；29例真实病例仅一模型优于随机；任何模型任何配置都不可植入（无法同时满足远离现存骨与体积增益），而任务专用体积模型除1例外全部可植入；点云密度下厚度不可从输出点读取，属表示固有属性。
AI.conclusion: 现可获得的形状补全基础模型不可信，按发布状态无法用于临床；形状补全基础模型需在可信度与可制造性方面做实质研究。

title: Attn-Forcing: Learning Full-Context Attention Proxies for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Increasing the attention context length significantly improves streaming video generation quality, while incurring prohibitive memory and computational costs as the context grows. Existing methods attempt to capture this contextual information through attention selection or compression, but remain limited by bounded representations and lack explicit attention-level supervision to retain historical contributions to current queries. To address this, we introduce Attn-Forcing, a novel framework that preserves full-context attention contributions for streaming video generation under bounded memory and computation. We achieve this by introducing attention proxies that continuously approximate the attention responses induced by the historical context. Specifically, we implement the proxies as learnable visual latents and employ a Proxy Update Module to incorporate visual context from historical latents. Moreover, we propose an Attention Matching Loss to explicitly constrain the attention behavior of the learned proxies using full-context attention supervision. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that Attn-Forcing consistently improves streaming video generation quality and achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing baseline methods.

AI.tldr: Attn-Forcing：用可学习视觉潜变量作为"注意力代理"近似历史上下文的注意力响应，并以 Attention Matching Loss 显式监督，在有限显存/算力下为流式视频生成保留全上下文注意力贡献。
AI.motivation: 流式视频生成中，延长注意力上下文能显著提升质量，但显存与算力随上下文增长而激增；现有注意力选择/压缩方法受限于有界表示，且缺乏注意力层面的显式监督来保留历史对当前 query 的贡献。
AI.method: 引入 attention proxies（可学习视觉 latent）持续近似历史上下文引发的注意力响应；用 Proxy Update Module 将历史 latent 中的视觉上下文写入代理；提出 Attention Matching Loss，以全上下文注意力作为显式监督约束代理的注意力行为。
AI.result: 定性与定量实验表明，方法稳定提升流式视频生成质量，并在现有基线中达到 state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 以"注意力响应"而非"特征/帧"为压缩对象，为长上下文流式生成提供了有界内存下近似全上下文注意力的可行路线，思路可迁移到其他长时序自回归生成任务。

title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

AI.tldr: TARSphere 是面向长时程具身智能体的全栈框架：物理仿真基础设施 (Infra)、冻结 MLLM 驱动的具身大脑封装 (Harness) 以及 360 条 episode/30 个室内场景的基准 (Bench)，评估感知鲁棒性、扰动适应、任务更新、人机协同与意图理解。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体系统多依赖指定目标或将执行抽象为符号动作，难以在动态演进的真实世界中评测物理与社会约束下的长时程能力。
AI.method: TARSphere-Infra 在物理仿真器中运行机器人策略，含具身 NPC 与受限对话；事件驱动 FSM 依据完成动作与传递信息更新任务状态并评估结果。TARSphere-Harness 使冻结 MLLM 通过多层次可执行技能行动，借助观测、分层记忆与执行反馈修正决策。agent-in-the-loop 数据策展对齐任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何，构建 360 条 episode 基准。
AI.result: 8 个 MLLM 的评测显示通用模型可优于具身专用模型；任务更新与人机交互仍是难点；频繁碰撞与跌倒表明需在任务成功率之外评估执行安全性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了物理与社会约束下长时程具身智能体的仿真—智能体—基准一体化评测体系，揭示通用 MLLM 的潜力与安全性、人机协同的短板。

title: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires an effective interface between high-level task policies and whole-body control. Existing interfaces typically rely on a single action representation for both task intent and whole-body coordination. This may burden the high-level policy or leave one aspect underspecified. We present SP-HLM, a framework built on a sparse-pose-driven interface. The interface combines five task-critical body poses with a learned latent motion prior to represent spatial intent and whole-body coordination in complementary forms. SP-VLA, a vision-language-action model, first predicts task-relevant sparse poses and finger joint positions from multimodal observations and language instructions using asynchronous action-chunk inference. Given these sparse targets, SP-MGM, a motion generation model trained through two-stage distillation, reconstructs coordinated full-body motion in real time. A pretrained motion encoder maps this motion to a compact latent representation. SP-GMT, a general motion tracker, then integrates the explicit sparse targets with this implicit motion prior for whole-body control. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot demonstrate improved motion tracking, whole-body coordination, and loco-manipulation success over existing approaches. Additional results and videos are available on our \href{ this https URL }{\textcolor{blue}{project page}}.

AI.tldr: SP-HLM提出稀疏姿态驱动的分层接口：SP-VLA预测任务关键稀疏身体姿态与手指关节，SP-MGM经两阶段蒸馏实时重建全身动作，SP-GMT结合显式稀疏目标与隐式运动先验做全身控制。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人loco-manipulation需要高层任务策略与全身控制之间的有效接口，而现有接口通常用单一动作表示同时承载任务意图与全身协调，导致高层策略负担过重或某一侧欠定义。
AI.method: 以五个任务关键身体姿态加学习到的隐式运动先验构成互补表示；SP-VLA从多模态观测与语言指令异步动作分块推理稀疏姿态与手指关节；SP-MGM通过两阶段蒸馏实时生成协调全身动作；预训练运动编码器压缩为latent；SP-GMT融合显式稀疏目标与隐式先验进行跟踪控制。
AI.result: 仿真与真实人形机器人实验显示，在动作跟踪、全身协调及loco-manipulation成功率上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏姿态接口可作为VLA与全身控制之间的有效中间表示，显式空间意图与隐式运动先验互补有助于提升人形机器人移动操作性能。

title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. May Espinola and Qifan Zhang contributed equally. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training. However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks. In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark. Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills. We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes. Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%. Increasing reasoning effort generally improves manipulation performance, but the benefits vary across models and come at additional inference cost. We also observe substantial differences across tasks, with models performing relatively well on object placement tasks but struggling with precise spatial arrangements and complex multi-step interactions. These findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of frontier AI models for robot manipulation, highlighting the challenges of translating reasoning capabilities into reliable physical actions. We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该报告提出一个统一的闭环机器人操作框架，让前沿通用AI模型（GPT-6系列、Claude Opus 5系列、Gemini-4 Argon）在LIBERO-10基准上通过视觉观测、本体感知与结构化工具调用直接控制机械臂，系统评估18种配置共1800个episode。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型在视觉理解、推理、规划与工具使用上表现突出，但其机器人操作能力缺乏标准化机器人基准上的系统评测；作者希望检验无需任务特定微调或预训练操作技能的通用模型能否胜任真实操作任务。
AI.method: 构建统一闭环操作框架：模型以视觉观测、机器人本体状态和结构化工具调用（指定末端执行器目标位姿与夹爪指令）直接控制机器人；在LIBERO-10上评测6个前沿模型×3档推理强度=18种配置、1800个episode，无任务微调、无预训练操作技能。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra成功率最高44%，Gemini-4 Argon 43%；提高推理强度总体提升操作性能但增益因模型而异且推理成本上升；任务间差异显著——物体放置类任务较好，精确空间排布与复杂多步交互较差。
AI.conclusion: 前沿AI模型用于机器人操作兼具潜力与局限，核心挑战在于将推理能力转化为可靠的物理动作；作者开源评测框架与结果以支持可复现基准评测与后续研究。

title: Test-Time Motion Steering for Perceptive Humanoid Fall Recovery
summary: Humanoid fall recovery requires selecting a motion that suits both the surrounding scene and the task. The same fallen pose can admit several ways to stand, with different routes, support transitions, and final headings. Yet reliable recovery alone does not provide control over which of these alternatives the robot executes. Steering this choice requires anticipating the physical consequences of a requested movement. We present RISE, an approach to perceptive humanoid recovery that lets task objectives steer how the robot returns to standing at inference time. It builds on two insights: diverse recoveries can be composed from shared movements, and anticipating how these movements unfold allows recovery to be steered toward a task objective. We learn a recovery vocabulary that connects intended movements to motor actions through sensory feedback. A visual diffusion planner learns from executions of this vocabulary to predict motion intent as future body states. Task costs guide this prediction toward a desired heading, rise speed, or path. The planner then generates motion latents conditioned on the steered intent, allowing the requested movement to shape its execution. Simulation experiments demonstrate diverse recoveries, terrain adaptation, and test-time steering without retraining, complemented by real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RISE 提出一种可在推理时被任务目标"操控"的感知式人形机器人跌倒恢复方法：用运动词汇表(diffusion planner)组合多样化恢复动作，并通过视觉扩散规划器预测未来身体状态(运动意图)，再以任务代价(朝向、起身速度、路径)引导该意图，实现无需重训练的任务导向恢复。
AI.motivation: 同一跌倒姿态存在多种起身方式（路线、支撑转换、最终朝向不同），而仅靠"能恢复"无法让机器人选择符合场景与任务的方案；要控制这一选择必须预判所请求运动的物理后果。
AI.method: 两个核心洞察：多样化恢复可由共享运动组合而成，且预判运动展开方式可实现转向。具体学习一个连接"意图运动"与"电机动作"的恢复词汇表（通过感知反馈）；视觉扩散规划器从该词汇表的执行中学习，以未来身体状态形式预测运动意图；任务代价引导预测朝目标朝向/速度/路径；规划器再生成以被引导意图为条件的运动 latent，使执行受请求运动调制。
AI.result: 仿真中展示多样化恢复、地形适应、无需重训练的测试时引导；并在 Unitree G1 真机上给出演示。
AI.conclusion: 将恢复动作分解为可组合词汇表 + 未来状态意图预测 + 任务代价引导，是实现可操控、感知驱动的人形恢复的有效路径，并具备真机可行性。

title: Do Earth-Trained Humanoid Controllers Walk on the Moon? Gravity, Terrain, and Soil Transfer
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material (13 pages) included as an ancillary file
summary: The Moon changes gravity, terrain, and soil at once. Learned locomotion has studied reduced gravity on rigid ground and granular terrain mostly at Earth gravity, but not humanoids under both, generalist-controller transfer, or the Earth cost of lunar adaptation. On a simulated Unitree G1, we train 12 policies with one recipe, varying gravity, terrain geometry, and ground contact (rigid or three-dimensional resistive force theory, 3D RFT), and including Earth-to-Moon fine-tuning and gravity randomization. We test them at both gravities on rigid ground and 3D RFT, and at their training gravity on three held-out soil models. We also test the frozen SONIC, a released generalist humanoid controller, at both gravities on rigid ground only. Gravity transfer is asymmetric. Earth-trained policies keep 0.64 to 0.75 survival at the Moon on flat rigid ground, Moon-trained and fine-tuned policies cannot stand at Earth, and SONIC survives at most 0.10 at the Moon. Rough training lifts combined-tile survival from 0.53 to 0.98 at Earth and 0.80 to 0.99 at the Moon. In 3D RFT, soil training helps on Earth sand, on tiles and for rough-trained policies also on flat sand. On the stiffer lunar soil it helps only flat-trained Earth policies at Earth and changes the survival of Moon-trained policies by at most a few hundredths. In the sampled rollouts of the held-out soil models, Moon-trained policies keep most of their rigid-ground progress on lunar regolith at the low G1 foot pressure, with per-seed progress ratios of 0.84 to 1.39 apart from one seed with a short rigid reference. A gravity-randomized policy trained on rough 3D RFT terrain has a seed-mean survival of at least 0.84 at Earth and 0.96 at the Moon on every key test cell up to 20 degrees. Lunar results are simulation predictions conditional on the contact model and soil stiffness.

AI.tldr: 在仿真Unitree G1上统一配方训练12个策略，联合改变重力、地形粗糙度与地面接触模型（刚体或3D RFT颗粒土），系统考察地月双向迁移、通用控制器SONIC的月球表现，以及月球适应在地球上的代价。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型运动控制分别研究低重力刚性地形或地球重力颗粒土，缺少两者叠加下的人形机器人研究、通用控制器迁移评估，以及"为月球训练是否牺牲地球性能"的量化证据。
AI.method: 固定训练配方，交叉扫描重力（地球/月球/重力随机化）、地形几何（平地/粗糙/组合瓦片）与接触模型（刚体/三维阻力理论3D RFT），并加入地球→月球微调；在地球与月球两种重力、刚体与3D RFT、以及三个留出土壤模型上做系统评测；同时冻结测试公开通用人形控制器SONIC。
AI.result: 重力迁移显著非对称：地球训练策略在月球平地刚体存活率0.64–0.75，而月球训练/微调策略在地球基本无法站立，SONIC在月球存活率≤0.10。粗糙地形训练使组合瓦片存活率从0.53→0.98（地球）、0.80→0.99（月球）。3D RFT下土壤训练收益依赖土质与地形，在较硬月壤上影响仅数个百分点；月球训练策略在低足压下基本保留刚性地面进展（每seed比值0.84–1.39）。粗糙3D RFT上的重力随机化策略在各关键测试格（最高20°）达成seed均值存活≥0.84（地球）与≥0.96（月球）。
AI.conclusion: 低重力运动策略存在严重的地球回迁壁垒，粗糙地形随机化是提升跨重力鲁棒性的有效手段；但结论为依赖于接触模型与土壤刚度的仿真预测，缺真实硬件验证。

title: ProactEgoMem: Benchmarking Proactive Memory in Streaming Egocentric Video
comment: 30 pages, 22 figures, Project Page: this https URL
summary: Today's multimodal assistants are typically prompted to interpret the visual evidence presented to them. To offload the cognitive burden of remembering across long horizons, wearable assistants should instead proactively acquire and maintain useful memory as the user's surroundings evolve. Doing so on the user's behalf requires identifying what matters, understanding the scene in real time, and initiating memory maintenance in the background while the user stays focused on their activities. We introduce ProactEgoMem, a benchmark that evaluates proactive memory in streaming egocentric video. Three tasks ground the evaluation in ambient environmental needs: Information Capture (IC) preserves transient yet dense visual information, State Tracking (ST) follows changing object states, and Location Tracking (LT) records object movements. The benchmark defines its protocol at two levels of proactiveness: the Notification Level asks for a single timely notification that satisfies the user's intent, while the deeper Intervention Level asks the agent to maintain memory on the user's behalf through an active start-to-stop tool lifecycle. Parallel ProactEgoMem-Daily and ProactEgoMem-Sci tracks contain 300/100 clips covering daily and scientific use cases, paired with 1000/500 questions in ProactEgoMem-QA, which measures the quality of the proactively acquired memory. Across proprietary, open-source, video-language, and streaming baselines, even the strongest models fail to capture memory both timely and accurately. ProactEgoMem provides a rigorous evaluation foundation for proactive multimodal assistance and for video agents that co-exist with their users.

AI.tldr: ProactEgoMem：面向流式第一视角视频的"主动记忆"基准，含信息捕获、状态跟踪、位置跟踪三任务，设通知级/介入级两级主动性协议，配套 300/100 片段与 1000/500 QA。
AI.motivation: 现有第一视角多模态助手多为被动响应提示，需用户主动提问；长期穿戴场景下人工记忆负担重，助手应主动判断"什么重要"、实时理解场景并在后台维护记忆。
AI.method: 构建流式 egocentric 视频基准，定义信息捕获（IC）、状态跟踪（ST）、位置跟踪（LT）三类环境需求任务；提出 Notification Level（单次及时通知）与 Intervention Level（主动 start-to-stop 工具生命周期维护记忆）两级协议；分 Daily / Sci 两个赛道，并以 QA 集合评估所获取记忆的质量。
AI.result: 在闭源、开源、视频语言与流式等多类基线上评测，最强模型仍无法同时做到"及时且准确"地捕获记忆，暴露出显著的主动记忆能力缺口。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为主动式多模态助手与长期共存视频智能体提供了严格评测基础，但本质上仍是基准/评测类贡献，未提出可迁移的方法。

title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: AtomicRL: 面向 VLA 策略的强化学习后训练框架，利用原子任务结构实现可靠信用分配与自适应探索（SAPO 语义门控 + BATE 瓶颈自适应探索 + Real2Sim2Real 部署流水线）。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在机器人操作上有潜力，但单纯模仿学习难以掌握复杂长程技能；现有 VLA-RL 方法受轨迹级稀疏奖励导致的延迟与有偏信用分配困扰，且子任务掌握不均衡形成性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 AtomicRL：1) Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO)，用语义感知门控阻断失败原子子任务的 TD 残差跨任务边界传播，抑制信用污染，同时保留子任务内信用分配与价值自举；2) Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE)，依据各原子子任务掌握度动态协调任务采样与局部探索激励；3) Real2Sim2Real 流水线，将仿真在线 RL 与真机部署衔接。
AI.result: LIBERO-LONG 上相较 PPO 在两种 VLA 架构上分别取得 3.6% 与 4.0% 绝对性能提升；CALVIN ABC-D 上全任务性能最高提升 9.5%；结合 Real2Sim2Real 后真机任务平均提升 21.3%。
AI.conclusion: 基于原子任务结构的 RL 后训练可有效提升 VLA 策略在长程任务上的学习效率与操作性能，并具备真机可迁移性。

title: Implementation of Dynamic Microsegmentation for a Multi-Robot Network
summary: This report describes a laboratory instantiation of a dynamic microsegmentation function for an Internet-of-Things network, specifically a multi-robot network, using a commercial software-defined microsegmentation tool. Fine-grained dynamic segmentation policies are defined, where segments are adapted based on asset functional and health tags. Automated implementation of the dynamic policies in software is also undertaken. The microsegmentation solution is shown to automatically isolate an indicated threat in real time, while maintaining unaffected operations. The demonstration indicates that microsegmentation can be implemented in IoT networks, in a way that allows for robust operation in the face of threats and disruptions.

AI.tldr: 在实验室多机器人IoT网络中，用商用软件定义微隔离工具实现基于资产功能与健康标签的细粒度动态分段策略自动化部署，可实时隔离威胁并保持其余业务运行。
AI.motivation: IoT/多机器人网络缺乏细粒度、可动态适配的分段隔离手段，难以在受攻击或故障时既隔离威胁又不影响正常机器人作业。
AI.method: 基于商用SDN微隔离工具的实验室实例化；定义以资产功能标签与健康状态标签为条件的动态分段策略，并自动化下发与实施策略；以真实威胁注入验证隔离效果。
AI.result: 系统可实时自动隔离被标记的威胁资产，同时未受影响节点的运行保持不变，验证了动态策略自动化落地的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 微隔离可在IoT/多机器人网络中落地，提供面对威胁与中断时的鲁棒运行能力；但仅为实验室演示，缺乏规模化与物理机器人任务层面的量化评估。

title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
summary: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student's on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ~2x higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses ~100x fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by +40% over standard distillation. Overall, it provides a simple yet surprisingly effective framework to learn efficient test-time exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASTEROID：学生-教师监督框架，学生用自身 on-policy 上下文收集轨迹，特权专家以该历史为条件标注动作，从而蒸馏出"不确定时主动探索、揭示隐状态后利用"的测试时探索行为。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测下的序贯决策需要先探索以获得隐藏的任务相关信息；在线 RL 样本效率低，离线模仿对隐藏状态平均专家动作、学不到探索。
AI.method: Student-teacher 监督学习：学生先在部分可观测下收集 on-policy 上下文，特权专家（全观测）基于该学生历史条件给出动作标签，学生蒸馏这些动作，从而内化"先搜索后利用"策略；无需 RL 训练成本。
AI.result: 在 11 类环境（离散探索基准、机器人操作、导航、Procgen）中，固定探索预算下回报约 2x，交互量比 RL 基线少约 100x，探索能力超过前沿模型；仿真策略迁移到无视觉真实机器人操作，成功率比标准蒸馏 +40%。
AI.conclusion: 以极简的师生监督框架即可学到高效的测试时探索（近似贝叶斯后验采样），同时避免 RL 的数据成本，并具备 sim-to-real 迁移能力。

title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
summary: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAPAV 能力中心框架（Perceive, Anticipate, Plan, Act, Verify），用于统一比较多模态具身智能体（MMEA）、多模态智能体（MMA）与机器人系统（RS），并指出当前评测严重偏重 Act 能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体（如计算机使用智能体）与机器人系统各自发展，缺少统一视角说明当智能体从"计算机使用"转向"机器人使用"时本质发生了什么变化，以及物理约束如何改变任务可解性。
AI.method: 概念性与综述性工作：定义 MMEA 为耦合多模态任务推理与物理动作、并依据反馈修正决策的目标导向系统；提出 PAPAV 五功能框架（感知状态、预期动作效果、规划可行路径、通过接口或本体执行、验证结果），按功能而非架构划分，据此横向对比 MMEA、MMA 与 RS；归纳五项物理约束（含部分可观测、结果不可验证等）；对 64 个基准进行能力标注统计。
AI.result: 对比显示三类系统在五功能上的共享与差异；物理约束导致可预先固定的选择更少、纠错回旋空间更小；在 64 个基准中显式评测集中于 Act，仅 5 个涉及 Anticipate、3 个涉及 Verify，二者大多被任务成功率掩盖。
AI.conclusion: PAPAV 为设计可靠物理智能体提供共同基础，并主张从单一任务成功率转向覆盖五类能力的度量；据此提出开放挑战。属于视角/框架类论文，无具体方法与实证实验。

title: CW-WAM: A Structured Contact-Wrench World Action Model for Force-Sensitive Manipulation
summary: Force-sensitive manipulation requires contact and load information that is not provided explicitly by visual observations. We present CW-WAM, a world action model that jointly predicts video, motion, and contact wrench. Inspired by hybrid motion-force control, it contains a unified interaction module that treats both motion and contact wrench as modeling targets and predicts time-aligned motion-wrench chunks as control references. A pair-causal attention mechanism structures the motion-wrench dependencies, while a long fixed-length wrench memory retains past interaction information. The predicted wrench chunk acts as a force reference for a 20-Hz outer-loop admittance controller within a slow-fast control system that maintains force feedback and smooth motion between model queries. CW-WAM improves contact prediction and increases the insertion success rate from 25% to 70% for square pegs with 1-mm clearance per side and from 40% to 95% for power adapters, compared with WAM without wrench input. It also improves lifting-height accuracy across different loads. Our framework with an admittance controller reduces force-reference RMSE from 4.8 to 2.7 N for peg insertion and from 2.0 to 1.3 N for wiping, respectively, with smaller force fluctuations during successful execution. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: CW-WAM是联合预测视频、运动与接触力旋量(wrench)的世界动作模型，预测的wrench chunk作为导纳控制器的力参考，实现慢-快力位混合控制。
AI.motivation: 视觉观测无法显式提供接触与载荷信息，而力敏感操作(如精密插装)本质上依赖接触力反馈；需要让世界动作模型同时建模运动与接触力，以生成可执行的力参考。
AI.method: 统一的交互模块将motion与contact wrench同时作为建模目标，输出时间对齐的motion-wrench chunk作为控制参考；采用pair-causal attention刻画运动-力旋量依赖，并用长定长wrench memory保留历史交互信息；预测的wrench作为20Hz外环导纳控制器的力参考，构成慢-快控制架构，在模型查询之间维持力反馈与平滑运动。
AI.result: 相比无wrench输入的WAM，方形销(单边1mm间隙)插入成功率25%→70%，电源适配器40%→95%；不同负载下提升抬升高度精度；力参考RMSE钉插入4.8N→2.7N、擦拭2.0N→1.3N，且成功执行时力波动更小。
AI.conclusion: 将接触力旋量显式纳入世界动作模型并与导纳控制耦合，可显著提升接触丰富操作的精度与鲁棒性，为力感知的世界模型控制提供了有效范式。

title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
comment: 35 pages (15 main + 20 supplementary), 13 figures, 26 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.

AI.tldr: ALPS：仅用静态图像与文本预训练 ViT-B/16 视觉状态编码器，联合语言对齐、像素重建与空间对应目标，再经跨视角自蒸馏精化，使单一 patch token 表示同时支持状态预测、指令理解与像素可视化。
AI.motivation: 世界模型需要视觉表征同时承载物理状态信息、原生语言对齐与像素重建能力，但现有编码器通常只覆盖其中一到两项，导致预测、指令与可视化需拼接多个表征。
AI.method: 在图片+文本上从零预训练 ViT-B/16，采用语言对齐、重建、空间对应三类目标，并用跨视角自蒸馏精化；下游冻结编码器配原生文本塔接入 LIBERO 策略与世界模型规划器。
AI.result: 十五个公开编码器统一评测中，ViT-B 规模下 LIBERO 状态探针误差最低（追平 3.5 倍大的 V-JEPA 2-L），同时保持良好语言对齐与像素重建；冻结 token 在 LIBERO 平均成功率 85.5%，在 PushT/Wall/Granular 规划任务上持平或超越领先编码器，未来 token 可直接解码成像素。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉预训练确立为理解、预测与动作共享的基础表征，单编码器即可服务世界模型的感知、控制与可视化。

title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
summary: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysiCalWorld，用视频自监督方式从测试场景中的探索交互片段提取紧凑"物理描述符 token"，作为 in-context 提示校准动作条件世界模型的实例级动力学，无需微调或解析物理建模。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型仅依赖当前帧或短历史窗口，难以推断质量分布、关节阻尼、表面摩擦等决定转移动力学的物理属性；未做物理校准的模型在分布外新场景中会向经验先验回归，导致严重漂移。
AI.method: 编码式地：将测试场景内一段主动探索交互 clip 编码为紧凑 physics descriptor token，注入动作条件世界模型作为上下文，使后续 rollout 预测锚定于该场景真实物理行为。整个流程端到端训练，仅用潜空间预测损失监督，无需物理参数标签；推理时描述符只需提取一次，可在多次 rollout 中复用，计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种物理变化的四个环境中评测，rollout 预测精度与视觉规划成功率均显著提升；学到的描述符形成物理结构化的潜空间，并能泛化到训练时未见过的物理参数范围之外。
AI.conclusion: 物理属性可通过少量交互上下文被隐式校准，无需显式物理建模或微调即可缓解世界模型在新场景中的漂移，且上下文式校准具有良好的潜空间结构与分布外泛化能力。

title: VoxProg: 3D Spatial Reasoning through Voxel Programming
summary: Language models' abilities to interpret tasks and generate programs offer a promising basis for 3D spatial reasoning. Yet following spatial instructions in 3D scenes requires programs to construct geometric references that language leaves implicit. In this work, we introduce VoxProg, which formulates 3D object placement through voxel programming: a language model translates task interpretations into executable programs over local voxel views of scene surfaces. Because these views index surface geometry on regular grids with explicit coordinates and neighborhood relations, an evidence program can isolate task-relevant regions and boundaries directly from scene meshes, and a downstream pose program can measure the resulting geometry to compute a target $SE(3)$ pose. Visual and numerical feedback from execution lets the model inspect intermediate selections and candidate placements to iteratively revise its code. To evaluate open-ended placement across functional use, geometric fit, and contextual arrangements, we introduce the 71-task VoxProg-Bench benchmark along with an evaluation suite pairing perceptual Intent Alignment and 3D Physical Validity. Across VoxProg-Bench and external benchmarks, VoxProg consistently outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines.

AI.tldr: VoxProg将3D物体摆放任务形式化为"体素编程"：语言模型把任务意图翻译为在场景表面局部体素视图上可执行的程序，用证据程序从网格中定位相关区域与边界，再用位姿程序测量几何并计算目标SE(3)位姿，借助执行反馈迭代改码；同时提出71任务VoxProg-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 在3D场景中执行空间指令，需要程序构造语言所隐含的几何参照；纯语言模型难以显式表达坐标、边界与邻接关系等几何约束，关系式/关键点式方法缺乏可执行的几何度量手段。
AI.method: 提出体素编程范式：以规则网格上的局部体素视图（显式坐标与邻域关系）作为程序操作对象；分两阶段程序——证据程序从场景网格中筛选任务相关区域与边界，位姿程序对选中几何进行测量并求解目标SE(3)位姿；执行返回的视觉与数值反馈用于检查中间选择与候选位姿并迭代修改代码。构建71任务VoxProg-Bench及配套评测套件（Intent Alignment感知指标 + 3D Physical Validity）。
AI.result: 在VoxProg-Bench及外部基准上，VoxProg一致优于基于关系、基于关键点与基于网格的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以体素为中间表征的"代码生成+执行反馈迭代"可有效弥合语言隐含几何与可执行几何度量之间的鸿沟，为3D空间推理与开放式物体摆放提供可解释、可迭代的方案；主要局限在于对体素化分辨率与程序正确性的依赖，且实验限于离线场景摆放而非真实机器人执行。

title: Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
summary: Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出CADRE：开源的可变时空压缩率因果扩散表示自编码器族，用于系统研究视频世界模型"该在哪里压缩、压缩多少"，并给出四条经验结论。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型在视频自编码器潜空间内生成，压缩率决定单帧成本与动作响应延迟；但现有世界模型多直接复用离线文生视频自编码器，既不为交互式智能体的等待时间而设计，也因缺少训练数据与代码而无法在其它压缩率下重训。故需系统回答"世界模型应如何、在何处、压缩多少"。
AI.method: 构建CADRE——一族在多个时空压缩率上排布的因果扩散表示自编码器，各成员仅在冻结特征的微小瓶颈上不同，并共享经自蒸馏得到的单步/少步扩散解码器；在操作与导航两类域、共四个环境中，用每个自编码器训练同一个世界模型，做延迟—质量权衡与压缩维度的对照分析。
AI.result: CADRE在大体上占据延迟—质量前沿，在移动相机场景尤为明显。四条发现：强压缩下扩散解码器比感知回归解码器更锐利；机器人操作任务中，时序压缩放进自编码器比放进世界模型更有效；操作与导航需要相反压缩策略——相机静止时时序压缩代价小，相机移动时空间压缩代价小；相机静止时，更粗的空间token对运动的损害远大于对图像质量的损害。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的压缩设计应与任务、相机运动模态耦合而非沿用离线视频生成器默认配置；作者开源代码、模型与在线演示，为交互式世界模型的表示设计提供可复用的基线族与经验准则。

title: Agentic World Action Models
summary: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

AI.tldr: AW-0 将代码、未来视频与机器人动作作为三条耦合生成流，统一于混合 Transformer 架构；代码专家生成参数化技能程序，视频与动作专家输出未来视觉状态与底层控制，实现"规划—预测—执行"闭环及可复用技能库。
AI.motivation: 现有 world action model 具备视觉预知与未来预测能力，但缺乏显式的组合式技能复用机制；agentic robotics 将代码规划与可复用技能结合，却缺少物理动力学层面的预测接地。作者希望融合二者，让代码既承担世界模型内的多步预测与控制结构化，又充当可供智能体执行的可复用程序。
AI.method: 提出 AW-0 统一混合 Transformer（mixture-of-transformers）框架，联合建模 code、future video、robot action 三条生成流，分别由 code expert、video expert、action expert 负责。代码具备双重角色：结构化世界模型内的多步预测与控制，以及以可复用程序表示技能。另设计自动化数据策管流水线，为机器人与人类视频轨迹标注对齐程序，并将重复出现的例行流程归并为可复用技能库。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 及物理双臂操作任务上，相较 VLA 与 WAM 基线任务成功率提升，并在语言跟随、语义推理与鲁棒性方面取得增益。
AI.conclusion: Agentic code 可作为连接规划、预测与执行的枢纽，使 WAM 同时具备物理预测接地与组合式技能复用能力；统一生成建模代码/视频/动作是一条可行且有前景的路线。
